entries.zh: 伐越兀及烏古、六奚、比沙諸部，克之。
entries.en: He marched against Yuewu and the Wugu, Liuxi, and Bisha tribes, among others, and brought them to heel.
entries.literal: He attacked the Yuewu, Wugu, Liuxi, Bisha, and other tribes, and conquered them.

entries.zh: 國人號阿主沙裏。
entries.en: His countrymen gave him the name Azhu Shar.
entries.literal: The people of the state called him Azhu Shar.

entries.zh: 唐天復元年，歲辛酉，痕德可汗立，以太祖為本部夷離，專征討，連破室韋、于厥及奚帥轄剌哥，俘獲甚眾。
entries.en: In the first year of the Tang Tianfu era (901), the xinyou year, Hende Khan came to power and made Taizu yilijin of his own branch, entrusting him with military command. Taizu in succession broke the Shiwei and Yujue and the Xi leader Xialage, taking vast numbers captive.
entries.literal: In the first year of the Tang Tianfu reign, the year xinyou, Hende Khan was enthroned and appointed Taizu yilijin of the native tribe, put in charge of campaigns; he repeatedly defeated the Shiwei, Yujue, and the Xi chieftain Xialage, capturing many prisoners.

entries.zh: 冬十月，授大迭烈府夷離。
entries.en: That winter, in the tenth month, he was given the post of yilijin of the Great Diela Prefecture.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, he was appointed yilijin of the Great Diela Prefecture.

entries.zh: 明年春，伐女直，下之，獲其戶三百。
entries.en: The next spring he campaigned against the Jurchen, brought them down, and took three hundred households.
entries.literal: The following spring, he attacked the Jurchen, subjugated them, and captured three hundred households.

entries.zh: 九月，復攻下河東懷遠等軍。
entries.en: In the ninth month he renewed the assault on Hedong and took the Huaiyuan garrison and others.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, he again attacked and captured the Huaiyuan Army and other Hedong garrisons.

entries.zh: 冬十月，引軍略至薊北，俘獲以還。
entries.en: That winter, in the tenth month, he pushed his forces in a foray to the north of Ji and returned laden with prisoners and plunder.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, he led his army in a raid as far as north of Ji and returned with captives and booty.

entries.zh: 先是德祖俘奚七千戶，徙饒樂之清河，至是創為奚迭剌部，分十三縣。
entries.en: Earlier Dezu had taken seven thousand Xi households and resettled them at Qinghe in Raole; now they were organized into the Xi Diela branch, divided into thirteen counties.
entries.literal: Previously Dezu had captured seven thousand Xi households and moved them to Qinghe in Raole; at this time they were established as the Xi Diela branch and divided into thirteen districts.

entries.zh: 遂拜太祖于越、總知軍國事。
entries.en: Taizu was thereupon made yue, with full authority over army and state.
entries.literal: Taizu was then appointed yue and given overall charge of military and state affairs.

entries.zh: 明年二月，復擊劉仁恭。
entries.en: The next year, in the second month, they struck Liu Rengong once more.
entries.literal: The following year, in the second month, they again attacked Liu Rengong.

entries.zh: 還，襲山北奚，破之。
entries.en: On the homeward march they fell upon the mountain-north Xi and broke them.
entries.literal: On the return, they raided the Xi north of the mountains and defeated them.

entries.zh: 汴州朱全忠遣人浮海奉書幣、衣帶、珍玩來聘。
entries.en: Zhu Quanzhong of Bianzhou dispatched envoys by sea with letters, tribute gifts, robes, sashes, and curiosities to propose alliance.
entries.literal: Zhu Quanzhong of Bianzhou sent men by sea bearing letters, gifts, robes and belts, and precious objects to offer friendship.

entries.zh: 十一月，遣偏師討奚、諸部及東北女直之未附者，悉破降之。
entries.en: In the eleventh month he sent a subsidiary army against the Xi and allied tribes, and against Jurchen in the northeast still outside his sway; all were crushed and brought to surrender.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, he sent a detached force to campaign against the Xi and various tribes, and the unsubmitted Jurchen of the northeast; all were defeated and made to submit.

entries.zh: 十二月，痕德可汗殂，群臣奉遺命請立太祖。
entries.en: In the twelfth month Hende Khan died. The ministers, following his dying wish, pressed Taizu to take the throne.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, Hende Khan died; the ministers, obeying his final command, asked that Taizu be enthroned.

entries.zh: 曷魯等勸進。
entries.en: Helu and others pressed him to ascend.
entries.literal: Helu and others urged him to accept.

entries.zh: 太祖三讓，從之。
entries.en: Taizu refused thrice before yielding to them.
entries.literal: Taizu declined three times, then acquiesced.

entries.zh: 元年春正月庚寅，命有司設壇于如迂王集會堝，<三>燔柴告天，即皇帝位。
entries.en: In his first year, on the gengyin day of the first spring month, he had officials erect an altar at the Ru'erwang Assembly Mound, <3> offered burnt sacrifices to Heaven, and ascended the throne.
entries.literal: In the first year, on gengyin day in the first month of spring, he ordered officials to set up an altar at the Ru'erwang Assembly Mound; <3> he burned sacrificial wood to announce Heaven and took the imperial throne.

entries.zh: 尊母蕭氏為皇太后，立皇后蕭氏。
entries.en: He raised his mother of the Xiao clan to Empress Dowager and crowned an Empress Xiao.
entries.literal: He honored his mother, née Xiao, as Empress Dowager and installed Empress Xiao.

entries.zh: 北宰相蕭轄剌、南宰相耶律歐裏思率群臣上尊號曰天皇帝，後曰地皇后。
entries.en: Northern Chancellor Xiao Xialage and Southern Chancellor Yelü Oulisi, at the head of the court, presented the elevated titles Heavenly Emperor for him and Earth Empress for her.
entries.literal: The Northern Chancellor Xiao Xialage and the Southern Chancellor Yelü Oulisi led the ministers in offering the honorific titles Heavenly Emperor and Earth Empress.

entries.zh: 庚子，詔皇族承遙輦氏九帳為第十帳。
entries.en: On gengzi day he decreed that the royal house should take its place as a tenth tent, succeeding the nine tents of the Yaolian line.
entries.literal: On gengzi day, an edict proclaimed that the imperial clan would succeed the nine tents of the Yaolian clan as the tenth tent.

entries.zh: 明年七月，復討黑車子室韋。
entries.en: The next year, in the seventh month, he returned to punish the Black-Cart Shiwei.
entries.literal: The following year, in the seventh month, he again campaigned against the Black-Cart Shiwei.

entries.zh: 唐河東節度使李克用遣通事康令德乞盟。
entries.en: Li Keyong, Tang's Hedong governor, sent his interpreter Kang Lingde to sue for an alliance.
entries.literal: Li Keyong, Military Governor of Hedong under the Tang, sent the interpreter Kang Lingde to request an alliance.

entries.zh: 冬十月，太祖以騎兵七萬會克用於雲州，宴酣，克用借兵以報劉仁恭木瓜澗之役，太祖許之。
entries.en: That winter, in the tenth month, Taizu brought seventy thousand horsemen to meet Keyong at Yunzhou. Over wine Keyong asked for troops to settle the score with Liu Rengong at Mugua Ravine, and Taizu consented.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Taizu with seventy thousand cavalry met Keyong at Yunzhou; when the banquet was well underway, Keyong asked to borrow troops to avenge his defeat by Liu Rengong at Mugua Ravine, and Taizu agreed.

entries.zh: 易袍馬，約為兄弟。
entries.en: They exchanged cloaks and mounts and swore themselves brothers.
entries.literal: They exchanged robes and horses and pledged brotherhood.

entries.zh: 及進兵擊仁恭，撥數州，盡徙其民以歸。
entries.en: Marching on Rengong, they overran several prefectures and carried off the entire populace.
entries.literal: When they advanced to attack Rengong, they seized several prefectures and moved all the people away with them.

entries.zh: 八月壬辰，上次恩德山。
entries.en: On renchen day in the eighth month he encamped on Mount Ende.
entries.literal: On renchen day in the eighth month, the Emperor halted at Mount Ende.

entries.zh: 皇子李胡生。
entries.en: The prince Li Hu was born.
entries.literal: The Prince Li Hu was born.

entries.zh: 三月癸丑，次蘆水，弟迭剌哥圖為奚王，與安端擁千餘騎而至，紿稱入覲。
entries.en: On guichou day in the third month he halted at Lushui. His younger brother Diela plotted to become King of Xi and, together with Anduan at the head of more than a thousand horsemen, arrived, falsely claiming they had come to attend court.
entries.literal: On guichou day in the third month, halting at Lushui, his younger brother Diela plotted to become King of Xi and arrived with Anduan leading more than a thousand horsemen, falsely claiming they had come to pay court.

entries.zh: 上怒曰：「爾曹始謀逆亂，朕特恕之，使改過自新，尚爾反覆，將不利於朕！」
entries.en: The Emperor said in anger, "You first plotted rebellion; I specially forgave you and let you reform, yet you are still so fickle—this can only mean harm to me!"
entries.literal: The Emperor said in anger: "You at first plotted rebellion; I especially pardoned you and let you reform yourselves, yet you are still so changeable—this will be harmful to me!"

entries.zh: 遂拘之。
entries.en: He thereupon had them seized.
entries.literal: Thereupon he detained them.

entries.zh: 以所部分隸諸軍。
entries.en: Their followers were distributed among the various armies.
entries.literal: Their detachments were assigned to the various armies.

entries.zh: 而剌葛引其眾至乙室堇澱，具天子旗鼓，將自立，皇太后陰遣人諭令避去。
entries.en: Meanwhile Cige led his forces to Yishijin Marsh, arrayed the imperial drums and banners, and was about to set himself up as ruler; the Empress Dowager secretly sent word telling him to withdraw.
entries.literal: Meanwhile Cige led his host to Yishijin Marsh, equipped with the imperial drums and banners, intending to declare himself ruler; the Empress Dowager secretly sent someone to instruct him to withdraw.

entries.zh: 會弭姑乃、懷裏陽言車駕且至，其眾驚潰，掠居民北走，上以兵追之。
entries.en: Just then Migunai and Huailiyang spread word that the imperial carriage was nearing; Cige's men broke in panic, looted the local people, and fled north, and the Emperor gave chase with troops.
entries.literal: At that time Migunai and Huailiyang said the imperial carriage was about to arrive; his host panicked and scattered, plundered the inhabitants, and fled north; the Emperor pursued with troops.

entries.zh: 剌葛遣其党寅底石引兵徑趨行宮，焚其輜重、廬帳，縱兵大殺。
entries.en: Cige sent his follower Yindishi to march straight on the traveling palace, burn the baggage train and tents, and unleash his troops in a great slaughter.
entries.literal: Cige sent his partisan Yindishi to lead troops straight to the traveling palace, burn the baggage train and tents, and let the soldiers slaughter widely.

entries.zh: 皇后急遣蜀古魯救之，<六>僅得天子旗鼓而已。
entries.en: The Empress urgently dispatched Shugulu to the rescue; <6> they recovered nothing but the imperial drums and banners.
entries.literal: The Empress urgently sent Shugulu to rescue them; <6> they recovered only the imperial drums and banners.

entries.zh: 其党神速姑復劫西樓，焚明王樓。
entries.en: His follower Shensugun raided Xilou again and burned Mingwang Tower.
entries.literal: His partisan Shensugun again raided Xilou and burned Mingwang Tower.

entries.zh: 上至土河，秣馬休兵，若不為意。
entries.en: When the Emperor reached the Tuh River, he let the horses graze and rested the army as though none of this troubled him.
entries.literal: The Emperor reached the Tuh River, fed the horses and rested the troops, as if unconcerned.

entries.zh: 諸將請急追之，上曰：「俟其遠遁，人各懷土。
entries.en: The generals urged an immediate pursuit, but the Emperor said, "Wait until they have fled far off; then each man will yearn for home.
entries.literal: The generals asked to pursue them urgently; the Emperor said: "Wait until they have fled far—each man will long for home.

entries.zh: 懷土既切，其心必離，我軍乘之，破之必矣！」
entries.en: Once homesickness bites deep, their hearts will surely break apart; if our army strikes then, we are certain to crush them!"
entries.literal: Once longing for home is keen, their hearts will surely split apart; our army will strike them and defeat them for certain!"

entries.zh: 盡以先所獲資畜分賜將士，留夷離畢直裏姑總政務。
entries.en: He distributed all the livestock and goods taken earlier among the officers and soldiers, and left the yilijin Zhiligu to oversee affairs of state.
entries.literal: He distributed all the livestock and goods seized earlier among the officers and soldiers, and left the yilijin Zhiligu in charge of government affairs.

entries.zh: 明年歲甲子，三月，廣龍化州之東城。
entries.en: The next year, a jiazi year, in the third month the eastern quarter of Longhua Prefecture was enlarged.
entries.literal: The following year, the jiazi year, in the third month, the eastern wall of Longhua Prefecture was expanded.

entries.zh: 九月，討黑車子室韋，唐盧龍軍節度使劉仁恭發兵數萬，遣養子趙霸來拒。
entries.en: In the ninth month he marched against the Black-Cart Shiwei. Liu Rengong, Tang governor of the Lulong Army, raised tens of thousands of men and sent his adopted son Zhao Ba to meet him.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, he campaigned against the Black-Cart Shiwei; Liu Rengong, Military Governor of the Tang Lulong Army, sent tens of thousands of troops and dispatched his adopted son Zhao Ba to resist.

entries.zh: 霸至武州，太祖諜知之，伏勁兵桃山下。
entries.en: Ba reached Wuzhou; Taizu, warned by his scouts, lay in wait with elite troops beneath Peach Mountain.
entries.literal: When Ba reached Wuzhou, Taizu learned of it through spies and hid crack troops below Peach Mountain.

entries.zh: 遣室韋人牟裏詐稱其酋長所遣，約霸兵會平原。
entries.en: He sent a Shiwei named Moli to pose as an envoy from the chieftain and invite Ba's army to a rendezvous on the open plain.
entries.literal: He sent a Shiwei man named Moli, who falsely claimed to have been sent by his chieftain, to arrange a meeting with Ba's forces on the plain.

entries.zh: 既至，四面伏發，擒霸，殲其眾，乘勝大破室韋。
entries.en: When Ba came, ambushers rose on every side. They took Ba prisoner, wiped out his army, and drove on to shatter the Shiwei.
entries.literal: When they arrived, the hidden troops sprang up on all sides; they captured Ba, annihilated his force, and pressing the victory routed the Shiwei.

entries.zh: 明年秋七月，以兵四十萬伐河東代北，<二>攻下九郡，獲生口九萬五千，駝、馬、牛、羊不可勝紀。
entries.en: The next autumn, in the seventh month, he led four hundred thousand men against Hedong and northern Dai, <2> seized nine commanderies, took ninety-five thousand captives, and won camels, horses, cattle, and sheep past all count.
entries.literal: The following year, in the seventh month of autumn, with four hundred thousand troops he attacked Hedong and the north of Dai; <2> he captured nine commanderies, taking ninety-five thousand captives, and camels, horses, cattle, and sheep beyond numbering.

entries.zh: 九月，城龍化州於潢河之南，始建開教寺。
entries.en: In the ninth month he fortified Longhua Prefecture on the south bank of the Huang River and founded Kaijiao Temple.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, he walled Longhua Prefecture south of the Huang River and for the first time built Kaijiao Temple.

entries.zh: 二年春正月癸酉朔，禦正殿受百官及諸國使朝。
entries.en: On the guiyou new moon of the second year's first spring month, he held court in the main hall to receive the obeisance of officials and foreign envoys.
entries.literal: On guiyou, the first day of the first month of spring in the second year, he received homage in the main hall from officials and envoys of various states.

entries.zh: 辛巳，始置惕隱，典族屬，以皇弟撒剌為之。
entries.en: On xinsi day he created the office of tiyin to govern the clans and appointed his brother Salaci to the post.
entries.literal: On xinsi day, the office of tiyin was first established to oversee clan affairs, and his imperial brother Salaci was appointed to it.

entries.zh: 河東李克用卒，子存勗襲，遣使吊慰。
entries.en: Li Keyong of Hedong died; his son Li Cunxu took his place, and Taizu sent envoys with condolences.
entries.literal: Li Keyong of Hedong died; his son Li Cunxu succeeded him, and envoys were sent to offer condolences.

entries.zh: 五年春正月丙戌朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the bingxu new moon of the fifth year's first spring month the sun was eclipsed.
entries.literal: On bingxu, the first day of the first month of spring in the fifth year, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 丙申，上親征西部奚。
entries.en: On bingshen day the Emperor took the field in person against the western Xi.
entries.literal: On bingshen day, the Emperor personally campaigned against the western Xi.

entries.zh: 奚阻險，叛服不常，數招諭弗聽。
entries.en: The Xi barricaded themselves in rugged country, wavering between rebellion and submission; repeated appeals brought no answer.
entries.literal: The Xi held difficult terrain; their submission and rebellion were inconstant, and repeated summons and persuasion went unheeded.

entries.zh: 是役所向輒下，遂分兵討東部奚，亦平之。
entries.en: In that campaign he took every stronghold he met; he then split his army to subdue the eastern Xi and pacified them too.
entries.literal: In this campaign wherever he went he prevailed; he then divided his forces to campaign against the eastern Xi and pacified them as well.

entries.zh: 於是盡有奚、霫之地。
entries.en: He now held the full territory of the Xi and Mohe.
entries.literal: Thus he came to possess all the lands of the Xi and Mohe.

entries.zh: 東際海，南暨白檀，西松漠，北抵潢水，凡五部，咸入版籍。
entries.en: Eastward it ran to the sea, south to Baitan, west to Songmo, north to the Huang River — five divisions in all, every one entered on the tax rolls.
entries.literal: It reached the sea on the east, touched Baitan on the south, Songmo on the west, and the Huang River on the north; all five divisions were entered on the registers.

entries.zh: 五月，皇弟剌葛、迭剌、寅底石、安端謀反。
entries.en: In the fifth month his brothers Cige, Diela, Yindishi, and Anduan conspired to rebel.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, his imperial brothers Cige, Diela, Yindishi, and Anduan plotted rebellion.

entries.zh: 安端妻粘睦姑知之，以告，得實。
entries.en: Anduan's wife Nianmugu discovered the plot, informed the court, and the charge was proved true.
entries.literal: Anduan's wife Nianmugu learned of it, reported it, and the plot was verified.

entries.zh: 上不忍加誅，乃與諸弟登山刑牲，告天地為誓而赦其罪。
entries.en: Unable to bring himself to punish them, he climbed a mountain with his brothers, offered sacrifice, swore before Heaven and Earth, and granted them pardon.
entries.literal: The Emperor could not bear to execute them; he therefore climbed a mountain with his brothers, sacrificed animals, announced Heaven and Earth as witnesses to an oath, and pardoned their crime.

entries.zh: 出剌葛為迭剌部夷離，封粘睦姑為晉國夫人。
entries.en: He posted Cige as yilijin of the Diela branch and ennobled Nianmugu as Lady of Jin.
entries.literal: Cige was sent out as yilijin of the Diela branch, and Nianmugu was enfeoffed as Lady of Jin.

entries.zh: 冬十月戊寅，剌葛破平州，還，復與迭剌、寅底石、安端等反。
entries.en: In the tenth winter month, on wuyin day, Cige captured Pingzhou and returned, then rebelled again with Diela, Yindishi, Anduan, and others.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin day, Cige captured Pingzhou and returned, then rebelled again with Diela, Yindishi, Anduan, and others.

entries.zh: 甲申，遣人使梁致祭。
entries.en: On jiashen day he dispatched envoys to the Liang court to offer sacrifice.
entries.literal: On jiashen day, he sent envoys to Liang to perform sacrifice.

entries.zh: 壬辰，還次北阿魯山，聞諸弟以兵阻道，引軍南趨十七濼。
entries.en: On renchen day, as he withdrew and encamped at North Alu Mountain, he learned that his younger brothers had barred the route with troops, and he turned the army south toward the Seventeen Marshes.
entries.literal: On renchen day, returning he halted at North Alu Mountain; hearing his younger brothers had blocked the road with troops, he led the army south toward the Seventeen Marshes.

entries.zh: 是日燔柴。
entries.en: That day he performed the firewood-burning rite.
entries.literal: That day they burned firewood.

entries.zh: 翼日，次七渡河，諸弟各遣人謝罪。
entries.en: The following day he halted at Seven Crossings River, and each of his younger brothers sent a messenger to beg forgiveness.
entries.literal: The next day, halting at Seven Crossings River, each younger brother sent someone to apologize.

entries.zh: 上猶矜憐，許以自新。
entries.en: The Emperor still showed them mercy and granted them a chance to mend their ways.
entries.literal: The Emperor still showed pity and allowed them to reform themselves.

entries.zh: 七年春正月甲辰朔，以用兵免朝。
entries.en: In the first month of spring in the seventh year, on the jiachen new moon, the court audience was waived because of active campaigning.
entries.literal: In spring of the seventh year, on the jiachen new moon of the first month, court audience was exempted because of military operations.

entries.zh: 晉王李存勗拔幽州，擒劉守光。
entries.en: Li Cunxu, Prince of Jin, marched on Youzhou and took Liu Shouguang prisoner.
entries.literal: The Prince of Jin, Li Cunxu, attacked Youzhou and captured Liu Shouguang.

entries.zh: 甲寅，王師次赤水城，弟剌葛等乞降。
entries.en: On jiayin day the imperial forces encamped at Chishui Fort, and his younger brothers Cige and the others pleaded to submit.
entries.literal: On jiayin day, the imperial army halted at Chishui Fort; the younger brothers Cige and others begged to surrender.

entries.zh: 上素服，乘赭白馬，以將軍耶律樂姑、轄剌僅阿缽為禦，解兵器、肅侍衛以受之，因加慰諭。
entries.en: The Emperor dressed in plain white and rode a reddish-white horse, with Generals Yelü Legu and Xiachi Jin'abo as his escort; he set aside his weapons, had his attendants stand in strict order to receive them, and then spoke words of reassurance.
entries.literal: The Emperor wore plain white garments, rode a reddish-white horse, with Generals Yelü Legu and Xiachi Jin'abo as escort; he laid aside weapons and ordered the guards to stand in order to receive them, and thereupon added words of consolation.

entries.zh: 剌葛等引退，上復數遣使撫慰。
entries.en: Cige and the others withdrew, and the Emperor again sent envoys repeatedly to comfort them.
entries.literal: Cige and the others withdrew; the Emperor again sent envoys several times to console them.

entries.zh: 夏四月丁未朔，唐梁王朱全忠廢其主，尋弑之，<四>自立為帝，國號梁，遣使來告。
entries.en: On the dingwei new moon of the fourth summer month, Zhu Quanzhong, Tang's Prince of Liang, deposed his lord and shortly afterward murdered him; <4> he proclaimed himself emperor under the name Liang and sent envoys with the news.
entries.literal: On dingwei, the first day of the fourth month of summer, Zhu Quanzhong, Prince of Liang under the Tang, deposed his sovereign and soon killed him; <4> he declared himself emperor, taking the dynastic name Liang, and sent envoys to announce it.

entries.zh: 劉仁恭子守光囚其父，自稱幽州盧龍軍節度使。
entries.en: Liu Shouguang, son of Liu Rengong, locked up his father and declared himself governor of Youzhou and the Lulong Army.
entries.literal: Liu Rengong's son Shouguang imprisoned his father and styled himself Military Governor of Youzhou and the Lulong Army.

entries.zh: 夏四月，梁郢王友弑父自立。
entries.en: In the fourth summer month Zhu Yougui, Liang's Prince of Ying, murdered his father and seized the throne.
entries.literal: In the fourth month of summer, You, Prince of Ying of Liang, killed his father and declared himself ruler.

entries.zh: 贊曰：遼之先，出自炎帝，世為審吉國，其可知者蓋自奇首雲。
entries.en: Thus the historian praises them: Liao's ancestors sprang from the Flame Emperor; for ages they were the Shenji people; the record becomes clear, it seems, with Qishou.
entries.literal: The encomium states: The forebears of Liao arose from the Flame Emperor; for generations they were the Shenji state; what can be known begins, perhaps, with Qishou.

entries.zh: 奇首生都山，徙潢河之濱。
entries.en: Qishou was born on Mount Du and later settled on the Huang River.
entries.literal: Qishou was born at Mount Du and moved to the banks of the Huang River.

entries.zh: 傳至雅裏，始立制度，置官屬，刻木為契，穴地為牢。
entries.en: By Yali's time the tribe first fixed laws, set officers in place, carved wooden tallies, and dug earthen cells for prisoners.
entries.literal: Passing down to Yali, he first established institutions, appointed officials, carved wood for tallies, and dug earth for prisons.

entries.zh: 讓阻午而不肯自立。
entries.en: He stood aside for Zuwu and refused to proclaim himself chief.
entries.literal: He yielded to Zuwu and would not set himself up as ruler.

entries.zh: 雅里生毗牒。
entries.en: Yali had a son Bidie.
entries.literal: Yali begot Bidie.

entries.zh: 毗牒生頦領。
entries.en: Bidie was the father of Feiling.
entries.literal: Bidie begot Feiling.

entries.zh: 領生耨里思，大度寡欲，令不嚴而人化，是為肅祖。
entries.en: Ling's son Noulisi was broad-minded and sparing in wants; though his rule was mild, the people were naturally swayed—this was Emperor Suzu.
entries.literal: Ling begot Noulisi, who was magnanimous and few in desires; his orders were not strict yet the people were transformed—he is known as Emperor Suzu.

entries.zh: 肅祖生薩剌德，嘗與黃室韋挑戰，矢貫數劄，是為懿祖。
entries.en: Suzu had Salade, who once duelled the Yellow Shiwei; arrows ran through stack upon stack of quivers—this was Emperor Yizu.
entries.literal: Suzu begot Salade, who once fought the Yellow Shiwei in battle; arrows pierced through several quivers—he is known as Emperor Yizu.

entries.zh: 懿祖生勻德實，始教民稼穡，善畜牧，國以殷富，是為玄祖。
entries.en: Yizu begot Jundeshi, who first taught grain-growing, kept fine herds, and made the country wealthy—this was Emperor Xuanzu.
entries.literal: Yizu begot Jundeshi, who first taught the people agriculture, excelled at animal husbandry, and the state grew rich—he is known as Emperor Xuanzu.

entries.zh: 玄祖生撒剌的，仁民愛物，始置鐵冶，教民鼓鑄，是為德祖，即太祖之父也。
entries.en: Xuanzu had Saladi, humane toward the people and tender toward things; he founded ironworks and taught folk to smelt and cast—this was Emperor Dezu, father of Taizu.
entries.literal: Xuanzu begot Saladi, who loved the people and cherished things, first established ironworks, and taught people smelting and casting—he is known as Emperor Dezu, Taizu's father.

entries.zh: 世為契丹遙輦氏之夷離，執其政柄。
entries.en: For generations they held the yilijinship of the Khitan Yaolian line and wielded the reins of power.
entries.literal: For generations they served as yilijin of the Khitan Yaolian clan, holding governmental power.

entries.zh: 德祖之弟述瀾，北征於厥、室韋，南略易、定、奚、，始興板築，置城邑，教民種桑麻，習織組，己有廣土眾民之志。
entries.en: Dezu's brother Shuluo marched north against the Jue and Shiwei and south against Yi, Ding, and Xi; he introduced rammed-earth building, founded towns, taught mulberry and hemp planting and weaving—the ambition for broad lands and a populous realm was already plain.
entries.literal: Dezu's younger brother Shuluo campaigned north against the Jue and Shiwei, raided south into Yi, Ding, and Xi; he first promoted rammed-earth construction, established towns, taught people to plant mulberry and hemp and practice weaving—already harboring ambitions for broad territory and a large population.

entries.zh: 而太祖受可汗之禪，遂建國。
entries.en: Then Taizu received the khan's surrender of the throne and founded the kingdom.
entries.literal: Then Taizu received the khan's abdication in his favor and thereupon founded the state.

entries.zh: 東征西討，如折枯拉朽。
entries.en: East and west his campaigns went, snapping dry wood and pulling rotten timber.
entries.literal: Campaigning east and west, like snapping withered stalks and pulling rotten wood.

entries.zh: 東自海，西至於流沙，北絕大漠，信威萬里，歷年二百，豈一日之故哉！
entries.en: From the eastern sea to the western wastes, from the northern desert to ten thousand li of sway—a realm two centuries in the making: was that the work of a single day?
entries.literal: East from the sea, west to the drifting sands, north cutting across the great desert—trust and majesty for ten thousand li, two hundred years in duration—could this be the work of a single day!

entries.zh: 周公誅管、蔡，人未有能非之者。
entries.en: When the Duke of Zhou put Guan and Cai to death, no one faulted him for it.
entries.literal: When the Duke of Zhou executed Guan and Cai, none could find fault with him.

entries.zh: 剌葛、安端之亂，太祖既貸其死而復用之，非人君之度乎？
entries.en: In the rebellions of Lage and Anduan, Taizu spared them and then put them back in office—was that truly the measure of a prince?
entries.literal: In the rebellion of Gege and Anduan, Taizu spared their lives and then employed them again—is this not beyond the measure of a ruler?

entries.zh: 舊史扶餘之變，亦異矣夫！
entries.en: How strange too is the old histories' tale of the Fuyu crisis!
entries.literal: The old histories' account of the Fuyu affair is also strange indeed!

entries.zh: 太祖下
entries.en: Taizu, Part Two
entries.literal: Taizu, Part Two

entries.zh: 世宗孝和莊憲皇帝，諱阮，小字兀欲。
entries.en: Emperor Shizong, posthumously Xiaohé Zhuangxian, bore the personal name Ruan and the childhood name Wuyu.
entries.literal: Emperor Shizong, posthumously Xiaohé Zhuangxian, personal name Ruan, childhood name Wuyu.

entries.zh: 讓國皇帝長子，母柔貞皇后蕭氏。
entries.en: He was the eldest son of the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and his mother was Empress Rouzhen of the Xiao clan.
entries.literal: He was the eldest son of the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm; his mother was Empress Rouzhen, née Xiao.

entries.zh: 帝儀觀豐偉，內寬外嚴，善騎射，樂施予，人望歸之。
entries.en: He was imposing in bearing, lenient at heart yet stern in demeanor, skilled at horsemanship and archery, generous by nature, and the people looked to him with hope.
entries.literal: The emperor was imposing in bearing, lenient within and stern without, skilled at horsemanship and archery, delighted in giving, and the people's hopes turned to him.

entries.zh: 太宗愛之如子。
entries.en: Emperor Taizong loved him as his own son.
entries.literal: Emperor Taizong loved him as a son.

entries.zh: 會同九年，從伐晉。
entries.en: In the ninth year of Huitong he took part in the campaign against Jin.
entries.literal: In the ninth year of Huitong he followed the campaign against Jin.

entries.zh: 大同元年春二月，封永康王。
entries.en: In the second month of spring in the first year of Datong he was enfeoffed as Prince Yongkang.
entries.literal: In the second month of spring in the first year of Datong he was enfeoffed as Prince Yongkang.

entries.zh: 夏四月丁丑，太宗崩於欒城。
entries.en: In the fourth month that summer, on dingchou day, Emperor Taizong died at Luancheng.
entries.literal: That summer, on dingchou day of the fourth month, Emperor Taizong died at Luancheng.

entries.zh: 戊寅，梓宮次鎮陽，即皇帝位於柩前。
entries.en: On wuyin day the imperial coffin paused at Zhenyang, and he took the throne before the bier.
entries.literal: On wuyin day the coffin halted at Zhenyang, and he took the throne before the bier.

entries.zh: 甲申，次定州，命天德、朔古、解裏等護梓宮先赴上京。
entries.en: On jiashen day he stopped at Ding Prefecture and ordered Tiande, Shuogu, Jieli, and others to escort the coffin on to the Supreme Capital first.
entries.literal: On jiashen day he halted at Ding Prefecture and ordered Tiande, Shuogu, Jieli, and others to escort the coffin ahead to the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 太后聞帝即位，遣太弟李胡率兵拒之。
entries.en: Learning that the Emperor had succeeded, the Empress Dowager sent Li Hu, the Imperial Younger Brother, with an army to oppose him.
entries.literal: When the Empress Dowager heard the Emperor had succeeded, she sent Li Hu, the Imperial Younger Brother, with troops to resist him.

entries.zh: 六月甲寅朔，次南京，五院夷離堇安端、詳穩劉哥遣人馳報，請為前鋒；
entries.en: On the jiayin new moon of the sixth month he reached the Southern Capital; Five Courts yilijin Anduan and xiangwen Liu Ge sent riders in haste to offer themselves as vanguard.
entries.literal: On the jiayin new moon of the sixth month he halted at the Southern Capital; Five Courts yilijin Anduan and xiangwen Liu Ge sent swift messengers asking to serve as vanguard.

entries.zh: 至泰德泉，遇李胡軍，戰敗之。
entries.en: At Taide Spring he met Li Hu's army and routed it.
entries.literal: Reaching Taide Spring, he met Li Hu's army and defeated it.

entries.zh: 上遣郎君勤德等詣兩軍諭解。
entries.en: The Emperor sent langjun Qinde and others to both camps to urge a settlement.
entries.literal: The Emperor sent langjun Qinde and others to both armies to counsel reconciliation.

entries.zh: 秋閏七月，次潢河，太后、李胡整兵拒於橫渡，相持數日。
entries.en: In the intercalary seventh autumn month he halted at the Huang River; the Empress Dowager and Li Hu arrayed troops to resist at Hengdu Ford, and the two sides faced off for several days.
entries.literal: In the intercalary month of autumn, the seventh month, he halted at the Huang River; the Empress Dowager and Li Hu arrayed troops to resist at Hengdu Ford, and they faced off for several days.

entries.zh: 用屋質之謀，各罷兵趨上京。
entries.en: Following Wuzhi's counsel, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: Following Wuzhi's plan, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 既而聞太后、李胡復有異謀，遷於祖州。
entries.en: Before long, hearing that the Empress Dowager and Li Hu were plotting again, he had them moved to Zu Prefecture.
entries.literal: Soon after, hearing the Empress Dowager and Li Hu were plotting again, he had them moved to Zu Prefecture.

entries.zh: 誅司徒劃設及楚補裏。
entries.en: He executed Minister over the Masses Huashe and Chubuli.
entries.literal: Minister over the Masses Huashe and Chubuli were put to death.

entries.zh: 八月壬午朔，尊母蕭氏為皇太后，以太后族剌只撒古魯為國舅帳，立詳穩以總焉。
entries.en: On the renwu new moon of the eighth month he honored his mother, Lady Xiao, as Empress Dowager, made the empress dowager's kinsman Laji Saguolu head of the imperial maternal-uncle account, and set a xiangwen over it.
entries.literal: On the renwu new moon of the eighth month he honored his mother Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager, made the empress dowager's clansman Laji Saguolu head of the imperial maternal-uncle account, and appointed a xiangwen to oversee it.

entries.zh: 以崇德宮戶分賜翼戴功臣，及北院大王窪、南院大王吼各五十，安摶、楚補各百。
entries.en: Households from the Palace of Honored Virtue were divided and bestowed on those who had raised him to the throne; Northern Chancellor Wa and Southern Chancellor Hou each received fifty, and Anpo and Chubu each a hundred.
entries.literal: Households from the Palace of Honored Virtue were divided and bestowed on meritorious supporters; Northern Chancellor Wa and Southern Chancellor Hou each received fifty; Anpo and Chubu each a hundred.

entries.zh: 的魯、鐵剌子孫先以非罪籍沒者歸之。
entries.en: Descendants of Dilu and Tiela, earlier registered and confiscated though guilty of no crime, were restored to them.
entries.literal: Descendants of Dilu and Tiela, earlier registered and confiscated without crime, were restored to them.

entries.zh: 癸未，始置北院樞密使，以安摶為之。
entries.en: On guiwei day the Northern Palace Commissioner was established for the first time, with Anpo appointed to the post.
entries.literal: On guiwei day the Northern Palace Commissioner was first established, with Anpo appointed to it.

entries.zh: 九月壬子朔，葬嗣聖皇帝於懷陵。
entries.en: On the renzi new moon of the ninth month the Succeeding Sage Emperor was interred at Huai Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On the renzi new moon of the ninth month the Succeeding Sage Emperor was buried at Huai Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 丁卯，行柴冊禮，群臣上尊號曰天授皇帝。
entries.en: On dingmao day the firewood-and-script rites were performed, and the assembled ministers offered the honorific title Emperor Who Received Heaven's Mandate.
entries.literal: On dingmao day the firewood-and-script rites were performed; the assembled ministers offered the honorific title Emperor Who Received Heaven's Mandate.

entries.zh: 大赦，改大同元年為天祿元年。
entries.en: He proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the first year of Datong to the first year of Tianlu.
entries.literal: A general amnesty was granted, and the first year of Datong was changed to the first year of Tianlu.

entries.zh: 追謚皇考曰讓國皇帝。
entries.en: He gave his late father the posthumous title Emperor Who Yielded the Realm.
entries.literal: His deceased father was posthumously titled Emperor Who Yielded the Realm.

entries.zh: 以安端主東丹國，封明王，察割為泰寧王，劉哥為惕隱，高勛為南院樞密使。
entries.en: Anduan was set to rule the Dongdan state and enfeoffed as Prince of Ming; Chage was made Prince of Taining; Liu Ge was made tiyin; and Gao Xun was made Southern Palace Commissioner.
entries.literal: Anduan was made to rule the Dongdan state and enfeoffed as Prince of Ming; Chage as Prince of Taining; Liu Ge as tiyin; Gao Xun as Southern Palace Commissioner.

entries.zh: 五年春正月癸亥朔，如百泉湖。
entries.en: On the guihai new moon of the first spring month of the fifth year he went to Baiquan Lake.
entries.literal: On the guihai new moon of the first spring month of the fifth year he went to Baiquan Lake.

entries.zh: 漢郭威弒其主自立，國號周，遣朱憲來告。
entries.en: Guo Wei of Han murdered his sovereign and declared himself emperor under the state name Zhou, then sent Zhu Xian to announce it.
entries.literal: Guo Wei of Han murdered his lord and declared himself emperor; his state name was Zhou, and he sent Zhu Xian to report it.

entries.zh: 即遣使致良馬。
entries.en: He at once sent envoys presenting fine horses.
entries.literal: At once envoys were dispatched presenting fine horses.

entries.zh: 漢劉崇自立於太原。
entries.en: Liu Chong of Han declared himself emperor at Taiyuan.
entries.literal: Liu Chong of Han declared himself emperor at Taiyuan.

entries.zh: 二月，周遣姚漢英、華昭胤來，以書辭抗禮，留漢英等。
entries.en: In the second month Zhou sent Yao Hanying and Hua Zhaoyin; because their letter used language asserting equal standing, Hanying and the others were detained.
entries.literal: In the second month Zhou sent Yao Hanying and Hua Zhaoyin; because their letter used language of equal standing, Hanying and the others were detained.

entries.zh: 夏五月壬戌朔，太子太傅趙瑩薨，輟朝一日，命歸葬於汴。
entries.en: On the renxu new moon of the fifth summer month Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhao Ying died; court was suspended for one day, and he was ordered interred at Bian.
entries.literal: On the renxu new moon of the fifth summer month Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhao Ying died; court was suspended for one day, and he was ordered buried at Bian.

entries.zh: 詔州縣錄事參軍、主簿委政事省銓註。
entries.en: An edict entrusted the appointment of prefectural and county recorders and registrars to the Directorate of Government Affairs.
entries.literal: An edict entrusted the appointment of prefectural and county recorders and registrars to the Directorate of Government Affairs.

entries.zh: 六月辛卯朔，劉崇為周所攻，遣使稱，乞援，且求封冊。
entries.en: On the xinmao new moon of the sixth month Liu Chong was attacked by Zhou; he sent envoys declaring submission, begging aid, and requesting formal investiture.
entries.literal: On the xinmao new moon of the sixth month Liu Chong was attacked by Zhou; he sent envoys declaring submission, begging aid, and also requesting investiture.

entries.zh: 即遣燕王牒哷、樞密使高勛冊為大漢神武皇帝。
entries.en: He at once sent Prince of Yan Dielie and Palace Secretariat Commissioner Gao Xun to invest him as Emperor Shenwu of Great Han.
entries.literal: At once Prince of Yan Dielie and Palace Secretariat Commissioner Gao Xun were dispatched to invest him as Emperor Shenwu of Great Han.

entries.zh: 南唐遣蔣洪來，乞舉兵應援。
entries.en: Southern Tang sent Jiang Hong, begging that troops be raised in support.
entries.literal: Southern Tang sent Jiang Hong, begging that troops be raised in support.

entries.zh: 是夏，清暑百泉嶺。
entries.en: That summer he escaped the heat at Baiquan Ridge.
entries.literal: That summer he escaped the heat at Baiquan Ridge.

entries.zh: 九月庚申朔，自將南伐。
entries.en: On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month he personally led a southern campaign.
entries.literal: On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month he personally led a southern campaign.

entries.zh: 壬戌，次歸化州祥古山。
entries.en: On renxu day he halted at Xianggu Mountain in Guihua Prefecture.
entries.literal: On renxu day he halted at Xianggu Mountain in Guihua Prefecture.

entries.zh: 癸亥，祭讓國皇帝於行宮。
entries.en: On guihai day he sacrificed to the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm at the traveling palace.
entries.literal: On guihai day he sacrificed to the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm at the traveling palace.

entries.zh: 群臣皆醉，察割反，帝遇弒，年三十四。
entries.en: All the ministers were drunk; Chage rebelled, and the emperor was assassinated at the age of thirty-four.
entries.literal: All the ministers were drunk; Chage rebelled, and the emperor was assassinated, aged thirty-four.

entries.zh: 應歷元年，葬於顯州西山，陵曰顯陵。
entries.en: In the first year of Yingli he was buried on the western hills of Xian Prefecture; the mausoleum was called Xian Mausoleum.
entries.literal: In the first year of Yingli he was buried on the western hills of Xian Prefecture; the mausoleum was called Xian Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 二年，謚孝和皇帝，廟號世宗。
entries.en: In the second year he was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaohé, with the temple name Shizong.
entries.literal: In the second year he was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaohé, with temple name Shizong.

entries.zh: 統和二十六年七月，加謚孝和莊憲皇帝。
entries.en: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe his posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Xiaohé Zhuangxian.
entries.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe his posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Xiaohé Zhuangxian.

entries.zh: 贊曰：世宗中才之主也，入繼大統，曾未三年，納唐丸書，即議南伐，即乏持重，宜乖周防，蓋有致禍之道矣。
entries.en: The eulogy says: Shizong was a ruler of middling talent. Having succeeded to the great mandate, within barely three years he accepted Tang's wax-sealed letter and at once debated a southern campaign — lacking steadiness and contrary to circumspection; he surely had within him the ways that bring ruin.
entries.literal: The eulogy says: Shizong was a ruler of middling talent. Having succeeded to the great mandate, within barely three years he accepted Tang's wax-sealed letter and at once debated a southern campaign — lacking steadiness, contrary to circumspection; he surely had the ways that bring ruin.

entries.zh: 然而孝友寬慈，亦有君人之度焉。
entries.en: Yet in filial piety, brotherly affection, lenience, and kindness he still showed a measure fit for a ruler.
entries.literal: Yet he was filial, friendly, lenient, and kind, and possessed something of a ruler's measure.

entries.zh: 未及師還，變起沈湎，豈不可哀也哉！
entries.en: Before the army could return, upheaval arose from deep drinking — how could it not be lamentable!
entries.literal: Before the army could return, upheaval arose from deep drinking — how could it not be lamentable!

entries.zh: 二年春正月，天德、蕭翰、劉哥、盆都等謀反。
entries.en: In the spring of the second year, first month, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liu Ge, Pendu, and others plotted rebellion.
entries.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liu Ge, Pendu, and others plotted rebellion.

entries.zh: 誅天德，杖蕭翰，遷劉哥於邊，罰盆都使轄戛斯國。
entries.en: Tiande was executed, Xiao Han was flogged, Liu Ge was transferred to the frontier, and Pendu was punished by being sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.
entries.literal: Tiande was executed, Xiao Han was beaten with the staff, Liu Ge was transferred to the frontier, and Pendu was punished by being sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.

entries.zh: 漢主劉知遠殂，子承祐立。
entries.en: Han ruler Liu Zhiyuan died, and his son Chengyou succeeded him.
entries.literal: Han ruler Liu Zhiyuan died, and his son Chengyou succeeded.

entries.zh: 夏四月庚辰朔，南唐遣李朗、王祚來慰且賀，兼奉蠟丸書，議攻漢。
entries.en: On the gengchen new moon of the fourth summer month Southern Tang sent Li Lang and Wang Zuo with condolences and congratulations, also presenting a wax-ball dispatch to discuss an attack on Han.
entries.literal: On the gengchen new moon of the fourth summer month Southern Tang sent Li Lang and Wang Zuo to offer condolences and congratulations, also presenting a wax-ball dispatch to discuss attacking Han.

entries.zh: 秋七月壬申，皇子賢生。
entries.en: In the seventh autumn month, on renshen day, Prince Xian was born.
entries.literal: On renshen day in the seventh autumn month Prince Xian was born.

entries.zh: 冬十月壬午，南京留守魏王趙延壽薨，以中臺省右相牒哷葛為南京留守，封燕王。
entries.en: On renwu day in the tenth winter month Zhao Yanshou, Prince Wei and regent of the Southern Capital, died; Dielige, right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, was made regent of the Southern Capital and enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.
entries.literal: On renwu day in the tenth winter month Zhao Yanshou, Prince Wei and regent of the Southern Capital, died; Central Secretariat Right Chancellor Dielige was made regent of the Southern Capital and enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.

entries.zh: 十一月，駐蹕彰武南。
entries.en: In the eleventh month he halted the imperial progress south of Zhangwu.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month he halted the imperial progress south of Zhangwu.

entries.zh: 三年春正月，蕭翰及公主阿不裏謀反，翰伏誅，阿不裏瘐死獄中。
entries.en: In the spring of the third year, first month, Xiao Han and Princess Abuli plotted rebellion; Han was executed, and Abuli wasted away and died in prison.
entries.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, Xiao Han and Princess Abuli plotted rebellion; Han was executed, and Abuli died of illness in prison.

entries.zh: 庚申，肆赦。
entries.en: On gengshen day he proclaimed a general amnesty.
entries.literal: On gengshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

entries.zh: 內外官各進一階。
entries.en: Every civil and military official was promoted one step in rank.
entries.literal: Civil and military officials alike were promoted one rank.

entries.zh: 夏六月戊寅，以敞史耶律胡離軫為北院大王。
entries.en: That summer, on wuyin day of the sixth month, Yelü Hulizhen, chamberlain of records, was made Northern Chancellor.
entries.literal: That summer, on wuyin day of the sixth month, Yelü Hulizhen, chamberlain of records, was made Northern Chancellor.

entries.zh: 己卯，惕隱頹昱封漆水郡王。
entries.en: On jimao day tiyin Tuibai was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.
entries.literal: On jimao day tiyin Tuibai was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui commandery.

entries.zh: 秋九月辛丑朔，召群臣議南伐。
entries.en: On the xinchou new moon of the ninth autumn month he summoned the ministers to deliberate on a southern campaign.
entries.literal: On the xinchou new moon of the ninth autumn month the ministers were summoned to discuss a southern campaign.

entries.zh: 冬十月，遣諸將率兵攻下貝州高老鎮，徇地鄴都、南宮、堂陽，殺深州刺史史萬山，俘獲甚眾。
entries.en: In the tenth month of winter he sent generals with troops to take Gaolao town in Bei Prefecture, raided through Yedu, Nangong, and Tangyang, killed Shen Prefecture prefect Shi Wanshan, and captured a great host.
entries.literal: In the tenth winter month generals were dispatched with troops to capture Gaolao town in Bei Prefecture, marched through Yedu, Nangong, and Tangyang, killed Shen Prefecture prefect Shi Wanshan, and took many captives.

entries.zh: 四年春二月辛未，泰寧王察割來朝，留侍。
entries.en: In the fourth year, spring, second month, on xinwei day Prince of Taining Chage came to court and was kept in attendance at court.
entries.literal: In the fourth year, spring, second month, on xinwei day Prince of Taining Chage came to court and was kept in attendance.

entries.zh: 是月，建政事省。
entries.en: That month he established the Directorate of Government Affairs.
entries.literal: That month the Directorate of Government Affairs was established.

entries.zh: 三月戊戌朔，南唐遣趙延嗣、張福等來賀南征捷。
entries.en: On the wuxu new moon of the third month Southern Tang sent Zhao Yansi, Zhang Fu, and others to congratulate him on the southern campaign's victory.
entries.literal: On the wuxu new moon of the third month Southern Tang sent Zhao Yansi, Zhang Fu, and others to congratulate him on the southern campaign's victory.

entries.zh: 秋九月乙丑朔，如山西。
entries.en: On the yichou new moon of the ninth autumn month he traveled to Shanxi.
entries.literal: On the yichou new moon of the ninth autumn month he went to Shanxi.

entries.zh: 冬十月，自將南伐，攻下安平、內丘、束鹿等城，大獲而還。
entries.en: In the tenth month of winter he personally led a southern campaign, took Anping, Neiqiu, Shulu, and other cities, and returned laden with booty.
entries.literal: In the tenth winter month he personally led a southern campaign, captured Anping, Neiqiu, Shulu, and other cities, and returned with great spoils.

entries.zh: 是歲，冊皇后蕭氏。
entries.en: That year he installed Lady Xiao as empress.
entries.literal: That year Lady Xiao was installed as empress.

entries.zh: 穆宗上
entries.en: Muzong, Part One
entries.literal: Muzong, Part One

entries.zh: 穆宗孝安敬正皇帝，諱璟，小字述律。
entries.en: Emperor Muzong, Filial, Peaceful, Reverent, and Upright, whose personal name was Jing and whose childhood name was Shulü.
entries.literal: Emperor Muzong, Filial, Peaceful, Reverent, and Upright — personal name Jing, childhood name Shulü.

entries.zh: 太宗皇帝長子，母曰靖安皇后蕭氏。
entries.en: Eldest son of Emperor Taizong, born to Empress Jing'an of the Xiao clan.
entries.literal: He was the eldest son of Emperor Taizong; his mother was Empress Jing'an of the Xiao clan.

entries.zh: 會同二年，封壽安王。
entries.en: In the second year of Huitong he received the title Prince of Shou'an.
entries.literal: In the second year of Huitong he was enfeoffed as Prince of Shou'an.

entries.zh: 天祿五年秋九月癸亥，世宗遇害。
entries.en: In the fifth year of Tianlu, on guihai day in the ninth month of autumn, Shizong was assassinated.
entries.literal: In the fifth year of Tianlu, in the ninth month of autumn, on guihai day, Shizong met with assassination.

entries.zh: 逆臣察割等伏誅。
entries.en: The rebel Chage and his accomplices were put to death.
entries.literal: The treacherous ministers Chage and others were executed.

entries.zh: 丁卯，即皇帝位，群臣上尊號曰天順皇帝，改元應歷。
entries.en: On dingmao day he took the throne; the court invested him as Emperor of Heavenly Accord and changed the era name to Yingli.
entries.literal: On dingmao day he ascended the imperial throne; the assembled ministers offered the elevated title Emperor of Heavenly Accord, and the era name was changed to Yingli.

entries.zh: 戊辰，如南京。
entries.en: On wuchen day the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.
entries.literal: On wuchen day he went to the Southern Capital.

entries.zh: 是月，遣劉承訓告哀於漢。
entries.en: That month Liu Chengxun was sent to Han to announce the Emperor's bereavement.
entries.literal: That month Liu Chengxun was dispatched to announce the mourning to Han.

entries.zh: 冬十一月，漢、周、南唐各遣使來吊。
entries.en: That winter, in the eleventh month, Han, Zhou, and Southern Tang each dispatched envoys of condolence.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Han, Zhou, and Southern Tang each sent envoys to offer condolences.

entries.zh: 乙亥，詔朝會依嗣聖皇帝故事，用漢禮。
entries.en: On yihai day an edict directed that court assemblies follow the precedent of Emperor Sisheng and adopt Han court ritual.
entries.literal: On yihai day an edict ordered court assemblies to follow the precedent of Emperor Sisheng, using Han ritual.

entries.zh: 十二月甲辰，漢遣使獻弓矢、鞍馬。
entries.en: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, Han sent envoys with bows and arrows, saddles, and horses.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, Han sent envoys presenting bows and arrows, saddles, and horses.

entries.zh: 壬子，鐵驪、鼻骨德皆來貢。
entries.en: On renzi day Tieli and Bigude both brought tribute.
entries.literal: On renzi day Tieli and Bigude both came to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 七年春正月庚子，鼻骨德來貢。
entries.en: In the seventh year, on gengzi day of the first spring month, the Biegude brought tribute.
entries.literal: In the seventh year, on day gengzi of the first month of spring, the Biegude came to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 二月辛酉，南唐遣使奉蠟丸書。
entries.en: On xinyou day in the second month Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter.
entries.literal: On day xinyou in the second month, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter.

entries.zh: 辛未，駐蹕潢河。
entries.en: On xinwei day he encamped at the Huang River.
entries.literal: On day xinwei, he halted at the Huang River.

entries.zh: 夏四月戊午朔，還上京。
entries.en: That summer, on the wuwu new moon of the fourth month, he returned to the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuwu new moon, he returned to the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 初，女巫肖古上延年藥方，當用男子膽和之。
entries.en: Earlier the witch Xiao Gu had submitted a recipe for longevity medicine that called for human gall to be mixed in.
entries.literal: Previously, the witch Xiao Gu submitted a recipe for longevity medicine that required human gall to be mixed in.

entries.zh: 不數年，殺人甚多，至是，覺其妄，辛巳，射殺之。
entries.en: Within a few years a great many people had been killed; when he realized the deception, on xinsi day he shot and killed her.
entries.literal: Within a few years many people had been killed; at this point he realized the fraud, and on day xinsi he shot and killed her.

entries.zh: 五月辛卯，漢遣使來貢。
entries.en: On xinmao day in the fifth month Han sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On day xinmao in the fifth month, Han sent envoys to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 六月丙辰朔，周遣使來聘。
entries.en: On the bingchen new moon of the sixth month Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.
entries.literal: On the bingchen new moon of the sixth month, Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.

entries.zh: 南唐遣使來貢。
entries.en: Southern Tang sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Southern Tang sent envoys to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 八月己未，周遣使來聘。
entries.en: On jiwei day in the eighth month Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.
entries.literal: On day jiwei in the eighth month, Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.

entries.zh: 是秋，不聽政。
entries.en: That autumn he did not hold court.
entries.literal: That autumn, he did not hold court.

entries.zh: 冬十月庚申，獵於七鷹山。
entries.en: That winter, in the tenth month, on gengshen day, he hunted at Seven Eagle Mountain.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day gengshen, he hunted at Seven Eagle Mountain.

entries.zh: 十二月丁巳，詔大臣曰：「有罪者，法當刑。
entries.en: On dingsi day in the twelfth month he issued an edict to the ministers: "Those who commit crimes should be punished according to law.
entries.literal: On day dingsi in the twelfth month, he issued an edict to the ministers, saying, "Those who are guilty should be punished according to law.

entries.zh: 朕或肆怒，濫及無辜，卿等切諫，無或面從。」
entries.en: If I give way to rage and harm the innocent, you must remonstrate forcefully and not merely agree to my face."
entries.literal: If I give way to anger and it extends to the innocent, you must remonstrate urgently and not merely agree to my face."

entries.zh: 辛巳，還上京。
entries.en: On xinsi day he returned to the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: On day xinsi, he returned to the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 十年春正月，周殿前都點檢趙匡胤廢周自立，建國號宋。
entries.en: In the tenth year, in the first spring month, Zhou's Palace Front inspector Zhao Kuangyin deposed Zhou and enthroned himself, founding the state of Song.
entries.literal: In the tenth year, in the first month of spring, Zhou's Palace Front inspector Zhao Kuangyin deposed Zhou and enthroned himself, founding the state of Song.

entries.zh: 夏五月乙巳，謁懷陵。
entries.en: That summer, on yisi day in the fifth month, he visited Huai Mausoleum.
entries.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on day yisi, he visited Huai Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 壬子，漢以潞州歸附來告。
entries.en: On renzi day Han sent word that Luzhou had submitted to them.
entries.literal: On day renzi, Han sent word that Luzhou had submitted to them.

entries.zh: 丙寅，至自懷陵。
entries.en: On bingyin day he returned from Huai Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On day bingyin, he returned from Huai Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 六月庚申，漢以宋兵圍石州來告，遣大同軍節度使阿剌率四部往援，詔蕭思溫以三部兵助之。
entries.en: On gengshen day in the sixth month Han reported that Song troops were besieging Shizhou; Datong Army military governor Ala was dispatched with four tribes to the rescue, and Xiao Siwen was ordered to assist with troops from three tribes.
entries.literal: On day gengshen in the sixth month, Han reported that Song troops were besieging Shizhou; Datong Army military governor Ala was dispatched with four tribes to the rescue, and Xiao Siwen was ordered to assist with troops from three tribes.

entries.zh: 秋七月己亥朔，宋兵陷石州，潞州復叛，漢使來告。
entries.en: On the jihai new moon of the seventh autumn month Song troops took Shizhou and Luzhou rebelled again; Han sent envoys with the news.
entries.literal: On the jihai new moon of the seventh month of autumn, Song troops captured Shizhou and Luzhou rebelled again; Han sent envoys with the news.

entries.zh: 辛酉，政事令耶律壽遠、太保楚阿不等謀反，伏誅。
entries.en: On xinyou day Affairs commissioner Yelü Shouyuan, Grand Guardian Chu Abu, and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
entries.literal: On day xinyou, Affairs commissioner Yelü Shouyuan, Grand Guardian Chu Abu, and others plotted rebellion and were put to death.

entries.zh: 以酒脯祠天地於黑山。
entries.en: At Black Mountain he offered wine and dried meat in sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
entries.literal: He sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at Black Mountain with wine and dried meat.

entries.zh: 八月，如秋山，幸懷州。
entries.en: In the eighth month he went to Autumn Mountain and visited Huai Prefecture.
entries.literal: In the eighth month, he went to Autumn Mountain and visited Huai Prefecture.

entries.zh: 庚午，以鎮茵石狻猊擊殺近侍古哥。
entries.en: On gengwu day he killed his attendant Guge by striking him with a stone lion from the zhenyins screen.
entries.literal: On day gengwu, he killed his attendant Guge by striking him with a stone lion from the zhenyins screen.

entries.zh: 冬十月丙子，李胡子喜隱謀反，辭連李胡，下獄死。
entries.en: That winter, in the tenth month, on bingzi day Li Huzi Xiyin plotted rebellion; testimony implicated Li Hu, who was imprisoned and died in custody.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day bingzi, Li Huzi Xiyin plotted rebellion; testimony implicated Li Hu, who was imprisoned and died there.

entries.zh: 十一月，海思獄中上書，陳便宜。
entries.en: In the eleventh month Haisi submitted a memorial from prison setting forth practical proposals.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, Haisi submitted a memorial from prison setting forth practical proposals.

entries.zh: 十三年春正月，自丁巳晝夜酣飲者九日。
entries.en: In the thirteenth year, in the first spring month, from dingsi day he drank heavily day and night for nine days.
entries.literal: In the thirteenth year, in the first month of spring, from dingsi day he drank heavily day and night for nine days.

entries.zh: 丙寅，宋欲城益津關，命南京留守高勛、統軍使崔廷勛以兵擾之。
entries.en: On bingyin day, as Song sought to fortify Yijin Pass, he ordered Nanjing garrison commander Gao Xun and army commander Cui Tingxun to harass them with troops.
entries.literal: On day bingyin, as Song sought to fortify Yijin Pass, he ordered Nanjing garrison commander Gao Xun and army commander Cui Tingxun to harass them with troops.

entries.zh: 癸酉，殺獸人海裏。
entries.en: On guiyou day he killed beast keeper Haili.
entries.literal: On day guiyou, he killed beast keeper Haili.

entries.zh: 二月庚寅，漢遣使來告，欲巡邊僥，乞張聲援。
entries.en: On gengyin day in the second month Han sent envoys reporting that they wished to patrol the border and asking that Liao make a show of support.
entries.literal: On day gengyin in the second month, Han sent envoys reporting that they wished to patrol the border and asking that Liao make a show of support.

entries.zh: 壬辰，如潢河。
entries.en: On renchen day he went to the Huang River.
entries.literal: On day renchen, he went to the Huang River.

entries.zh: 癸巳，觀群臣射，賜物有差。
entries.en: On guisi day he watched the ministers shoot and granted gifts according to rank.
entries.literal: On day guisi, he watched the ministers shoot and granted gifts according to rank.

entries.zh: 乙巳，老人星見。
entries.en: On yisi day the Old Man Star appeared.
entries.literal: On day yisi, the Old Man Star appeared.

entries.zh: 三月癸丑朔，殺鹿人彌裏吉，梟其首以示掌鹿者。
entries.en: On the guichou new moon of the third month he killed deer keeper Miliji and had his head displayed as a warning to the deer keepers.
entries.literal: On the guichou new moon of the third month, he killed deer keeper Miliji and had his head displayed as a warning to the deer keepers.

entries.zh: 夏四月壬寅，獵於潢河。
entries.en: That summer, on renyin day in the fourth month, he hunted at the Huang River.
entries.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day renyin, he hunted at the Huang River.

entries.zh: 五月壬戌，視斡朗改國所進花鹿生麛。
entries.en: On renxu day in the fifth month he inspected a newborn spotted-deer fawn presented by Wolanguo.
entries.literal: On day renxu in the fifth month, he inspected a newborn spotted-deer fawn presented by Wolanguo.

entries.zh: 六月癸未，近侍傷獐，杖殺之。
entries.en: On guiwei day in the sixth month an attendant injured a roe deer, and the Emperor had him beaten to death.
entries.literal: On day guiwei in the sixth month, an attendant injured a roe deer, and the Emperor had him beaten to death.

entries.zh: 甲申，殺獐人霞馬。
entries.en: On jiashen day he killed roe deer keeper Xiamar.
entries.literal: On day jiashen, he killed roe deer keeper Xiamar.

entries.zh: 壬辰，詔諸路錄囚。
entries.en: On renchen day he ordered every circuit to review prisoners on record.
entries.literal: On day renchen, he ordered every circuit to review prisoners on record.

entries.zh: 秋七月辛亥朔，漢以宋侵來告。
entries.en: On the xinhai new moon of the seventh autumn month Han reported a Song invasion.
entries.literal: On the xinhai new moon of the seventh month of autumn, Han reported a Song invasion.

entries.zh: 乙丑，薦時羞於廟。
entries.en: On yichou day he offered seasonal delicacies at the ancestral temple.
entries.literal: On day yichou, he offered seasonal delicacies at the ancestral temple.

entries.zh: 八月甲申，以生日，縱五坊鷹鶻。
entries.en: On jiashen day in the eighth month, on his birthday, he released the hawks and falcons of the Five Wards.
entries.literal: On day jiashen in the eighth month, on his birthday, he released the hawks and falcons of the Five Wards.

entries.zh: 戊戌，幸近山，呼鹿射之，旬有七日而後返。
entries.en: On wuxu day he went to nearby mountains, called deer, and shot them; only after seventeen days did he return.
entries.literal: On day wuxu, he went to nearby mountains, called deer, and shot them; only after seventeen days did he return.

entries.zh: 九月庚戌朔，以青牛白馬祭天地。
entries.en: On the gengxu new moon of the ninth month he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with a blue ox and a white horse.
entries.literal: On the gengxu new moon of the ninth month, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with a blue ox and a white horse.

entries.zh: 飲於野次，終夕乃罷。
entries.en: He drank at a field encampment and kept at it all night long.
entries.literal: He drank at a field encampment and did not stop until dawn.

entries.zh: 辛亥，以酒脯祭天地，復終夜酣飲。
entries.en: On xinhai day he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with wine and dried meat, then drank heavily through the night again.
entries.literal: On day xinhai, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with wine and dried meat, then drank heavily through the night again.

entries.zh: 冬十月丙申，漢以宋侵來告。
entries.en: That winter, in the tenth month, on bingshen day, Han reported a Song invasion.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day bingshen, Han reported a Song invasion.

entries.zh: 十一月庚午，獵，飲於虞人之家，凡四日。
entries.en: On gengwu day in the eleventh month he hunted and drank at a forester's home for four days altogether.
entries.literal: On day gengwu in the eleventh month, he hunted and drank at a forester's home for four days altogether.

entries.zh: 十一月戊子，射野鹿，賜虞人物有差。
entries.en: On wuzi day in the eleventh month he shot wild deer and granted the foresters gifts according to rank.
entries.literal: On day wuzi in the eleventh month, he shot wild deer and granted the foresters gifts according to rank.

entries.zh: 庚寅，殺彘人曷主。
entries.en: On gengyin day he killed pig keeper Hezhu.
entries.literal: On day gengyin, he killed pig keeper Hezhu.

entries.zh: 二年春正月戊午朔，南唐遣使奉蠟丸書，及進犀兕甲萬屬。
entries.en: In the second year, on the wuwu new moon of the first spring month, Southern Tang sent envoys with a wax-sealed letter and ten thousand suits of rhinoceros-hide armor.
entries.literal: In the second year, on the wuwu new moon of the first month of spring, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter and presenting ten thousand suits of rhinoceros-hide armor.

entries.zh: 壬戌，太尉忽古質謀逆，伏誅。
entries.en: On renxu day Grand Commandant Huguzhi was executed for plotting rebellion.
entries.literal: On renxu day Grand Commandant Huguzhi plotted rebellion and was executed.

entries.zh: 二月癸卯，女直來貢。
entries.en: In the second month, on guimao day, the Jurchen brought tribute.
entries.literal: In the second month, on guimao day, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 三月癸亥，南唐遣使奉蠟丸書。
entries.en: In the third month, on guihai day, Southern Tang dispatched envoys with a wax-sealed letter.
entries.literal: In the third month, on guihai day, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter.

entries.zh: 丁卯，復遣使來貢。
entries.en: On dingmao day Southern Tang sent tribute envoys again.
entries.literal: On dingmao day they again sent envoys to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 甲申，以耶律撻烈為南院大王。
entries.en: On jiashen day Yelü Talie was made Great King of the Southern Court.
entries.literal: On jiashen day Yelü Talie was appointed Great King of the Southern Court.

entries.zh: 夏四月丙戌朔，日有食之。
entries.en: That summer, on the bingxu new moon of the fourth month, the sun was eclipsed.
entries.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 己亥，鐵驪進鷹鶻。
entries.en: On jihai day Tieli presented hawks and falcons for the hunt.
entries.literal: On jihai day Tieli presented hunting hawks and falcons.

entries.zh: 五月丙辰朔，視朝。
entries.en: On the bingchen new moon of the fifth month the Emperor held court.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingchen new moon, he held court.

entries.zh: 壬午，南唐遣使來貢。
entries.en: On renwu day Southern Tang sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: On renwu day Southern Tang sent envoys to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 六月壬辰，國舅政事令蕭眉古得、宣政殿學士李澣等謀南奔，事覺，詔暴其罪。
entries.en: In the sixth month, on renchen day, Chief Councillor Meigude of the imperial maternal uncle's household, Hall of Promulgating Governance academician Li Han, and others plotted to flee south; the plot was discovered, and an edict publicly proclaimed their crimes.
entries.literal: In the sixth month, on renchen day, Chief Councillor of State Affairs Meigude of the imperial maternal uncle's household, Academician of the Hall of Promulgating Governance Li Han, and others plotted to flee south; when the plot was discovered, an edict publicly proclaimed their crimes.

entries.zh: 乙未，祭天地。
entries.en: On yiwei day the Emperor sacrificed to heaven and earth.
entries.literal: On yiwei day heaven and earth were sacrificed to.

entries.zh: 壬寅，漢為周所侵，遣使求援，命中臺省右相高模翰赴之。
entries.en: On renyin day, as Zhou invaded Han, Han sent envoys begging aid; the Emperor ordered Central Secretariat Vice Chancellor Gao Mohan to their relief.
entries.literal: On renyin day Han, invaded by Zhou, sent envoys requesting aid; the Emperor ordered Central Secretariat Vice Chancellor Gao Mohan to go to their assistance.

entries.zh: 丁未，命乳媼之兄曷魯世為阿速石烈夷離堇。
entries.en: On dingwei day Helu Shi, elder brother of the wet nurse, was appointed yilijin of the Asu Shilie.
entries.literal: On dingwei day the elder brother of the wet nurse, Helu Shi, was appointed yilijin of the Asu Shilie.

entries.zh: 秋七月乙亥，政事令婁國、林牙敵烈、侍中神都、郎君海裏等謀亂，就執。
entries.en: That autumn, in the seventh month on yihai day, Chief Councillor Louguo, linya Dilie, Palace Attendant Shendu, langjun Haili, and others plotted rebellion and were seized where they stood.
entries.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai day, Chief Councillor Louguo, linya Dilie, Palace Attendant Shendu, langjun Haili, and others plotted rebellion and were seized on the spot.

entries.zh: 八月己丑，眉古得、婁國等伏誅，杖李澣而釋之。
entries.en: In the eighth month, on jichou day, Meigude, Louguo, and their co-conspirators were put to death; Li Han was flogged and then released.
entries.literal: In the eighth month, on jichou day, Meigude, Louguo, and the others were executed; Li Han was flogged and released.

entries.zh: 九月甲寅朔，雲州進嘉禾四莖，二穗。
entries.en: In the ninth month, on the jiayin new moon, Yun Prefecture reported auspicious grain of four stalks bearing two ears.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on the jiayin new moon, Yun Prefecture presented auspicious grain with four stalks and two ears.

entries.zh: 戊午，詔以先平察割日，用白黑羊、玄酒祭天，歲以為常。
entries.en: On wuwu day an edict established an annual rite: on the anniversary of Chage's defeat, heaven was to be sacrificed to with white and black sheep and dark wine.
entries.literal: On wuwu day an edict ordered that on the anniversary of Chage's defeat, white and black sheep and dark wine be used to sacrifice to heaven — established as an annual rite.

entries.zh: 壬戌，獵炭山。
entries.en: On renxu day the Emperor hunted at Mount Tanshan.
entries.literal: On renxu day he hunted at Mount Tanshan.

entries.zh: 祭天。
entries.en: He performed the heaven sacrifice.
entries.literal: He sacrificed to heaven.

entries.zh: 庚辰，敵烈部來貢。
entries.en: On gengchen day the Dilie tribe brought tribute.
entries.literal: On gengchen day the Dilie tribe came to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 冬十月甲申朔，漢遣使進葡萄酒。
entries.en: That winter, on the jiashen new moon of the tenth month, Han sent envoys with grape wine.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiashen new moon, Han sent envoys presenting grape wine.

entries.zh: 甲午，司徒老古等獻白雉。
entries.en: On jiawu day Grand Tutor Laogu and others presented white pheasants in tribute.
entries.literal: On jiawu day Grand Tutor Laogu and others presented white pheasants.

entries.zh: 戊申，回鶻及轄戛斯皆遣使來貢。
entries.en: On wushen day the Uyghurs and Kirghiz both sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: On wushen day the Uyghurs and Kirghiz both dispatched envoys to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 十二月癸丑朔，視朝。
entries.en: On the guichou new moon of the twelfth month the Emperor held court.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on the guichou new moon, he held court.

entries.zh: 己巳，地震。
entries.en: On jisi day the earth quaked.
entries.literal: On jisi day there was an earthquake.

entries.zh: 己卯，日南至，始用舊制行拜日禮。
entries.en: On jimao day, at the winter solstice, the court performed the old sun-bowing rite for the first time.
entries.literal: On jimao day, at the winter solstice, the old rite of bowing to the sun was performed for the first time.

entries.zh: 朔州民進黑兔。
entries.en: Commoners of Shuozhou presented a black rabbit.
entries.literal: The people of Shuozhou presented a black rabbit.

entries.zh: 十二月癸未朔，高模翰及漢兵圍晉州。
entries.en: On the guiwei new moon of the twelfth month, Gao Mohan and Han forces laid siege to Jin Prefecture.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on the guiwei new moon, Gao Mohan and Han troops besieged Jin Prefecture.

entries.zh: 辛卯，以生日，飯僧，釋系囚。
entries.en: On xinmao day, his birthday, the Emperor fed the monks and released prisoners.
entries.literal: On xinmao day, on his birthday, he fed the monks and released prisoners.

entries.zh: 甲辰，獵於近郊。
entries.en: On jiachen day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
entries.literal: On jiachen day he hunted in the near suburbs.

entries.zh: 祀天地。
entries.en: He performed sacrifices to heaven and earth.
entries.literal: He sacrificed to heaven and earth.

entries.zh: 辛亥，明王安端薨。
entries.en: On xinhai day Prince Ming'an Anduan passed away.
entries.literal: On xinhai day Prince Ming'an Anduan died.

entries.zh: 三年春閏正月壬午朔，漢以高模翰卻周軍，遣使來謝。
entries.en: In the third year, on the renwu new moon of the intercalary first spring month, Han sent envoys to give thanks after Gao Mohan had driven back the Zhou army.
entries.literal: In the third year, in the intercalary first month of spring, on the renwu new moon, because Gao Mohan had repelled the Zhou army, Han sent envoys to offer thanks.

entries.zh: 二月辛亥朔，詔用嗣聖皇帝舊璽。
entries.en: On the xinhai new moon of the second month an edict directed that Emperor Sisheng's old imperial seal be used.
entries.literal: In the second month, on the xinhai new moon, an edict ordered use of Emperor Sisheng's old imperial seal.

entries.zh: 甲子，太保敵烈修易州城，鎮州以兵來挑戰，卻之。
entries.en: On jiazi day Grand Guardian Dilie repaired the walls of Yizhou; when Zhen Prefecture sent troops to challenge him, he drove them back.
entries.literal: On jiazi day Grand Guardian Dilie repaired the walls of Yizhou city; Zhen Prefecture sent troops to challenge him, and he repulsed them.

entries.zh: 三月庚辰朔，南唐遣使來貢，因附書於漢，詔達之。
entries.en: On the gengchen new moon of the third month Southern Tang sent tribute envoys with a letter for Han; the Emperor ordered it forwarded.
entries.literal: In the third month, on the gengchen new moon, Southern Tang sent envoys to pay tribute and attached a letter for Han; an edict ordered it delivered.

entries.zh: 庚寅，如應州擊鞠。
entries.en: On gengyin day the Emperor went to Ying Prefecture to play cuju.
entries.literal: On gengyin day he went to Ying Prefecture to play cuju.

entries.zh: 丁酉，漢遣使進球衣及馬。
entries.en: On dingyou day Han sent envoys with ball-playing equipment and horses.
entries.literal: On dingyou day Han sent envoys presenting ball-playing gear and horses.

entries.zh: 庚子，觀漁於神德湖。
entries.en: On gengzi day the Emperor watched the fishing at Shende Lake.
entries.literal: On gengzi day he watched fishing at Shende Lake.

entries.zh: 夏四月庚申，鐵驪來貢。
entries.en: That summer, in the fourth month on gengshen day, Tieli brought tribute.
entries.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen day, Tieli came to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 五月壬寅，漢遣使言石晉樹先帝《聖德神功碑》為周人所毀，請再刻，許之。
entries.en: In the fifth month, on renyin day, Han sent envoys reporting that Zhou had destroyed the Sacred Virtue and Divine Merit stele Later Jin had erected for the late emperor, and asking that it be recarved; the Emperor assented.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, on renyin day, Han sent envoys reporting that the Sacred Virtue and Divine Merit stele erected by Later Jin for the late emperor had been destroyed by the people of Zhou, and requesting that it be carved again; permission was granted.

entries.zh: 六月丁卯，應天皇太后崩。
entries.en: In the sixth month, on dingmao day, Empress Dowager Yingtian passed away.
entries.literal: In the sixth month, on dingmao day, the Empress Dowager Yingtian died.

entries.zh: 秋七月，不視朝。
entries.en: That autumn, in the seventh month, the Emperor withdrew from court.
entries.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he did not hold court.

entries.zh: 八月壬子，以生日，釋囚。
entries.en: In the eighth month, on renzi day, his birthday, the Emperor released prisoners.
entries.literal: In the eighth month, on renzi day, on his birthday, prisoners were released.

entries.zh: 己未，漢遣使求援。
entries.en: On jiwei day Han sent envoys begging military aid.
entries.literal: On jiwei day Han sent envoys requesting aid.

entries.zh: 三河烏古、吐蕃、吐谷渾、鼻骨德皆遣使來貢。
entries.en: The Sanhe Wugu, Tibetans, Tuyuhun, and Bigude all sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: The Sanhe Wugu, Tibetans, Tuyuhun, and Bigude all dispatched envoys to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 九月庚子，漢遣使貢藥。
entries.en: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, Han sent envoys with medicines.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, Han sent envoys presenting medicines.

entries.zh: 冬十月己酉，命太師唐骨德治大行皇太后園陵。
entries.en: That winter, in the tenth month on jiyou day, Grand Preceptor Tang Gude was ordered to oversee the tomb park of the late Grand Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiyou day, Grand Preceptor Tang Gude was ordered to oversee the tomb park of the late Grand Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 李胡子宛、郎君嵇幹、敵烈謀反，事覺，辭逮太平王罨撒葛、林牙華割、郎君新羅等，皆執之。
entries.en: Li Huzi Wanyuan, langjun Jigan, and Dilie plotted rebellion; when the plot was uncovered, their confessions implicated Prince Taiping Yansage, linya Huage, langjun Silla, and others, and all were arrested.
entries.literal: Li Huzi Wanyuan, langjun Jigan, and Dilie plotted rebellion; when the plot was discovered, their confessions implicated Prince Taiping Yansage, linya Huage, langjun Silla, and others — all were seized.

entries.zh: 十一月辛丑，謚皇太后曰貞烈，葬祖陵。
entries.en: In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, the late empress dowager was posthumously titled Chaste and Resolute and interred at the ancestral tombs.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, the late empress dowager was given the posthumous title Chaste and Resolute and was buried at the ancestral tombs.

entries.zh: 漢遣使來會。
entries.en: Han dispatched envoys to attend the burial rites.
entries.literal: Han sent envoys to attend the funeral.

entries.zh: 是冬，駐蹕奉聖州。
entries.en: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Fengsheng Prefecture.
entries.literal: That winter the court encamped at Fengsheng Prefecture.

entries.zh: 以南京水，詔免今歲租。
entries.en: Flooding at the Southern Capital prompted an edict remitting that year's land tax.
entries.literal: Because of flooding at the Southern Capital, an edict remitted that year's land tax.

entries.zh: 四年春正月戊寅，回鶻來貢。
entries.en: In the fourth year, on wuyin day in the first month of spring, the Uyghurs brought tribute.
entries.literal: In the fourth year, in the first month of spring, on wuyin day, the Uyghurs came to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 己丑，華割、嵇幹等伏誅，宛及罨撒葛皆釋之。
entries.en: On jichou day Huage, Jigan, and their co-conspirators were put to death; Wanyuan and Yansage were both released.
entries.literal: On jichou day Huage, Jigan, and the others were executed; Wanyuan and Yansage were both released.

entries.zh: 是月，周主威殂，養子晉王柴榮嗣立。
entries.en: That month Zhou's ruler Guo Wei died, and his adopted son, Prince of Jin Chai Rong, succeeded him.
entries.literal: That month Zhou ruler Wei died; his adopted son, Prince of Jin Chai Rong, succeeded to the throne.

entries.zh: 二月丙午朔，周攻漢，命政事令耶律敵祿援之。
entries.en: On the bingwu new moon of the second month, as Zhou attacked Han, Chief Councillor Yelü Dilu was ordered to their relief.
entries.literal: In the second month, on the bingwu new moon, Zhou attacked Han; Chief Councillor Yelü Dilu was ordered to go to their aid.

entries.zh: 丙辰，漢遣使進茶藥。
entries.en: On bingchen day Han sent envoys with tea and medicines.
entries.literal: On bingchen day Han sent envoys presenting tea and medicines.

entries.zh: 幸南京。
entries.en: The Emperor visited the Southern Capital.
entries.literal: He visited the Southern Capital.

entries.zh: 夏五月乙亥，忻、代二州叛漢，遣南院大王撻烈助敵祿討之。
entries.en: That summer, in the fifth month on yihai day, when Xin and Dai prefectures rebelled against Han, Great King of the Southern Court Talie was ordered to join Dilu in suppressing the revolt.
entries.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on yihai day, Xin and Dai prefectures rebelled against Han; Great King of the Southern Court Talie was ordered to assist Dilu in suppressing them.

entries.zh: 丁酉，撻烈敗周將符彥卿於忻口。
entries.en: On dingyou day Talie routed Zhou general Fu Yanqing at Xinkou.
entries.literal: On dingyou day Talie defeated Zhou general Fu Yanqing at Xinkou.

entries.zh: 六月癸亥，撻烈獻所獲。
entries.en: In the sixth month, on guihai day, Talie presented his captives and booty.
entries.literal: In the sixth month, on guihai day, Talie presented what he had captured.

entries.zh: 秋七月乙酉，漢民有為遼軍誤掠者，遣使來請，詔悉歸之。
entries.en: That autumn, in the seventh month on yiyou day, when Han civilians had been mistakenly seized by Liao troops, Han sent envoys asking their return, and an edict ordered every one of them restored.
entries.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yiyou day, Han civilians had been mistakenly seized by Liao troops; Han sent envoys requesting their return, and an edict ordered all of them restored.

entries.zh: 九月丙申，漢為周人所侵，遣使來告。
entries.en: In the ninth month, on bingshen day, as Zhou invaded Han, Han sent envoys to report the attack.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen day, Han, invaded by the people of Zhou, sent envoys to report it.

entries.zh: 冬十一月，彰國軍節度使蕭敵烈，太保許從赟奏忻、代二州捷。
entries.en: That winter, in the eleventh month, Zhangguo Army Military Governor Xiao Dilie and Grand Tutor Xu Congyun reported the victory at Xin and Dai prefectures.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Zhangguo Army Military Governor Xiao Dilie and Grand Tutor Xu Congyun memorialized the victory at Xin and Dai prefectures.

entries.zh: 十二月辛酉朔，謁祖陵。
entries.en: On the xinyou new moon of the twelfth month the Emperor visited the ancestral tombs.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinyou new moon, he visited the ancestral tombs.

entries.zh: 庚午，漢遣使來貢。
entries.en: On gengwu day Han sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: On gengwu day Han sent envoys to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 是冬，駐蹕杏堝。
entries.en: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Xingguo.
entries.literal: That winter the court encamped at Xingguo.

entries.zh: 五年春正月辛未朔，鼻骨德來貢。
entries.en: In the fifth year, on the xinwei new moon of the first spring month, Bigude brought tribute.
entries.literal: In the fifth year, on the xinwei new moon of the first month of spring, Bigude came to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 二月庚子朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the gengzi new moon of the second month the sun was eclipsed.
entries.literal: In the second month, on the gengzi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
