entries.zh: 庚申，漢遣使請上尊號，不許。
entries.en: On gengshen day Han sent envoys asking that an elevated title be conferred on the Emperor; the request was refused.
entries.literal: On gengshen day Han sent envoys requesting that an elevated title be conferred on the Emperor; it was not granted.

entries.zh: 壬戌，如潭。
entries.en: On renxu day the Emperor went to Tan.
entries.literal: On renxu day he went to Tan.

entries.zh: 夏四月己酉，周侵漢，漢遣使求援。
entries.en: That summer, in the fourth month on jiyou day, as Zhou invaded Han, Han sent envoys begging aid.
entries.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou day, Zhou invaded Han, and Han sent envoys requesting aid.

entries.zh: 癸丑，命郎君蕭海璃世為北府宰相。
entries.en: On guichou day langjun Xiao Hailishi was made Northern Chancellery Chancellor.
entries.literal: On guichou day langjun Xiao Hailishi was appointed Northern Chancellery Chancellor.

entries.zh: 秋九月庚辰，漢主有疾，遣使來告。
entries.en: That autumn, in the ninth month on gengchen day, the ruler of Han fell ill and sent envoys to announce it.
entries.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, on gengchen day, the Han ruler fell ill and sent envoys to report it.

entries.zh: 冬十月壬申，女直來貢。
entries.en: That winter, in the tenth month on renshen day, the Jurchen brought tribute.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on renshen day, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 丁亥，謁太宗廟。
entries.en: On dinghai day the Emperor visited Taizong's temple.
entries.literal: On dinghai day he visited Taizong's temple.

entries.zh: 庚寅，南唐遣使來貢。
entries.en: On gengyin day Southern Tang sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: On gengyin day Southern Tang sent envoys to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 十一月乙未朔，漢主崇殂，子承鈞遣使來告，且求嗣立。
entries.en: On the yiwei new moon of the eleventh month Han's ruler Liu Chong died; his son Liu Chengjun sent envoys announcing the death and asking that his succession be recognized.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, on the yiwei new moon, Han ruler Chong died; his son Liu Chengjun sent envoys to announce the death and request recognition of his succession.

entries.zh: 遣使吊祭，遂封冊之。
entries.en: The Emperor sent envoys to mourn and invest the new ruler, and Liu Chengjun was thereupon enfeoffed and confirmed in succession.
entries.literal: Envoys were dispatched to offer condolences and perform the investiture; he was thereupon enfeoffed and invested.

entries.zh: 十二月乙丑朔，謁太祖廟。
entries.en: On the yichou new moon of the twelfth month the Emperor visited Taizu's temple.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on the yichou new moon, he visited Taizu's temple.

entries.zh: 辛巳，漢遣使來議軍事。
entries.en: On xinsi day Han sent envoys to consult on military affairs.
entries.literal: On xinsi day Han sent envoys to discuss military affairs.

entries.zh: 六年夏五月丁酉，謁懷陵。
entries.en: In the sixth year, on dingyou day in the fifth month of summer, the Emperor visited Huai Mausoleum.
entries.literal: In the sixth year, in the fifth month of summer, on dingyou day, he visited Huai Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 六月甲子，漢遣使來議軍事。
entries.en: In the sixth month, on jiazi day, Han sent envoys to consult on military affairs.
entries.literal: In the sixth month, on jiazi day, Han sent envoys to discuss military affairs.

entries.zh: 秋七月，不視朝。
entries.en: That autumn, in the seventh month, the Emperor withdrew from court.
entries.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he did not hold court.

entries.zh: 九月戊子，謁祖陵。
entries.en: In the ninth month, on wuzi day, the Emperor visited the ancestral tombs.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on wuzi day, he visited the ancestral tombs.

entries.zh: 冬十一月壬寅，鼻骨德來貢。
entries.en: That winter, in the eleventh month, on renyin day, the Biegude brought tribute.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on day renyin, the Biegude came to pay tribute.

entries.zh: 十二月己未朔，謁太祖廟。
entries.en: On the jiwei new moon of the twelfth month he visited Emperor Taizu's temple.
entries.literal: On the jiwei new moon of the twelfth month, he visited Emperor Taizu's temple.

entries.zh: 八年春二月乙丑，駐蹕潢河。
entries.en: In the eighth year, on yichou day of the second spring month, he encamped at the Huang River.
entries.literal: In the eighth year, on day yichou of the second month of spring, he halted at the Huang River.

entries.zh: 夏四月甲寅，南京留守蕭思溫攻下沿邊州縣，遣人勞之。
entries.en: That summer, on jiayin day in the fourth month, Nanjing garrison commander Xiao Siwen captured border prefectures and counties, and the Emperor sent men to reward the troops.
entries.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day jiayin, Nanjing garrison commander Xiao Siwen captured border prefectures and counties, and the Emperor sent men to reward the troops.

entries.zh: 五月，周陷束城縣。
entries.en: In the fifth month Zhou took Dongcheng County.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, Zhou captured Dongcheng County.

entries.zh: 六月辛未，蕭思溫請益兵，乞駕幸燕。
entries.en: On xinwei day in the sixth month Xiao Siwen asked for reinforcements and pleaded that the Emperor come in person to Yan.
entries.literal: On day xinwei in the sixth month, Xiao Siwen requested reinforcements and pleaded that the Emperor come in person to Yan.

entries.zh: 秋七月，獵於拽剌山。
entries.en: In the seventh autumn month he hunted at Zhaila Mountain.
entries.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, he hunted at Zhaila Mountain.

entries.zh: 迄於九月，射鹿諸山，不視朝。
entries.en: Through the ninth month he hunted deer on various mountains and did not hold court.
entries.literal: Through the ninth month he shot deer on various mountains and did not hold court.

entries.zh: 冬十一月辛酉，漢遣使來告周復來侵。
entries.en: That winter, in the eleventh month, on xinyou day, Han sent envoys reporting that Zhou had invaded again.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on day xinyou, Han sent envoys reporting that Zhou had invaded again.

entries.zh: 乙丑，使再至。
entries.en: On yichou day the envoys came again.
entries.literal: On day yichou, the envoys came again.

entries.zh: 十二月庚辰，又至。
entries.en: On gengchen day in the twelfth month they came again.
entries.literal: On day gengchen in the twelfth month, they came again.

entries.zh: 九年春正月戊辰，駐蹕潢河。
entries.en: In the ninth year, on wuchen day of the first spring month, he encamped at the Huang River.
entries.literal: In the ninth year, on day wuchen of the first month of spring, he halted at the Huang River.

entries.zh: 夏四月丙戌，周來侵。
entries.en: That summer, on bingxu day in the fourth month, Zhou invaded.
entries.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day bingxu, Zhou invaded.

entries.zh: 戊戌，以南京留守蕭思溫為兵馬都總管，擊之。
entries.en: On wuxu day Xiao Siwen, Nanjing garrison commander, was made grand commander of army and horse and sent to attack them.
entries.literal: On day wuxu, Xiao Siwen, Nanjing garrison commander, was appointed grand commander of army and horse and sent to attack them.

entries.zh: 是月，周拔益津、瓦橋、淤口三關。
entries.en: That month Zhou took the three passes of Yijin, Waqiao, and Yukou.
entries.literal: That month, Zhou captured the three passes of Yijin, Waqiao, and Yukou.

entries.zh: 五月乙巳朔，陷瀛、莫二州。
entries.en: On the yisi new moon of the fifth month Zhou captured Ying and Mo prefectures.
entries.literal: On the yisi new moon of the fifth month, Zhou captured Ying and Mo prefectures.

entries.zh: 癸亥，如南京。
entries.en: On guihai day he went to Nanjing.
entries.literal: On day guihai, he went to Nanjing.

entries.zh: 辛未，周兵退。
entries.en: On xinwei day the Zhou army withdrew.
entries.literal: On day xinwei, the Zhou army withdrew.

entries.zh: 六月乙亥朔，視朝。
entries.en: On the yihai new moon of the sixth month he held court.
entries.literal: On the yihai new moon of the sixth month, he held court.

entries.zh: 戊寅，復容城縣。
entries.en: On wuyin day Rongcheng County was recovered.
entries.literal: On day wuyin, Rongcheng County was recovered.

entries.zh: 庚申，西幸，如懷州。
entries.en: On gengshen day he went west on tour to Huai Prefecture.
entries.literal: On day gengshen, he went west on tour to Huai Prefecture.

entries.zh: 是月，周主榮殂，子宗訓立。
entries.en: That month Zhou's ruler Rong died and his son Zongxun succeeded to the throne.
entries.literal: That month, Zhou's ruler Rong died and his son Zongxun succeeded to the throne.

entries.zh: 秋七月，發南京軍戍范陽。
entries.en: In the seventh autumn month he sent Nanjing troops to garrison Fanyang.
entries.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, he sent Nanjing troops to garrison Fanyang.

entries.zh: 冬十二月戊寅，還上京。
entries.en: That winter, in the twelfth month, on wuyin day, he returned to the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on day wuyin, he returned to the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 庚辰，王子敵烈、前宣徽使海思及蕭達干等謀反，事覺，鞫之。
entries.en: On gengchen day Prince Dilie, former Xuanhui commissioner Haisi, Xiao Dagan, and others plotted rebellion; when the plot was discovered they were put to interrogation.
entries.literal: On day gengchen, Prince Dilie, former Xuanhui commissioner Haisi, Xiao Dagan, and others plotted rebellion; when the plot was discovered they were interrogated.

entries.zh: 辛巳，祀天地、祖考，告逆黨事敗。
entries.en: On xinsi day he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth and the imperial ancestors, announcing that the rebel conspiracy had failed.
entries.literal: On day xinsi, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth and the imperial ancestors, announcing that the rebel conspiracy had failed.

entries.zh: 丙申，召群臣議時政。
entries.en: On bingshen day he summoned the ministers to discuss current affairs.
entries.literal: On day bingshen, he summoned the ministers to discuss current policy.

entries.zh: 十一年春二月丙寅，釋喜隱。
entries.en: In the eleventh year, on bingyin day in the second spring month, Xiyin was released.
entries.literal: In the eleventh year, on day bingyin of the second month of spring, Xiyin was released.

entries.zh: 辛亥，司徒烏裏只子叠剌哥誣告其父謀反，復詐乘傳及殺行人，以其父請，杖而釋之。
entries.en: On xinhai day Wulizhi's son Dielage falsely accused his father of plotting rebellion and also abused the imperial relay system and killed passersby; at his father's plea he was flogged and released.
entries.literal: On day xinhai, Wulizhi's son Dielage falsely accused his father of plotting rebellion and also abused the imperial relay system and killed travelers; at his father's plea he was flogged and released.

entries.zh: 三月丙辰，蕭思溫奏老人星見，乞行赦宥。
entries.en: On bingchen day in the third month Xiao Siwen reported that the Old Man Star had appeared and asked that an amnesty be proclaimed.
entries.literal: On day bingchen in the third month, Xiao Siwen reported that the Old Man Star had appeared and asked that an amnesty be proclaimed.

entries.zh: 閏月甲子朔，如潢河。
entries.en: On the jiazi new moon of the intercalary month he went to the Huang River.
entries.literal: On the jiazi new moon of the intercalary month, he went to the Huang River.

entries.zh: 夏四月癸巳朔，日有食之。
entries.en: That summer, on the guisi new moon of the fourth month, there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the guisi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 是月，射鹿，不視朝。
entries.en: That month he hunted deer and did not hold court.
entries.literal: That month, he hunted deer and did not hold court.

entries.zh: 五月乙亥，司天王白、李正等進歷。
entries.en: On yihai day in the fifth month Astronomical Bureau director Wang Bai, Li Zheng, and others presented the calendar.
entries.literal: On day yihai in the fifth month, Astronomical Bureau director Wang Bai, Li Zheng, and others presented the calendar.

entries.zh: 六月甲午，赦。
entries.en: On jiawu day in the sixth month he proclaimed an amnesty.
entries.literal: On day jiawu in the sixth month, he proclaimed an amnesty.

entries.zh: 冬十一月，歲星犯月。
entries.en: That winter, in the eleventh month, Jupiter trespassed the moon.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Jupiter trespassed the moon.

entries.zh: 十二年春正月甲戌，夜觀燈。
entries.en: In the twelfth year, on jiaxu day of the first spring month, he viewed lanterns at night.
entries.literal: In the twelfth year, on day jiaxu of the first month of spring, he viewed lanterns at night.

entries.zh: 二月己丑朔，以御史大夫蕭護思為北院樞密使，賜對衣、鞍馬。
entries.en: On the jichou new moon of the second month Censor-in-chief Xiao Husi was made Northern Court Privy Commissioner and given paired robes, a saddle, and a horse.
entries.literal: On the jichou new moon of the second month, Censor-in-chief Xiao Husi was made Northern Court Privy Commissioner and given paired robes, a saddle, and a horse.

entries.zh: 夏五月庚午，以旱，命左右以水相沃，頃之，果雨。
entries.en: That summer, on gengwu day in the fifth month, because of drought he ordered his attendants to douse one another with water; before long rain indeed fell.
entries.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on day gengwu, because of drought he ordered his attendants to douse one another with water; before long rain indeed fell.

entries.zh: 六月甲午，祠木葉山及潢河。
entries.en: On jiawu day in the sixth month he sacrificed at Muye Mountain and the Huang River.
entries.literal: On day jiawu in the sixth month, he sacrificed at Muye Mountain and the Huang River.

entries.zh: 秋，如黑山、赤山射鹿。
entries.en: That autumn he hunted deer at Black Mountain and Red Mountain.
entries.literal: That autumn, he hunted deer at Black Mountain and Red Mountain.

entries.zh: 景宗上
entries.en: Jingzong, Part One
entries.literal: Jingzong, Part One

entries.zh: 景宗孝成康靖皇帝，諱賢，字賢寧，小字明扆。
entries.en: The Emperor Jingzong, posthumous title Xiaocheng Kangjing, personal name Xian, courtesy name Xianning, childhood name Mingyi.
entries.literal: Emperor Jingzong Xiaocheng Kangjing, taboo name Xian, style name Xianning, childhood name Mingyi.

entries.zh: 世宗皇帝第二子，母曰懷節皇后蕭氏。
entries.en: He was the second son of Emperor Shizong; his mother was Empress Huaijie of the Xiao clan.
entries.literal: Second son of Emperor Shizong; his mother was Empress Huaijie, née Xiao.

entries.zh: 察割之亂，帝甫四歲。
entries.en: During the Chaige Rebellion the Emperor was only four years old.
entries.literal: At the Chaige Rebellion the Emperor was only four years old.

entries.zh: 穆宗即位，養永興宮。
entries.en: After Muzong ascended the throne, he was raised in Yongxing Palace.
entries.literal: When Muzong took the throne, he was raised in Yongxing Palace.

entries.zh: 即長，穆宗酗酒怠政。
entries.en: Once he came of age, Muzong drank heavily and neglected governance.
entries.literal: Once grown, Muzong drank heavily and neglected governance.

entries.zh: 帝一日與韓匡嗣語及時事，耶律賢適止之。
entries.en: One day the Emperor spoke with Han Kuangsi about current affairs, and Yelü Xianshi cut him off.
entries.literal: One day the Emperor discussed current affairs with Han Kuangsi; Yelü Xianshi stopped it.

entries.zh: 帝悟，不復言。
entries.en: The Emperor took the hint and said no more.
entries.literal: The Emperor understood and spoke no more.

entries.zh: 應歷十九年春二月戊辰，入見，穆宗曰：「吾兒已成人，可付以政。」
entries.en: In the nineteenth year of Yingli, on wuchen day in the second spring month, he came for an audience; Muzong said, "My son is already grown and may be entrusted with government."
entries.literal: In the nineteenth year of Yingli, on wuchen day of the second spring month, he entered for audience; Muzong said, "My son is already grown and may be entrusted with government."

entries.zh: 己巳，穆宗遇弒，帝率飛龍使女裏、侍中蕭思溫、南院樞密使高勛率甲騎千人馳赴。
entries.en: On jisi day Muzong was assassinated; the Emperor led Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli, Palace Attendant Xiao Siwen, and Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun at the head of a thousand armored horsemen in haste to the scene.
entries.literal: On jisi day Muzong was assassinated; the Emperor led Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli, Palace Attendant Xiao Siwen, and Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun with a thousand armored horsemen in haste to the spot.

entries.zh: 黎明，至行在，哭之慟。
entries.en: At dawn he reached the traveling palace and wept in deep grief.
entries.literal: At dawn he reached the traveling palace and wept bitterly.

entries.zh: 群臣勸進，遂即皇帝位於柩前。
entries.en: The ministers urged him to ascend, and he took the throne before the coffin.
entries.literal: The ministers urged him to take the throne, and he thereupon ascended the imperial seat before the coffin.

entries.zh: 百官上尊號曰天贊皇帝，大赦，改元保寧。
entries.en: The officials submitted the honorific title Emperor Tianzan; a grand amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Baoning.
entries.literal: The officials submitted the honorific title Emperor Tianzan, granted a grand amnesty, and changed the era name to Baoning.

entries.zh: 以殿前都點檢耶律夷臘、右皮室詳穩蕭烏裏只宿衛不嚴，斬之。
entries.en: Palace Front Inspector Yelü Yila and right Pishi xiangwen Xiao Wulizhi were beheaded for lax palace security.
entries.literal: Because Palace Front Inspector Yelü Yila and right Pishi xiangwen Xiao Wulizhi had failed to guard the palace strictly, both were executed.

entries.zh: 三月丙戌，入上京，以蕭思溫為北院樞密使。
entries.en: In the third month, on bingxu day, he entered the Supreme Capital and appointed Xiao Siwen Northern Chancellery Commissioner.
entries.literal: In the third month, on bingxu day, he entered the Supreme Capital and made Xiao Siwen Northern Chancellery Commissioner.

entries.zh: 太平王罨撒葛亡入沙沱。
entries.en: Prince of Taiping Yansage fled into Shato.
entries.literal: Prince of Taiping Yansage fled into Shato.

entries.zh: 己丑，夷離畢粘木袞以陰附罨撒葛伏誅。
entries.en: On jichou day yilijin Nianmugun was put to death for secretly siding with Yansage.
entries.literal: On jichou day yilijin Nianmugun, who had secretly joined Yansage, was executed.

entries.zh: 癸巳，罨撒葛入朝。
entries.en: On guisi day Yansage came to court and submitted.
entries.literal: On guisi day Yansage entered court.

entries.zh: 甲午，以北院樞密使蕭思溫兼北府宰相。
entries.en: On jiawu day Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen was also made Northern Prime Minister.
entries.literal: On jiawu day Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen was additionally made Northern Prime Minister.

entries.zh: 己亥，南院樞密使高勛封秦王。
entries.en: On jihai day Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin.
entries.literal: On jihai day Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin.

entries.zh: 夏四月戊申朔，進封太平王罨撒葛為齊王，改封趙王喜隱為宋王，封隆先為平王，稍為吳王，道隱為蜀王，必攝為越王，敵烈為冀王，宛為衛王。
entries.en: That summer, on the wushen new moon of the fourth month, Prince of Taiping Yansage was advanced to Prince of Qi; Prince of Zhao Xiyin was renamed Prince of Song; Longxian was made Prince of Ping, Shao Prince of Wu, Daoyin Prince of Shu, Bishe Prince of Yue, Dilie Prince of Ji, and Wan Prince of Wei.
entries.literal: That summer, on the wushen new moon of the fourth month, Prince of Taiping Yansage was advanced to Prince of Qi; Prince of Zhao Xiyin was changed to Prince of Song; Longxian was enfeoffed as Prince of Ping, Shao as Prince of Wu, Daoyin as Prince of Shu, Bishe as Prince of Yue, Dilie as Prince of Ji, and Wan as Prince of Wei.

entries.zh: 五月戊寅，立貴妃蕭氏為皇后。
entries.en: In the fifth month, on wuyin day, Consort Xiao of the Xiao clan was made empress.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, on wuyin day, Consort Xiao was established as empress.

entries.zh: 丙申，射柳祈雨。
entries.en: On bingshen day the Emperor shot the willow branch to pray for rain.
entries.literal: On bingshen day he shot the willow branch to pray for rain.

entries.zh: 有司請以帝生日為天清節，從之。
entries.en: The officials asked that the Emperor's birthday be declared the Tianqing Festival, and the request was granted.
entries.literal: The officials requested that the Emperor's birthday be made the Tianqing Festival, and this was approved.

entries.zh: 壬寅，漢遣李匡弼、劉繼文、李元素等來賀。
entries.en: On renyin day Han sent Li Kuangbi, Liu Jiwen, Li Yuansu, and others to offer congratulations on the accession.
entries.literal: On renyin day Han sent Li Kuangbi, Liu Jiwen, Li Yuansu, and others to offer congratulations.

entries.zh: 冬十月，東幸瑽潭。
entries.en: That winter, in the tenth month, the Emperor traveled east to Congtan.
entries.literal: That winter, in the tenth month, he traveled east to Congtan.

entries.zh: 十一月甲辰朔，行柴冊禮，祠木葉山，駐蹕鶴谷。
entries.en: In the eleventh month, on the jiachen new moon, he performed the fire-wood enthronement rite, sacrificed to Mount Muye, and encamped at Crane Valley.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiachen new moon, he performed the fire-wood enthronement rite, sacrificed to Mount Muye, and halted at Crane Valley.

entries.zh: 乙巳，蕭思溫封魏王，北院大王屋質加於越。
entries.en: On yisi day Xiao Siwen was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, and Northern Grand Prince Wuzhi was promoted to yuyue.
entries.literal: On yisi day Xiao Siwen was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, and Northern Grand Prince Wuzhi was advanced to yuyue.

entries.zh: 三年春正月甲寅，右夷離畢奚底遣人獻敵烈俘，詔賜有功將士。
entries.en: In the third year, on jiayin day in the first spring month, right yilijin Xidi sent men with captives taken from Dilie; an edict rewarded the officers and soldiers who had earned merit.
entries.literal: In the third year, on jiayin day of the first spring month, right yilijin Xidi sent men presenting captives of Dilie; an edict granted rewards to meritorious officers and soldiers.

entries.zh: 庚申，置登聞鼓院。
entries.en: On gengshen day the Petition Drum Office was established.
entries.literal: On gengshen day the Petition Drum Office was established.

entries.zh: 辛酉，南京統軍使魏國公韓匡美封鄴王。
entries.en: On xinyou day Southern Capital Military Commissioner Han Kuangmei, Duke of Wei, was enfeoffed as Prince of Ye.
entries.literal: On xinyou day Southern Capital Military Commissioner Duke of Wei Han Kuangmei was enfeoffed as Prince of Ye.

entries.zh: 二月癸酉，東幸。
entries.en: In the second month, on guiyou day, the Emperor traveled east.
entries.literal: In the second month, on guiyou day, he traveled east.

entries.zh: 壬午，遣鐸遏使阿薩蘭回鶻。
entries.en: On renwu day a duo'e commissioner was dispatched to the Uighurs.
entries.literal: On renwu day the duo'e commissioner was sent to Uighur.

entries.zh: 己丑，以青牛白馬祭天地。
entries.en: On jichou day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
entries.literal: On jichou day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

entries.zh: 三月丁未，以飛龍使女裏為契丹行宮都部署。
entries.en: In the third month, on dingwei day, Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli was appointed chief steward of the Khitan traveling palace.
entries.literal: In the third month, on dingwei day, Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli was made Khitan traveling palace chief steward.

entries.zh: 夏四月丁卯，世宗妃啜裏及蒲哥厭魅，賜死。
entries.en: That summer, in the fourth month on dingmao day, Shizong's consorts Chuoluo and Puge were executed for sorcery.
entries.literal: That summer, in the fourth month on dingmao day, Shizong's consorts Chuoluo and Puge used malevolent sorcery and were granted death.

entries.zh: 己卯，祠木葉山，行再生禮。
entries.en: On jimao day the Emperor sacrificed to Mount Muye and performed the rebirth rite.
entries.literal: On jimao day he sacrificed to Mount Muye and performed the rebirth rite.

entries.zh: 丙戌，至自東幸。
entries.en: On bingxu day the Emperor returned from the eastern tour.
entries.literal: On bingxu day he returned from the eastern tour.

entries.zh: 戊子，蕭神睹伏誅。
entries.en: On wuzi day Xiao Shendu was put to death.
entries.literal: On wuzi day Xiao Shendu was executed.

entries.zh: 六月丙子，漢遣使問起居，自是繼月而至。
entries.en: In the sixth month, on bingzi day, Han sent envoys to inquire after the Emperor's health, and such missions thereafter arrived every month.
entries.literal: In the sixth month, on bingzi day, Han sent envoys inquiring after the Emperor's health; from then on they came month after month.

entries.zh: 丁丑，回鶻遣使來貢。
entries.en: On dingchou day the Uighurs sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: On dingchou day Uighur sent tribute envoys.

entries.zh: 秋七月辛丑，以北院樞密使賢適為西北路招討使。
entries.en: That autumn, in the seventh month on xinchou day, Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xianshi was appointed Northwest Route pacification commissioner.
entries.literal: That autumn, in the seventh month on xinchou day, Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xianshi was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.

entries.zh: 八月甲戌，如秋山。
entries.en: In the eighth month, on jiaxu day, the Emperor went to Autumn Mountain.
entries.literal: In the eighth month, on jiaxu day, he went to Autumn Mountain.

entries.zh: 辛卯，祭皇兄吼墓，追冊為皇太子，謚莊聖。
entries.en: On xinmao day the Emperor sacrificed at the tomb of his elder brother Hou, who was posthumously enfeoffed as crown prince with the posthumous title Zhuangsheng.
entries.literal: On xinmao day he sacrificed at the tomb of his elder brother Hou; Hou was posthumously enfeoffed as crown prince with posthumous title Zhuangsheng.

entries.zh: 九月乙巳，賜傅父侍中達裏叠、太保楚補、太保婆兒、保母回室、押雅等戶口、牛羊有差。
entries.en: In the ninth month, on yisi day, the wet-nurse fathers Palace Attendant Daliedie, Grand Guardian Chubu, Grand Guardian Po'er, nurse Huishi, yaya, and others received grants of households, cattle, and sheep according to rank.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on yisi day, wet-nurse fathers Palace Attendant Daliedie, Grand Guardian Chubu, Grand Guardian Po'er, nurse Huishi, yaya, and others were granted households and cattle and sheep in differing amounts.

entries.zh: 又以潛邸給使者為撻馬部，置官掌之。
entries.en: Envoys from the former princely residence were also organized as the tame-horse section, with officials appointed to oversee it.
entries.literal: The former residence's supply envoys were also made the tame-horse section, with officials appointed to administer it.

entries.zh: 壬子，幸歸化州。
entries.en: On renzi day the Emperor visited Guihua Prefecture.
entries.literal: On renzi day he visited Guihua Prefecture.

entries.zh: 甲寅，如南京。
entries.en: On jiayin day the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.
entries.literal: On jiayin day he went to the Southern Capital.

entries.zh: 冬十月己巳，以黑白羊祀神。
entries.en: That winter, in the tenth month on jisi day, black and white sheep were sacrificed to the spirits.
entries.literal: That winter, in the tenth month on jisi day, black and white sheep were sacrificed to the spirits.

entries.zh: 癸未，漢遣使來貢。
entries.en: On guiwei day Han sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: On guiwei day Han sent tribute envoys.

entries.zh: 丙戌，鼻骨德、吐谷渾來貢。
entries.en: On bingxu day the Biegude and Tuyuhun sent tribute.
entries.literal: On bingxu day Biegude and Tuyuhun came to offer tribute.

entries.zh: 十一月庚子，臚朐河於越延尼裏等率戶四百五十來附，乞隸宮籍。
entries.en: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day, yuyue Yan Nili of Luchu River and others led four hundred fifty households to submit and petitioned to be enrolled in palace registers.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day, yuyue Yan Nili of Luchu River and others led four hundred fifty households to submit and asked to be enrolled in palace registers.

entries.zh: 詔留其戶，分隸敦睦、積慶、永興三宮，優賜遣之。
entries.en: An edict kept their households and assigned them to the Dunmu, Jiqing, and Yongxing palaces; they were richly rewarded and sent home.
entries.literal: An edict retained their households and distributed them among the Dunmu, Jiqing, and Yongxing palaces; they were generously rewarded and sent away.

entries.zh: 十二月癸酉，以青牛白馬祭天地。
entries.en: In the twelfth month, on guiyou day, the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on guiyou day, a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

entries.zh: 己丑，皇子隆緒生。
entries.en: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.
entries.literal: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.

entries.zh: 是冬，駐蹕金川。
entries.en: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Jinchuan.
entries.literal: That winter the court encamped at Jinchuan.

entries.zh: 四年春二月癸亥，漢以皇子生，遣使來賀。
entries.en: In the fourth year, on guihai day in the second spring month, Han sent envoys to offer congratulations on the birth of a prince.
entries.literal: In the fourth year, on guihai day of the second spring month, Han, because a prince was born, sent envoys to offer congratulations.

entries.zh: 閏月戊申，齊王罨撒葛薨。
entries.en: In the intercalary month, on wushen day, Prince of Qi Yansage died.
entries.literal: In the intercalary month, on wushen day, Prince of Qi Yansage died.

entries.zh: 三月庚申朔，追冊為皇太叔。
entries.en: In the third month, on the gengshen new moon, Yansage was posthumously enfeoffed as Imperial Grand Uncle.
entries.literal: In the third month, on the gengshen new moon, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Imperial Grand Uncle.

entries.zh: 夏四月庚寅朔，追封蕭思溫為楚國王。
entries.en: That summer, on the gengyin new moon of the fourth month, Xiao Siwen was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.
entries.literal: That summer, on the gengyin new moon of the fourth month, Xiao Siwen was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.

entries.zh: 是夏，駐蹕冰井。
entries.en: That summer the court encamped at Ice Well.
entries.literal: That summer the court encamped at Bingjing.

entries.zh: 秋七月，如云州。
entries.en: That autumn, in the seventh month, the Emperor went to Yun Prefecture.
entries.literal: That autumn, in the seventh month, went to Yun Prefecture.

entries.zh: 丁丑，鼻骨德來貢。
entries.en: On dingchou day the Biegude sent tribute.
entries.literal: On dingchou day Biegude came to offer tribute.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，如南京。
entries.en: That winter, on the dinghai new moon of the tenth month, the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.
entries.literal: That winter, on the dinghai new moon of the tenth month, went to the Southern Capital.

entries.zh: 十二月甲午，詔內外官上封事。
entries.en: In the twelfth month, on jiawu day, an edict ordered officials throughout the court to submit sealed memorials.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiawu day, an edict ordered inner and outer officials to submit sealed memorials.

entries.zh: 二年春正月丁未，如潢河。
entries.en: In the second year, on dingwei day in the first spring month, the Emperor went to the Huang River.
entries.literal: In the second year, on dingwei day of the first spring month, he went to the Huang River.

entries.zh: 夏四月，幸東京，致奠於讓國皇帝及世宗廟。
entries.en: That summer, in the fourth month, he visited the Eastern Capital and made offerings at the temples of the Abdication Emperor and Shizong.
entries.literal: That summer, in the fourth month, he visited the Eastern Capital and offered sacrifice at the temples of the Abdication Emperor and Shizong.

entries.zh: 五月癸丑，西幸。
entries.en: In the fifth month, on guichou day, the Emperor traveled west.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, on guichou day, he traveled west.

entries.zh: 乙卯，次盤道嶺，盜殺北院樞密使蕭思溫。
entries.en: On yimao day the court halted at Pansdao Ridge, where bandits murdered Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen.
entries.literal: On yimao day he halted at Pansdao Ridge; bandits murdered Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen.

entries.zh: 六月，還上京。
entries.en: In the sixth month the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: In the sixth month he returned to the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 秋七月，以右皮室詳穩賢適為北院樞密使。
entries.en: That autumn, in the seventh month, right Pishi xiangwen Xianshi was appointed Northern Chancellery Commissioner.
entries.literal: That autumn, in the seventh month, right Pishi xiangwen Xianshi was made Northern Chancellery Commissioner.

entries.zh: 九月辛丑，得國舅蕭海只及海裏殺蕭思溫狀，皆伏誅，流其弟神睹於黃龍府。
entries.en: In the ninth month, on xinchou day, proof was obtained that the empress's uncle Xiao Haizhi and Haili had murdered Xiao Siwen; both were put to death, and Siwen's brother Shendu was banished to Huanglong Prefecture.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on xinchou day, evidence was obtained that the empress's uncle Xiao Haizhi and Haili had killed Xiao Siwen; both were executed, and Siwen's brother Shendu was exiled to Huanglong Prefecture.

entries.zh: 冬十二月庚午，漢遣使來貢。
entries.en: That winter, in the twelfth month on gengwu day, Han sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: That winter, in the twelfth month on gengwu day, Han sent tribute envoys.

entries.zh: 五年春正月甲子，惕隱休哥伐党項，破之，以俘獲之數來上。
entries.en: In the fifth year, on jiazi day in the first spring month, tithen Xiuge attacked the Tangut, routed them, and reported the number of captives taken.
entries.literal: In the fifth year, on jiazi day of the first spring month, tithen Xiuge attacked the Tangut and defeated them, presenting the tally of captives.

entries.zh: 漢遣使來貢。
entries.en: Han sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: Han sent tribute envoys.

entries.zh: 庚午，禦五鳳樓觀燈。
entries.en: On gengwu day the Emperor mounted the Five Phoenix Tower to view the lanterns.
entries.literal: On gengwu day he mounted the Five Phoenix Tower to view the lanterns.

entries.zh: 二月丁亥，近侍實魯裏誤觸神纛，法論死，杖釋之。
entries.en: In the second month, on dinghai day, the attendant Shiluli accidentally touched the spirit banner; though the law called for death, he was caned and released.
entries.literal: In the second month, on dinghai day, the attendant Shiluli accidentally touched the spirit banner; by law he deserved death, but he was beaten and released.

entries.zh: 壬辰，越王必攝獻党項俘獲之數。
entries.en: On renchen day Prince of Yue Bishe presented the count of Tangut captives taken.
entries.literal: On renchen day Prince of Yue Bishe presented the tally of Tangut captives.

entries.zh: 戊申，以青牛白馬祭天地。
entries.en: On wushen day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
entries.literal: On wushen day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

entries.zh: 辛亥，幸新城。
entries.en: On xinhai day the Emperor visited New City.
entries.literal: On xinhai day he visited New City.

entries.zh: 三月乙卯朔，復幸新城。
entries.en: On the yimao new moon of the third month the Emperor again visited New City.
entries.literal: In the third month, on the yimao new moon, he again visited New City.

entries.zh: 追封皇后祖胡母裏為韓王，贈伯胡魯古兼政事令，尼古只兼侍中。
entries.en: The empress's grandfather Humuli was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Han; bos Huolugu was granted the concurrent title Chief Councillor, and Niguzhi concurrent Palace Attendant.
entries.literal: The empress's grandfather Humuli was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Han; bos Huolugu was granted concurrent Chief Councillor, and Niguzhi concurrent Palace Attendant.

entries.zh: 夏四月丙申，白氣晝見。
entries.en: That summer, in the fourth month on bingshen day, a white vapor appeared in the daytime sky.
entries.literal: That summer, in the fourth month on bingshen day, a white vapor was seen by day.

entries.zh: 五月癸亥，於越屋質薨，輟朝三日。
entries.en: In the fifth month, on guihai day, yuyue Wuzhi died; court was suspended for three days.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, on guihai day, yuyue Wuzhi died; court was suspended for three days.

entries.zh: 辛未，女直侵邊，殺都監達裏叠、拽剌斡裏魯，驅掠邊民牛馬。
entries.en: On xinwei day the Jurchen raided the frontier, killing supervisors Daliedie and Zhuaolawuilu and seizing cattle and horses from the border population.
entries.literal: On xinwei day the Jurchen raided the border, killing supervisors Daliedie and Zhuaolawuilu and driving off the border people's cattle and horses.

entries.zh: 己卯，阿薩蘭回鶻來貢。
entries.en: On jimao day the Asalan Uighurs sent tribute.
entries.literal: On jimao day Asalan Uighur came to offer tribute.

entries.zh: 六月庚寅，女直宰相及夷離堇來朝。
entries.en: In the sixth month, on gengyin day, the Jurchen chancellor and yilijin came to court.
entries.literal: In the sixth month, on gengyin day, Jurchen chancellor and yilijin came to court.

entries.zh: 丙申，漢遣人以宋事來告。
entries.en: On bingshen day Han sent envoys to report on affairs with Song.
entries.literal: On bingshen day Han sent men to report on Song affairs.

entries.zh: 秋七月庚辰，以保大軍節度使耶律斜裏底為中臺省左相。
entries.en: That autumn, in the seventh month on gengchen day, Baoda Army Military Commissioner Yelü Xielidi was appointed Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
entries.literal: That autumn, in the seventh month on gengchen day, Baoda Army Military Commissioner Yelü Xielidi was made Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.

entries.zh: 是月，駐蹕燕子城。
entries.en: That month the court encamped at Swallow City.
entries.literal: That month the court encamped at Swallow City.

entries.zh: 九月壬子，鼻骨德部長曷魯撻覽來貢。
entries.en: In the ninth month, on renzi day, Biegude tribal chief Helutalan sent tribute.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on renzi day, Biegude tribal chief Helutalan came to offer tribute.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁酉，如南京。
entries.en: That winter, in the tenth month on dingyou day, the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.
entries.literal: That winter, in the tenth month on dingyou day, he went to the Southern Capital.

entries.zh: 十一月辛亥朔，始獲應歷逆黨近侍小哥、花哥、辛古等，誅之。
entries.en: In the eleventh month, on the xinhai new moon, Xiaoge, Huage, Xingu, and other Yingli-era rebels among the attendants were at last captured and put to death.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, on the xinhai new moon, Yingli rebels the attendant Xiaoge, Huage, Xingu, and others were at last captured and executed.

entries.zh: 十二月戊戌，漢將改元，遣使稟命。
entries.en: In the twelfth month, on wuxu day, Han planned to change its era name and sent envoys to seek imperial approval.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuxu day, Han was about to change its era name and sent envoys to report for imperial approval.

entries.zh: 是月，如歸化州。
entries.en: That month the Emperor went to Guihua Prefecture.
entries.literal: That month he went to Guihua Prefecture.

entries.zh: 六年春正月癸未，幸南京。
entries.en: In the sixth year, on guiwei day in the first spring month, the Emperor visited the Southern Capital.
entries.literal: In the sixth year, on guiwei day of the first spring month, he visited the Southern Capital.

entries.zh: 三月，宋遣使請和，以涿州刺史耶律昌朮加侍中與宋議和。
entries.en: In the third month Song sent envoys seeking peace; Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Changzhu was also made Palace Attendant to negotiate terms with Song.
entries.literal: In the third month Song sent envoys requesting peace; Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Changzhu was additionally made Palace Attendant to negotiate peace with Song.

entries.zh: 夏四月，宋王喜隱坐謀反廢。
entries.en: That summer, in the fourth month, Prince of Song Xiyin was deposed for plotting rebellion.
entries.literal: That summer, in the fourth month, Prince of Song Xiyin was deposed for plotting rebellion.

entries.zh: 秋七月丁未朔，閤門使酌古加檢校太尉兼御史大夫，男海裏以告喜隱事，遙授隴州防禦使。
entries.en: That autumn, on the dingwei new moon of the seventh month, Gate Commissioner Zhuogu was also made honorary Grand Marshal and Censor-in-Chief; his son Haili, who had reported Xiyin's conspiracy, was remotely appointed Defense Commissioner of Long Prefecture.
entries.literal: That autumn, on the dingwei new moon of the seventh month, Gate Commissioner Zhuogu was additionally made honorary Grand Marshal and Censor-in-Chief; his son Haili, who had reported Xiyin's plot, was remotely appointed Defense Commissioner of Long Prefecture.

entries.zh: 庚申，獵於平地松林。
entries.en: On gengshen day the Emperor hunted at Level Ground Pine Forest.
entries.literal: On gengshen day he hunted at Level Ground Pine Forest.

entries.zh: 冬十月乙亥朔，還上京。
entries.en: That winter, on the yihai new moon of the tenth month, the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: That winter, on the yihai new moon of the tenth month, he returned to the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 十二月戊子，以沙門照敏為三京諸道僧尼都總管，加兼侍中。
entries.en: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, the monk Zhaomin was appointed chief overseer of monks and nuns in the Three Capitals and all circuits and was also made Palace Attendant.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, the monk Zhaomin was made chief overseer of monks and nuns throughout the Three Capitals and all circuits, additionally made Palace Attendant.

entries.zh: 七年春正月甲戌朔，宋遣使來賀。
entries.en: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month, Song sent envoys to offer congratulations.
entries.literal: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month, Song sent envoys to offer congratulations.

entries.zh: 壬寅，望祠木葉山。
entries.en: On renyin day the Emperor performed the full-moon sacrifice at Mount Muye.
entries.literal: On renyin day he performed the full-moon sacrifice at Mount Muye.

entries.zh: 二月癸亥，漢雁門節度使劉繼文來朝。
entries.en: In the second month, on guihai day, Han's Yanmen Military Commissioner Liu Jiwen came to court.
entries.literal: In the second month, on guihai day, Han's Yanmen Military Commissioner Liu Jiwen came to court.

entries.zh: 貢方物。
entries.en: He presented local products in tribute.
entries.literal: He presented local products as tribute.

entries.zh: 丙寅，以青牛白馬祭天地。
entries.en: On bingyin day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
entries.literal: On bingyin day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

entries.zh: 三月壬午，耶律速撒等獻党項俘，分賜群臣。
entries.en: In the third month, on renwu day, Yelü Susa and others presented Tangut captives, which were distributed among the ministers.
entries.literal: In the third month, on renwu day, Yelü Susa and others presented Tangut captives, which were distributed as gifts among the ministers.

entries.zh: 夏四月，遣郎君矧思使宋。
entries.en: That summer, in the fourth month, langjun Shansi was dispatched as envoy to Song.
entries.literal: That summer, in the fourth month, langjun Shansi was sent as envoy to Song.

entries.zh: 己酉，祠木葉山。
entries.en: On jiyou day he offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.
entries.literal: On jiyou day, sacrificed at Mount Muye.

entries.zh: 辛亥，射柳祈雨。
entries.en: On xinhai day he performed the willow-shooting rite to pray for rain.
entries.literal: On xinhai day, shot willow to pray for rain.

entries.zh: 如頻蹕澱清暑。
entries.en: He went to Pinbi Marsh for his summer quarters.
entries.literal: He went to Pinbi Marsh to escape the summer heat.

entries.zh: 五月丙戌，祭神姑。
entries.en: On bingxu day in the fifth month he sacrificed to the divine aunt.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, on bingxu day, sacrificed to the divine aunt.

entries.zh: 秋七月，黃龍府衛將燕頗殺都監張琚以叛，遣敞史耶律曷裏必討之。
entries.en: In the seventh autumn month Huanglong Prefecture garrison officer Yan Yan killed superintendent Zhang Ju and rebelled; commissary Yelü Helibi was sent to suppress him.
entries.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Huanglong Prefecture garrison officer Yan Yan killed superintendent Zhang Ju in rebellion; commissary Yelü Helibi was dispatched to suppress him.

entries.zh: 九月，敗燕頗於治河，遣其弟安摶追之。
entries.en: In the ninth month Yan Yan was defeated at the Zhi River and his brother Anbo was dispatched in pursuit.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, Yan Yan was defeated at the Zhi River; his brother Anbo was sent in pursuit.

entries.zh: 燕頗走保兀惹城，安摶乃還，以餘黨千餘戶城通州。
entries.en: Yan Yan fled and held Wurena city; Anbo then withdrew, and more than a thousand households of the remnant force were settled behind walls at Tong Prefecture.
entries.literal: Yan Yan fled and held Wurena city; Anbo then returned, and over a thousand households of the remnant force were walled at Tong Prefecture.

entries.zh: 是秋，至自頻蹕澱。
entries.en: That autumn he returned from Pinbi Marsh.
entries.literal: That autumn, returned from Pinbi Marsh.

entries.zh: 冬十月，鉤魚土河。
entries.en: In the tenth winter month he ice-fished on the Tu River.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, ice-fished on the Tu River.

entries.zh: 八年春正月癸酉，宋遣使來聘。
entries.en: In the eighth year, on guiyou day in the first spring month, Song sent envoys on a diplomatic visit.
entries.literal: In the eighth year, on guiyou day in the first month of spring, Song sent envoys on a visit.

entries.zh: 二月壬寅，諭史館學士，書皇后言亦稱「朕」暨「予」，著為定式。
entries.en: On renyin day in the second month he instructed the Hanlin academicians that in official records the empress's pronouncements were also to use "I" — both zhen and yu — and this was established as fixed convention.
entries.literal: In the second month, on renyin day, instructed Hanlin academicians that in writing the empress's words also use "I" (zhen and yu), establishing this as fixed form.

entries.zh: 三月辛未，遣五使廉問四方鰥寡孤獨及貧乏失職者，振之。
entries.en: On xinwei day in the third month he dispatched five envoys to inquire throughout the realm after widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary, as well as the poor who had lost their positions, and granted them relief.
entries.literal: In the third month, on xinwei day, dispatched five envoys to inquire throughout the four directions after widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, and those impoverished who had lost office, and relieved them.

entries.zh: 夏六月，以西南面招討使耶律斜軫為北院大王。
entries.en: In the sixth summer month Southwest circuit pacification commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was appointed Northern Court Great King.
entries.literal: In the sixth month of summer, Southwest circuit pacification commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was made Northern Court Great King.

entries.zh: 秋七月丙寅朔，寧王只沒妻安只伏誅，只沒、高勛等除名。
entries.en: On bingyin day, the first of the seventh autumn month, Prince of Ning Zhimel's wife Anzhi was executed and Zhimel, Gao Xun, and others were removed from office.
entries.literal: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, bingyin day, Prince of Ning Zhimel's wife Anzhi was executed; Zhimel, Gao Xun, and others were struck from the rolls.

entries.zh: 辛未，宋遣使來賀天清節。
entries.en: On xinwei day Song sent envoys to offer congratulations on the Tianqing Festival.
entries.literal: On xinwei day, Song sent envoys to congratulate the Tianqing Festival.

entries.zh: 八月癸卯，漢遣使言天清節設無遮會，飯僧祝釐。
entries.en: On guimao day in the eighth month Han sent envoys reporting that for the Tianqing Festival they had held an unbounded assembly, fed the monks, and prayed for blessings.
entries.literal: In the eighth month, on guimao day, Han sent envoys saying that for the Tianqing Festival they held an unbounded assembly, fed monks, and prayed for blessings.

entries.zh: 丁未，如秋山。
entries.en: On dingwei day he went to Autumn Mountain.
entries.literal: On dingwei day, went to Autumn Mountain.

entries.zh: 己酉，漢以宋事來告。
entries.en: On jiyou day Han sent word reporting developments in Song affairs.
entries.literal: On jiyou day, Han came reporting Song affairs.

entries.zh: 是月，女直侵貴德州東境。
entries.en: That month Jurchen raided the eastern border of Guide Prefecture.
entries.literal: That month, Jurchen invaded the eastern border of Guide Prefecture.

entries.zh: 九月己巳，謁懷陵。
entries.en: On jisi day in the ninth month he visited Huai Mausoleum.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on jisi day, visited Huai Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 辛未，東京統軍使察鄰、詳穩涸奏女直襲歸州五寨，剽掠而去。
entries.en: On xinwei day Eastern Capital garrison commander Chalin and xiangwen He reported that Jurchen had struck five stockades in Gui Prefecture and withdrawn after plundering.
entries.literal: On xinwei day, Eastern Capital garrison commander Chalin and xiangwen He reported Jurchen attacked five stockades of Gui Prefecture and raided away.

entries.zh: 乙亥，鼻骨德來貢。
entries.en: On yihai day the Biegude brought tribute.
entries.literal: On yihai day, Biegude came with tribute.

entries.zh: 壬午，漢為宋人所侵，遣使求援，命南府宰相耶律沙、冀王敵烈赴之。
entries.en: On renwu day Han, under attack by Song, sent envoys begging aid; Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha and Prince of Ji Dilie were ordered to march to their relief.
entries.literal: On renwu day, Han being invaded by Song sent envoys seeking aid; Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha and Prince of Ji Delie were ordered to go.

entries.zh: 戊子，漢以宋師壓境，遣駙馬都尉盧俊來告。
entries.en: On wuzi day Han reported that Song troops were pressing the frontier and sent imperial son-in-law commander Lu Jun to notify the court.
entries.literal: On wuzi day, Han reported Song army pressing the border; imperial son-in-law commander Lu Jun was sent to inform.

entries.zh: 冬十月辛丑，漢以遼師退宋軍來謝。
entries.en: On xinchou day in the tenth winter month Han sent envoys to thank the court after Liao troops had driven back the Song army.
entries.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinchou day, Han came to thank because Liao army drove back Song army.

entries.zh: 十一月丙子，宋主匡胤殂，其弟炅自立，遣使來告。
entries.en: On bingzi day in the eleventh month Song ruler Zhao Kuangyin died; his brother Zhao Kuangyi took the throne himself and sent envoys to announce the fact.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingzi day, Song ruler Zhao Kuangyin died; his brother Zhao Kuangyi seized the throne and sent envoys to announce.

entries.zh: 辛卯，遣郎君王六、撻馬涅木古等使宋吊慰。
entries.en: On xinmao day langjun Wang Liu, tamasa Niemugu, and others were dispatched to Song to offer mourning condolences.
entries.literal: On xinmao day, dispatched langjun Wang Liu, tamasa Niemugu, and others as envoys to Song for condolences.

entries.zh: 十二月壬寅，遣蕭只古、馬哲賀宋即位。
entries.en: On renyin day in the twelfth month Xiao Zhigu and Ma Zhe were sent to congratulate Song on the new ruler's accession.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on renyin day, dispatched Xiao Zhigu and Ma Zhe to congratulate Song on accession.

entries.zh: 丁未，漢以宋軍復至掠其軍儲來告。
entries.en: On dingwei day Han reported that Song troops had again crossed the border and stripped their military stores.
entries.literal: On dingwei day, Han reported Song army again arrived and plundered their military stores.

entries.zh: 且乞賜糧為助。
entries.en: They also begged grain as assistance.
entries.literal: And requested grain as aid.

entries.zh: 戊午，詔南京復禮部貢院。
entries.en: On wuwu day an edict ordered the restoration of the Ministry of Rites examination hall at Nanjing.
entries.literal: On wuwu day, edict restored Ministry of Rites examination hall at Nanjing.

entries.zh: 是月，轄戛斯國遣使來貢。
entries.en: That month envoys from Kirghiz arrived with tribute.
entries.literal: That month, Kirghiz sent envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 景宗下九年春正月丙寅，女直遣使來貢。
entries.en: Jingzong, Part Two. In the ninth year, on bingyin day of the first spring month, the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: Jingzong, Part Two. In the ninth year, spring, first month, on bingyin day, Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 二月庚子，宋遣使致其先帝遺物。
entries.en: On gengzi day in the second month Song sent envoys bearing relics of their deceased emperor.
entries.literal: In the second month, on gengzi day, Song sent envoys presenting relics of their late emperor.

entries.zh: 甲寅，以青牛白馬祭天地。
entries.en: On jiayin day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
entries.literal: On jiayin day, a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

entries.zh: 贊曰：遼興六十餘年，神冊、會同之間，日不暇給；
entries.en: Appraisal: In more than sixty years since Liao's founding, from Shence through Huitong, the court knew no day of rest;
entries.literal: Appraisal: In over sixty years since Liao's rise, between the Shence and Huitong reigns, there was no day with spare time;

entries.zh: 天祿、應歷之君，不令其終；
entries.en: The Tianlu and Yingli emperors were not permitted to finish their reigns;
entries.literal: The rulers of Tianlu and Yingli did not end their reigns as ordained;

entries.zh: 保寧而來，人人望治。
entries.en: From the Baoning era onward, everyone looked for stable rule.
entries.literal: Since Baoning, every person hoped for good governance.

entries.zh: 以景宗之資，任人不疑，信賞必罰，若可與有為也。
entries.en: Jingzong had the makings of a capable ruler: he employed men without suspicion and matched reward to merit and punishment to fault, so that great things seemed within reach.
entries.literal: With Jingzong's endowment, employing men without doubt, rewarding faithfulness and punishing surely, it seemed one could accomplish great things with him.

entries.zh: 而竭國之力以助河東，破軍殺將，無救滅亡。
entries.en: Yet he drained the state's strength to aid Hedong, breaking armies and losing generals without preventing Han's extinction.
entries.literal: Yet he exhausted the state's strength to aid Hedong; armies were broken and generals killed, without saving them from extinction.

entries.zh: 雖一取償於宋，得不償失。
entries.en: Though he won one reckoning from Song, the gains did not offset the losses.
entries.literal: Though he took one compensation from Song, the gain did not repay the loss.

entries.zh: 知匡嗣之罪，數而不罰；
entries.en: He knew Kuangsi's guilt, listed his crimes, yet withheld punishment;
entries.literal: Knowing Kuangsi's offenses, he enumerated them but did not punish;

entries.zh: 善郭襲之諫，納而不用；
entries.en: He praised Guo Xi's remonstrance, accepted it in word but ignored it in deed;
entries.literal: He approved Guo Xi's remonstrance, accepted it but did not use it;

entries.zh: 沙門昭敏以左道亂德，寵以侍中。
entries.en: The monk Zhaomin led men astray with heterodox practices, yet was favored with the post of Palace Attendant.
entries.literal: The monk Zhaomin, by heterodox ways corrupting virtue, was favored with the post of Palace Attendant.

entries.zh: 不亦惑乎！
entries.en: Was this not a bewildering way to govern?
entries.literal: Is this not confused judgment!

entries.zh: 四年春正月己亥，如華林、天柱。
entries.en: In the fourth year, on jihai day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Hualin and Tianzhu.
entries.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on jihai day, he went to Hualin and Tianzhu.

entries.zh: 三月乙未，清明，與諸王大臣較射，宴飲。
entries.en: On yiwei day in the third month, at Qingming, the Emperor competed in archery with princes and ministers and held a feast.
entries.literal: In the third month, on yiwei day, at the Qingming festival, he competed in archery with princes and ministers and feasted.

entries.zh: 夏四月，自將南伐。
entries.en: In the fourth summer month the Emperor personally led a southern campaign.
entries.literal: In summer, fourth month, he personally led troops south on campaign.

entries.zh: 至滿城，戰不利，守太尉奚瓦里中流矢死。
entries.en: At Mancheng the battle went badly; Defender-in-Chief Xi Wali was hit by a stray arrow and died.
entries.literal: Reaching Mancheng, the battle went badly; Defender-in-Chief Xi Wali was struck by a flying arrow and died.

entries.zh: 統軍使善補為伏兵所圍，樞密使斜軫救免，詔以失備杖之。
entries.en: Army commander Shanbu was trapped by ambushers; Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen rescued him, and an edict ordered him flogged for failing to stay alert.
entries.literal: Army commander Shanbu was surrounded by ambush troops; Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen rescued him, and an edict ordered him caned for inadequate preparedness.

entries.zh: 五月，班師。
entries.en: In the fifth month the army withdrew from the campaign.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, the army withdrew.

entries.zh: 清暑燕子城。
entries.en: The Emperor took his summer quarters at Swallow City.
entries.literal: He escaped the summer heat at Swallow City.

entries.zh: 秋七月壬辰，遣使賜喜隱死。
entries.en: On renchen day in the seventh autumn month envoys were sent to order Xiyin put to death.
entries.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on renchen day, envoys were dispatched ordering Xiyin to death.

entries.zh: 八月，如西京。
entries.en: In the eighth month the Emperor went to the Western Capital.
entries.literal: In the eighth month, he went to the Western Capital.

entries.zh: 九月庚子，幸雲州。
entries.en: On gengzi day in the ninth month the Emperor visited Yunzhou.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, he visited Yunzhou.

entries.zh: 甲辰，獵於祥古山，帝不豫。
entries.en: On jiachen day the Emperor hunted at Xianggu Mountain and fell ill.
entries.literal: On jiachen day, he hunted at Xianggu Mountain; the Emperor fell ill.

entries.zh: 壬子，次焦山，崩於行在。
entries.en: On renzi day the court halted at Jiaoshan, and the Emperor died at the traveling palace.
entries.literal: On renzi day, he halted at Jiaoshan and died at the traveling palace.

entries.zh: 年三十五，在位十三年。
entries.en: He was thirty-five years old and had reigned for thirteen years.
entries.literal: He was thirty-five years old and had reigned thirteen years.

entries.zh: 遺詔梁王隆緒嗣位，軍國大事聽皇后命。
entries.en: His testamentary edict named Prince of Liang Longxu successor, and military and state affairs were to follow the Empress's orders.
entries.literal: His testamentary edict made Prince of Liang Longxu his successor; military and state affairs were to follow the Empress's command.

entries.zh: 統和元年正月壬戌，上尊謚孝成皇帝，廟號景宗。
entries.en: In the first year of Tonghe, on renxu day of the first month, the court bestowed the posthumous title Xiaocheng Emperor and the temple name Jingzong.
entries.literal: In the first year of Tonghe, first month, on renxu day, the posthumous honorific title Xiaocheng Emperor was bestowed and the temple name Jingzong was announced.

entries.zh: 重熙二十一年，加謚孝成康靖皇帝。
entries.en: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi the posthumous title was augmented to Xiaocheng Kangjing Emperor.
entries.literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi, the posthumous title was augmented to Xiaocheng Kangjing Emperor.

entries.zh: 鵩二年春正月丙子朔，封皇子隆緒為梁王，隆慶為恒王。
entries.en: In the second year of Qianheng, on the bingzi new moon of the first spring month, the princes Longxu and Longqing were enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Prince of Heng respectively.
entries.literal: In the second year of Qianheng, spring, first month, on bingzi day the new moon, the imperial son Longxu was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Longqing as Prince of Heng.

entries.zh: 丁亥，以惕隱休哥為北院大王，前樞密使賢適封西平郡王。
entries.en: On dinghai day tithen Xiuge was appointed Northern Court Great King, and former Commissioner of Military Affairs Xianshi was enfeoffed Prince of Xiping commandery.
entries.literal: On dinghai day, tithen Xiuge was made Northern Court Great King, and former Commissioner of Military Affairs Xianshi was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiping commandery.

entries.zh: 二月戊辰，如清河。
entries.en: On wuchen day in the second month the Emperor went to Qing River.
entries.literal: In the second month, on wuchen day, he went to Qing River.

entries.zh: 三月丁亥，西南面招討副使耶律王六、太尉化哥遣人獻党項俘。
entries.en: On dinghai day in the third month Southwest Route pacification vice-commissioner Yelü Wangliu and Grand Commandant Huage sent men with Tangut prisoners.
entries.literal: In the third month, on dinghai day, Southwest Route pacification vice-commissioner Yelü Wangliu and Grand Commandant Huage sent men presenting Tangut captives.

entries.zh: 閏月庚午，有鴇飛止禦帳，獲以祭天。
entries.en: On gengwu day in the intercalary month a bustard flew down onto the imperial tent, was captured, and offered in sacrifice to heaven.
entries.literal: In the intercalary month, on gengwu day, a bustard flew and alighted on the imperial tent; it was taken and used to sacrifice to heaven.

entries.zh: 夏四月庚辰，祈雨。
entries.en: On gengchen day in the fourth summer month the court prayed for rain.
entries.literal: In summer, fourth month, on gengchen day, prayer was made for rain.

entries.zh: 戊子，清暑燕子城。
entries.en: On wuzi day the Emperor took his summer quarters at Swallow City.
entries.literal: On wuzi day, he escaped the summer heat at Swallow City.

entries.zh: 五月，雷火乾陵松。
entries.en: In the fifth month lightning struck and burned a pine at Qian Mausoleum.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, lightning set fire to a pine at Qian Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 六月己亥，喜隱復謀反，囚於祖州。
entries.en: On jihai day in the sixth month Xiyin plotted rebellion again and was imprisoned at Zuzhou.
entries.literal: In the sixth month, on jihai day, Xiyin again plotted rebellion and was imprisoned at Zuzhou.

entries.zh: 秋七月戊午，王六等獻党項俘。
entries.en: On wuwu day in the seventh autumn month Wangliu and the others presented Tangut prisoners.
entries.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on wuwu day, Wangliu and others presented Tangut captives.

entries.zh: 八月戊戌，東幸。
entries.en: On wuxu day in the eighth month the Emperor traveled east.
entries.literal: In the eighth month, on wuxu day, he traveled east.

entries.zh: 冬十月辛未朔，命巫者祠天地及兵神。
entries.en: On the xinwei new moon of the tenth winter month shamans were ordered to sacrifice to heaven and earth and the god of war.
entries.literal: In winter, tenth month, on xinwei day the new moon, shamans were ordered to sacrifice to heaven and earth and the god of war.

entries.zh: 辛巳，將南伐，祭旗鼓。
entries.en: On xinsi day, preparing to march south, the Emperor sacrificed to the campaign banners and drums.
entries.literal: On xinsi day, about to campaign south, he sacrificed to banners and drums.

entries.zh: 癸未，次南京。
entries.en: On guiwei day the court halted at Nanjing.
entries.literal: On guiwei day, he halted at Nanjing.

entries.zh: 丁亥，獲敵人，射鬼箭。
entries.en: On dinghai day a captive was taken and the ghost-arrow rite performed.
entries.literal: On dinghai day, an enemy captive was taken and the ghost-arrow rite performed.

entries.zh: 庚寅，次固安，以青牛白馬祭天地。
entries.en: On gengyin day the court halted at Gu'an and sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
entries.literal: On gengyin day, he halted at Gu'an and sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

entries.zh: 己亥，圍瓦橋關。
entries.en: On jihai day the army besieged Waqiao Pass.
entries.literal: On jihai day, Waqiao Pass was besieged.

entries.zh: 十一月庚子朔，宋兵夜襲營，突呂不部節度使蕭幹及四捷軍詳穩耶律痕德戰卻之。
entries.en: On the gengzi new moon of the eleventh month Song forces raided the camp by night; Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Xiao Gan and Four Victorious Army xiangwen Yelü Hende beat them back.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day the new moon, Song troops raided the camp by night; Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Xiao Gan and Four Victorious Army xiangwen Yelü Hende fought them off.

entries.zh: 壬寅，休哥敗宋兵於瓦橋東，守將張師引兵出戰，休哥奮擊，敗之。
entries.en: On renyin day Xiuge routed Song east of Waqiao; when the garrison commander Zhang Shi sallied forth, Xiuge attacked fiercely and put his force to flight.
entries.literal: On renyin day, Xiuge defeated Song troops east of Waqiao; the defending general Zhang Shi led troops out to fight, and Xiuge struck fiercely and routed them.

entries.zh: 戊申，宋兵陣於水南，休哥涉水擊破之，追至莫州，殺傷甚眾。
entries.en: On wushen day Song drew up south of the river; Xiuge waded across, shattered their line, and pursued to Mozhou, inflicting heavy casualties.
entries.literal: On wushen day, Song troops formed battle lines south of the water; Xiuge crossed the water, broke them, and pursued to Mozhou, killing and wounding very many.

entries.zh: 己酉，宋兵復來，擊之殆盡。
entries.en: On jiyou day Song forces returned and were attacked until nearly wiped out.
entries.literal: On jiyou day, Song troops came again and were struck until nearly annihilated.

entries.zh: 丙辰，班師。
entries.en: On bingchen day the army withdrew from the campaign.
entries.literal: On bingchen day, the army withdrew.

entries.zh: 乙丑，還次南京。
entries.en: On yichou day the Emperor returned and encamped at Nanjing.
entries.literal: On yichou day, he returned and halted at Nanjing.

entries.zh: 十二月庚午朔，休哥拜於越。
entries.en: On the gengwu new moon of the twelfth month Xiuge was invested as yuyue.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengwu day the new moon, Xiuge was made yuyue.

entries.zh: 大饗軍士。
entries.en: The court held a great feast for the troops.
entries.literal: A great feast for the troops was held.

entries.zh: 鵩十年春正月癸丑，如長濼。
entries.en: In the tenth year, on guichou day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Chang Marsh.
entries.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on guichou day, he went to Chang Marsh.

entries.zh: 二月庚午，阿薩蘭回鶻來貢。
entries.en: On gengwu day in the second month the Asalan Uighurs sent tribute.
entries.literal: In the second month, on gengwu day, Asalan Uighur came with tribute.

entries.zh: 三月庚寅，祭顯陵。
entries.en: On gengyin day in the third month the court sacrificed at Xian Mausoleum.
entries.literal: In the third month, on gengyin day, sacrifice was performed at Xian Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 夏四月丁卯，西幸。
entries.en: On dingmao day in the fourth summer month the Emperor traveled west.
entries.literal: In summer, fourth month, on dingmao day, he traveled west.

entries.zh: 己巳，女直遣使來貢。
entries.en: On jisi day the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: On jisi day, Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 五月癸卯，賜女裏死，遣人誅高勛等。
entries.en: On guimao day in the fifth month Nüli was put to death and agents were sent to execute Gao Xun and his associates.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, on guimao day, Nüli was granted death; men were dispatched to execute Gao Xun and others.

entries.zh: 六月己未，駐蹕沿柳湖。
entries.en: On jiwei day in the sixth month the court made camp at Willow Lake.
entries.literal: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the court halted at Willow Lake.

entries.zh: 秋七月庚戌，享太祖廟。
entries.en: On gengxu day in the seventh autumn month the court offered sacrifice at Taizu Temple.
entries.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengxu day, sacrifice was offered at Taizu Temple.

entries.zh: 九月癸未朔，平王隆先子陳哥謀害其父，車裂以徇。
entries.en: On the guiwei new moon of the ninth month Chenge, son of Prince of Ping Longxian, plotted to murder his father and was torn apart by carts as a public warning.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on guiwei day the new moon, Prince of Ping Longxian's son Chenge plotted to kill his father; he was dismembered by cart and displayed.

entries.zh: 是冬，駐蹕金川。
entries.en: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Jinchuan.
entries.literal: That winter, the court encamped at Jinchuan.

entries.zh: 鵩乾亨元年春正月乙酉，遣撻馬長壽使宋，問興師伐劉繼元之故。
entries.en: In the first year of Qianheng, on yiyou day of the first spring month, tamasa Changshou was sent to Song to demand an explanation for mobilizing against Liu Jiyuan.
entries.literal: In the first year of Qianheng, spring, first month, on yiyou day, tamasa Changshou was dispatched as envoy to Song to ask the reason for raising troops against Liu Jiyuan.

entries.zh: 丙申，長壽還，言「河東朔命，所當問罪。
entries.en: On bingshen day Changshou returned and reported, "The Hedong regime must answer for its offenses.
entries.literal: On bingshen day, Changshou returned and said, "The mandate of Hedong must be called to account.

entries.zh: 若北朝不援，和約如舊，不然則戰。」
entries.en: If the Northern Court refuses aid, the old treaty still stands; if not, we fight."
entries.literal: If the Northern Court does not aid us, the peace treaty remains as before; otherwise there will be war."

entries.zh: 二月丁卯，漢以宋兵壓境，遣使乞援。
entries.en: In the second month, on dingmao day, Han sent envoys begging relief, reporting that Song armies were pressing the frontier.
entries.literal: In the second month, on dingmao day, Han, with Song troops pressing the border, sent envoys begging aid.

entries.zh: 詔南府宰相耶律沙為都統、冀王敵烈為監軍赴之；
entries.en: An edict named Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha commander-in-chief and Prince of Ji Delie army supervisor and ordered them to march to Han's relief;
entries.literal: An edict appointed Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha as commander-in-chief and Prince of Ji Delie as army supervisor to go to their aid;

entries.zh: 又命南院大王斜軫以所部從，樞密副使抹只督之。
entries.en: Southern Court Great King Xiezhen was also commanded to follow with his troops, under the supervision of Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Mochi.
entries.literal: Southern Court Great King Xiezhen was also ordered to follow with his command, and Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Mochi to supervise them.

entries.zh: 三月辛巳，速撒遣人以別部化哥等降，納之。
entries.en: On xinsi day in the third month Susa reported that Huage and other chiefs of a detached division had submitted, and they were received.
entries.literal: In the third month, on xinsi day, Susa sent men reporting that chieftains of a separate division, Huage and others, had surrendered; they were accepted.

entries.zh: 丙戌，漢遣使謝撫諭軍民，詔北院大王奚底、乙室王撒合等以兵戍燕。
entries.en: On bingxu day Han sent envoys thanking the court for reassuring troops and civilians; an edict ordered Northern Court Great King Xidi, Prince of Yishi Sahe, and others to garrison Yan.
entries.literal: On bingxu day, Han sent envoys thanking the court for comforting army and people; an edict ordered Northern Court Great King Xidi, Prince of Yishi Sahe, and others to garrison Yan with troops.

entries.zh: 己丑，漢復告宋兵入境，詔左千牛衛大將軍韓侼、大同軍節度使耶律善補以本路兵南援。
entries.en: On jichou day Han again reported a Song incursion; an edict ordered Left Thousand-Ox Guard General Han Zhuo and Datong Army Military Commissioner Yelü Shanbu to lead their circuit forces south to reinforce.
entries.literal: On jichou day, Han again reported Song troops entering the border; an edict ordered Left Thousand-Ox Guard General Han Zhuo and Datong Army Military Commissioner Yelü Shanbu to lead their circuit troops south in relief.

entries.zh: 辛卯，女直遣使來貢。
entries.en: On xinmao day the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.
entries.literal: On xinmao day, Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 丁酉，耶律沙等與宋戰於白馬嶺，不利，冀王敵烈及突呂不部節度使都敏、黃皮室詳穩唐筈皆死之，士卒死傷甚眾。
entries.en: On dingyou day Yelü Sha and the others battled Song at White Horse Ridge and were defeated; Prince of Ji Delie, Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Du Min, and Yellow Pishi xiangwen Tang Kuo were killed, and casualties among the troops were very heavy.
entries.literal: On dingyou day, Yelü Sha and others fought Song at White Horse Ridge with an unfavorable outcome; Prince of Ji Delie, Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Du Min, and Yellow Pishi xiangwen Tang Kuo all died, and soldiers were killed and wounded in great numbers.

entries.zh: 夏四月辛亥，漢以行軍事宜來奏，盧俊自代州馳狀告急。
entries.en: On xinhai day in the fourth summer month Han submitted reports on the campaign, and Lu Jun galloped from Daizhou with an emergency dispatch.
entries.literal: In summer, fourth month, on xinhai day, Han memorialized on campaign affairs; Lu Jun raced from Daizhou with an urgent report.

entries.zh: 辛酉，敵烈來貢。
entries.en: On xinyou day Delie arrived with tribute.
entries.literal: On xinyou day, Delie came with tribute.

entries.zh: 五月己卯朔，宋兵至河東，漢與戰，不利，劉繼文、盧俊來奔。
entries.en: On the jimao new moon of the fifth month Song armies reached Hedong; Han fought them and was beaten, and Liu Jiwen and Lu Jun came over in flight.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao day the new moon, Song troops reached Hedong; Han fought them with an unfavorable outcome, and Liu Jiwen and Lu Jun fled to submit.

entries.zh: 六月，劉繼元降宋，漢亡。
entries.en: In the sixth month Liu Jiyuan surrendered to Song and the state of Han was extinguished.
entries.literal: In the sixth month, Liu Jiyuan surrendered to Song and Han perished.

entries.zh: 甲子，封劉繼文為彭城郡王，盧俊同政事門下平章事。
entries.en: On jiazi day Liu Jiwen was enfeoffed Prince of Pengcheng commandery and Lu Jun was made co-director of the Secretariat with the rank of co-chancellor under the Gate.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, Liu Jiwen was enfeoffed as Prince of Pengcheng commandery and Lu Jun made co-director of the Secretariat and co-chancellor under the Gate.

entries.zh: 宋主來侵。
entries.en: The Song emperor marched to invade.
entries.literal: The Song ruler came to invade.

entries.zh: 丁卯，北院大王奚底、統軍使蕭討古、乙室王撒合擊之。
entries.en: On dingmao day Northern Court Great King Xidi, army commander Xiao Taogu, and Prince of Yishi Sahe moved to intercept them.
entries.literal: On dingmao day, Northern Court Great King Xidi, army commander Xiao Taogu, and Prince of Yishi Sahe struck them.

entries.zh: 戰於沙河，失利。
entries.en: They engaged at Sha River and were defeated.
entries.literal: They fought at Sha River and suffered defeat.

entries.zh: 己巳，宋主圍南京。
entries.en: On jisi day the Song emperor laid siege to Nanjing.
entries.literal: On jisi day, the Song ruler besieged Nanjing.

entries.zh: 丁丑，詔諭耶律沙及奚底、討古等軍中事宜。
entries.en: On dingchou day an edict addressed Yelü Sha, Xidi, Taogu, and the other commanders on conduct of the campaign.
entries.literal: On dingchou day, an edict instructed Yelü Sha and Xidi, Taogu, and others on army affairs.

entries.zh: 秋七月癸未，沙等及宋兵戰於高梁河，少卻；
entries.en: On guiwei day in the seventh autumn month Sha and his forces fought Song at Gaoliang River and briefly fell back;
entries.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on guiwei day, Sha and the others fought Song troops at Gaoliang River and briefly gave ground;

entries.zh: 休哥、斜軫橫擊，大敗之。
entries.en: Xiuge and Xiezhen then struck from the flank and routed the Song army.
entries.literal: Xiuge and Xiezhen struck from the flank and routed them completely.

entries.zh: 宋主僅以身免，至涿州，竊乘驢車遁去。
entries.en: The Song emperor barely escaped with his life; reaching Zhuozhou, he slipped away secretly in a donkey cart.
entries.literal: The Song ruler barely escaped with his life; reaching Zhuozhou, he secretly fled away in a donkey cart.

entries.zh: 甲申，擊宋餘軍，所殺甚眾，獲兵仗、器甲、符印、糧饋、貨幣不可勝計。
entries.en: On jiashen day the remaining Song forces were attacked; the slaughter was immense, and arms, armor, seals, provisions, and booty taken were beyond reckoning.
entries.literal: On jiashen day, the remaining Song troops were struck down; those killed were very numerous, and weapons, armor, tally-seals, grain, and goods captured were beyond counting.

entries.zh: 辛丑，耶律沙遣人上俘獲，以權知南京留守事韓德讓、權南京馬步軍都指揮使耶律學古、知三司事劉弘皆能安人心，捍城池，並賜詔褒獎。
entries.en: On xinchou day Yelü Sha sent up prisoners; edicts commended Han Derang, acting Nanjing regent, Yelü Xuegu, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander, and Liu Hong, director of the Three Departments, for steadying morale and holding the city.
entries.literal: On xinchou day, Yelü Sha sent men presenting captives; because acting Nanjing regent Han Derang, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander Yelü Xuegu, and Director of the Three Departments Liu Hong had all been able to steady hearts and defend the walls, edicts of praise and reward were granted to each.

entries.zh: 八月壬子，阻卜惕隱曷魯、夷離堇阿裏睹等來朝。
entries.en: On renzi day in the eighth month Zubu tithen Helu, yilijin Alidu, and others came to court.
entries.literal: In the eighth month, on renzi day, Zubu tithen Helu, yilijin Alidu, and others came to court.

entries.zh: 乙丑，耶律沙等獻俘。
entries.en: On yichou day Yelü Sha and the others presented prisoners.
entries.literal: On yichou day, Yelü Sha and others presented captives.

entries.zh: 丙寅，以白馬之役責沙、抹只，復以走宋主功釋之；
entries.en: On bingyin day Sha and Mochi were censured for White Horse Ridge but pardoned for their success in driving off the Song emperor;
entries.literal: On bingyin day, Sha and Mochi were blamed for the White Horse campaign yet released on account of driving off the Song ruler;

entries.zh: 奚底遇敵而退，以劍背擊之；
entries.en: Xidi, who had retreated before the enemy, was beaten with the flat of a sword;
entries.literal: Xidi, meeting the enemy, withdrew and was struck with the flat of a sword;

entries.zh: 撒合雖卻，部伍不亂，宥之；
entries.en: Sahe, though forced back, kept his formation intact and was forgiven;
entries.literal: Sahe, though he had fallen back, kept his ranks unbroken and was pardoned;

entries.zh: 冀王敵烈麾下先遁者斬之，都監以下杖之。
entries.en: under Prince of Ji Delie the first to flee were beheaded, and from army supervisor downward offenders were flogged.
entries.literal: under Prince of Ji Delie those who fled first were beheaded, and from army supervisor downward they were caned.

entries.zh: 壬申，宴沙、抹只等將校，賜物有差。
entries.en: On renshen day Sha, Mochi, and the other commanders were banqueted and rewarded according to rank.
entries.literal: On renshen day, Sha, Mochi, and other officers were feasted and gifts were granted in differing amounts.

entries.zh: 九月己卯，燕王韓匡嗣為都統，南府宰相耶律沙為監軍，惕隱休哥、南院大王斜軫、權奚王抹只等各率所部兵南伐；
entries.en: On jimao day in the ninth month Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was named commander-in-chief, Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha army supervisor, and tithen Xiuge, Southern Court Great King Xiezhen, acting Xi King Mochi, and others were each ordered south with their commands;
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on jimao day, Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was made commander-in-chief, Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha army supervisor, tithen Xiuge, Southern Court Great King Xiezhen, acting Xi King Mochi, and others each leading their troops south on campaign;

entries.zh: 仍命大同軍節度使善補領山西兵分道以進。
entries.en: Datong Army Military Commissioner Shanbu was also commanded to lead Shanxi forces forward by separate routes.
entries.literal: Datong Army Military Commissioner Shanbu was still ordered to lead Shanxi troops advancing by separate routes.

entries.zh: 冬十月乙丑，韓匡嗣與宋兵戰於滿城，敗績。
entries.en: On yichou day in the tenth winter month Han Kuangsi fought Song at Mancheng and suffered defeat.
entries.literal: In winter, tenth month, on yichou day, Han Kuangsi fought Song troops at Mancheng and was defeated.

entries.zh: 辛未，太保矧思與宋兵戰於火山，敗之。
entries.en: On xinwei day Grand Guardian Shensi fought Song at Huoshan and routed them.
entries.literal: On xinwei day, Grand Guardian Shensi fought Song troops at Huoshan and defeated them.

entries.zh: 乙亥，詔數韓匡嗣五罪，赦之。
entries.en: On yihai day an edict listed five crimes of Han Kuangsi and then pardoned him.
entries.literal: On yihai day, an edict enumerated five offenses of Han Kuangsi and pardoned him.

entries.zh: 十一月戊寅，宴賞休哥及有功將校。
entries.en: On wuyin day in the eleventh month Xiuge and other officers who had earned merit were banqueted and rewarded.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuyin day, Xiuge and meritorious officers were feasted and rewarded.

entries.zh: 乙未，南院樞密使兼政事令郭襲上書諫畋獵，嘉納之。
entries.en: On yiwei day Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Guo Xi memorialized against the hunt, and the counsel was praised and heeded.
entries.literal: On yiwei day, Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Guo Xi submitted a memorial remonstrating against hunting; it was praised and accepted.

entries.zh: 辛丑，冬至，赦，改元乾亨。
entries.en: On xinchou day, the winter solstice, the court proclaimed an amnesty and changed the era name to Qianheng.
entries.literal: On xinchou day, the winter solstice, an amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Qianheng.

entries.zh: 十二月乙卯，燕王韓匡嗣遙授晉昌軍節度使，降封秦王。
entries.en: On yimao day in the twelfth month Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was remotely made Jinchang Army Military Commissioner and reduced in rank to Prince of Qin.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on yimao day, Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was remotely appointed Jinchang Army Military Commissioner and demoted to Prince of Qin.

entries.zh: 壬戌，蜀王道隱南京留守，徙封荊王。
entries.en: On renxu day Prince of Shu Daoyin, Nanjing regent, was transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Jing.
entries.literal: On renxu day, Prince of Shu Daoyin was Nanjing regent and was transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Jing.

entries.zh: 是冬，駐蹕南京。
entries.en: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Nanjing.
entries.literal: That winter, the court encamped at Nanjing.

entries.zh: 三年春二月丙子，東幸。
entries.en: In the third year, on bingzi day of the second spring month, the Emperor traveled east.
entries.literal: In the third year, spring, second month, on bingzi day, he traveled east.

entries.zh: 己丑，復幸南京。
entries.en: On jichou day he again went to Nanjing.
entries.literal: On jichou day, he again went to Nanjing.

entries.zh: 三月乙卯，皇子韓八卒。
entries.en: On yimao day in the third month Prince Han Ba died.
entries.literal: In the third month, on yimao day, Prince Han Ba died.

entries.zh: 辛酉，葬潢、土二河之間，置永州。
entries.en: On xinyou day the prince was buried between the Huang and Tu rivers and Yongzhou was established.
entries.literal: On xinyou day, he was buried between the Huang and Tu rivers, and Yongzhou was established.

entries.zh: 以秦王韓匡嗣為西南面招討使。
entries.en: Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi was appointed Southwest Route pacification commissioner.
entries.literal: Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi was made Southwest Route pacification commissioner.

entries.zh: 夏五月丙午，上京漢軍亂，劫立喜隱不克，偽立其子留禮壽，上京留守除室擒之。
entries.en: On bingwu day in the fifth summer month Han troops at Shangjing rebelled; failing to install Xiyin by force, they spuriously enthroned his son Liulishou, whom Shangjing regent Chushi captured.
entries.literal: In summer, fifth month, on bingwu day, Han troops at Shangjing rebelled; attempting to install Xiyin by force they failed, spuriously enthroned his son Liulishou, and Shangjing regent Chushi captured him.

entries.zh: 秋七月甲子，留禮壽伏誅。
entries.en: On jiazi day in the seventh autumn month Liulishou was put to death.
entries.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on jiazi day, Liulishou was executed.

entries.zh: 冬十月，如蒲瑰坡。
entries.en: In the tenth winter month the Emperor went to Puguipo.
entries.literal: In winter, tenth month, he went to Puguipo.

entries.zh: 十一月辛亥，加除室同政事門下平章事。
