entries.en: On xinwei day the court encamped at Huaizhou.
entries.literal: On xinwei day imperial halt at Huaizhou.

entries.zh: 秋七月，增太祖、太宗、讓國皇帝、世宗謚，仍謚皇太弟李胡曰欽順皇帝。
entries.en: In the seventh autumn month the posthumous titles of Emperor Taizu, Emperor Taizong, the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and Emperor Shizong were augmented; Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu was also posthumously titled Emperor Qinshun.
entries.literal: In autumn, seventh month, augmented posthumous titles of Taizu, Taizong, Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and Shizong; also posthumously titled Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu Emperor Qinshun.

entries.zh: 冬十月戊子朔，幸中京。
entries.en: On the wuzi new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuzi new moon, favorably visited the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 十二月，蕭圖玉奏討甘州回鶻，降其王耶剌裏，撫慰而還。
entries.en: In the twelfth month Xiao Tuyu reported a campaign against the Ganzhou Uighurs, subdued their king Yelali, reassured the people, and returned.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, Xiao Tuyu memorialized campaigning against Ganzhou Uighurs, reduced their king Yelali, pacified and returned.

entries.zh: 是年，放進士史克忠等一十三人。
entries.en: That year Shi Kezhong and twelve others passed the examinations.
entries.literal: That year, jinshi Shi Kezhong and twelve others were passed and granted degree.

entries.zh: 二十七年春正月，鉤魚土河。
entries.en: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first spring month, the court went ice fishing on the Tu River.
entries.literal: Twenty-seventh year, spring, first month, hooked fish on the Tu River.

entries.zh: 獵於瑞鹿原。
entries.en: The court hunted at Ruilu Plain.
entries.literal: Hunted at Ruilu Plain.

entries.zh: 夏四月丙戌朔，駐蹕中京，營建宮室。
entries.en: On the bingxu new moon of the fourth summer month the court encamped at the Central Capital and began building palace halls.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingxu new moon, imperial halt at the Central Capital, constructing palace halls.

entries.zh: 庚戌，廢霸州處置司。
entries.en: On gengxu day the Bazhou disposition office was abolished.
entries.literal: On gengxu day abolished Bazhou disposition office.

entries.zh: 秋七月甲寅朔，霖雨，潢、土、斡剌、陰涼四河皆溢，漂沒民舍。
entries.en: On the jiayin new moon of the seventh autumn month heavy rains caused the Huang, Tu, Wala, and Yinliang rivers to overflow and wash away civilian dwellings.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiayin new moon, continuous rain; Huang, Tu, Wala, and Yinliang four rivers all overflowed, washing away commoners' dwellings.

entries.zh: 八月甲申，北幸。
entries.en: On jiashen day of the eighth month the court made a northern tour.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on jiashen day, northern tour.

entries.zh: 冬十一月壬子朔，行柴冊禮。
entries.en: On the renzi new moon of the eleventh winter month the firewood-and-script rites were performed.
entries.literal: Winter, eleventh month, on renzi new moon, performed firewood-and-script rite.

entries.zh: 十二月乙酉，南幸。
entries.en: On yiyou day of the twelfth month the court made a southern tour.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou day, southern tour.

entries.zh: 皇太后不豫。
entries.en: The Empress Dowager fell ill.
entries.literal: The Empress Dowager was unwell.

entries.zh: 戊子，肆赦。
entries.en: On wuzi day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: On wuzi day proclaimed general amnesty.

entries.zh: 辛卯，皇太后崩於行宮。
entries.en: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager died at the traveling palace.
entries.literal: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager died at the traveling palace.

entries.zh: 壬辰，遣使報哀於宋、夏、高麗。
entries.en: On renchen day envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Song, Western Xia, and Goryeo.
entries.literal: On renchen day dispatched envoys to report mourning to Song, Xia, and Goryeo.

entries.zh: 戊申，如中京。
entries.en: On wushen day the court went to the Central Capital.
entries.literal: On wushen day went to the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 己酉，詔免賀千齡節。
entries.en: On jiyou day an edict canceled observance of the Thousand Age Festival.
entries.literal: On jiyou day an edict canceled congratulations for the Thousand Age Festival.

entries.zh: 是歲，御前引試劉二宜等三人。
entries.en: That year Liu Eryi and two others were examined before the throne.
entries.literal: That year, imperial preliminary examination of Liu Eryi and two others.

entries.zh: 六年春正月癸卯，如錐子河。
entries.en: In the sixth year, on guimao day of the first spring month, the court went to the Zhuizi River.
entries.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, on guimao day, went to Zhuizi River.

entries.zh: 二月甲戌，以公主賽哥殺無罪婢，駙馬蕭圖玉不能齊家，降公主為縣主，削圖玉同平章事。
entries.en: On jiaxu day of the second month Princess Saige was demoted to county mistress and Xiao Tuyu was stripped of his co-equal chief councillor title because she had killed an innocent maidservant and he could not keep his household in order.
entries.literal: Second month, on jiaxu day, because Princess Saige killed an innocent maidservant and imperial son-in-law Xiao Tuyu could not manage the household, the Princess was demoted to county mistress and Tuyu's position as co-equal chief councillor was stripped.

entries.zh: 丁丑，詔國舅帳詳穩蕭隗窪將本部兵東征高麗，其國舅司事以都監攝之。
entries.en: On dingchou day an edict ordered imperial maternal uncle xianwen Xiao Aiwo to lead his command east against Goryeo, with the supervisory commander acting in his office during the campaign.
entries.literal: On dingchou day an edict ordered imperial maternal uncle tent xianwen Xiao Aiwo to lead his division's troops on eastern expedition against Goryeo; the imperial maternal uncle office affairs would be administered by the supervisory commander in his stead.

entries.zh: 庚辰，以南面林牙涅合為南院大王。
entries.en: On gengchen day Southern Court linya Niehe was appointed Southern Court great king.
entries.literal: On gengchen day made Southern Court linya Niehe Southern Court great king.

entries.zh: 三月乙巳，如顯州，葬秦晉國王隆慶。
entries.en: On yisi day of the third month the court went to Xian Prefecture and buried Qin-Jin State King Longqing.
entries.literal: Third month, on yisi day, went to Xian Prefecture and buried Qin-Jin State King Longqing.

entries.zh: 有事於顯、乾二陵。
entries.en: Sacrifice was offered at the Xian and Qian mausoleums.
entries.literal: Performed rites at the Xian and Qian mausoleums.

entries.zh: 追冊隆慶為太弟。
entries.en: Longqing was posthumously enregistered as Imperial Elder Brother.
entries.literal: Posthumously enregistered Longqing as Imperial Elder Brother.

entries.zh: 夏四月辛卯，封隆慶少子謝家奴為長沙郡王，以樞密使漆水郡王耶律制心權知諸行宮都部署事。
entries.en: On xinmao day of the fourth summer month Longqing's youngest son Xiejianu was made Prince of Changsha, and Commissioner of Military Affairs Prince of Qishui Yelü Zhixin was appointed acting director of all traveling palace deployments.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinmao day, enfeoffed Longqing's youngest son Xiejianu as Prince of Changsha Commandery; Commissioner of Military Affairs Prince of Qishui Yelü Zhixin was put in temporary charge of all traveling palace deployments.

entries.zh: 壬辰，禁命婦再醮。
entries.en: On renchen day an edict forbade widows from remarrying.
entries.literal: On renchen day forbade widowed women remarriage.

entries.zh: 丙申，如涼陘。
entries.en: On bingshen day the court went to Liang Pass.
entries.literal: On bingshen day went to Liang Pass.

entries.zh: 五月戊戌朔，命樞密使蕭合卓為都統，漢人行宮都部署王繼忠為副，殿前都點檢蕭屈烈為都監，以伐高麗。
entries.en: On the wuxu new moon of the fifth month Xiao Hezhuo was appointed commander-in-chief, Wang Jizhong deputy commander, and Xiao Qulie supervisory commander for a campaign against Goryeo.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on wuxu new moon, ordered Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiao Hezhuo as commander-in-chief, Han traveling palace deployment director Wang Jizhong as deputy, Palace Front inspector Xiao Qulie as supervisory commander to campaign against Goryeo.

entries.zh: 翌日，賜合卓劍，俾得專殺。
entries.en: The next day Hezhuo was given a sword conferring authority to execute at his discretion.
entries.literal: Next day granted Hezhuo a sword, enabling him to execute on his own authority.

entries.zh: 丙午，錄囚。
entries.en: On bingwu day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On bingwu day reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 己酉，設四帳都詳穩。
entries.en: On jiyou day chief xianwen posts were established for the four accounts.
entries.literal: On jiyou day established four-accounts chief xianwen.

entries.zh: 甲寅，以南京統軍使蕭惠為右夷離畢。
entries.en: On jiayin day Nanjing army commander Xiao Hui was appointed right yilibi.
entries.literal: On jiayin day made Nanjing army commander Xiao Hui right yilibi.

entries.zh: 乙卯，祠木葉山、潢河。
entries.en: On yimao day sacrifice was offered at Muye Mountain and on the Huang River.
entries.literal: On yimao day sacrificed at Muye Mountain and Huang River.

entries.zh: 乙丑，駐蹕九層臺。
entries.en: On yichou day the court encamped at the Nine-Tier Terrace.
entries.literal: On yichou day imperial halt at Nine-Tier Terrace.

entries.zh: 六月戊辰朔，德妃蕭氏賜死，葬兔兒山西。
entries.en: On the wuchen new moon of the sixth month Noble Consort Xiao was ordered to take her own life and was buried west of Rabbit Mountain.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on wuchen new moon, Noble Consort Xiao was granted death and buried west of Rabbit Mountain.

entries.zh: 後數日，大風起冢上，晝暝，大雷電而雨不止者逾月。
entries.en: Several days later a great wind rose over the tomb, daylight turned dark, and thunder, lightning, and unceasing rain lasted more than a month.
entries.literal: Several days later great wind rose over the tomb, daylight darkened, great thunder and lightning and rain did not cease for more than a month.

entries.zh: 是月，南京諸縣蝗。
entries.en: That month locusts afflicted the counties of Nanjing.
entries.literal: That month Nanjing various counties had locusts.

entries.zh: 秋七月辛亥，如秋山。
entries.en: On xinhai day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Autumn Mountain.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day, went to Autumn Mountain.

entries.zh: 遣禮部尚書劉京、翰林學士吳叔達、知制誥仇正己、起居舍人程翥、吏部員外郎南承顏、禮部員外郎王景運分路按察刑獄。
entries.en: Liu Jing, Wu Shuda, Qiu Zhengji, Cheng Zhu, Nan Chengyan, and Wang Jingyun were sent along separate routes to review criminal cases.
entries.literal: Dispatched Minister of Rites Liu Jing, Hanlin academician Wu Shuda, drafter of edicts Qiu Zhengji, diarist Cheng Zhu, Ministry of Personnel vice bureau director Nan Chengyan, and Ministry of Rites vice bureau director Wang Jingyun to inspect legal cases by separate routes.

entries.zh: 辛酉，以西南路招討請，置寧仁縣於勝州。
entries.en: On xinyou day, at the Southwestern Pacification Commissioner's request, Ningren County was established in Sheng Prefecture.
entries.literal: On xinyou day, at the request of the Southwestern Pacification commissioner, established Ningren County at Sheng Prefecture.

entries.zh: 九月庚子，還上京，以皇子屬思生，大赦。
entries.en: On gengzi day of the ninth month the court returned to the Upper Capital and proclaimed a general amnesty on the birth of Prince Shusi.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on gengzi day returned to Upper Capital; because Prince Shusi was born, general amnesty.

entries.zh: 丁未，以駙馬蕭璉、節度使化哥、知制誥仇正己、楊佶充賀宋生辰正旦使副。
entries.en: On dingwei day Xiao Lian, Huage, Qiu Zhengji, and Yang Ji were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday and New Year's Day.
entries.literal: On dingwei day made imperial son-in-law Xiao Lian, military commissioner Huage, drafter of edicts Qiu Zhengji, and Yang Ji envoys and deputies to congratulate Song on birthday and New Year's Day.

entries.zh: 乙卯，蕭合卓等攻高麗興化軍不克，還師。
entries.en: On yimao day Xiao Hezhuo and others failed to take Goryeo's Xinghua Army and withdrew.
entries.literal: On yimao day Xiao Hezhuo and others attacked Goryeo's Xinghua Army but did not take it and returned the army.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁卯，南京路饑，免雲、應、朔、弘等州粟振之。
entries.en: On dingmao day of the tenth winter month famine struck the Nanjing circuit, and grain levies were remitted and relief distributed in Yun, Ying, Shuo, Hong, and other prefectures.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingmao day, Nanjing circuit had famine; exempted grain and gave relief in Yun, Ying, Shuo, Hong and other prefectures.

entries.zh: 辛未，獵鏵子河。
entries.en: On xinwei day the court hunted on the Huazi River.
entries.literal: On xinwei day hunted at Huazi River.

entries.zh: 庚寅，駐蹕達離山。
entries.en: On gengyin day the court encamped at Mount Dali.
entries.literal: On gengyin day imperial halt at Dali Mountain.

entries.zh: 十一月乙卯，建州節度使石匡弼卒。
entries.en: On yimao day of the eleventh month Jian Prefecture military commissioner Shi Kuangbi died.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on yimao day, Jian Prefecture military commissioner Shi Kuangbi died.

entries.zh: 十二月丁卯，上輕騎還上京。
entries.en: On dingmao day of the twelfth month the Emperor rode back to the Upper Capital with a light escort.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on dingmao day the Emperor returned to the Upper Capital on light horses.

entries.zh: 戊子，宋遣李行簡、張信來賀千齡節。
entries.en: On wuzi day Song sent Li Xingjian and Zhang Xin to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
entries.literal: On wuzi day Song dispatched Li Xingjian and Zhang Xin to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

entries.zh: 翌日，宋馮元、張綸來賀正旦。
entries.en: The next day Song sent Feng Yuan and Zhang Lun to congratulate New Year's Day.
entries.literal: Next day Song Feng Yuan and Zhang Lun came to congratulate New Year's Day.

entries.zh: 聖宗六
entries.en: Shengzong, Part Six
entries.literal: Shengzong, Part Six

entries.zh: 七年春正月壬寅朔，宋遣張保維、孫繼業、孔道輔、馬崇至來賀。
entries.en: In the seventh year of Taiping, on the renyin new moon of the first spring month Song sent Zhang Baowei, Sun Jiye, Kong Daofu, and Ma Chongzhi with congratulations.
entries.literal: In the seventh year of Taiping, spring, first month, on the renyin new moon, Song sent Zhang Baowei, Sun Jiye, Kong Daofu, and Ma Chongzhi to congratulate.

entries.zh: 如混同江。
entries.en: The court went to Hun River.
entries.literal: Went to Hun River.

entries.zh: 辛亥，以女直白縷為惕隱，蒲馬為巖母部太師。
entries.en: On xinhai day Jurchen Bailü was appointed tiyin and Puma Grand Preceptor of the Yanmu tribe.
entries.literal: On xinhai day, made Jurchen Bailü tiyin and Puma Grand Preceptor of the Yanmu tribe.

entries.zh: 甲寅，蒲盧毛朵部遣使來貢。
entries.en: On jiayin day the Puloumaoduo tribe sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On jiayin day, the Puloumaoduo tribe sent envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 夏四月乙未，獵黑嶺。
entries.en: On yiwei day of the fourth summer month the court hunted at Heiling.
entries.literal: In summer, fourth month, on yiwei day, hunted at Heiling.

entries.zh: 五月，清暑永安山。
entries.en: In the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.
entries.literal: In the fifth month, took summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.

entries.zh: 西南路招討司奏陰山中產金銀，請置冶，從之。
entries.en: The Southwestern Route pacification office reported that the Yin Mountains produced gold and silver and requested a smeltery; approval was granted.
entries.literal: Southwestern Route pacification office memorialized that the Yin Mountains produced gold and silver and requested a smeltery; approved.

entries.zh: 復遣使循遼河源求產金銀之礦。
entries.en: Envoys were again dispatched along the Liao River source to seek mines producing gold and silver.
entries.literal: Again dispatched envoys along the Liao River source to seek mines producing gold and silver.

entries.zh: 六月，禁諸屯田不得擅貨官粟。
entries.en: In the sixth month all military colonies were forbidden to privately sell official grain.
entries.literal: In the sixth month, forbade all military colonies from privately selling official grain.

entries.zh: 癸巳，詔蕭惠再討阻卜。
entries.en: On guisi day an edict ordered Xiao Hui to campaign against the Zubu again.
entries.literal: On guisi day, edict ordered Xiao Hui to campaign against the Zubu again.

entries.zh: 秋七月己亥朔，詔更定法令。
entries.en: On the jihai new moon of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered laws and regulations revised.
entries.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the jihai new moon, edict to revise laws and regulations.

entries.zh: 庚子，詔諭駙馬蕭鉏不、公主粘米袞：「爾於後有父母之尊，後或臨幸，祗謁先祖，祗拜空帳，失致敬之禮，今後可設像拜謁。」
entries.en: On gengzi day an edict instructed imperial son-in-law Xiao Cubu and Princess Nianmigun: "You will afterward have the status of parents; when the Empress visits in future and you reverently attend the ancestral spirits, reverently bowing before empty tents falls short of the rite of respect; hereafter you may set up portraits and bow before them."
entries.literal: On gengzi day, edict instructed imperial son-in-law Xiao Cubu and Princess Nianmigun: "You will afterward have the status of parents; when the Empress visits in future and you reverently attend the ancestral spirits, reverently bowing before empty tents falls short of the rite of respect; hereafter you may set up portraits and bow before them."

entries.zh: 乙巳，詔輦路所經，旁三十步內不得耕種者，不在訴訟之限。
entries.en: On yisi day an edict ordered that land within thirty paces on either side of the imperial carriage route that might not be cultivated was not subject to litigation.
entries.literal: On yisi day, edict: land within thirty paces on either side of the imperial carriage route that may not be cultivated was not subject to litigation.

entries.zh: 九月，駐蹕遼河。
entries.en: In the ninth month the court encamped at the Liao River.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, encamped at the Liao River.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁卯朔，詔諸帳院庶孽，並從其母論貴賤。
entries.en: On the dingmao new moon of the tenth winter month an edict ordered all tent-palace illegitimate offspring to follow their mothers in rank.
entries.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the dingmao new moon, edict ordered all tent-palace illegitimate offspring to follow their mothers in rank.

entries.zh: 十一月，宋遣石中立、石貽孫來賀千齡節，王博文、王雙賀順天節。
entries.en: In the eleventh month Song sent Shi Zhongli and Shi Yisun to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival and Wang Bowen and Wang Shuang to congratulate the Shuntian Festival.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, Song sent Shi Zhongli and Shi Yisun to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival, and Wang Bowen and Wang Shuang to congratulate the Shuntian Festival.

entries.zh: 辛亥，以楊又玄、邢祥知貢舉。
entries.en: On xinhai day Yang Youxuan and Xing Xiang were appointed examination supervisors.
entries.literal: On xinhai day, made Yang Youxuan and Xing Xiang examination supervisors.

entries.zh: 己未，匡義軍節度使中山郡王查葛、保寧軍節度使長沙郡王謝家奴、廣德軍節度使樂安郡王遂哥奏，各將之官，乞選伴讀書史，從之。
entries.en: On jiwei day Kuangyi Army military commissioner Prince of Zhongshan Zhage, Baoning Army military commissioner Prince of Changsha Xiejianu, and Guangde Army military commissioner Prince of Le'an Suige memorialized that as each was about to take up his post he requested companions versed in history; permission was granted.
entries.literal: On jiwei day, Kuangyi Army military commissioner Prince of Zhongshan Zhage, Baoning Army military commissioner Prince of Changsha Xiejianu, and Guangde Army military commissioner Prince of Le'an Suige memorialized that as each was about to take up his post he requested companions who read history selected; permitted.

entries.zh: 癸亥，以三韓王欽為啟聖軍節度使，楊佶刑部侍郎。
entries.en: On guihai day Three Han Prince Qin was appointed Qisheng Army military commissioner and Yang Ji Vice Minister of Justice.
entries.literal: On guihai day, made Three Han Prince Qin Qisheng Army military commissioner and Yang Ji Vice Minister of Justice.

entries.zh: 甲子，以左千牛衛上將軍耶律古昱為北院大王。
entries.en: On jiazi day Left Thousand-Ox Guard senior general Yelü Guyü was appointed Northern Great King.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, made Left Thousand-Ox Guard senior general Yelü Guyü Northern Great King.

entries.zh: 十二月丁卯朔，遣耶律遂英、王永錫充賀宋太后生辰，蕭速撒、馬保永充賀正旦使副。
entries.en: On the dingmao new moon of the twelfth month Yelü Suiying and Wang Yongxi were dispatched as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Xiao Susa and Ma Baoyong as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on the dingmao new moon, dispatched Yelü Suiying and Wang Yongxi as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Xiao Susa and Ma Baoyong as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

entries.zh: 癸酉，以金吾蕭高六為奚舍利軍詳穩。
entries.en: On guiyou day jinwu guard Xiao Gaoliu was appointed Xi Sheli Army xiangwen.
entries.literal: On guiyou day, made jinwu guard Xiao Gaoliu Xi Sheli Army xiangwen.

entries.zh: 八年春正月乙亥，如混同江。
entries.en: In the eighth year of Taiping, on yihai day of the first spring month the court went to Hun River.
entries.literal: In the eighth year of Taiping, spring, first month, on yihai day, went to Hun River.

entries.zh: 庚申，党項侵邊，破之。
entries.en: On gengshen day the Tangut invaded the border and were defeated.
entries.literal: On gengshen day, Tangut invaded the border; they were defeated.

entries.zh: 甲子，詔州縣長吏勸農。
entries.en: On jiazi day an edict ordered prefectural and county chief officials to encourage agriculture.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, edict ordered prefectural and county chief officials to encourage agriculture.

entries.zh: 二月戊子，燕京留守蕭孝穆乞於拒馬河接宋境上置戍長巡察，詔從之。
entries.en: On wuzi day of the second month Yanjing regent Xiao Xiaomu requested guard posts on the Juma River at the Song border for patrol; an edict approved.
entries.literal: In the second month, on wuzi day, Yanjing regent Xiao Xiaomu requested guard posts on the Juma River at the Song border for patrol; an edict approved.

entries.zh: 三月，駐蹕長春河。
entries.en: In the third month the court encamped at Changchun River.
entries.literal: In the third month, encamped at Changchun River.

entries.zh: 夏五月，清暑永安山。
entries.en: In the fifth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.
entries.literal: In summer, fifth month, took summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.

entries.zh: 六月，以韓寧、劉湘充賀宋太后生辰使副，吳克荷充賀夏國王李德昭生辰使。
entries.en: In the sixth month Han Ning and Liu Xiang were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Wu Kehe envoy to congratulate Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday.
entries.literal: In the sixth month, made Han Ning and Liu Xiang chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Wu Kehe envoy to congratulate Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday.

entries.zh: 癸巳，權北院大王耶律鄭留奏，今歲十一月皇太子納妃，諸族備會親之帳。
entries.en: On guisi day Acting Northern Great King Yelü Zhengliu reported that in the eleventh month of this year the Crown Prince would take a consort and the tribes should prepare marriage-reception tents.
entries.literal: On guisi day, Acting Northern Great King Yelü Zhengliu memorialized that in the eleventh month of this year the Crown Prince would take a consort and the tribes should prepare marriage-reception tents.

entries.zh: 詔以豪盛者三十戶給其費。
entries.en: An edict ordered thirty wealthy households to supply the expenses.
entries.literal: An edict ordered thirty wealthy households to supply the expenses.

entries.zh: 秋七月丁酉，以遙輦帳郎君陳哥為西北路巡檢，與蕭諧領同管二招討地。
entries.en: On dingyou day of the seventh autumn month Yaolian tent langjun Chenge was appointed Northwestern Route inspector, jointly with Xiao Xie to administer the two pacification territories.
entries.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on dingyou day, made Yaolian tent langjun Chenge Northwestern Route inspector, jointly with Xiao Xie to administer the two pacification territories.

entries.zh: 以南院大王耶律敵烈為上京留守。
entries.en: Southern Great King Yelü Dilie was appointed Upper Capital regent.
entries.literal: Made Southern Great King Yelü Dilie Upper Capital regent.

entries.zh: 戊戌，獵平地松林。
entries.en: On wuxu day the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.
entries.literal: On wuxu day, hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.

entries.zh: 九月壬辰朔，以渤海宰相羅漢權東京統軍使。
entries.en: On the renchen new moon of the ninth month Bohai chancellor Luohan was appointed acting Eastern Capital army commander.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on the renchen new moon, made Bohai chancellor Luohan acting Eastern Capital army commander.

entries.zh: 壬子，幸中京。
entries.en: On renzi day the court visited the Central Capital.
entries.literal: On renzi day, visited the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 北敵烈部節度使耶律延壽請視諸部，賜旗鼓，詔從之。
entries.en: Bei Dilie tribe military commissioner Yelü Yanshou requested to inspect the tribes and was granted banners and drums; an edict approved.
entries.literal: Bei Dilie tribe military commissioner Yelü Yanshou requested to inspect the tribes and was granted banners and drums; an edict approved.

entries.zh: 癸丑，阻卜別部長胡懶來降。
entries.en: On guichou day Zubu sub-tribe chief Hulan came to surrender.
entries.literal: On guichou day, Zubu sub-tribe chief Hulan came to surrender.

entries.zh: 乙卯，阻卜長舂古來降。
entries.en: On yimao day Zubu chief Chungu submitted.
entries.literal: On yimao day Zubu chief Chungu came to submit.

entries.zh: 冬十月，宋遣唐肅、葛懷湣來賀順天節。
entries.en: In the tenth winter month Song sent Tang Su and Ge Huaimin to congratulate the Shuntian Festival.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, Song dispatched Tang Su and Ge Huaimin to come congratulate the Shuntian Festival.

entries.zh: 樞密使、魏王耶律斜軫孫婦阿聒指斥乘輿，其孫骨欲為之隱，事覺，乃並坐之，仍籍其家。
entries.en: Privy Council commissioner and King of Wei Yelü Xiezhen's grandson's wife Awu reviled the imperial carriage; his grandson Guyu tried to conceal it; when the matter came out both were punished and their household was confiscated.
entries.literal: Privy Council commissioner and King of Wei Yelü Xiezhen's grandson's wife Awu reviled the imperial carriage; his grandson Guyu tried to conceal it; when the matter came out both were punished and their household was confiscated.

entries.zh: 詔燕城將士，若敵至，總管備城之東南，統軍守其西北，馬步軍備其野戰，統軍副使繕壁壘，課士卒，各練其事。
entries.en: An edict to Yan city officers and soldiers ordered that if the enemy arrives the garrison commander is to secure the southeast of the city, the supreme commander the northwest, cavalry and infantry to prepare for field battle, and the deputy supreme commander to repair walls and ramparts and drill troops, each training for his task.
entries.literal: An edict to Yan city officers and soldiers: if the enemy arrives, the garrison commander is to secure the southeast of the city, the supreme commander the northwest, cavalry and infantry to prepare for field battle, the deputy supreme commander to repair walls and ramparts and drill troops—each to train for his task.

entries.zh: 十一月丙申，皇太子納妃蕭氏。
entries.en: On bingshen day of the eleventh month the crown prince took consort the Xiao clan.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen day the crown prince took consort the Xiao clan.

entries.zh: 以耶律求翰為北院大王十二月辛酉朔，以遙輦太尉謝佛留為天雲軍詳穩。
entries.en: Yelü Qiuhan was appointed Northern Court king. On the xinyou new moon of the twelfth month Yaolian grand marshal Xie Foliu was made Tianyun Army xiangwen.
entries.literal: Yelü Qiuhan was made Northern Court king; twelfth month, on the xinyou new moon, Yaolian grand marshal Xie Foliu was made Tianyun Army xiangwen.

entries.zh: 壬申，以前北院大王耶律留寧為雙州節度使，康筠崇德宮都部署，謝十永興宮都部署，旅墳宜州節度使，菴遼州節度使，耶律野同知中京留守，耶律曷魯突愧為大將軍。
entries.en: On renshen day former Northern Court king Yelü Liuning was appointed Shuang Prefecture military commissioner; Kang Jun was made Chongde Palace metropolitan garrison commander; Xie Shi Yongxing Palace metropolitan garrison commander; Lü Fen Yizhou military commissioner; An Liaozhou military commissioner; Yelü Ye concurrent Central Capital regent; and Yelü Helutukui great general.
entries.literal: On renshen day former Northern Court king Yelü Liuning was made Shuang Prefecture military commissioner, Kang Jun Chongde Palace metropolitan garrison commander, Xie Shi Yongxing Palace metropolitan garrison commander, Lü Fen Yizhou military commissioner, An Liaozhou military commissioner, Yelü Ye concurrent Central Capital regent, and Yelü Helutukui great general.

entries.zh: 丁丑，詔庶孽雖已為良，不得預世選。
entries.en: On dingchou day an edict declared that though base-born offspring may have become commoners, they may not participate in household selection.
entries.literal: On dingchou day an edict: though base-born offspring may have become commoners, they may not participate in household selection.

entries.zh: 丁亥，宋遣寇瑊、康德來賀千齡節。
entries.en: On dinghai day Song sent Kou Zhen and Kang De to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
entries.literal: On dinghai day Song dispatched Kou Zhen and Kang De to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

entries.zh: 朱諫、曹英、張逸、劉永釗賀來歲兩宮正旦。
entries.en: Zhu Jian, Cao Ying, Zhang Yi, and Liu Yongzhao were to congratulate both palaces on New Year's Day of the coming year.
entries.literal: Zhu Jian, Cao Ying, Zhang Yi, and Liu Yongzhao to congratulate both palaces on New Year's Day of the coming year.

entries.zh: 詔兩國舅及南、北王府乃國之貴族，賤庶不得任本部官。
entries.en: An edict declared that the two imperial maternal uncles and the Southern and Northern Princes' Households are the state's nobility and that low-born commoners may not hold offices in those households.
entries.literal: An edict: the two imperial maternal uncles and the Southern and Northern Princes' Households are the state's nobility; low-born commoners may not hold offices in those households.

entries.zh: 是歲，放進士張宥等五十七人。
entries.en: That year fifty-seven jinshi including Zhang You passed the examinations.
entries.literal: That year fifty-seven jinshi including Zhang You passed the examinations.

entries.zh: 十年春正月乙卯朔，宋遣王夷簡、竇處約、張易、張士宜來賀。
entries.en: In the tenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first spring month, Song sent Wang Yijian, Dou Chuyue, Zhang Yi, and Zhang Shiyi to offer congratulations.
entries.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, on the yimao new moon Song dispatched Wang Yijian, Dou Chuyue, Zhang Yi, and Zhang Shiyi to come congratulate.

entries.zh: 二月，幸龍化州。
entries.en: In the second month the court visited Longhua Prefecture.
entries.literal: Second month, visited Longhua Prefecture.

entries.zh: 三月甲寅朔，詳穩蕭匹敵至自遼東，言都統蕭孝穆去城四面各五里許，築城堡以圍之。
entries.en: On the jiayin new moon of the third month xiangwen Xiao Pide returned from Liaodong and reported that supreme commander Xiao Xiaomu had built fortresses five li from each side of the city to besiege it.
entries.literal: Third month, on the jiayin new moon xiangwen Xiao Pide returned from Liaodong, reporting supreme commander Xiao Xiaomu had built fortresses five li from each side of the city to besiege it.

entries.zh: 駙馬延寧與其妹穴地遁去，惟公主崔八在後，為守陴者覺而止。
entries.en: Imperial son-in-law Yanning and his sister escaped through a tunnel; only Princess Cui Ba remained behind and was detected by the wall defenders and stopped.
entries.literal: Imperial son-in-law Yanning and his sister escaped through a tunnel; only Princess Cui Ba remained behind and was detected by wall defenders and stopped.

entries.zh: 夏四月，如乾陵。
entries.en: In the fourth summer month the court went to Qianling.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, went to Qianling.

entries.zh: 以耶律行平為廣平軍節度使，夏行美為忠順軍節度使，李延弘知易州，蕭從順加太子太師。
entries.en: Yelü Xingping was appointed Guangping Army military commissioner, Xia Xingmei as Zhongshun Army military commissioner, Li Yanhong as Yizhou intendant, and Xiao Congshun was promoted to Crown Prince Grand Preceptor.
entries.literal: Yelü Xingping was made Guangping Army military commissioner, Xia Xingmei was made Zhongshun Army military commissioner, Li Yanhong was appointed Yizhou intendant, and Xiao Congshun was promoted to Crown Prince Grand Preceptor.

entries.zh: 五月戊申，清暑柏坡。
entries.en: On wushen day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Baipo.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on wushen day took summer retreat at Baipo.

entries.zh: 秋七月壬午，詔來歲行貢舉法。
entries.en: On renwu day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered civil service examinations the following year.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renwu day an edict ordered civil service examinations next year.

entries.zh: 八月丙午，東京賊將楊詳世密送款，夜開南門納遼軍。
entries.en: On bingwu day of the eighth month Eastern Capital rebel general Yang Xiangshi secretly sent surrender, and at night opened the south gate to admit Liao troops.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on bingwu day Eastern Capital rebel general Yang Xiangshi secretly sent surrender; at night he opened the south gate to admit Liao troops.

entries.zh: 擒延琳，渤海平。
entries.en: Yanlin was captured and Bohai was pacified.
entries.literal: Yanlin was captured; Bohai was pacified.

entries.zh: 冬十月，駐蹕長寧澱。
entries.en: In the tenth winter month the court halted at Changning Marsh.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, halted at Changning Marsh.

entries.zh: 十一月辛亥，南京留守燕王蕭孝穆以東征將士凱還，戎服見上，上大加宴勞。
entries.en: On xinhai day of the eleventh month Nanjing regent Prince of Yan Xiao Xiaomu returned victorious with the eastern expedition troops and appeared before the Emperor in martial dress; the Emperor greatly feasted and rewarded him.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on xinhai day Nanjing regent Prince of Yan Xiao Xiaomu returned victorious with eastern expedition troops, appeared before the Emperor in martial dress; the Emperor greatly feasted and rewarded him.

entries.zh: 翌日，以孝穆為東平王、東京留守，國舅詳穩、駙馬都尉蕭匹敵封蘭陵郡王，奚王蒲奴加侍中；
entries.en: The next day Xiao Xiaomu was made King of Dongping and Eastern Capital regent; imperial maternal uncle xiangwen and imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Pide was enfeoffed as King of Lanling; and Xi king Punu was promoted to Vice Director.
entries.literal: The next day Xiao Xiaomu was made King of Dongping and Eastern Capital regent, imperial maternal uncle xiangwen and imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Pide was enfeoffed as King of Lanling, and Xi king Punu was promoted to Vice Director.

entries.zh: 以權燕京留守兼侍中蕭惠為燕京統軍使，前統軍委窊大將軍、節度使，宰相兼樞密使馬保忠權知燕京留守，奚王府都監蕭阿古軫東京統軍使。
entries.en: Acting Yanjing regent and Vice Director Xiao Hui was appointed Yanjing supreme commander; former supreme commander Weiwa was made great general and military commissioner; Grand Chancellor and concurrent Privy Council commissioner Ma Baozhong was appointed acting Yanjing regent; and Xi Princes' Household metropolitan garrison commander Xiao Aguzhen was made Eastern Capital supreme commander.
entries.literal: Acting Yanjing regent and Vice Director Xiao Hui was made Yanjing supreme commander; former supreme commander Weiwa was made great general and military commissioner; Grand Chancellor and concurrent Privy Council commissioner Ma Baozhong was appointed acting Yanjing regent; and Xi Princes' Household metropolitan garrison commander Xiao Aguzhen was made Eastern Capital supreme commander.

entries.zh: 詔渤海舊族有勛勞材力者敘用，餘分居來、隰、遷、潤等州。
entries.en: An edict ordered that Bohai old clans with merit and ability be appointed to office, while the rest were distributed to Lai, Xi, Qian, Run, and other prefectures.
entries.literal: An edict: Bohai old clans with merit and ability were appointed to office; the rest were distributed to Lai, Xi, Qian, Run, and other prefectures.

entries.zh: 十二月乙巳，宋遣梅詢、王令傑來賀千齡節。
entries.en: On yisi day of the twelfth month Song sent Mei Xun and Wang Lingjie to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on yisi day Song dispatched Mei Xun and Wang Lingjie to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

entries.zh: 漆水郡王耶律敵烈加尚父，烏古部節度使蕭普達為乙室部大王，尚書左僕射蕭琳為臨海軍節度使。
entries.en: Qishui Commandery King Yelü Dilie was promoted to Esteemed Father; Wugu Department military commissioner Xiao Puda was made Yishi Department king; and Xiao Lin, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Linhai Army military commissioner.
entries.literal: Qishui Commandery King Yelü Dilie was promoted to Esteemed Father; Wugu Department military commissioner Xiao Puda was made Yishi Department king; Xiao Lin, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Linhai Army military commissioner.

entries.zh: 聖宗八
entries.en: Shengzong, Part Eight
entries.literal: Shengzong, Part Eight

entries.zh: 十一年夏六月己卯，聖宗崩，即皇帝位於柩前。
entries.en: In the eleventh year, on jimao day of the sixth summer month Shengzong died, and [the heir] immediately took the throne before the coffin.
entries.literal: In the eleventh year, summer, sixth month, on jimao day, Shengzong died; immediately took the imperial throne before the coffin.

entries.zh: 壬午，尊母元妃蕭氏為皇太后。
entries.en: On renwu day the new Emperor honored his mother, Lady Xiao, as Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: On renwu day, honored mother Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 甲申，遣使告哀於宋及夏、高麗。
entries.en: On jiashen day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song, Xia, and Goryeo.
entries.literal: On jiashen day, dispatched envoys to announce the mourning to Song, Xia, and Goryeo.

entries.zh: 是年，禦宣政殿放進士劉貞等五十七人。
entries.en: That year jinshi examinations were held at Xuanzheng Hall and fifty-seven candidates including Liu Zhen passed.
entries.literal: That year, held jinshi examination at Xuanzheng Hall and released fifty-seven including Liu Zhen.

entries.zh: 辛卯，大赦，改元景福。
entries.en: On xinmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Jingfu.
entries.literal: On xinmao day, general amnesty; changed era name to Jingfu.

entries.zh: 乙未，奉大行皇帝梓宮，殯於永安山太平殿。
entries.en: On yiwei day the late Emperor's coffin was escorted and encoffined at Taiping Hall on Yong'an Mountain.
entries.literal: On yiwei day, escorted the late Emperor's coffin and encoffined it at Taiping Hall on Yong'an Mountain.

entries.zh: 辛丑，皇太后賜駙馬蕭鉏不裏、蕭匹敵死，圍場都太師女直著骨裏、右祗候郎君詳穩蕭延留等七人皆棄市，籍其家，遷齊天皇后於上京。
entries.en: On xinchou day the Empress Dowager ordered imperial son-in-law Xiao Cubu and Xiao Pide to death; Hunt-grounds grand preceptor Jurchen Zhuguli, Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen Xiao Yanliu, and seven others were all executed in the marketplace; their households were confiscated; and Empress Qi Tian was moved to the Upper Capital.
entries.literal: On xinchou day, the Empress Dowager ordered imperial son-in-law Xiao Cubu to death and Xiao Pide to death; Hunt-grounds grand preceptor Jurchen Zhuguli, Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen Xiao Yanliu, and seven others were all executed in the marketplace; their households were confiscated; Empress Qi Tian was moved to the Upper Capital.

entries.zh: 秋七月丙午朔，皇太后率皇族大臨於太平殿。
entries.en: On the bingwu new moon of the seventh autumn month the Empress Dowager led the imperial clan in great mourning at Taiping Hall.
entries.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the bingwu new moon, the Empress Dowager led the imperial clan in great mourning at Taiping Hall.

entries.zh: 高麗遣使吊慰。
entries.en: Goryeo dispatched envoys to express condolences.
entries.literal: Goryeo dispatched envoys to express condolences.

entries.zh: 上召晉王蕭普古等飲博，夜分乃罷。
entries.en: The Emperor summoned Prince of Jin Xiao Pugu and others to drink and gamble; only at midnight did they stop.
entries.literal: The Emperor summoned Prince of Jin Xiao Pugu and others to drink and gamble; only at midnight did they stop.

entries.zh: 丁未，擊鞠。
entries.en: On dingwei day the court played cuju.
entries.literal: On dingwei day, played cuju.

entries.zh: 戊申，以耶律韓八為左夷離畢，特末裏為左祗候郎君詳穩，橫帳郎君樂古權右祗候郎君祥穩。
entries.en: On wushen day Yelü Hanba was appointed Left yilibi; Temuli was made Left Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen; and Cross-Tent langjun Yegu acting Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen.
entries.literal: On wushen day, made Yelü Hanba Left yilibi, Temuli Left Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen, and Cross-Tent langjun Yegu acting Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen.

entries.zh: 己酉，以耶律鄭留為於厥迪烈都詳穩，高八為右皮室詳穩。
entries.en: On jiyou day Yelü Zhengliu was appointed Ugu diledu xiangwen and Gao Ba Right Pishi xiangwen.
entries.literal: On jiyou day, made Yelü Zhengliu Ugu diledu xiangwen and Gao Ba Right Pishi xiangwen.

entries.zh: 庚戌，賑薊州民饑。
entries.en: On gengxu day relief was provided for hungry people in Jizhou.
entries.literal: On gengxu day, provided relief for hungry people in Jizhou.

entries.zh: 癸丑，詔寫大行皇帝御容。
entries.en: On guichou day an edict ordered the late Emperor's portrait painted.
entries.literal: On guichou day, edict ordered painting of the late Emperor's portrait.

entries.zh: 甲寅，錄囚。
entries.en: On jiayin day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On jiayin day, reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 以觀察姚居信為上將軍。
entries.en: Observation commissioner Yao Juxin was appointed upper general.
entries.literal: Made observation commissioner Yao Juxin upper general.

entries.zh: 建慶州於慶陵之南，徙民實之，充奉陵邑。
entries.en: Qingzhou was built south of Qing Mausoleum; people were moved to fill it, serving as a mausoleum-attendant settlement.
entries.literal: Built Qingzhou south of Qing Mausoleum, moved people to fill it, serving as mausoleum-attendant settlement.

entries.zh: 乙卯，以比歲豐稔，罷給東京統軍司糧。
entries.en: On yimao day, because grain harvests had been abundant in recent years, grain supplies to the Eastern Capital military governor's office were discontinued.
entries.literal: On yimao day, because grain harvest had been abundant in recent years, ceased supplying grain to the Eastern Capital military governor's office.

entries.zh: 丁巳，上謁大行皇帝御容，哀慟久之。
entries.en: On dingsi day the Emperor visited the late Emperor's portrait and mourned deeply for a long time.
entries.literal: On dingsi day, the Emperor visited the late Emperor's portrait and mourned deeply for a long time.

entries.zh: 因詔寫北府宰相蕭孝先、南府宰相蕭孝穆像於御容殿。
entries.en: Thereupon an edict ordered portraits of Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaoxian and Southern Chancellor Xiao Xiaomu painted in the Imperial Portrait Hall.
entries.literal: Thereupon edict ordered painting portraits of Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaoxian and Southern Chancellor Xiao Xiaomu in the Imperial Portrait Hall.

entries.zh: 以蕭阿姑軫為東京留守。
entries.en: Xiao Aguzhen was appointed Eastern Capital regent.
entries.literal: Made Xiao Aguzhen Eastern Capital regent.

entries.zh: 丁卯，謁太平殿，焚先帝所禦弓矢。
entries.en: On dingmao day the court visited Taiping Hall and burned the late Emperor's bow and arrows.
entries.literal: On dingmao day, visited Taiping Hall and burned the late Emperor's bow and arrows.

entries.zh: 幸晉王普古第視疾。
entries.en: The court visited Prince of Jin Pugu's residence to inquire after his illness.
entries.literal: Visited Prince of Jin Pugu's residence to inquire after his illness.

entries.zh: 辛未，錄囚。
entries.en: On xinwei day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On xinwei day, reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 壬申，上謁神主帳，時奧隈蕭氏始入宮，亦命拜之。
entries.en: On renshen day the Emperor visited the tent containing the spirit tablets; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and she too was ordered to bow before them.
entries.literal: On renshen day, the Emperor visited the spirit-tablet tent; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and she too was ordered to bow before the tablets.

entries.zh: 八月壬午，遷大行皇帝梓宮於菆塗殿。
entries.en: In the eighth month, on renwu day, the late Emperor's coffin was moved to Zutu Hall.
entries.literal: In the eighth month, on renwu day, moved the late Emperor's coffin to Zutu Hall.

entries.zh: 九月戊申，躬視慶陵。
entries.en: In the ninth month, on wushen day, the Emperor personally inspected Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: In the ninth month, on wushen day, personally inspected Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 庚戌，問安於皇太后。
entries.en: On gengxu day the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: On gengxu day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 辛亥，宋遣王隨、曹儀致祭，王鬷、許懷信、梅詢、張綸來慰兩宮，範諷、孫繼業賀即位，孔道輔、魏昭文賀皇太吊後冊禮。
entries.en: On xinhai day Song sent Wang Sui and Cao Yi to perform sacrifices; Wang Ji, Xu Huaixin, Mei Xun, and Zhang Lun came to console the two palaces; Fan Feng and Sun Jiye congratulated on the accession; and Kong Daofu and Wei Zhaowen congratulated on the Empress Dowager's post-mourning investiture rites.
entries.literal: On xinhai day, Song sent Wang Sui and Cao Yi to perform sacrifices; Wang Ji, Xu Huaixin, Mei Xun, and Zhang Lun came to console the two palaces; Fan Feng and Sun Jiye congratulated on the accession; Kong Daofu and Wei Zhaowen congratulated on the Empress Dowager's post-mourning investiture rites.

entries.zh: 戊午，焚弧矢、鞍勒於菆塗殿。
entries.en: On wuwu day bows, arrows, saddle, and bridle were burned at Zutu Hall.
entries.literal: On wuwu day, burned bows, arrows, saddle, and bridle at Zutu Hall.

entries.zh: 庚申，夏國遣使來慰。
entries.en: On gengshen day Xia State sent envoys with condolences.
entries.literal: On gengshen day, Xia State sent envoys with condolences.

entries.zh: 庚午，以宋使吊祭，喪服臨菆塗殿。
entries.en: On gengwu day, because Song envoys came to mourn and sacrifice, the Emperor wore mourning dress and attended at Zutu Hall.
entries.literal: On gengwu day, because Song envoys came to mourn and sacrifice, wore mourning dress and attended at Zutu Hall.

entries.zh: 甲戌，遣御史中丞耶律翥、司農卿張確、詳穩耶律勵、四方館使高維翰謝宋吊慰。
entries.en: On jiaxu day Censorate Vice Director Yelü Xu, Minister of Agriculture Zhang Que, xiangwen Yelü Li, and Four Directions Bureau envoy Gao Weihan were dispatched to thank Song for condolences.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day, dispatched Censorate Vice Director Yelü Xu, Minister of Agriculture Zhang Que, xiangwen Yelü Li, and Four Directions Bureau envoy Gao Weihan to thank Song for condolences.

entries.zh: 冬十月戊寅，宰臣呂德懋薨。
entries.en: On wuyin day of the tenth winter month chief minister Lü Demao died.
entries.literal: In winter, tenth month, on wuyin day, chief minister Lü Demao died.

entries.zh: 癸未，殺鉏不裏黨彌勒奴、觀音奴等。
entries.en: On guiwei day Cubu faction members Mile Nu, Guanyin Nu, and others were executed.
entries.literal: On guiwei day, killed Cubu faction members Mile Nu, Guanyin Nu, and others.

entries.zh: 丙戌，遣工部尚書高德順、崇祿卿李可封致先帝遺物於宋；
entries.en: On bingxu day Minister of Works Gao Deshun and Chamberlain for Imperial Insignia Li Kefeng were dispatched to present the late Emperor's bequests to Song;
entries.literal: On bingxu day, dispatched Minister of Works Gao Deshun and Chamberlain for Imperial Insignia Li Kefeng to present the late Emperor's bequests to Song;

entries.zh: 以右領軍衛上將軍耶律遜、少府監馬憚充皇太后謝宋使；
entries.en: Right Imperial Guard upper general Yelü Xun and Palace Manufactories supervisor Ma Dan were appointed envoys to thank Song on behalf of the Empress Dowager;
entries.literal: made Right Imperial Guard upper general Yelü Xun and Palace Manufactories supervisor Ma Dan envoys to thank Song on behalf of the Empress Dowager;

entries.zh: 右監門衛上將軍耶律元載、引進使魏永充皇帝謝宋使。
entries.en: Right Palace Gate Guard upper general Yelü Yuanzai and presenting envoy Wei Yong served as the Emperor's envoys to thank Song.
entries.literal: Right Palace Gate Guard upper general Yelü Yuanzai and presenting envoy Wei Yong served as the Emperor's envoys to thank Song.

entries.zh: 丁酉，夏國遣使來賻。
entries.en: On dingyou day Xia State sent envoys with funeral gifts.
entries.literal: On dingyou day, Xia State sent envoys with funeral gifts.

entries.zh: 戊戌，以蕭革、趙為果、耶律郁、馬保業充來歲賀宋正旦使副。
entries.en: On wuxu day Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.
entries.literal: On wuxu day, appointed Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.

entries.zh: 閏月辛亥，謁菆塗殿，閱玄宮器。
entries.en: In the intercalary month, on xinhai day, the court visited Zutu Hall and inspected inner-chamber vessels.
entries.literal: In the intercalary month, on xinhai day, visited Zutu Hall and inspected inner-chamber vessels.

entries.zh: 有司請以生辰為永壽節，皇太后生辰為應聖節，從之。
entries.en: The relevant offices requested making the Emperor's birthday the Eternal Longevity Festival and the Empress Dowager's birthday the Responding Sage Festival; approval was granted.
entries.literal: The relevant offices requested making the birthday the Eternal Longevity Festival and the Empress Dowager's birthday the Responding Sage Festival; approved.

entries.zh: 辛酉，閱新造鎧甲。
entries.en: On xinyou day newly made armor was inspected.
entries.literal: On xinyou day, inspected newly made armor.

entries.zh: 丁卯，振黃龍府饑民。
entries.en: On dingmao day hungry people in Huanglong Prefecture were relieved.
entries.literal: On dingmao day, relieved hungry people in Huanglong Prefecture.

entries.zh: 十一月壬辰，上率百僚奠於菆塗殿。
entries.en: On renchen day of the eleventh month the Emperor led all officials in offerings at Zutu Hall.
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen day, the Emperor led all officials in offerings at Zutu Hall.

entries.zh: 出大行皇帝服御、玩好焚之。
entries.en: The late Emperor's clothing, accoutrements, and treasured articles were brought out and burned.
entries.literal: Brought out the late Emperor's clothing, accoutrements, and treasured articles and burned them.

entries.zh: 縱五坊鷹鶻。
entries.en: The five-compound hawks and falcons were released.
entries.literal: Released the five-compound hawks and falcons.

entries.zh: 甲午，葬文武大孝宣皇帝於慶陵。
entries.en: On jiawu day the Cultured and Martial Great Filial Xuan Emperor was buried at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On jiawu day, buried the Cultured and Martial Great Filial Xuan Emperor at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 乙未，祭天地。
entries.en: On yiwei day sacrifices were offered to Heaven and Earth.
entries.literal: On yiwei day, sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.

entries.zh: 問安皇太后。
entries.en: The Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: Paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 丙申，謁慶陵，以遺物賜群臣，名其山曰慶雲，殿曰望仙。
entries.en: On bingshen day the court visited Qing Mausoleum, bestowed bequest articles on ministers, named the mountain Qingyun, and named the hall Wangxian.
entries.literal: On bingshen day, visited Qing Mausoleum, bestowed bequest articles on ministers, named the mountain Qingyun, and the hall Wangxian.

entries.zh: 十二月癸丑，至自慶陵。
entries.en: On guichou day of the twelfth month the court returned from Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on guichou day, returned from Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 皇太后聽政，帝不親庶務，群臣表請，不從。
entries.en: The Empress Dowager held court; the Emperor did not personally handle routine affairs; ministers memorialized requesting that he do so, but he did not agree.
entries.literal: The Empress Dowager held court; the Emperor did not personally handle routine affairs; ministers memorialized requesting [him to], but he did not agree.

entries.zh: 是歲，以興平公主下嫁夏國王李德昭子元昊，以元昊為夏國公、駙馬都尉。
entries.en: That year Princess Xingping was married to Li Dezhao's son Yuanhao of Xia State; Yuanhao was made Duke of Xia State and Commandant of Imperial Son-in-law.
entries.literal: That year, Princess Xingping was married to Li Dezhao's son Yuanhao of Xia State; Yuanhao was made Duke of Xia State and Commandant of Imperial Son-in-law.

entries.zh: 重熙元年春正月壬申朔，皇太后禦正殿，受帝與群臣朝。
entries.en: In the first year of Chongxi, on the renshen new moon of the first spring month the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.
entries.literal: In the first year of Chongxi, spring, first month, on the renshen new moon, the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.

entries.zh: 宋遣任布、王遵範、陳琰、王克善來賀。
entries.en: Song sent Ren Bu, Wang Zunfan, Chen Yan, and Wang Keshan with congratulations.
entries.literal: Song sent Ren Bu, Wang Zunfan, Chen Yan, and Wang Keshan to congratulate.

entries.zh: 乙亥，宋遣鄭向、郭遵範來賀永壽節。
entries.en: On yihai day Song sent Zheng Xiang and Guo Zunfan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.
entries.literal: On yihai day, Song sent Zheng Xiang and Guo Zunfan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

entries.zh: 丁丑，如雪林。
entries.en: On dingchou day the court went to Xuelin.
entries.literal: On dingchou day, went to Xuelin.

entries.zh: 二月，大蒐。
entries.en: In the second month a grand hunt was held.
entries.literal: In the second month, held a grand hunt.

entries.zh: 三月壬申朔，尚父、漆水郡王敵烈復為惕隱。
entries.en: On the renshen new moon of the third month Imperial Father, Prince of Qishui Dilie, was again appointed tiyin.
entries.literal: On the renshen new moon of the third month, Imperial Father, Prince of Qishui Dilie, was again appointed tiyin.

entries.zh: 是春，皇太后誣齊天皇后以罪，遣人即上京行弒。
entries.en: That spring the Empress Dowager falsely charged Empress Qi Tian with crimes and dispatched people to assassinate her at the Upper Capital.
entries.literal: That spring, the Empress Dowager falsely charged Empress Qi Tian with crimes and dispatched people to assassinate her at the Upper Capital.

entries.zh: 後請具浴以就死，許之。
entries.en: The Empress requested a full bath before death; permission was granted.
entries.literal: The Empress requested a full bath before death; permission was granted.

entries.zh: 有頃，後崩。
entries.en: Before long the Empress died.
entries.literal: Before long the Empress died.

entries.zh: 夏四月乙巳，清暑別輦鬥。
entries.en: On yisi day of the fourth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Bielian Dou.
entries.literal: In summer, fourth month, on yisi day, took summer retreat at Bielian Dou.

entries.zh: 秋七月，獵平地松林。
entries.en: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.
entries.literal: In autumn, seventh month, hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.

entries.zh: 以蕭達溥、王英秀、蕭麓、張素羽充來歲賀宋正旦生辰使。
entries.en: Xiao Dapu, Wang Yingxiu, Xiao Lu, and Zhang Suyu were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day and birthdays of the coming year.
entries.literal: Appointed Xiao Dapu, Wang Yingxiu, Xiao Lu, and Zhang Suyu envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day and birthdays of the coming year.

entries.zh: 八月丙午，駐蹕剌河源。
entries.en: In the eighth month, on bingwu day, the court encamped at Cila River source.
entries.literal: In the eighth month, on bingwu day, encamped at Cila River source.

entries.zh: 皇子洪基生。
entries.en: The imperial prince Hongji was born.
entries.literal: The imperial prince Hongji was born.

entries.zh: 冬十月己酉，幸中京。
entries.en: On jiyou day of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital.
entries.literal: In winter, tenth month, on jiyou day, visited the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 十一月己卯，帝率群臣上皇太后尊號曰法天應運仁德章聖皇太后；
entries.en: On jimao day of the eleventh month the Emperor led ministers in presenting to the Empress Dowager the honorific title Responding to Heaven, Following the Mandate, Benevolent and Virtuous, Manifest Sage Empress Dowager;
entries.literal: In the eleventh month, on jimao day, the Emperor led ministers in presenting to the Empress Dowager the honorific title Responding to Heaven, Following the Mandate, Benevolent and Virtuous, Manifest Sage Empress Dowager;

entries.zh: 群臣上皇帝尊號曰文武仁聖昭孝皇帝。
entries.en: ministers presented to the Emperor the honorific title Cultured and Martial, Benevolent and Sage, Illustrious and Filial Emperor.
entries.literal: ministers presented to the Emperor the honorific title Cultured and Martial, Benevolent and Sage, Illustrious and Filial Emperor.

entries.zh: 大赦，改元重熙。
entries.en: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Chongxi.
entries.literal: General amnesty; changed era name to Chongxi.

entries.zh: 癸未，宋遣劉隨、王德本來賀應聖節。
entries.en: On guiwei day Song sent Liu Sui and Wang Deben to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.
entries.literal: On guiwei day, Song sent Liu Sui and Wang Deben to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.

entries.zh: 以楊佶為翰林承旨。
entries.en: Yang Jie was appointed Hanlin Academician Recipient.
entries.literal: Made Yang Jie Hanlin Academician Recipient.

entries.zh: 丙戌，夏國遣使來賀。
entries.en: On bingxu day Xia State sent envoys to congratulate.
entries.literal: On bingxu day, Xia State sent envoys to congratulate.

entries.zh: 辛卯，五國酋長來貢。
entries.en: On xinmao day chiefs of the Five States came with tribute.
entries.literal: On xinmao day, chiefs of the Five States came with tribute.

entries.zh: 夏國王李德昭薨，冊其子夏國公元昊為夏國王。
entries.en: King Li Dezhao of Xia State died; his son Duke of Xia State Yuanhao was enfeoffed as King of Xia State.
entries.literal: King Li Dezhao of Xia State died; his son Duke of Xia State Yuanhao was enfeoffed as King of Xia State.

entries.zh: 十二月庚戌，宋遣胥偃、王從益、崔暨、張懷誌來賀來歲正旦；
entries.en: On gengxu day of the twelfth month Song sent Xu Yan, Wang Congyi, Cui Ji, and Zhang Huaizhi to congratulate New Year's Day of the coming year;
entries.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengxu day, Song sent Xu Yan, Wang Congyi, Cui Ji, and Zhang Huaizhi to congratulate New Year's Day of the coming year;

entries.zh: 又遣楊日嚴、王克纂來賀永壽節。
entries.en: Song also sent Yang Riyan and Wang Kezuan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.
entries.literal: also sent Yang Riyan and Wang Kezuan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

entries.zh: 以北大王耶律求翰同平章事。
entries.en: Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhan was appointed Associate Councilor of State.
entries.literal: Made Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhan Associate Councilor of State.

entries.zh: 是年，放進士劉師貞等五十七人。
entries.en: That year jinshi examinations were held and Liu Shizhen and fifty-six others passed.
entries.literal: That year, released jinshi Liu Shizhen and fifty-six others.

entries.zh: 三年春正月丁卯，宋使章頻卒，詔有司賻贈，命近侍護喪以歸。
entries.en: In the third year, on dingmao day of the first spring month Song envoy Zhang Pin died; an edict ordered the relevant offices to grant funeral gifts and commanded close attendants to escort the coffin home.
entries.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on dingmao day, Song envoy Zhang Pin died; edict ordered the relevant offices to grant funeral gifts and commanded close attendants to escort the coffin home.

entries.zh: 辛卯，如春水。
entries.en: On xinmao day the court went to spring waters.
entries.literal: On xinmao day, went to spring waters.

entries.zh: 二月壬辰朔，以北院樞密使蕭普古為東京留守。
entries.en: On the renchen new moon of the second month Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Pugu was appointed Eastern Capital regent.
entries.literal: On the renchen new moon of the second month, made Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Pugu Eastern Capital regent.

entries.zh: 戊申，耶律大師奴有侍繈褓恩，詔入屬籍。
entries.en: On wushen day Yelü Dashinu had cradle attendant grace; an edict ordered him entered into the clan registry.
entries.literal: On wushen day Yelü Dashinu had cradle attendant grace; edict ordered entry into the clan registry.

entries.zh: 夏四月甲寅，振耶迷只部。
entries.en: In the fourth summer month, on jiayin day, relief was provided for the Yemizhi tribe.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiayin day, provided relief for the Yemizhi tribe.

entries.zh: 五月庚申朔，清暑沿柳湖。
entries.en: On the gengshen new moon of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat along Yangliu Lake.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on the gengshen new moon, took summer retreat along Yangliu Lake.

entries.zh: 是月，皇太后還政於上，躬守慶陵。
entries.en: That month the Empress Dowager returned government to the Emperor and personally guarded Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: That month, the Empress Dowager returned government to the Emperor and personally guarded Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 六月己亥，以蕭普古為南院樞密使。
entries.en: On jihai day of the sixth month Xiao Pugu was appointed Southern Court Privy Commissioner.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jihai day, made Xiao Pugu Southern Court Privy Commissioner.

entries.zh: 秋七月戊子朔，上始親政，以耶律庶徵、劉六符、耶律睦、薄可久充賀宋來歲正旦使副。
entries.en: On the wuzi new moon of the seventh autumn month the Emperor began to personally administer government; Yelü Shuzheng, Liu Liufu, Yelü Mu, and Bo Kejiu were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the wuzi new moon, the Emperor began to personally administer government; appointed Yelü Shuzheng, Liu Liufu, Yelü Mu, and Bo Kejiu chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.

entries.zh: 壬辰，如秋山。
entries.en: On renchen day the court went to Autumn Mountain.
entries.literal: On renchen day, went to Autumn Mountain.

entries.zh: 冬十月已未，駐蹕中會川。
entries.en: On jiwei day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Zhonghui River.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiwei day, halted at Zhonghui River.

entries.zh: 十二月，宋遣段少連、杜仁贊來賀來歲正旦，楊偕、李守忠來賀永壽節。
entries.en: In the twelfth month Song sent Duan Shaolian and Du Renzan to congratulate New Year's Day of the coming year, and Yang Xie and Li Shouzhong to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, Song dispatched Duan Shaolian and Du Renzan to congratulate New Year's Day of the coming year; Yang Xie and Li Shouzhong to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

entries.zh: 興宗一
entries.en: Xingzong, Part One
entries.literal: Xingzong, Part One

entries.zh: 十年春正月辛亥朔，宋遣梁適、張從一、富弼、趙日宣來賀。
entries.en: In the tenth year, on the xinhai new moon of the first spring month Song sent Liang Shi, Zhang Congyi, Fu Bi, and Zhao Rixuan with congratulations.
entries.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on the xinhai new moon, Song dispatched Liang Shi, Zhang Congyi, Fu Bi, and Zhao Rixuan to come congratulate.

entries.zh: 甲子，復遣吳育、馮戴來賀永壽節。
entries.en: On jiazi day Wu Yu and Feng Dai were again dispatched to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, again dispatched Wu Yu and Feng Dai to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

entries.zh: 二月庚辰朔，詔蒲盧毛朵部歸曷蘇館戶之沒入者使復業。
entries.en: On the gengchen new moon of the second month an edict ordered households of the Pulu Modu tribe who had returned to Yasus Guan and been confiscated to resume their occupations.
entries.literal: Second month, on the gengchen new moon, edict ordered households of the Pulu Modu tribe who had returned to Yasus Guan and been confiscated to resume their occupations.

entries.zh: 甲申，北樞密院言，南、北二王府及諸部節度侍衛祗候郎君，皆出族帳，既免與民戍邊，其祗候事，請亦得以部曲代行。
entries.en: On jiashen day the Northern Privy Council reported that attendants of the Southern and Northern Princes' palaces and various tribal military commissioners all came from tribal tents; since they were exempted from border garrison service along with commoners, it requested that attendant duties also be permitted to be performed by retainers in their stead.
entries.literal: On jiashen day, Northern Privy Council reported that attendants of the Southern and Northern Princes' palaces and various tribal military commissioners all came from tribal tents; since they were exempted from border garrison service along with commoners, it requested that attendant duties also be permitted to be performed by retainers in their stead.

entries.zh: 詔從其請。
entries.en: An edict approved the request.
entries.literal: Edict approved the request.

entries.zh: 夏四月，詔罷修鴨淥江浮梁及漢兵屯戍之役。
entries.en: In the fourth summer month an edict abolished the work of building the Yalü River pontoon bridge and Han troops' border garrison service.
entries.literal: In summer, fourth month, edict abolished the work of building the Yalü River pontoon bridge and Han troops' border garrison service.

entries.zh: 又以東京留守蕭撒八言，馳東京擊鞠之禁。
entries.en: Also, because Eastern Capital regent Xiao Saba memorialized, the ban on cuju in the Eastern Capital was lifted.
entries.literal: Also, because Eastern Capital regent Xiao Saba memorialized, lifted the ban on cuju in the Eastern Capital.

entries.zh: 六月戊寅朔，以蕭寧、耶律坦、崔禹稱、馬世良、耶律仁先、劉六符充賀宋生辰使副；
entries.en: On the wuyin new moon of the sixth month Xiao Ning, Yelü Tan, Cui Yucheng, Ma Shiliang, Yelü Renxian, and Liu Liufu were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays;
entries.literal: Sixth month, on the wuyin new moon, appointed Xiao Ning, Yelü Tan, Cui Yucheng, Ma Shiliang, Yelü Renxian, and Liu Liufu chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays;

entries.zh: 耶律庶成、趙成、耶律烈、張旦充來歲賀宋正旦使副。
entries.en: Yelü Shucheng, Zhao Cheng, Yelü Lie, and Zhang Dan were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.
entries.literal: Yelü Shucheng, Zhao Cheng, Yelü Lie, and Zhang Dan chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.

entries.zh: 秋七月壬戌，詔諸職官私取官物者，以正盜論。
entries.en: On renxu day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered that officials who privately took government goods be judged as common theft.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renxu day, edict ordered that officials who privately took government goods be judged as common theft.

entries.zh: 諸敢以先朝已斷事相告言者，罪之。
entries.en: Whoever dared to bring lawsuits citing cases already decided in former reigns was to be punished.
entries.literal: Whoever dared to bring lawsuits citing cases already decided in former reigns was to be punished.

entries.zh: 諸帳郎君等於禁地射鹿，決三百，不征償；
entries.en: Attendant langjun who hunted deer in forbidden grounds received three hundred strokes and were not assessed compensation;
entries.literal: Attendant langjun who hunted deer in forbidden grounds received three hundred strokes and were not assessed compensation;

entries.zh: 小將軍決二百以下；
entries.en: lesser generals received two hundred strokes or less;
entries.literal: lesser generals received two hundred strokes or less;

entries.zh: 及百姓犯者，罪同郎君論。
entries.en: and commoners who violated were punished on the same terms as langjun.
entries.literal: and commoners who violated were punished on the same terms as langjun.

entries.zh: 八月丙戌，以醫者鄧延貞治詳穩蕭留寧疾驗，贈其父母官以獎之。
entries.en: On bingxu day of the eighth month, because physician Deng Yanzhen's treatment of xiangwen Xiao Liuning's illness proved effective, his parents were granted official rank as reward.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on bingxu day, because physician Deng Yanzhen's treatment of xiangwen Xiao Liuning's illness proved effective, his parents were granted official rank as reward.

entries.zh: 九月辛亥，朝皇太后。
entries.en: On xinhai day of the ninth month the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on xinhai day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 國舅留寧薨。
entries.en: Imperial maternal uncle Liuning died.
entries.literal: Imperial maternal uncle Liuning died.

entries.zh: 庚申，皇太后射獲熊，上進酒為壽。
entries.en: On gengshen day the Empress Dowager shot and captured a bear, and the Emperor offered wine to wish her long life.
entries.literal: On gengshen day, the Empress Dowager shot and captured a bear; the Emperor offered wine to wish her long life.

entries.zh: 癸亥，上獵馬孟山，草木蒙密，恐獵者誤射傷人，命耶律迪姑各書姓名於矢以誌之。
entries.en: On guihai day the Emperor hunted at Ma Meng Mountain; vegetation was thick and dense, and fearing hunters might accidentally shoot and injure people, he ordered Yelü Digu and the others each to write their names on their arrows for identification.
entries.literal: On guihai day, the Emperor hunted at Ma Meng Mountain; vegetation was thick and dense, fearing hunters might accidentally shoot and injure people, he ordered Yelü Digu and the others each to write their names on their arrows for identification.

entries.zh: 丙寅，夏國獻宋俘。
entries.en: On bingyin day Xia State presented Song captives.
entries.literal: On bingyin day, Xia State presented Song captives.

entries.zh: 以石硬砦太保郭三避虎不射，免官。
entries.en: Because Shiying Stockade grand preceptor Guo San avoided a tiger and did not shoot, he was dismissed from office.
entries.literal: Because Shiying Stockade grand preceptor Guo San avoided a tiger and did not shoot, he was dismissed from office.

entries.zh: 冬十月丙戌，詔東京留守蕭孝忠察官吏有廉幹清強者，具以名聞。
entries.en: On bingxu day of the tenth winter month an edict ordered Eastern Capital regent Xiao Xiaozhong to investigate officials who were incorruptible, capable, pure, and forceful, and report their names in full.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingxu day, edict ordered Eastern Capital regent Xiao Xiaozhong to investigate officials who were incorruptible, capable, pure, and forceful, and report their names in full.

entries.zh: 庚寅，以女直太師臺押為曷蘇館都大王。
entries.en: On gengyin day Jurchen grand preceptor Taiya was made Great King of Yasus Guan.
entries.literal: On gengyin day, made Jurchen grand preceptor Taiya Great King of Yasus Guan.

entries.zh: 辛卯，以皇子胡盧斡裏生，北宰相、駙馬撒八寧迎上至其第宴飲，上命衛士與漢人角觝為樂。
entries.en: On xinmao day, because the imperial prince Hulu Woli was born, Northern Chancellor and imperial son-in-law Saba Ning welcomed the Emperor to his residence for feasting and drinking; the Emperor ordered guards and Han people to wrestle for amusement.
entries.literal: On xinmao day, because the imperial prince Hulu Woli was born, Northern Chancellor and imperial son-in-law Saba Ning welcomed the Emperor to his residence for feasting and drinking; the Emperor ordered guards and Han people to wrestle for amusement.

entries.zh: 壬辰，復飲皇太后殿，以皇子生，肆赦。
entries.en: On renchen day the court drank again in the Empress Dowager's hall; because an imperial prince had been born, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: On renchen day, drank again in the Empress Dowager's hall; because an imperial prince was born, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

entries.zh: 夕，復引公主、駙馬及內族大臣入寢殿劇飲。
entries.en: In the evening princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and inner-chamber ministers were summoned into the sleeping hall for heavy drinking again.
entries.literal: In the evening, summoned princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and inner-chamber ministers into the sleeping hall for heavy drinking again.

entries.zh: 甲午，幸中京。
entries.en: On jiawu day the court visited the Central Capital.
entries.literal: On jiawu day, visited the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 庚子，以駙馬都尉蕭忽列為國舅詳穩。
entries.en: On gengzi day imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hulie was appointed imperial maternal uncle xiangwen.
entries.literal: On gengzi day, made imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hulie imperial maternal uncle xiangwen.

entries.zh: 十一月丙辰，回鶻遣使來貢。
entries.en: On bingchen day of the eleventh month Uighur sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on bingchen day, Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 十二月丙子朔，宋遣劉沆、王整來賀應聖節。
entries.en: On the bingzi new moon of the twelfth month Song sent Liu Hang and Wang Zheng to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on the bingzi new moon, Song dispatched Liu Hang and Wang Zheng to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.

entries.zh: 乙未，置撻朮不姑酋長。
entries.en: On yiwei day chiefs were established for the Tazhubu Gu tribe.
entries.literal: On yiwei day, established chiefs for the Tazhubu Gu tribe.

entries.zh: 以胡撻剌為平章事。
entries.en: Hu Talaci was appointed Associate Councilor of State.
entries.literal: Made Hu Talaci Associate Councilor of State.

entries.zh: 上聞宋設關河，治壕塹，恐為邊患，與南、北樞密吳國王蕭孝穆、趙國王蕭貫寧謀取宋舊割關南十縣地，遂遣蕭英、劉六符使宋。
entries.en: The Emperor heard that Song had fortified the passes and rivers and dug moats and feared it would become a border threat; with Southern and Northern Privy Commissioners Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu and Prince of Zhao Xiao Guanning he plotted to recover the ten Song counties south of the passes ceded in former times, and thereupon dispatched Xiao Ying and Liu Liufu as envoys to Song.
entries.literal: The Emperor heard that Song had fortified the passes and rivers and dug moats, fearing it would become a border threat; with Southern and Northern Privy Commissioners Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu and Prince of Zhao Xiao Guanning he plotted to recover the ten Song counties south of the passes ceded in former times, and thereupon dispatched Xiao Ying and Liu Liufu as envoys to Song.

entries.zh: 庚寅，宋遣張沔、侯宗亮、薛申、侍其浚、施昌言、潘永照來賀永壽節及來歲正旦。
entries.en: On gengyin day Song sent Zhang Mian, Hou Zongliang, Xue Shen, Shi Qijun, Shi Changyan, and Pan Yongzhao to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival and New Year's Day of the coming year.
entries.literal: On gengyin day, Song dispatched Zhang Mian, Hou Zongliang, Xue Shen, Shi Qijun, Shi Changyan, and Pan Yongzhao to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival and New Year's Day of the coming year.

entries.zh: 以宣政殿學士楊佶為吏部尚書、判順義軍節度使事。
entries.en: Xuanzheng Hall academician Yang Jie was appointed Minister of Personnel and administrator of Shunyi Army military commissioner affairs.
entries.literal: Made Xuanzheng Hall academician Yang Jie Minister of Personnel and administrator of Shunyi Army military commissioner affairs.

entries.zh: 丁酉，議伐宋，詔諭諸道。
entries.en: On dingyou day an attack on Song was discussed, and an edict ordered proclamation to all routes.
entries.literal: On dingyou day, discussed attacking Song; edict ordered proclamation to all routes.

entries.zh: 十三年春正月甲子朔，朝皇太后。
entries.en: In the thirteenth year, on the jiazi new moon of the first spring month, the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: Thirteenth year, spring, first month, on the jiazi new moon, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 戊辰，如混同江。
entries.en: On wuchen day the court went to Huntong River.
entries.literal: On wuchen day, went to Huntong River.

entries.zh: 辛未，獵兀魯館岡。
entries.en: On xinwei day the court hunted at Wulu Pavilion Ridge.
entries.literal: On xinwei day, hunted at Wulu Pavilion Ridge.

entries.zh: 二月庚戌，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: On gengxu day of the second month the court went to Yu'er Marsh.
entries.literal: Second month, on gengxu day, went to Yu'er Marsh.

entries.zh: 丙辰，以參知政事杜防為南府宰相。
entries.en: On bingchen day Associate Councilor Du Fang was appointed Southern Chancellor.
entries.literal: On bingchen day, made Associate Councilor Du Fang Southern Chancellor.

entries.zh: 三月丁亥，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the third month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Third month, on dinghai day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 以宣政殿學士楊佶參知政事。
entries.en: Xuanzheng Hall academician Yang Jie was appointed Associate Councilor.
entries.literal: Made Xuanzheng Hall academician Yang Jie Associate Councilor.

entries.zh: 是月，置契丹警巡院。
entries.en: That month a Khitan patrol inspectorate was established.
entries.literal: That month, established Khitan patrol inspectorate.

entries.zh: 夏四月己酉，遣東京留守耶律侯哂、知黃龍府事耶律歐裏斯將兵攻蒲盧毛朵部。
entries.en: On jiyou day of the fourth summer month Eastern Capital regent Yelü Houshen and Huanglong Prefecture intendant Yelü Oulisi were dispatched to lead troops against the Puluhu Modu tribe.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiyou day, dispatched Eastern Capital regent Yelü Houshen and Huanglong Prefecture intendant Yelü Oulisi to lead troops against the Puluhu Modu tribe.

entries.zh: 甲寅，南院大王耶律高十奏党項等部叛附夏國。
entries.en: On jiayin day Southern Court great king Yelü Gaoshi memorialized that Tangut and other tribes had rebelled and submitted to Xia State.
entries.literal: On jiayin day, Southern Court great king Yelü Gaoshi memorialized that Tangut and other tribes had rebelled and submitted to Xia State.

entries.zh: 丙辰，西南面招討都監羅漢奴、詳穩斡魯母等奏，山西部族節度使屈烈以五部叛入西夏，乞南、北府兵援送實威塞州戶。
entries.en: On bingchen day Southwestern Route pacification inspector Luohan Nu, xiangwen Wulumu, and others memorialized that Western Mountain tribal military commissioner Qulie had led five tribes in rebellion into Western Xia and requested Northern and Southern Court troops to aid in escorting Shiwei Saizhou households.
entries.literal: On bingchen day, Southwestern Route pacification inspector Luohan Nu, xiangwen Wulumu, and others memorialized that Western Mountain tribal military commissioner Qulie led five tribes in rebellion into Western Xia, requesting Northern and Southern Court troops to aid in escorting Shiwei Saizhou households.

entries.zh: 詔富者遣行，余留屯田天德軍。
entries.en: An edict ordered the wealthy to go; the remainder were to stay and farm at Tiande Army.
entries.literal: Edict ordered the wealthy to go; the remainder to stay and farm at Tiande Army.

entries.zh: 五月壬戌朔，羅漢奴奏所發部兵與党項戰不利，招討使蕭普達、四捷軍詳穩張佛奴歿於陣。
entries.en: On the renxu new moon of the fifth month Luohan Nu memorialized that dispatched tribal troops had fought Tangut unfavorably; pacification commissioner Xiao Puda and Sijie Army xiangwen Zhang Fonu died in battle.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on the renxu new moon, Luohan Nu memorialized that dispatched tribal troops fought Tangut unfavorably; pacification commissioner Xiao Puda and Sijie Army xiangwen Zhang Fonu died in battle.

entries.zh: 李元昊來援叛黨。
entries.en: Li Yuanhao came to aid the rebels.
entries.literal: Li Yuanhao came to aid the rebels.

entries.zh: 戊辰，詔征諸道兵會西南邊以討元昊。
entries.en: On wuchen day an edict ordered troops from all routes mustered to assemble on the southwestern border to attack Yuanhao.
entries.literal: On wuchen day, edict ordered mustering troops from all routes to assemble on the southwestern border to attack Yuanhao.

entries.zh: 六月甲午，阻卜酋長烏八遣其子執元昊所遣求援使窊邑改來，乞以兵助戰，從之。
entries.en: On jiawu day of the sixth month Zubu chieftain Wuba sent his son with Yuanhao's dispatched envoy seeking aid, Woyigai, whom he had seized, requesting troops to aid in battle; approval was granted.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jiawu day, Zubu chieftain Wuba sent his son bringing Yuanhao's dispatched envoy seeking aid Woyigai, whom he had seized, requesting troops to aid in battle; approved.

entries.zh: 駐蹕永安山。
entries.en: The court halted at Yong'an Mountain.
entries.literal: Halted at Yong'an Mountain.

entries.zh: 以將伐夏，遣延昌宮使耶律高家奴告宋。
entries.en: Because the court was about to attack Xia, Yanchang Palace commissioner Yelü Gao Jianu was dispatched to inform Song.
entries.literal: Because about to attack Xia, dispatched Yanchang Palace commissioner Yelü Gao Jianu to inform Song.

entries.zh: 丙申，詔前南院大王耶律谷欲、翰林都林牙耶律庶成等編集國朝上世以來事跡。
entries.en: On bingshen day an edict ordered former Southern Court great king Yelü Guyu, Hanlin Chief Linya Yelü Shucheng, and others to compile court records from the founding to the present.
entries.literal: On bingshen day, edict ordered former Southern Court great king Yelü Guyu, Hanlin Chief Linya Yelü Shucheng, and others to compile court records from the founding to the present.

entries.zh: 丙午，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On bingwu day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On bingwu day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 丁未，錄囚。
entries.en: On dingwei day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On dingwei day, reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 秋七月辛酉，香河縣民李宜兒以左道惑眾，伏誅。
entries.en: On xinyou day of the seventh autumn month Xianghe county man Li Yier was executed for leading the people astray by heterodox practices.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinyou day, Xianghe county man Li Yier was executed for leading the people astray by heterodox practices.

entries.zh: 庚午，行再生禮。
entries.en: On gengwu day the rebirth rite was performed.
entries.literal: On gengwu day, performed the rebirth rite.

entries.zh: 庚辰，夏國遣使來朝。
entries.en: On gengchen day Xia State sent envoys to court.
entries.literal: On gengchen day, Xia State dispatched envoys to court.

entries.zh: 八月乙未，以夏使對不以情，羈之。
entries.en: On yiwei day of the eighth month, because the Xia envoy answered without sincerity, he was detained.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on yiwei day, because the Xia envoy answered without sincerity, he was detained.

entries.zh: 丁巳，夏國復遣使來，詢以事宜，又不以實對，笞之。
entries.en: On dingsi day Xia State again sent envoys; when questioned on affairs they again answered untruthfully and were flogged.
entries.literal: On dingsi day, Xia State again dispatched envoys; questioned on affairs and again answered untruthfully; flogged.

entries.zh: 九月戊辰，宋以親征夏國，遣余靖致贐禮。
entries.en: On wuchen day of the ninth month, because Song was personally campaigning against Xia State, Yu Jing was dispatched with parting gifts.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on wuchen day, because Song was personally campaigning against Xia State, Yu Jing was dispatched with parting gifts.

entries.zh: 壬申，會大軍於九十九泉，以皇太弟重元、北院樞密使韓國王蕭惠將先鋒兵西征。
entries.en: On renshen day the great army assembled at Ninety-nine Springs; Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan and Northern Court Privy Commissioner King of Han Xiao Hui commanded vanguard troops on a western expedition.
