entries.literal: On renshen day, assembled the great army at Ninety-nine Springs; Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan and Northern Court Privy Commissioner King of Han Xiao Hui commanded vanguard troops on a western expedition.

entries.zh: 冬十月庚寅，祭天地。
entries.en: On gengyin day of the tenth winter month sacrifices were offered to Heaven and Earth.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengyin day, sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.

entries.zh: 丙申，獲党項偵人，射鬼箭。
entries.en: On bingshen day Tangut scouts were captured and ghost arrows were shot.
entries.literal: On bingshen day, captured Tangut scouts; shot ghost arrows.

entries.zh: 丁酉，李元昊上表謝罪。
entries.en: On dingyou day Li Yuanhao submitted a memorial begging forgiveness.
entries.literal: On dingyou day, Li Yuanhao submitted a memorial begging forgiveness.

entries.zh: 己亥，元昊遣使來奏，欲收叛黨以獻，從之。
entries.en: On jihai day Yuanhao sent envoys memorializing that he wished to take back the rebels and present them; approval was granted.
entries.literal: On jihai day, Yuanhao dispatched envoys memorializing that he wished to take back the rebels to present them; approved.

entries.zh: 辛亥，元昊遣使來進方物，詔北院樞密副使蕭革迓之。
entries.en: On xinhai day Yuanhao sent envoys presenting local products; an edict ordered Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ge to meet them.
entries.literal: On xinhai day, Yuanhao dispatched envoys presenting local products; edict ordered Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ge to meet them.

entries.zh: 壬子，軍於河曲。
entries.en: On renzi day the army encamped at River Bend.
entries.literal: On renzi day, encamped at River Bend.

entries.zh: 革言元昊親率党項三部來，詔革詰其納叛背盟，元昊伏罪，賜酒。
entries.en: Xiao Ge reported that Yuanhao was personally leading three Tangut tribes; an edict ordered Ge to reproach him for accepting rebels and breaking the alliance; Yuanhao acknowledged guilt and was granted wine.
entries.literal: Ge reported Yuanhao was personally leading three Tangut tribes; edict ordered Ge to reproach him for accepting rebels and breaking the alliance; Yuanhao acknowledged guilt and was granted wine.

entries.zh: 許以自新，遣之。
entries.en: He was permitted to reform and was dispatched.
entries.literal: Permitted him to reform; dispatched him.

entries.zh: 召群臣議，皆以大軍既集，宜加討伐。
entries.en: The ministers were summoned for deliberation; all held that with the great army already assembled, attack should be pressed.
entries.literal: Summoned ministers for deliberation; all held that with the great army already assembled, attack should be pressed.

entries.zh: 癸丑，督數路兵掩襲，殺數千人，駙馬都尉蕭胡睹為夏人所執。
entries.en: On guichou day troops of several routes were urged in a surprise raid, killing several thousand; imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hudu was captured by Xia.
entries.literal: On guichou day, urged troops of several routes in a surprise raid, killing several thousand; imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hudu was captured by Xia.

entries.zh: 丁巳，元昊遣使以先被執者來歸，詔所留夏使亦還其國。
entries.en: On dingsi day Yuanhao sent envoys returning those previously captured; an edict ordered detained Xia envoys also returned to their state.
entries.literal: On dingsi day, Yuanhao dispatched envoys returning those previously captured; edict ordered detained Xia envoys also returned to their state.

entries.zh: 十一月辛酉，賜有功將校有差。
entries.en: On xinyou day of the eleventh month meritorious officers and soldiers were rewarded in differing amounts.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on xinyou day, rewarded meritorious officers and soldiers in differing amounts.

entries.zh: 甲子，班師。
entries.en: On jiazi day the army withdrew.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, withdrew the army.

entries.zh: 丁卯，改雲州為西京。
entries.en: On dingmao day Yun Prefecture was renamed Western Capital.
entries.literal: On dingmao day, changed Yun Prefecture to Western Capital.

entries.zh: 辛巳，朝皇太后。
entries.en: On xinsi day the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: On xinsi day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 十二月己丑，幸西京。
entries.en: On jichou day of the twelfth month the court visited Western Capital.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on jichou day, visited Western Capital.

entries.zh: 戊戌，以北院樞密副使耶律敵烈為右夷離畢。
entries.en: On wuxu day Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Dilie was appointed right yilibi.
entries.literal: On wuxu day, made Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Dilie right yilibi.

entries.zh: 己亥，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On jihai day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On jihai day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 戊申，蕭胡睹自夏來歸。
entries.en: On wushen day Xiao Hudu returned from Xia.
entries.literal: On wushen day, Xiao Hudu returned from Xia.

entries.zh: 十一年春正月戊申，奉迎皇太后於內殿。
entries.en: In the eleventh year, on wushen day of the first spring month the Empress Dowager was escorted into the inner hall.
entries.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, on wushen day, escorted the Empress Dowager into the inner hall.

entries.zh: 庚戌，遣南院宣徽使蕭特末、翰林學士劉六符使宋，取晉陽及瓦橋以南十縣地；
entries.en: On gengxu day Southern Court commissioner of the palace secretariat Xiao Teme and Hanlin Academician Liu Liufu were dispatched as envoys to Song to recover the ten counties south of Jinyang and Waqiao;
entries.literal: On gengxu day, dispatched Southern Court commissioner of the palace secretariat Xiao Teme and Hanlin Academician Liu Liufu as envoys to Song to recover the ten counties south of Jinyang and Waqiao;

entries.zh: 且問興師伐夏及沿邊疏浚水澤、增益兵戍之故。
entries.en: and also to inquire into the reasons for mobilizing troops against Xia and dredging border marshes and increasing military garrisons.
entries.literal: and also to inquire into the reasons for mobilizing troops against Xia and dredging border marshes and increasing military garrisons.

entries.zh: 二月壬寅，如鴛鴦濼。
entries.en: On renyin day of the second month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
entries.literal: Second month, on renyin day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.

entries.zh: 夏四月甲戌朔，頒南征賞罰令。
entries.en: On the jiaxu new moon of the fourth summer month reward-and-punishment regulations for the southern campaign were promulgated.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the jiaxu new moon, promulgated reward-and-punishment regulations for the southern campaign.

entries.zh: 六月乙亥，宋遣富弼、張茂實奉書來聘，以書答之。
entries.en: On yihai day of the sixth month Song sent Fu Bi and Zhang Maoshi bearing letters on a goodwill mission, and a letter was sent in reply.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on yihai day, Song dispatched Fu Bi and Zhang Maoshi bearing letters on a goodwill mission; replied with a letter.

entries.zh: 壬午，禦含涼殿，放進士王寔等六十四人。
entries.en: On renwu day the court presided at Hailiang Hall and released jinshi Wang Shi and sixty-four others.
entries.literal: On renwu day, presided at Hailiang Hall and released jinshi Wang Shi and sixty-four others.

entries.zh: 禁氈、銀鬻入宋。
entries.en: The sale of felt and silver into Song was forbidden.
entries.literal: Forbade the sale of felt and silver into Song.

entries.zh: 秋七月壬寅朔，詔盜易官馬者減死論。
entries.en: On the renyin new moon of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered that those who stole or swapped official horses receive reduced death sentences.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the renyin new moon, edict ordered that those who stole or swapped official horses receive reduced death sentences.

entries.zh: 外路官勤瘁正直者，考滿代；
entries.en: Outside-route officials who were diligent and upright were replaced at term's end;
entries.literal: Outside-route officials who were diligent and upright were replaced at term's end;

entries.zh: 不治事者即易之。
entries.en: those who did not handle affairs were replaced immediately.
entries.literal: those who did not handle affairs were replaced immediately.

entries.zh: 八月丙申，宋復遣富弼、張茂實奉書來聘，乞增歲幣銀絹，以書答之。
entries.en: On bingshen day of the eighth month Song again sent Fu Bi and Zhang Maoshi bearing letters on a goodwill mission, requesting increased annual tribute in silver and silk, and a letter was sent in reply.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on bingshen day, Song again dispatched Fu Bi and Zhang Maoshi bearing letters on a goodwill mission, requesting increased annual tribute in silver and silk; replied with a letter.

entries.zh: 九月壬寅，遣北院樞密副使耶律仁先、漢人行宮副部署劉六符使宋約和。
entries.en: On renyin day of the ninth month Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian and Han traveling palace deputy deployment director Liu Liufu were dispatched as envoys to Song to negotiate peace.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, dispatched Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian and Han traveling palace deputy deployment director Liu Liufu as envoys to Song to negotiate peace.

entries.zh: 是時，富弼為上言，大意謂遼與宋和，坐獲歲幣，則利在國家，臣下無與；
entries.en: At that time Fu Bi spoke to the Emperor, the general purport being that if Liao made peace with Song and passively received annual tribute, the benefit lay with the state and subordinates had no share;
entries.literal: At that time Fu Bi spoke to the Emperor, the general purport being that if Liao made peace with Song and passively received annual tribute, the benefit lay with the state and subordinates had no share;

entries.zh: 與宋交兵，則利在臣下，害在國家。
entries.en: if Liao fought Song, the benefit lay with subordinates and the harm with the state.
entries.literal: if Liao fought Song, the benefit lay with subordinates and the harm with the state.

entries.zh: 上感其言，和好始定。
entries.en: The Emperor was moved by his words, and friendly relations were finally settled.
entries.literal: The Emperor was moved by his words, and friendly relations were finally settled.

entries.zh: 閏月癸未，耶律仁先遣人報，宋歲增銀、絹十萬兩、匹，文書稱貢，送至白溝；
entries.en: On guiwei day of the intercalary month Yelü Renxian dispatched a messenger reporting that Song's annual tribute was increased by one hundred thousand taels of silver and bolts of silk, the documents called it tribute, and it was delivered to Baigou;
entries.literal: Intercalary month, on guiwei day, Yelü Renxian dispatched a messenger reporting that Song's annual tribute was increased by one hundred thousand taels of silver and bolts of silk, the documents called it tribute, delivered to Baigou;

entries.zh: 帝喜，宴群臣於昭慶殿。
entries.en: the Emperor was pleased and feasted ministers at Zhaoqing Hall.
entries.literal: the Emperor was pleased and feasted ministers at Zhaoqing Hall.

entries.zh: 是日，振恤三父族之貧者。
entries.en: That day relief was provided for the poor among the three paternal clans.
entries.literal: That day, relief was provided for the poor among the three paternal clans.

entries.zh: 辛卯，仁先、劉六符還，進宋國誓書。
entries.en: On xinmao day Renxian and Liu Liufu returned and presented the Song State oath document.
entries.literal: On xinmao day, Renxian and Liu Liufu returned and presented the Song State oath document.

entries.zh: 冬十一月丁亥，群臣加上尊號曰聰文聖武英略神功睿哲仁孝皇帝，冊皇后蕭氏曰貞懿宣慈崇聖皇后。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the eleventh winter month ministers added the honorific title Sagacious Cultured, Sagacious Martial, Heroic Strategist, Divine Merit, Wise Sage, Benevolent Filial Emperor, and invested Empress Xiao as Chaste Virtuous, Proclaiming Benevolence, Exalted Sage Empress.
entries.literal: Winter, eleventh month, on dinghai day, ministers added the honorific title Sagacious Cultured, Sagacious Martial, Heroic Strategist, Divine Merit, Wise Sage, Benevolent Filial Emperor, and invested Empress Xiao as Chaste Virtuous, Proclaiming Benevolence, Exalted Sage Empress.

entries.zh: 太赦。
entries.en: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: General amnesty.

entries.zh: 梁王洪基進封燕國王。
entries.en: Prince of Liang Hongji was advanced to Prince of Yan.
entries.literal: Prince of Liang Hongji was advanced to Prince of Yan.

entries.zh: 十二月癸卯，朝皇太后。
entries.en: On guimao day of the twelfth month the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on guimao day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 甲辰，封皇太弟重元子涅魯古為安定郡王。
entries.en: On jiachen day Imperial Grand Younger Brother Chongyuan's son Nielugu was enfeoffed as Duke of Anding Commandery.
entries.literal: On jiachen day, enfeoffed Imperial Grand Younger Brother Chongyuan's son Nielugu as Duke of Anding Commandery.

entries.zh: 己酉，以宣獻皇后忌日，上與皇太后素服，飯僧於延壽、憫忠、三學三寺。
entries.en: On jiyou day, because it was Empress Xuanxian's death anniversary, the Emperor and Empress Dowager wore plain dress and fed monks at Yanshou, Minzhong, and Sanxue temples.
entries.literal: On jiyou day, because it was Empress Xuanxian's death anniversary, the Emperor and Empress Dowager wore plain dress and fed monks at Yanshou, Minzhong, and Sanxue temples.

entries.zh: 辛亥，詔蠲預備伐宋諸部租稅一年。
entries.en: On xinhai day an edict remitted one year's rent and tax for tribes that had prepared to attack Song.
entries.literal: On xinhai day, edict remitted one year's rent and tax for tribes that had prepared to attack Song.

entries.zh: 壬子，以吐渾、党項多鬻馬夏國，詔謹邊防。
entries.en: On renzi day, because the Tuyuhun and Tangut frequently sold horses to Xia State, an edict ordered strict border defense.
entries.literal: On renzi day, because the Tuyuhun and Tangut frequently sold horses to Xia State, edict ordered strict border defense.

entries.zh: 己未，宋遣賀正旦及永壽節使居邸，帝微服往觀。
entries.en: On jiwei day Song envoys congratulating on New Year's Day and the Eternal Longevity Festival were staying at their lodgings, and the Emperor went in disguise to observe them.
entries.literal: On jiwei day, Song envoys congratulating on New Year's Day and the Eternal Longevity Festival were staying at their lodgings; the Emperor went in disguise to observe them.

entries.zh: 丁卯，禁喪葬殺牛馬及藏珍寶。
entries.en: On dingmao day killing cattle and horses at funerals and hoarding precious treasures were forbidden.
entries.literal: On dingmao day, forbade killing cattle and horses at funerals and hoarding precious treasures.

entries.zh: 十二年春正月辛未，遣同知析津府事耶律敵烈、樞密院都承旨王惟吉諭夏國與宋和。
entries.en: In the twelfth year, on xinwei day of the first spring month Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji were dispatched to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.
entries.literal: Twelfth year, spring, first month, on xinwei day, dispatched Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.

entries.zh: 壬申，以吳國王蕭孝穆為南院樞密使，北府宰相蕭孝忠北院樞密使，封楚王，韓國王蕭惠北府宰相、同知元帥府事，韓八南院大王，耶律侯哂東京留守，北院樞密副使耶律仁先同知東京留守事，北面林牙蕭革北院樞密副使。
entries.en: On renshen day Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Southern Privy Commissioner; Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaozhong was made Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Chu; Prince of Han Xiao Hui was made Northern Chancellor and co-administrator of the marshal headquarters; Han Ba was made Southern Court great king; Yelü Houshen was appointed Eastern Capital regent; Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian was made co-administrator of Eastern Capital regent affairs; and Northern Court linya Xiao Ge was appointed Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.
entries.literal: On renshen day, made Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu Southern Privy Commissioner, Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaozhong Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Chu, Prince of Han Xiao Hui Northern Chancellor and co-administrator of the marshal headquarters, Han Ba Southern Court great king, Yelü Houshen Eastern Capital regent, Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian co-administrator of Eastern Capital regent affairs, Northern Court linya Xiao Ge Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.

entries.zh: 甲戌，如武清寨葦澱。
entries.en: On jiaxu day the court went to Wuqing Stockade Reed Marsh.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day, went to Wuqing Stockade Reed Marsh.

entries.zh: 二月壬寅，禁關南漢民弓矢。
entries.en: On renyin day of the second month Han commoners south of the passes were forbidden from possessing bows and arrows.
entries.literal: Second month, on renyin day, forbade Han commoners south of the passes from possessing bows and arrows.

entries.zh: 己酉，夏國以加上尊號，遣使來賀。
entries.en: On jiyou day Xia State, because of the added honorific title, sent envoys to congratulate.
entries.literal: On jiyou day, Xia State, because of the added honorific title, dispatched envoys to congratulate.

entries.zh: 甲寅，耶律敵烈等使夏國還，奏元昊罷兵，即遣使報宋。
entries.en: On jiayin day Yelü Dilie and others returned from their mission to Xia State and reported that Yuanhao had ceased hostilities; envoys were immediately dispatched to inform Song.
entries.literal: On jiayin day, Yelü Dilie and others returned from their mission to Xia State and reported that Yuanhao had ceased hostilities; envoys were immediately dispatched to inform Song.

entries.zh: 三月辛卯，幸南京。
entries.en: On xinmao day of the third month the court visited the Southern Capital.
entries.literal: Third month, on xinmao day, visited the Southern Capital.

entries.zh: 壬辰，高麗國以加上尊號，遣使來賀。
entries.en: On renchen day Goryeo, because of the added honorific title, sent envoys to congratulate.
entries.literal: On renchen day, Goryeo, because of the added honorific title, dispatched envoys to congratulate.

entries.zh: 夏四月己亥，置回跋部詳穩、都監。
entries.en: On jihai day of the fourth summer month xiangwen and chief superintendent were established for the Huiba tribe.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jihai day, established xiangwen and chief superintendent for the Huiba tribe.

entries.zh: 庚子，夏國遣使進馬、駝。
entries.en: On gengzi day Xia State sent envoys presenting horses and camels.
entries.literal: On gengzi day, Xia State dispatched envoys presenting horses and camels.

entries.zh: 五月辛卯，斡魯、蒲盧毛朵部二使來貢失期，宥而遣還。
entries.en: On xinmao day of the fifth month two envoys of the Wolu and Pulu Modu tribes came with tribute late; they were pardoned and sent back.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on xinmao day, two envoys of the Wolu and Pulu Modu tribes came with tribute late; they were pardoned and sent back.

entries.zh: 乙未，詔復定禮制。
entries.en: On yiwei day an edict restored and fixed the ritual regulations.
entries.literal: On yiwei day, edict restored and fixed the ritual regulations.

entries.zh: 是月，幸山西。
entries.en: That month the court visited the western mountains.
entries.literal: That month, visited western mountains.

entries.zh: 六月丙午，詔世選宰相、節度使族屬及身為節度使之家，許葬用銀器；
entries.en: On bingwu day of the sixth month an edict ordered that families of imperial-select chancellors and military commissioners and those who were themselves military commissioners be permitted burial goods of silver;
entries.literal: Sixth month, on bingwu day, edict ordered that families of imperial-select chancellors and military commissioners and those who were themselves military commissioners be permitted burial goods of silver;

entries.zh: 仍禁殺牲以祭。
entries.en: slaughtering livestock for sacrifice was still forbidden.
entries.literal: still forbade slaughtering livestock for sacrifice.

entries.zh: 庚戌，詔漢人宮分戶絕，恒產以親族繼之。
entries.en: On gengxu day an edict ordered that when Han palace allotment households died out, fixed property was to pass to relatives.
entries.literal: On gengxu day, edict ordered that when Han palace allotment households died out, fixed property was to pass to relatives.

entries.zh: 辛亥，阻卜大王屯禿古斯弟太尉撒葛裏來朝。
entries.en: On xinhai day Zubu great king Tuntu Gusi's younger brother Grand Commandant Sa Geli came to court.
entries.literal: On xinhai day, Zubu great king Tuntu Gusi's younger brother Grand Commandant Sa Geli came to court.

entries.zh: 丙辰，回鶻遣使來貢。
entries.en: On bingchen day Uighur sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On bingchen day, Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 甲子，以南院樞密使吳國王蕭孝穆為北院樞密使，徙封齊國王。
entries.en: On jiazi day Southern Privy Commissioner Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner and transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Qi.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, made Southern Privy Commissioner Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu Northern Privy Commissioner and transferred enfeoffment to Prince of Qi.

entries.zh: 秋七月丙寅朔，北院樞密使蕭孝忠薨，特釋系囚。
entries.en: On the bingyin new moon of the seventh autumn month Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaozhong died, and prisoners in custody were specially released.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the bingyin new moon, Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaozhong died; prisoners in custody were specially released.

entries.zh: 庚寅，夏國遣使上表，請伐宋，不從。
entries.en: On gengyin day Xia State sent envoys with a memorial requesting to attack Song; approval was not granted.
entries.literal: On gengyin day, Xia State dispatched envoys with a memorial requesting to attack Song; not approved.

entries.zh: 八月丙申，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On bingshen day of the eighth month the court visited Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on bingshen day, visited Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 辛，燕國王洪基加尚書令，知北南院樞密使事，進封燕趙國王。
entries.en: On xin day Prince of Yan Hongji was additionally made Director of the Department of State Affairs, administering Northern and Southern Privy Commissioner affairs, and advanced to Prince of Yan and Zhao.
entries.literal: On xin day, Prince of Yan Hongji was additionally made Director of the Department of State Affairs, administering Northern and Southern Privy Commissioner affairs, and advanced to Prince of Yan and Zhao.

entries.zh: 戊午，以前西北路招討使蕭塔烈葛為右夷離畢。
entries.en: On wuwu day former Northwest Route campaign commissioner Xiao Taliege was appointed Right yilibi.
entries.literal: On wuwu day, made former Northwest Route campaign commissioner Xiao Taliege Right yilibi.

entries.zh: 庚申，於越耶律洪古薨。
entries.en: On gengshen day yueye Yelü Honggu died.
entries.literal: On gengshen day, yueye Yelü Honggu died.

entries.zh: 甲子，阻卜來貢。
entries.en: On jiazi day Zubu came with tribute.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, Zubu came with tribute.

entries.zh: 九月壬申，朝皇太后，謁望仙殿。
entries.en: On renshen day of the ninth month the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager and visited Wangxian Hall.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on renshen day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager and visited Wangxian Hall.

entries.zh: 壬午，謁懷陵。
entries.en: On renwu day the court visited Huai Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On renwu day, visited Huai Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁酉，駐蹕中會川。
entries.en: On dingyou day of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Zhonghui River.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingyou day, encamped at Zhonghui River.

entries.zh: 己亥，北院樞密使蕭孝穆薨，追贈大丞相、晉國王。
entries.en: On jihai day Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaomu died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Chancellor and Prince of Jin.
entries.literal: On jihai day, Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaomu died; posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Chancellor and Prince of Jin.

entries.zh: 庚子，詔諸路上重囚，遣官詳讞。
entries.en: On gengzi day an edict ordered serious prisoners on all routes to have officials conduct detailed review.
entries.literal: On gengzi day, edict ordered serious prisoners on all routes to have officials conduct detailed review.

entries.zh: 辛亥，參知政事韓紹芳為廣德軍節度使，三司使劉六符長寧軍節度使。
entries.en: On xinhai day Associate Councilor Han Shaofang was appointed Guangde Army military commissioner, and Three Departments commissioner Liu Liufu was appointed Changning Army military commissioner.
entries.literal: On xinhai day, Associate Councilor Han Shaofang was made Guangde Army military commissioner, and Three Departments commissioner Liu Liufu Changning Army military commissioner.

entries.zh: 壬子，以夏人侵党項，遣延昌宮使高家奴讓之。
entries.en: On renzi day, because Xia people had encroached on the Tangut, Yanchang Palace envoy Gao Jianu was dispatched to rebuke them.
entries.literal: On renzi day, because Xia people had encroached on the Tangut, dispatched Yanchang Palace envoy Gao Jianu to rebuke them.

entries.zh: 甲子，北府宰相蕭惠為北院樞密使，豳王遂哥為惕隱，惕隱敵魯古封漆水郡王、西北路招討使，樞密副使蕭阿剌同知北院宣徽事。
entries.en: On jiazi day Northern Chancellor Xiao Hui was appointed Northern Court Privy Commissioner; Prince of Bin Suige was made tiyin; tiyin Dirugu was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner; and Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ala was appointed concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, made Northern Chancellor Xiao Hui Northern Court Privy Commissioner, Prince of Bin Suige tiyin, enfeoffed tiyin Dirugu as Prince of Qishui and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner, and Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ala concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner.

entries.zh: 出飛龍廄馬，分賜群臣。
entries.en: Flying Dragon stable horses were brought out and distributed among the ministers.
entries.literal: Flying Dragon stable horses were brought out and distributed among the ministers.

entries.zh: 十一月丁丑，追封楚王蕭孝忠為楚國王。
entries.en: On dingchou day of the eleventh month Prince of Chu Xiao Xiaozhong was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Chu.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on dingchou day, posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Chu Xiao Xiaozhong as King of Chu.

entries.zh: 丁亥，以上京歲儉，復其民租稅。
entries.en: On dinghai day, because the Upper Capital had a poor harvest, the people's land taxes were restored.
entries.literal: On dinghai day, because the Upper Capital had a poor harvest, restored the people's land taxes.

entries.zh: 癸巳，朝皇太后。
entries.en: On guisi day the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: On guisi day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 十二月戊申，改政事省為中書省。
entries.en: On wushen day of the twelfth month the Political Affairs Department was renamed the Zhongshu Department.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on wushen day, changed the Political Affairs Department to the Zhongshu Department.

entries.zh: 十五年春正月乙酉，如混同江。
entries.en: In the fifteenth year, on yiyou day of the first spring month, the court went to Huntong River.
entries.literal: Fifteenth year, spring, first month, on yiyou day, went to Huntong River.

entries.zh: 禁契丹以奴婢鬻與漢人。
entries.en: Khitan were forbidden to sell slave girls and boys to Han people.
entries.literal: Forbade Khitan selling slave girls and boys to Han people.

entries.zh: 二月乙卯，如長春河。
entries.en: On yimao day of the second month the court went to Changchun River.
entries.literal: Second month, on yimao day, went to Changchun River.

entries.zh: 丙寅，蒲盧毛朵界曷懶河戶來附，詔撫之。
entries.en: On bingyin day Puluhu Modu border Helan River households came to submit; an edict ordered them settled.
entries.literal: On bingyin day, Puluhu Modu border Helan River households came to submit; edict ordered them settled.

entries.zh: 三月甲申，朝皇太后。
entries.en: On jiashen day of the third month the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: Third month, on jiashen day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 乙酉，以應聖節，減死罪，釋徒以下。
entries.en: On yiyou day, on the occasion of the Responding Sage Festival, death sentences were commuted and those below convict labor were released.
entries.literal: On yiyou day, on the occasion of the Responding Sage Festival, commuted death sentences and released those below convict labor.

entries.zh: 辛卯，朝皇太后。
entries.en: On xinmao day the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: On xinmao day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 丁酉，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On dingyou day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On dingyou day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 詔諸道歲具獄訟以聞。
entries.en: An edict ordered all routes annually to submit lawsuit records for report.
entries.literal: Edict ordered all routes annually to submit lawsuit records for report.

entries.zh: 夏四月辛亥朔，禁五京吏民擊鞠。
entries.en: On the xinhai new moon of the fourth summer month officials and commoners of the Five Capitals were forbidden to play cuju.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the xinhai new moon, forbade officials and commoners of the Five Capitals from playing cuju.

entries.zh: 戊午，罷遙輦帳戍軍。
entries.en: On wuwu day Yaolian Tent garrison troops were abolished.
entries.literal: On wuwu day, abolished Yaolian Tent garrison troops.

entries.zh: 壬戌，以北女直詳穩蕭高六為奚六部大王。
entries.en: On renxu day Northern Jurchen xiangwen Xiao Gaoliu was appointed King of the Xi Six Tribes.
entries.literal: On renxu day, made Northern Jurchen xiangwen Xiao Gaoliu King of the Xi Six Tribes.

entries.zh: 甲子，清暑永安山。
entries.en: On jiazi day the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.

entries.zh: 甲戌，蒲盧毛朵曷懶河百八十戶來附。
entries.en: On jiaxu day one hundred eighty Puluhu Modu Helan River households came to submit.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day, one hundred eighty Puluhu Modu Helan River households came to submit.

entries.zh: 六月癸丑，以西京留守耶律馬六為漢人行宮都部署，參知政事楊佶出為武定軍節度使。
entries.en: On guichou day of the sixth month Western Capital regent Yelü Maliu was appointed Han mobile palace deployment director, and Associate Councilor Yang Jie was sent out as Wuding Army military commissioner.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on guichou day, made Western Capital regent Yelü Maliu Han mobile palace deployment director and Associate Councilor Yang Jie sent out as Wuding Army military commissioner.

entries.zh: 戊辰，禦清涼殿，放進士王棠等六十八人。
entries.en: On wuchen day the Emperor attended the Cool Hall and conferred the jinshi degree on sixty-eight men, including Wang Tang.
entries.literal: On wuchen day, attended the Cool Hall and tested jinshi; granted rank to sixty-eight including Wang Tang and below.

entries.zh: 甲戌，西北路招討使耶律敵魯古坐贓免官。
entries.en: On jiaxu day Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Yelü Dirugu was removed from office for corruption.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day, Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Yelü Dirugu was removed from office for corruption.

entries.zh: 秋七月乙酉，豳王遂哥薨。
entries.en: On yiyou day of the seventh autumn month Suige, Prince of Bin, died.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yiyou day, Suige, Prince of Bin, died.

entries.zh: 戊子，觀獲。
entries.en: On wuzi day the court observed the harvest.
entries.literal: On wuzi day, observed the harvest.

entries.zh: 乙未，以北院宣徽使旅墳為左夷離畢，前南府宰相耶律喜孫東北路詳穩。
entries.en: On yiwei day Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Lü Fen was appointed left yilibi, and former Southern Chancellor Yelü Xisun was made Northeast Route xiangwen.
entries.literal: On yiwei day, made Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Lü Fen left yilibi and former Southern Chancellor Yelü Xisun Northeast Route xiangwen.

entries.zh: 丙申，籍諸路軍。
entries.en: On bingshen day troops on all routes were registered.
entries.literal: On bingshen day, registered troops on all routes.

entries.zh: 丁酉，如秋山。
entries.en: On dingyou day the court went to Autumn Mountain.
entries.literal: On dingyou day, went to Autumn Mountain.

entries.zh: 辛丑，禁扈從踐民田。
entries.en: On xinchou day attendants were forbidden from trampling commoners' fields.
entries.literal: On xinchou day, forbade attendants from trampling commoners' fields.

entries.zh: 丁未，以女直部長遮母率眾來附，加太師。
entries.en: On dingwei day, because Jurchen tribal chief Zhemu had led his multitude to submit, he was promoted to grand preceptor.
entries.literal: On dingwei day, because Jurchen tribal chief Zhemu led his multitude to submit, promoted to grand preceptor.

entries.zh: 八月癸丑，高麗王欽薨，遣使來告。
entries.en: On guichou day of the eighth month Goryeo King Qin died, and envoys were dispatched to announce it.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on guichou day, Goryeo King Qin died; envoys dispatched to announce.

entries.zh: 九月甲辰，禁以罝網捕狐兔。
entries.en: On jiachen day of the ninth month using snare nets to catch foxes and hares was forbidden.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on jiachen day, forbade using snare nets to catch foxes and hares.

entries.zh: 冬十月己酉，駐蹕中會川。
entries.en: On jiyou day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Zhonghui River.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiyou day, halted at Zhonghui River.

entries.zh: 十一月丁亥，以南院樞密使蕭孝友為北府宰相，契丹行宮都部署耶律仁先南院大王，北府宰相蕭革同知北院樞密使事，知夷離畢事耶律信先漢人行宮都部署，左夷離畢旅墳惕隱，漢人行宮都部署耶律敵烈左夷離畢。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the eleventh month Southern Court Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaoyou was appointed Northern Chancellor; Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Renxian was made Southern Court great king; Northern Chancellor Xiao Ge was appointed associate Northern Court Privy Commissioner; yilibi affairs commissioner Yelü Xinxian was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Left yilibi Lü Fen was appointed tiyin; and Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Dilie was made Left yilibi.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on dinghai day, made Southern Court Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaoyou Northern Chancellor, Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Renxian Southern Court great king, Northern Chancellor Xiao Ge associate Northern Court Privy Commissioner, yilibi affairs commissioner Yelü Xinxian Han mobile palace deployment director, Left yilibi Lü Fen tiyin, Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Dilie Left yilibi.

entries.zh: 己亥，渤海部以契丹戶例通括軍馬。
entries.en: On jihai day Bohai tribes had troops and horses registered throughout the realm following Khitan household rules.
entries.literal: On jihai day, Bohai tribes universally registered troops and horses by Khitan household precedent.

entries.zh: 乙巳，振南京貧民。
entries.en: On yisi day relief was granted to the poor of Nanjing.
entries.literal: On yisi day, relief given to Nanjing poor.

entries.zh: 十二月壬申，曲赦徒以下罪。
entries.en: On renshen day of the twelfth month a partial amnesty was granted for offenses at or below convict labor.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on renshen day, partial amnesty for offenses at or below convict labor.

entries.zh: 是日為聖宗在時生辰。
entries.en: That day was Shengzong's birthday while he lived.
entries.literal: That day was Shengzong's birthday while he lived.

entries.zh: 興宗二
entries.en: Xingzong, Part Two
entries.literal: Xingzong, Part Two

entries.zh: 十八年春正月甲午朔，日有食之。
entries.en: In the eighteenth year, on the jiawu new moon of the first spring month there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: In the eighteenth year, spring, first month, on jiawu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 戊戌，留夏國賀正使不遣。
entries.en: On wuxu day Xia State envoys congratulating the New Year were detained without being sent back.
entries.literal: On wuxu day, detained Xia State envoys congratulating the New Year without sending them back.

entries.zh: 己亥，遣北院樞密副使蕭惟信以伐夏告宋。
entries.en: On jihai day Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin was dispatched to inform Song of the campaign against Xia.
entries.literal: On jihai day, dispatched Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin to inform Song of the campaign against Xia.

entries.zh: 辛丑，錄囚。
entries.en: On xinchou day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On xinchou day, reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 丙午，如鴛鴦濼。
entries.en: On bingwu day the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
entries.literal: On bingwu day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.

entries.zh: 丙辰，獵霸特山。
entries.en: On bingchen day the court hunted at Bate Mountain.
entries.literal: On bingchen day, hunted at Bate Mountain.

entries.zh: 耶律義先奏蒲奴裏捷。
entries.en: Yelü Yixian memorialized victory over Puniuli.
entries.literal: Yelü Yixian memorialized victory over Puniuli.

entries.zh: 二月庚辰，幸燕趙國王洪基帳視疾。
entries.en: On gengchen day of the second month the court visited Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji's tent to inquire after his illness.
entries.literal: Second month, on gengchen day, visited Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji's tent to inquire after his illness.

entries.zh: 乙酉，耶律義先等執陶得裏以獻。
entries.en: On yiyou day Yelü Yixian and others presented the captured Taodeli.
entries.literal: On yiyou day, Yelü Yixian and others presented the captured Taodeli.

entries.zh: 三月乙巳，高昌國遣使來貢。
entries.en: On yisi day of the third month Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Third month, on yisi day, Gaochang dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 壬子，以洪基疾愈，赦雜犯死罪以下。
entries.en: On renzi day, because Hongji's illness had recovered, amnesty was granted for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.
entries.literal: On renzi day, because Hongji's illness had recovered, amnesty for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.

entries.zh: 丁巳，烏古遣使送款。
entries.en: On dingsi day Wugu sent envoys submitting allegiance.
entries.literal: On dingsi day, Wugu dispatched envoys submitting allegiance.

entries.zh: 夏四月癸酉，以南府宰相耶律高十為南京統軍使。
entries.en: On guiyou day of the fourth summer month Southern Court chancellor Yelü Gaoshi was made Nanjing supreme commander.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guiyou day, made Southern Court chancellor Yelü Gaoshi Nanjing supreme commander.

entries.zh: 五月甲辰，五國酋長各率其部來附。
entries.en: On jiachen day of the fifth month chieftains of the Five States each led their tribes to submit.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on jiachen day, chieftains of the Five States each led their tribes to submit.

entries.zh: 庚戌，回跋部長兀叠臺紥等來朝。
entries.en: On gengxu day Huiba tribal chief Wudietai Zha and others came to court.
entries.literal: On gengxu day, Huiba tribal chief Wudietai Zha and others came to court.

entries.zh: 戊午，五國節度使耶律仙童以降烏古叛人，授左監門衛上將軍。
entries.en: On wuwu day Five States military commissioner Yelü Xiantong, for surrendering Wugu rebels, was appointed Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.
entries.literal: On wuwu day, Five States military commissioner Yelü Xiantong, for surrendering Wugu rebels, was appointed Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.

entries.zh: 六月壬戌朔，以韓國王蕭惠為河南道行軍都統，趙王蕭孝友、漢王貼不副之。
entries.en: On the renxu new moon of the sixth month, Xiao Hui, Prince of the Han State, was appointed supreme campaign commander for the Henan Route, with Xiao Xiaoyou, Prince of Zhao, and Tiebu, Prince of Han, as his deputies.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on the renxu new moon, appointed Xiao Hui, Prince of the Han State, supreme campaign commander for the Henan Route, with Xiao Xiaoyou, Prince of Zhao, and Tiebu, Prince of Han, as his deputies.

entries.zh: 乙丑，錄囚。
entries.en: On yichou day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On yichou day, reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 丙寅，行十二神纛禮。
entries.en: On bingyin day the ritual of the twelve spirit banners was performed.
entries.literal: On bingyin day, performed the ritual of the twelve spirit banners.

entries.zh: 己巳，宋以遼師伐夏，遣錢逸致贐禮。
entries.en: On jisi day, because Liao troops attacked Xia, Song sent Qian Yi with parting gifts.
entries.literal: On jisi day, because Liao troops attacked Xia, Song dispatched Qian Yi with parting gifts.

entries.zh: 庚辰，阻卜來貢馬、駝、珍玩。
entries.en: On gengchen day Zubu presented horses, camels, and precious curios.
entries.literal: On gengchen day, Zubu presented horses, camels, and precious curios.

entries.zh: 辛巳，夏國使來貢，留之不遣。
entries.en: On xinsi day Xia State envoys came with tribute and were detained without being sent back.
entries.literal: On xinsi day, Xia State envoys came with tribute and were detained without being sent back.

entries.zh: 丁亥，行再生禮。
entries.en: On dinghai day the rebirth ritual was performed.
entries.literal: On dinghai day, performed the rebirth ritual.

entries.zh: 秋七月戊戌，親征。
entries.en: On wuxu day of the seventh autumn month the Emperor personally campaigned.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuxu day, the Emperor personally campaigned.

entries.zh: 八月辛酉朔，渡河。
entries.en: On the xinyou new moon of the eighth month the army crossed the river.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on xinyou new moon, crossed the river.

entries.zh: 夏人遁，乃還。
entries.en: Xia troops fled, and the army returned.
entries.literal: Xia troops fled, and the army returned.

entries.zh: 九月丁未，蕭惠等為夏人所敗。
entries.en: On dingwei day of the ninth month Xiao Hui and others were defeated by Xia troops.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on dingwei day, Xiao Hui and others were defeated by Xia troops.

entries.zh: 冬十月，北道行軍都統耶律敵魯古率阻卜諸軍至賀蘭山，獲李元昊妻及其官僚家屬，遇夏人三千來戰，殪之；
entries.en: In the tenth winter month Northern Route campaign supreme commander Yelü Dilugu led Zubu armies to Helan Mountain, captured Li Yuanhao's wife and his officials' families; when three thousand Xia troops came to fight, they were annihilated;
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, Northern Route campaign supreme commander Yelü Dilugu led Zubu armies to Helan Mountain, captured Li Yuanhao's wife and his officials' families; when three thousand Xia troops came to fight, they were annihilated;

entries.zh: 烏古敵烈部都詳穩蕭慈氏奴、南克耶律斡裏死焉。
entries.en: Xiao Cishinu, chief xiangwen of the Wugu and Dilie tribes, and Yelü Woli, the Southern Ke, died in battle.
entries.literal: Chief xiangwen of the Wugu and Dilie tribes Xiao Cishinu and Southern Ke Yelü Woli died there.

entries.zh: 十二月戊寅，慶陵林木火。
entries.en: On wuyin day of the twelfth month trees at Qing Mausoleum caught fire.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on wuyin day, trees at Qing Mausoleum caught fire.

entries.zh: 己卯，錄囚。
entries.en: On jimao day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On jimao day, reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 有弟從兄為強盜者，兄弟俱無子，特原其弟。
entries.en: There was a case of a younger brother and a cousin elder brother who were bandits; both brothers were without sons, and the younger brother was specially pardoned.
entries.literal: There was a case of a younger brother and a cousin elder brother who were bandits; both brothers were without sons, and the younger brother was specially pardoned.

entries.zh: 十九年春正月庚寅，僧惠鑒加檢校太尉。
entries.en: In the nineteenth year, on gengyin day of the first spring month, the monk Huijian was granted the honorary title of Grand Commandant.
entries.literal: In the nineteenth year, spring, first month, on gengyin day, the monk Huijian was additionally granted the honorary title of Grand Commandant.

entries.zh: 庚子，耶律敵魯古復封漆水郡王，諸將校及阻卜等部酋長各進爵有差。
entries.en: On gengzi day Yelü Dilugu was again enfeoffed Prince of Qishui; various generals and Zubu tribal chieftains each advanced in rank by degree.
entries.literal: On gengzi day, Yelü Dilugu was again enfeoffed Prince of Qishui; various generals and Zubu tribal chieftains each advanced in rank by degree.

entries.zh: 贈蕭慈氏奴同中書門下平章事。
entries.en: Xiao Cishinu was posthumously honored as Associate Councilor of State.
entries.literal: Posthumously honored Xiao Cishinu as Associate Councilor of State.

entries.zh: 辛丑，遣使問罪於夏國。
entries.en: On xinchou day envoys were dispatched to demand accountability from Xia State.
entries.literal: On xinchou day, dispatched envoys to demand accountability from Xia State.

entries.zh: 壬寅，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: On renyin day the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: On renyin day, went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 二月丁亥，夏將窪普、猥貨、乙靈紀等來攻金肅城，南面林牙耶律高家奴等破之。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the second month Xia generals Wapu, Wohe, and Yilingji attacked Jinsu City; Southern Court linya Yelü Gaojianu and others defeated them.
entries.literal: Second month, on dinghai day, Xia generals Wapu, Wohe, and Yilingji attacked Jinsu City; Southern Court linya Yelü Gaojianu and others defeated them.

entries.zh: 窪普被創遁去，殺猥貨、乙靈紀。
entries.en: Wapu was wounded and fled; Wohe and Yilingji were killed.
entries.literal: Wapu was wounded and fled; Wohe and Yilingji were killed.

entries.zh: 三月戊戌，殿前都點檢蕭叠裏得與夏戰於三角川，敗之。
entries.en: On wuxu day of the third month Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide fought Xia at Sanjiao River and defeated them.
entries.literal: Third month, on wuxu day, Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide fought Xia at Sanjiao River and defeated them.

entries.zh: 癸卯，命西南招討使蕭蒲奴、北院大王宜新、林牙蕭撒抹等帥師伐夏，以行宮都部署別古得監戰。
entries.en: On guimao day Southwest pacification commissioner Xiao Punu, Northern Court great king Yixin, linya Xiao Samo, and others were ordered to lead troops against Xia, with mobile palace deployment director Biegude supervising the campaign.
entries.literal: On guimao day, ordered Southwest pacification commissioner Xiao Punu, Northern Court great king Yixin, linya Xiao Samo, and others to lead troops against Xia, with mobile palace deployment director Biegude supervising the campaign.

entries.zh: 甲辰，遣同知北院樞密使蕭革按軍邊城，以為聲援。
entries.en: On jiachen day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge was dispatched to inspect troops at the border cities as a supporting force.
entries.literal: On jiachen day, dispatched associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge to inspect troops at the border cities as a supporting force.

entries.zh: 己酉，駐蹕息雞澱。
entries.en: On jiyou day the court halted at Xijidian.
entries.literal: On jiyou day, halted at Xijidian.

entries.zh: 丙辰，幸殿前都點檢蕭叠裏得、駙馬都尉蕭胡睹帳視疾。
entries.en: On bingchen day the court visited Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hudu's tents to inquire after their illnesses.
entries.literal: On bingchen day, visited Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hudu's tents to inquire after their illnesses.

entries.zh: 夏四月丙寅，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: On bingyin day of the fourth summer month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingyin day, went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 壬申，蒲盧毛朵部惕隱信篤來貢。
entries.en: On renshen day Pulumaoduo tribe tiyin Xindu came with tribute.
entries.literal: On renshen day, Pulumaoduo tribe tiyin Xindu came with tribute.

entries.zh: 甲申，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On jiashen day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On jiashen day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 五月己丑，如涼陘。
entries.en: On jichou day of the fifth month the court went to Liang Pass.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on jichou day, went to Liang Pass.

entries.zh: 癸巳，蕭蒲奴等入夏境，不與敵遇，縱軍俘掠而還。
entries.en: On guisi day Xiao Punu and others entered Xia territory, met no enemy, and returned after letting the army plunder freely.
entries.literal: On guisi day, Xiao Punu and others entered Xia territory, met no enemy, and returned after letting the army plunder freely.

entries.zh: 丁酉，夏國窪普來降。
entries.en: On dingyou day Xia State's Wapu came to surrender.
entries.literal: On dingyou day, Xia State's Wapu came to surrender.

entries.zh: 己亥，遠夷拔思母部遣使來貢。
entries.en: On jihai day distant Yi of the Basimu tribe sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On jihai day, distant Yi of the Basimu tribe dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 六月丙辰朔，置倒塌嶺都監。
entries.en: On the bingchen new moon of the sixth month the Daotaoling inspector-general was established.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on bingchen new moon, established the Daotaoling inspector-general.

entries.zh: 丙寅，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On bingyin day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On bingyin day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 庚午，幸慶州，謁大安殿。
entries.en: On gengwu day the court visited Qing Prefecture and paid respects at the Great Peace Hall.
entries.literal: On gengwu day, visited Qing Prefecture and paid respects at the Great Peace Hall.

entries.zh: 壬申，詔醫卜屠販、奴隸及倍父母或犯事逃亡者，不得舉進士。
entries.en: On renshen day an edict forbade physicians, diviners, butchers, peddlers, slaves, and those who had served as substitute parents or fled after offenses from taking the jinshi examination.
entries.literal: On renshen day, edict forbade physicians, diviners, butchers, peddlers, slaves, and those who had served as substitute parents or fled after offenses from taking the jinshi examination.

entries.zh: 回跋、曷蘇館、蒲盧毛朵部各遣使貢馬。
entries.en: Huiba, Hesuguan, and Pulumaoduo tribes each sent envoys presenting horses.
entries.literal: Huiba, Hesuguan, and Pulumaoduo tribes each dispatched envoys presenting horses.

entries.zh: 甲戌，宋遣使來賀伐夏捷，高麗使俱至。
entries.en: On jiaxu day Song sent envoys to congratulate the victory over Xia; Goryeo envoys also arrived.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day, Song dispatched envoys to congratulate the victory over Xia; Goryeo envoys also arrived.

entries.zh: 辛巳，禦金鑾殿試進士。
entries.en: On xinsi day the jinshi examination was held in the Golden Hall.
entries.literal: On xinsi day, held the jinshi examination in the Golden Hall.

entries.zh: 秋七月壬辰，駐蹕括裏蒲碗。
entries.en: On renchen day of the seventh autumn month the court halted at Kuolipuwan.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renchen day, halted at Kuolipuwan.

entries.zh: 癸巳，以燕趙國王洪基領北南樞密院。
entries.en: On guisi day Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji was made head of the Southern and Northern Privy Councils.
entries.literal: On guisi day, made Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji head the Southern and Northern Privy Councils.

entries.zh: 乙未，阻卜長豁得剌弟斡得來朝，加太尉遣之。
entries.en: On yiwei day, Wode, younger brother of the Zubu chief Huodela, came to court. He was granted the title Grand Commandant and sent home.
entries.literal: On yiwei day, Wode, younger brother of Zubu chief Huodela, came to court, was granted the title Grand Commandant, and was sent away.

entries.zh: 戊戌，錄囚。
entries.en: On wuxu day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On wuxu day, reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 戊申，以左夷離畢蕭唐古為北院樞密副使。
entries.en: On wushen day Left yilibi Xiao Tanggu was made Northern Court associate privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On wushen day, made Left yilibi Xiao Tanggu Northern Court associate privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 壬子，獵侯裏吉。
entries.en: On renzi day the court hunted at Houliji.
entries.literal: On renzi day, hunted at Houliji.

entries.zh: 八月丁卯，阻卜酋長喘只葛拔裏斯來朝。
entries.en: On dingmao day of the eighth month Zubu chieftain Chuanzhige Balisi came to court.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on dingmao day, Zubu chieftain Chuanzhige Balisi came to court.

entries.zh: 九月壬寅，夏人侵邊，敵魯古遣六院軍將海裏擊敗之。
entries.en: On renyin day of the ninth month Xia troops invaded the border; Dilugu dispatched Six Courts general Haili and defeated them.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, Xia troops invaded the border; Dilugu dispatched Six Courts general Haili and defeated them.

entries.zh: 冬十月庚午，還上京。
entries.en: On gengwu day of the tenth winter month the court returned to the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengwu day, returned to the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 辛未，夏國王李諒祚母遣使乞依舊稱藩。
entries.en: On xinwei day Li Liangzuo's mother in Xia State sent envoys begging to resume vassal status as before.
entries.literal: On xinwei day, Li Liangzuo's mother in Xia State dispatched envoys begging to resume vassal status as before.

entries.zh: 使還，詔諭別遣信臣詣闕，當徐思之。
entries.en: When the envoys returned, an edict instructed them to send another trusted minister to the court separately; the matter would be considered at leisure.
entries.literal: When the envoys returned, an edict instructed them to send another trusted minister to the court separately; the matter would be considered at leisure.

entries.zh: 壬申，釋臨潢府役徒。
entries.en: On renshen day convict laborers of Linhuang Prefecture were released.
entries.literal: On renshen day, released convict laborers of Linhuang Prefecture.

entries.zh: 甲戌，如中會川。
entries.en: On jiaxu day the court went to Zhonghuichuan.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day, went to Zhonghuichuan.

entries.zh: 十一月甲午，阻卜酋長豁得剌遣使來貢。
entries.en: On jiawu day of the eleventh month Zubu chieftain Huodela sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day, Zubu chieftain Huodela dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 庚戌，錄囚。
entries.en: On gengxu day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On gengxu day, reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 壬子，出南府宰相韓知白為武定軍節度使，樞密副使楊績長寧軍節度使，翰林學士王綱澤州刺史，張宥徽州刺史，知制誥周白海北州刺史。
entries.en: On renzi day, Han Zhibai was transferred from the post of Southern Court chancellor to serve as military commissioner of the Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Yang Ji was appointed military commissioner of the Changning Army; Hanlin academician Wang Gang was appointed prefect of Ze; Zhang You, prefect of Hui; and edict drafter Zhou Bai, prefect of Haibei.
entries.literal: On renzi day, sent Southern Court chancellor Han Zhibai out to serve as military commissioner of the Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Yang Ji as military commissioner of the Changning Army; Hanlin academician Wang Gang as prefect of Ze; Zhang You as prefect of Hui; and edict drafter Zhou Bai as prefect of Haibei.

entries.zh: 閏月乙卯，以漢王貼不為中京留守。
entries.en: In the intercalary month, on yimao day, Prince of Han Tiebu was made regent of the Central Capital.
entries.literal: Intercalary month, on yimao day, made Prince of Han Tiebu regent of the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 辛未，以同知北院樞密使事蕭革為南院樞密使，南院大王耶律仁先知北院樞密使事，封宋王。
entries.en: On xinwei day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge was made Southern Court privy commissioner; Southern Court great king Yelü Renxian was appointed to administer Northern Court privy affairs and enfeoffed Prince of Song.
entries.literal: On xinwei day, made associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge Southern Court privy commissioner, Southern Court great king Yelü Renxian to administer Northern Court privy affairs, and enfeoffed him Prince of Song.

entries.zh: 十二月丁亥，北府宰相、趙王蕭孝友出為東京留守，東京留守蕭塔列葛為北府宰相，南院樞密使、潞王查葛為南院大王。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the twelfth month, Xiao Xiaoyou, Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Zhao, was transferred out to serve as regent of the Eastern Capital. Xiao Taliege, regent of the Eastern Capital, became Northern Court chancellor, and Chage, Southern Court privy commissioner and Prince of Lu, became Southern Court great king.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on dinghai day, Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Zhao Xiao Xiaoyou was sent out to serve as Eastern Capital regent; Eastern Capital regent Xiao Taliege became Northern Court chancellor; Southern Court privy commissioner and Prince of Lu Chage became Southern Court great king.

entries.zh: 庚戌，韓國王蕭惠徙封魏王，致仕。
entries.en: On gengxu day Prince of Han Xiao Hui was transferred to Prince of Wei and retired.
entries.literal: On gengxu day, Prince of Han Xiao Hui was transferred to Prince of Wei and retired.

entries.zh: 壬子，夏國李諒祚遣使上表，乞依舊臣屬。
entries.en: On renzi day Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys presenting a memorial begging to resume subject status as before.
entries.literal: On renzi day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys presenting a memorial begging to resume subject status as before.

entries.zh: 二十一年春正月辛亥，如混同江。
entries.en: In the twenty-first year, on xinhai day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the twenty-first year, spring, first month, on xinhai day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 二月，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: In the second month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: Second month, went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 夏四月癸未，以國舅詳穩蕭阿剌為西北路招討使，封西平郡王。
entries.en: On guiwei day of the fourth summer month imperial maternal uncle xiangwen Xiao Ala was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Xiping.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guiwei day, made imperial maternal uncle xiangwen Xiao Ala Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed him Prince of Xiping.

entries.zh: 六月丙子，駐蹕永安山。
entries.en: On bingzi day of the sixth month the court halted at Yongan Mountain.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on bingzi day, halted at Yongan Mountain.

entries.zh: 秋七月甲辰朔，召北府宰相蕭塔烈葛、南府宰相漢王貼不、南院樞密使蕭革、知北院樞密使事仁先等，賜坐，論古今治道。
entries.en: On the jiachen new moon of the seventh autumn month Northern Court chancellor Xiao Taliege, Southern Court chancellor Prince of Han Tiebu, Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge, and Renxian, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, were summoned; they were granted seats and discussed the ways of governing ancient and modern times.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiachen new moon, summoned Northern Court chancellor Xiao Taliege, Southern Court chancellor Prince of Han Tiebu, Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge, and Renxian, who administered Northern Court privy affairs; granted them seats and discussed the ways of governing ancient and modern times.

entries.zh: 戊申，祀天地。
entries.en: On wushen day Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to.
entries.literal: On wushen day, sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.

entries.zh: 己酉，詔北、南樞密院，日再奏事。
entries.en: On jiyou day an edict ordered the Northern and Southern Privy Councils to memorialize twice daily.
entries.literal: On jiyou day, edict ordered the Northern and Southern Privy Councils to memorialize twice daily.

entries.zh: 壬子，追尊太祖之祖為簡獻皇帝，廟號玄祖，祖妣為簡獻皇后；
entries.en: On renzi day Taizu's grandfather was posthumously honored as Emperor Jianxian, temple name Xuanzu, and his grandmother as Empress Jianxian;
entries.literal: On renzi day, posthumously honored Taizu's grandfather as Emperor Jianxian, temple name Xuanzu, and his grandmother as Empress Jianxian;

entries.zh: 太祖之考為宣簡皇帝，廟號德祖，妣為宣簡皇后。
entries.en: Taizu's father was honored as Emperor Xuanjian, temple name Dezu, and his mother as Empress Xuanjian.
entries.literal: Taizu's father as Emperor Xuanjian, temple name Dezu, and his mother as Empress Xuanjian.

entries.zh: 追封太祖伯父夷離堇巖木為蜀國王，於越釋魯為隋國王。
entries.en: Taizu's paternal uncle yilijin Yanmu was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Shu and yuyue Shilu as Prince of Sui.
entries.literal: Posthumously enfeoffed Taizu's paternal uncle yilijin Yanmu as Prince of Shu and yuyue Shilu as Prince of Sui.

entries.zh: 以燕趙國王洪基為天下兵馬大元帥、知惕隱事，賜詔諭之。
entries.en: Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji was made grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven and administrator of tiyin affairs, and granted an edict of instruction.
entries.literal: Made Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven and administrator of tiyin affairs, and granted him an edict of instruction.

entries.zh: 癸亥，近侍小底盧寶偽學御書，免死，配役終身。
entries.en: On guihai day, Lu Bao, a junior close attendant, was found to have forged the emperor's handwriting. His death sentence was commuted to lifelong penal servitude.
entries.literal: On guihai day, close-attendant xiaodi Lu Bao falsely imitated the imperial handwriting; he was spared death and assigned to lifelong penal labor.

entries.zh: 甲子，如秋山。
entries.en: On jiazi day the court went to autumn mountains.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, went to autumn mountains.

entries.zh: 戊辰，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On wuchen day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On wuchen day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 以南院樞密使蕭革為北院樞密使，封吳王。
entries.en: Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge was made Northern Court privy commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Wu.
entries.literal: Made Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Ge Northern Court privy commissioner and enfeoffed him Prince of Wu.

entries.zh: 辛未，如慶州。
entries.en: On xinwei day the court went to Qing Prefecture.
entries.literal: On xinwei day, went to Qing Prefecture.

entries.zh: 壬申，追封太祖弟寅底石為許國王。
entries.en: On renshen day Taizu's younger brother Yindishi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xu.
entries.literal: On renshen day, posthumously enfeoffed Taizu's younger brother Yindishi as Prince of Xu.

entries.zh: 八月戊子，太尉烏者薨，詔配享聖宗廟。
entries.en: On wuzi day of the eighth month, Grand Commandant Wuzhe died; an edict ordered that he receive joint sacrifices in Shengzong's temple.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on wuzi day, Grand Commandant Wuzhe died; an edict ordered him joined in sacrifice at Shengzong's temple.

entries.zh: 九月乙卯，平州進白兔。
entries.en: On yimao day of the ninth month Ping Prefecture presented a white hare.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on yimao day, Ping Prefecture presented a white hare.

entries.zh: 己未，謁懷陵。
entries.en: On jiwei day the court paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On jiwei day, paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 庚申，追上嗣聖皇帝、天順皇帝尊謚，及更謚彰德皇后曰靖安。
entries.en: On gengshen day honorific titles were posthumously advanced for the Shangsi Sage Emperor and the Tianshun Emperor, and Empress Zhangde's posthumous title was changed to Jing'an.
entries.literal: On gengshen day, posthumously advanced honorific titles for the Shangsi Sage Emperor and the Tianshun Emperor, and changed Empress Zhangde's posthumous title to Jing'an.

entries.zh: 癸亥，謚齊天皇后曰仁德皇后。
entries.en: On guihai day the posthumous title for Empress Qitian was changed to Empress Rende.
entries.literal: On guihai day, posthumous title for Empress Qitian was changed to Empress Rende.

entries.zh: 甲子，謁祖陵。
entries.en: On jiazi day the court paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

entries.zh: 增太祖謚大聖大明神烈天皇帝，更謚貞烈皇后曰淳欽，恭順皇帝曰章肅，后蕭氏謚曰和敬。
entries.en: Taizu's honorific was increased to Great Sage, Great Brightness, Divine Martyr, Heavenly Emperor; Empress Zhenlie's title was changed to Chunqin; Emperor Gongshun to Zhangsu; and Empress Xiao's title to Hejing.
entries.literal: Taizu's honorific was increased to Great Sage, Great Brightness, Divine Martyr, Heavenly Emperor; Empress Zhenlie's title was changed to Chunqin; Emperor Gongshun to Zhangsu; Empress Xiao's title to Hejing.

entries.zh: 冬十月戊寅，駐蹕中會川。
entries.en: On wuyin day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Zhonghuichuan.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuyin day, halted at Zhonghuichuan.

entries.zh: 丁亥，夏國李諒祚遣使乞弛邊備，即遣蕭友括奉詔諭之。
entries.en: On dinghai day Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys begging relaxation of border defenses; Xiao Youkuo was immediately dispatched to convey the edict of instruction.
entries.literal: On dinghai day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys begging relaxation of border defenses; immediately dispatched Xiao Youkuo to convey the edict of instruction.

entries.zh: 戊子，幸顯、懿二州。
entries.en: On wuzi day the court visited Xian and Yi prefectures.
entries.literal: On wuzi day, visited Xian and Yi prefectures.

entries.zh: 甲午，遼興軍節度使蕭虛烈封鄭王，南院大王、潞王查葛為南院樞密使，進封越國王。
entries.en: On jiawu day, Xiao Xulie, military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army, was enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng. Chage, Southern Court great king and Prince of Lu, was appointed Southern Court privy commissioner and promoted to Prince of Yue.
entries.literal: On jiawu day, enfeoffed Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie as Prince of Zheng; made Chage, Southern Court great king and Prince of Lu, Southern Court privy commissioner and promoted him to Prince of Yue.

entries.zh: 戊戌，射虎於南撒葛柏。
entries.en: On wuxu day tigers were shot at Nansagebo.
entries.literal: On wuxu day, shot tigers at Nansagebo.

entries.zh: 辛丑，謁乾陵。
entries.en: On xinchou day the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On xinchou day, paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 十一月壬寅朔，增謚文獻皇帝為文獻欽義皇帝，及謚二后曰端順，曰柔貞。
entries.en: On the renyin new moon of the eleventh month Emperor Wenxian's honorific was advanced to Emperor Wenxian, Qinyi, and posthumous titles for the two empresses to Duanshun and Rouzhen.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on renyin new moon, advanced Emperor Wenxian's honorific to Emperor Wenxian, Qinyi, and posthumous titles for the two empresses to Duanshun and Rouzhen.

entries.zh: 復更謚世宗孝烈皇后為懷節。
entries.en: Shizong's Empress Xiaolie posthumous title was again changed to Huaijie.
entries.literal: Again changed Shizong's Empress Xiaolie posthumous title to Huaijie.

entries.zh: 丁未，增孝成皇帝謚曰孝成康靖皇帝，更謚聖神宣獻皇后為睿智。
entries.en: On dingwei day Emperor Xiaocheng's honorific was advanced to Emperor Xiaocheng, Kangjing, and Empress Shengshen, Xuanxian posthumous title was changed to Ruizhi.
entries.literal: On dingwei day, advanced Emperor Xiaocheng's honorific to Emperor Xiaocheng, Kangjing, and changed Empress Shengshen, Xuanxian posthumous title to Ruizhi.

entries.zh: 甲子，次中會川。
entries.en: On jiazi day the court halted at Zhonghuichuan.
entries.literal: On jiazi day, halted at Zhonghuichuan.

entries.zh: 回鶻阿薩蘭遣使貢名馬、文豹。
entries.en: Uighur Asalan sent envoys presenting famous horses and literary leopards.
entries.literal: Uighur Asalan dispatched envoys presenting famous horses and literary leopards.

entries.zh: 丙寅，錄囚。
entries.en: On bingyin day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On bingyin day, reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 十二月戊戌，以北府宰相塔烈葛為南京統軍使，鄭王虛烈北府宰相，契丹行宮都部署耶律義先惕隱。
entries.en: On wuxu day of the twelfth month Northern Court chancellor Taliege was made Nanjing supreme commander, Prince of Zheng Xulie Northern Court chancellor, and Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yixian tiyin.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on wuxu day, made Northern Court chancellor Taliege Nanjing supreme commander, Prince of Zheng Xulie Northern Court chancellor, and Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yixian tiyin.

entries.zh: 釋役徒限年者。
entries.en: Convict laborers whose term limit had expired were released.
entries.literal: Released convict laborers whose term limit had expired.

entries.zh: 二十三年春正月己巳，如混同江。
entries.en: In the twenty-third year, on jisi day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the twenty-third year, spring, first month, on jisi day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 癸酉，獵雙子澱。
entries.en: On guiyou day the court hunted at Shuangzi Marsh.
entries.literal: On guiyou day, hunted at Shuangzi Marsh.

entries.zh: 戊子，夏國遣使貢方物。
entries.en: On wuzi day Xia State sent envoys with tribute goods.
entries.literal: On wuzi day, Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute goods.

entries.zh: 壬辰，如春水。
entries.en: On renchen day the court went to spring waters.
entries.literal: On renchen day, went to spring waters.

entries.zh: 甲午，獵盤直坡。
entries.en: On jiawu day the court hunted at Panzhipo.
entries.literal: On jiawu day, hunted at Panzhipo.

entries.zh: 三月丁亥，幸皇太弟重元帳。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the third month the court visited the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan's tent.
entries.literal: Third month, on dinghai day, visited the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan's tent.

entries.zh: 夏四月癸卯，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On guimao day of the fourth summer month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guimao day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 癸丑，獵合只忽裏。
entries.en: On guichou day the court hunted at Hezhihuli.
entries.literal: On guichou day, hunted at Hezhihuli.

entries.zh: 五月己巳，李諒祚乞進馬、駝，詔歲貢之。
entries.en: On jisi day of the fifth month Li Liangzuo begged to present horses and camels; an edict ordered yearly tribute.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on jisi day, Li Liangzuo begged to present horses and camels; edict ordered yearly tribute.

entries.zh: 庚寅，駐蹕永安山。
entries.en: On gengyin day the court halted at Yongan Mountain.
entries.literal: On gengyin day, halted at Yongan Mountain.

entries.zh: 壬辰，夏國遣使來貢。
entries.en: On renchen day Xia State sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On renchen day, Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 六月丙申，如慶州。
entries.en: On bingshen day of the sixth month the court went to Qing Prefecture.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on bingshen day, went to Qing Prefecture.

entries.zh: 乙亥，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On yihai day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On yihai day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 壬寅，高麗王徽請官其子，詔加檢校太尉。
entries.en: On renyin day Goryeo king Hui requested official rank for his son; an edict ordered promotion to acting Grand Master of War.
entries.literal: On renyin day, Goryeo king Hui requested official rank for his son; edict ordered promotion to acting Grand Master of War.

entries.zh: 辛亥，吐蕃遣使來貢。
entries.en: On xinhai day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On xinhai day, Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 秋七月己巳，夏國李諒祚遣使來求婚。
entries.en: On jisi day of the seventh autumn month Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys to seek marriage.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jisi day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys to seek marriage.

entries.zh: 甲戌，如秋山。
entries.en: On jiaxu day the court went to autumn mountains.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day, went to autumn mountains.

entries.zh: 己卯，詔八房族巾幘。
entries.en: On jimao day an edict ordered the eight house-clans to wear headcloths.
entries.literal: On jimao day, edict ordered the eight house-clans to wear headcloths.

entries.zh: 九月庚寅，獵，遇三虎，縱犬獲之。
entries.en: On gengyin day of the ninth month the court hunted; encountering three tigers, dogs were released and they were captured.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on gengyin day, hunted; encountering three tigers, released dogs and captured them.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁酉，駐蹕中京。
entries.en: On dingyou day of the tenth winter month the court halted at the Central Capital.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingyou day, halted at the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 戊戌，幸新建秘書監。
entries.en: On wuxu day the court visited the newly built Directorate of the Imperial Library.
entries.literal: On wuxu day, visited the newly built Directorate of the Imperial Library.

entries.zh: 辛丑，有事於祖廟。
entries.en: On xinchou day rites were performed at the ancestral temple.
entries.literal: On xinchou day, performed rites at the ancestral temple.

entries.zh: 癸丑，以開泰寺鑄銀佛像，曲赦在京囚。
entries.en: On guichou day, because silver Buddha images were cast at Kaitai Temple, a partial amnesty was granted for prisoners in the capital.
entries.literal: On guichou day, because silver Buddha images were cast at Kaitai Temple, a partial amnesty for prisoners in the capital.

entries.zh: 丙辰，李諒祚遣使進誓表。
entries.en: On bingchen day Li Liangzuo sent envoys presenting an oath memorial.
entries.literal: On bingchen day, Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys presenting an oath memorial.

entries.zh: 十一月乙丑，阻卜部長來貢。
entries.en: On yichou day of the eleventh month Zubu tribal chiefs came with tribute.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on yichou day, Zubu tribal chiefs came with tribute.

entries.zh: 壬申，帝率群臣上皇太后尊號曰仁慈聖善欽孝廣德安靜貞純懿和寬厚崇覺儀天皇太后，大赦。
entries.en: On renshen day the Emperor led the ministers in presenting the Empress Dowager the honorific title Benevolent, Sagely, Pious, Filial, Broadly Virtuous, Tranquil, Pure, Gracious, Harmonious, Generous, Reverent, Awakened, Ceremonious, Heavenly Empress Dowager, and proclaimed a great amnesty.
entries.literal: On renshen day, the Emperor led the ministers in presenting the Empress Dowager the honorific title Benevolent, Sagely, Pious, Filial, Broadly Virtuous, Tranquil, Pure, Gracious, Harmonious, Generous, Reverent, Awakened, Ceremonious, Heavenly Empress Dowager, and proclaimed a great amnesty.

entries.zh: 內外官進級有差。
entries.en: Inner and outer officials advanced in rank by degree.
entries.literal: Inner and outer officials advanced in rank by degree.

entries.zh: 癸未，錄囚。
entries.en: On guiwei day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On guiwei day, reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 甲申，群臣上皇帝尊號曰欽天奉道佑世興歷武定文成聖神仁孝皇帝，冊皇后蕭氏曰貞懿慈和文惠孝敬廣愛崇聖皇后。
entries.en: On jiashen day, the ministers conferred on the emperor the honorific title 'Emperor Who Reveres Heaven, Upholds the Way, Aids the Age, Revives the Calendar, Pacifies by Martial Power, Achieves through Culture, and Is Sage, Divine, Benevolent, and Filial.' Empress Xiao was invested as 'Empress Chaste and Gracious, Kind and Harmonious, Cultured and Beneficent, Filial and Reverent, Broadly Loving, and Exalting the Sage.'
entries.literal: On jiashen day, the ministers presented the emperor with the honorific title 'Emperor Revering Heaven, Upholding the Way, Aiding the Age, Reviving the Calendar, Martially Pacifying, Culturally Accomplished, Sage, Divine, Benevolent, and Filial,' and invested Empress Xiao as 'Empress Chaste, Gracious, Kind, Harmonious, Cultured, Beneficent, Filial, Reverent, Broadly Loving, and Exalting the Sage.'

entries.zh: 十二月丙申，如中會川。
entries.en: On bingshen day of the twelfth month the court went to Zhonghuichuan.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on bingshen day, went to Zhonghuichuan.

entries.zh: 二十四年春正月癸亥，如混同江。
entries.en: In the twenty-fourth year, on guihai day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, on guihai day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 戊辰，朝皇太后。
entries.en: On wuchen day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: On wuchen day, audience with the Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 辛巳，宋遣使來賀，饋馴象。
entries.en: On xinsi day Song sent envoys to offer congratulations and presented a trained elephant.
entries.literal: On xinsi day, Song dispatched envoys to offer congratulations and presented a trained elephant.

entries.zh: 二月己丑朔，召宋使釣魚、賦詩。
entries.en: On the jichou new moon of the second month Song envoys were summoned to fish and compose poetry.
entries.literal: Second month, on jichou new moon, summoned Song envoys to fish and compose poetry.

entries.zh: 癸巳，如長春河。
entries.en: On guisi day the court went to the Changchun River.
entries.literal: On guisi day, went to the Changchun River.

entries.zh: 甲寅，夏國遣使來賀。
entries.en: On jiayin day Xia State sent envoys to offer congratulations.
entries.literal: On jiayin day, Xia State dispatched envoys to offer congratulations.

entries.zh: 三月癸亥，皇太弟重元生子，曲赦行在及長春、鎮北二州徒以下罪。
entries.en: On guihai day of the third month the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan had a son; a partial amnesty was granted for offenses at or below convict labor in the travel palace and in Changchun and Zhenbei prefectures.
entries.literal: Third month, on guihai day, the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan had a son; partial amnesty for offenses at or below convict labor in the travel palace and Changchun and Zhenbei prefectures.

entries.zh: 夏五月，駐蹕南崖。
entries.en: In the fifth summer month the court halted at Nanya.
entries.literal: Summer, fifth month, halted at Nanya.

entries.zh: 秋七月，壬午，如秋山。
entries.en: On renwu day of the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renwu day, went to autumn mountains.

entries.zh: 次南崖之北峪，不豫。
entries.en: The court stopped at the northern ravine of Nanya and fell ill.
entries.literal: Stopped at the northern ravine of Nanya and fell ill.

entries.zh: 八月丁亥，疾大漸，召燕趙國王洪基，諭以治國之要。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the eighth month the illness grew grave; Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji was summoned and instructed on the essentials of governance.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on dinghai day, illness grew grave; summoned Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji and instructed him on essentials of governance.

entries.zh: 戊子，大赦，縱五坊鷹鶻，焚釣魚之具。
entries.en: On wuzi day a great amnesty was proclaimed; the five-compound hawks and falcons were released and fishing equipment was burned.
entries.literal: On wuzi day, great amnesty; released the five-compound hawks and falcons; burned fishing equipment.

entries.zh: 己丑，帝崩於行宮，年四十。
entries.en: On jichou day the Emperor died at the mobile palace at age forty.
entries.literal: On jichou day the Emperor died at the mobile palace, age forty.

entries.zh: 遺詔燕趙國王洪基嗣位。
entries.en: The testamentary edict ordered Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji to succeed to the throne.
entries.literal: The testamentary edict ordered Prince of Yan and Zhao Hongji to succeed to the throne.

entries.zh: 清寧元年十月庚子，上尊謚為神聖孝章皇帝，廟號興宗。
entries.en: In the first year of Qingning, on gengzi day of the tenth month, the posthumous title Sacred Filial Zhang Emperor was elevated and the temple name Xingzong was granted.
entries.literal: In the first year of Qingning, tenth month, on gengzi day the elevated posthumous title Sacred Filial Zhang Emperor was granted, temple name Xingzong.

entries.zh: 贊曰：興宗即位，年十有六矣，不能先尊母后而尊其母，以致臨朝專政，賊殺不辜，又不能以禮幾諫，使齊天死於弒逆，有虧王者之孝，惜哉！
entries.en: The eulogy says: When Xingzong took the throne he was already sixteen; he could not first honor the Empress Mother but instead exalted his own mother, with the result that she monopolized court power, unjustly killed the innocent, and again he could not remonstrate by proper ritual, allowing Qitian to die by regicide — a breach of princely filial piety. Alas!
entries.literal: The eulogy says: When Xingzong took the throne he was already sixteen; he could not first honor the Empress Mother but instead exalted his own mother, with the result that she monopolized court power, unjustly killed the innocent, and again he could not remonstrate by proper ritual, allowing Qitian to die by regicide — a breach of princely filial piety. Alas!

entries.zh: 若夫大行在殯，飲酒博鞠，疊見簡書。
entries.en: While the late emperor's coffin still lay in state he drank wine and played cuju football, repeatedly drawing rebuke in memorials.
entries.literal: When the late emperor's coffin still lay in state he drank wine and played cuju football, repeatedly drawing rebuke in memorials.

entries.zh: 及其謁遺像而哀慟，受宋吊而衰绖，所為若出二人。
entries.en: Yet when he paid homage before the departed image he wailed in grief, and when accepting Song's condolences he wore mourning hemp — his conduct seemed that of two men.
entries.literal: Yet when he paid homage before the departed image he wailed in grief, and when accepting Song's condolences he wore mourning hemp — his conduct seemed that of two men.

entries.zh: 何為其然歟？
entries.en: Why was this so?
entries.literal: Why was this so?

entries.zh: 至於感富弼之言而申南宋之好，許諒祚之盟而罷西夏之兵，邊鄙不聳，政治內修，親策進士，大修條制，下至士庶，得陳便宜，則求治之志切矣。
entries.en: As to responding to Fu Bi's words and renewing friendship with Southern Song, permitting Liangzuo's treaty and standing down Western Xia's forces — the frontiers were untroubled and governance was reformed within; he personally examined the jinshi, greatly revised statutes, and allowed even commoners to present expedients — his desire for good order was earnest indeed.
entries.literal: As to responding to Fu Bi's words and renewing friendship with Southern Song, permitting Liangzuo's treaty and standing down Western Xia's forces — the frontiers were untroubled and governance was reformed within; he personally examined the jinshi, greatly revised statutes, and allowed even commoners to present expedients — his desire for good order was earnest indeed.

entries.zh: 於時左右大臣，曾不聞一賢之進，一事之諫，欲庶幾古帝王之風，其可得乎？
entries.en: Yet at that time among the ministers at his side one never heard of a worthy advanced or a matter remonstrated — how could one hope for the manner of ancient emperors and kings?
entries.literal: Yet at that time among the ministers at his side one never heard of a worthy advanced or a matter remonstrated — how could one hope for the manner of ancient emperors and kings?

entries.zh: 雖然，聖宗而下，可謂賢君矣。
entries.en: Even so, from Shengzong downward he may be called a worthy ruler.
entries.literal: Even so, from Shengzong downward he may be called a worthy ruler.

entries.zh: 興宗三
entries.en: Xingzong, Part Three
entries.literal: Xingzong, Part Three

entries.zh: 道宗一
entries.en: Daozong, Part One
entries.literal: Daozong, Part One

entries.zh: 道宗孝文皇帝，諱洪基，字涅鄰，小字查剌。
entries.en: Emperor Xiaowen of Daozong, taboo name Hongji, courtesy name Nielin, childhood name Zala.
entries.literal: Emperor Xiaowen of Daozong, taboo name Hongji, courtesy name Nielin, childhood name Zala.

entries.zh: 興宗皇帝長子，母曰仁懿皇后蕭氏。
entries.en: He was the eldest son of Emperor Xingzong; his mother was Empress Renyi of the Xiao clan.
entries.literal: He was the eldest son of Emperor Xingzong; his mother was Empress Renyi of the Xiao clan.

entries.zh: 六歲封梁王。
entries.en: At age six he was enfeoffed Prince of Liang.
entries.literal: At age six he was enfeoffed Prince of Liang.

entries.zh: 重熙十一年，進封燕國，總領中丞司事。
entries.en: In the eleventh year of Chongxi he was advanced to Prince of Yan and oversaw Central Secretariat affairs.
entries.literal: In the eleventh year of Chongxi, he was advanced to Prince of Yan and oversaw Central Secretariat affairs.

entries.zh: 明年，總北南院樞密使事，加尚書令，進封燕趙國王。
entries.en: The next year he oversaw Southern and Northern Privy Council affairs, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and advanced to Prince of Yan and Zhao.
entries.literal: The next year he oversaw Southern and Northern Privy Council affairs, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and advanced to Prince of Yan and Zhao.

entries.zh: 二十一年，為天下兵馬大元帥，知惕隱事，預朝政。
entries.en: In the twenty-first year he became grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven, administrator of tiyin affairs, and participated in court government.
entries.literal: In the twenty-first year he became grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven, administrator of tiyin affairs, and participated in court government.

entries.zh: 帝性沈靜、嚴毅，每朝，興宗為之斂容。
