entries.en: The Emperor's nature was calm and stern; at each audience Xingzong would compose himself on his account.
entries.literal: The Emperor's nature was calm and stern; at each audience Xingzong would compose himself on his account.

entries.zh: 二年春正月丙辰，詔州郡官及僚屬決囚，如諸部族例。
entries.en: In the second year, on bingchen day of the first spring month an edict ordered prefectural and district officials and subordinates to decide criminal cases like the various tribal precedents.
entries.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on bingchen day, edict ordered prefectural and district officials and subordinates to decide criminal cases like the various tribal precedents.

entries.zh: 己巳，詔二女古部與世預宰相、節度使之選者免皮室軍。
entries.en: On jisi day an edict ordered that the Ernügu tribe, when hereditary in selection for chancellor and military commissioner, be exempted from the Pishi Army.
entries.literal: On jisi day, edict ordered that the Ernügu tribe, when hereditary in selection for chancellor and military commissioner, be exempted from the Pishi Army.

entries.zh: 是月，幸魚兒濼。
entries.en: That month the court visited Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: That month, visited Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 二月乙酉，以左夷離畢蕭謨魯知西南面招討都監事。
entries.en: On yiyou day of the second month Left yilibi Xiao Molu was made Southwest Route pacification inspector-general.
entries.literal: Second month, on yiyou day, made Left yilibi Xiao Molu Southwest Route pacification inspector-general.

entries.zh: 乙巳，以興宗在時生辰，宴群臣，命各賦詩。
entries.en: On yisi day, because it was Xingzong's birthday while he lived, ministers were feasted and each ordered to compose a poem.
entries.literal: On yisi day, because it was Xingzong's birthday while he lived, ministers were feasted and each ordered to compose a poem.

entries.zh: 三月丁巳，應聖節，曲赦百里內囚。
entries.en: On dingsi day of the third month, the Responding Sage Festival, a partial amnesty was granted for prisoners within a hundred li.
entries.literal: Third month, on dingsi day, the Responding Sage Festival; partial amnesty for prisoners within a hundred li.

entries.zh: 己卯，御製《放鷹賦》賜群臣，諭任臣之意。
entries.en: On jimao day the Emperor's composition 《Rhapsody on Releasing the Hawk》 was bestowed on the ministers, instructing them in employing ministers.
entries.literal: On jimao day the Emperor's composition 《Rhapsody on Releasing the Hawk》 was bestowed on the ministers, instructing them in employing ministers.

entries.zh: 閏月己亥，始行東京所鑄錢。
entries.en: In the intercalary month, on jihai day, Eastern Capital coinage was first put in circulation.
entries.literal: Intercalary month, on jihai day, Eastern Capital coinage was first put in circulation.

entries.zh: 乙巳，南京獄空，進留守以下官。
entries.en: On yisi day Nanjing's prisons were empty; the regent and officials below were promoted.
entries.literal: On yisi day Nanjing's prisons were empty; the regent and officials below were promoted.

entries.zh: 夏四月甲子，詔曰：「方夏，長養鳥獸孳育之時，不得縱火於郊。」
entries.en: On jiazi day of the fourth summer month an edict said: "In midsummer, the season when birds and beasts breed and grow, fire must not be set loose in the suburbs."
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiazi day, edict said: "In midsummer, the season when birds and beasts breed and grow, fire must not be set loose in the suburbs."

entries.zh: 五月戊戌，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On wuxu day of the fifth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: May, on wuxu day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 甲辰，有事於興宗廟。
entries.en: On jiachen day rites were performed at Xingzong's temple.
entries.literal: On jiachen day rites were performed at Xingzong's temple.

entries.zh: 六月丁巳，詔宰相舉才能之士，戊午，命有司籍軍補邊戍。
entries.en: On dingsi day of the sixth month an edict ordered chancellors to recommend men of talent; on wuwu day the relevant offices were ordered to register troops to replenish border garrisons.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on dingsi day, edict ordered chancellors to recommend men of talent; on wuwu day ordered the relevant offices to register troops to replenish border garrisons.

entries.zh: 辛酉，阻卜酋長來朝，貢方物。
entries.en: On xinyou day Zubu chieftains came to court and presented local products.
entries.literal: On xinyou day Zubu chieftains came to court and presented local products.

entries.zh: 丁卯，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On dingmao day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On dingmao day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 辛未，罷史官預聞朝議，俾問宰相而後書。
entries.en: On xinwei day historians' participation in hearing court deliberations was abolished; they were to inquire of the chancellor before writing.
entries.literal: On xinwei day abolished historians' participation in hearing court deliberations; they were to inquire of the chancellor before writing.

entries.zh: 乙亥，中京蝗蝻為災。
entries.en: On yihai day locusts and larvae caused disaster at the Central Capital.
entries.literal: On yihai day locusts and larvae caused disaster at the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 丙子，詔強盜得實者，聽諸路決之。
entries.en: On bingzi day an edict ordered that when banditry was substantiated, all routes might decide the case.
entries.literal: On bingzi day, edict ordered that when banditry was substantiated, all routes might decide the case.

entries.zh: 丁丑，南院樞密使趙國王查葛為上京留守，同知南京留守事吳王仁先為南院樞密使。
entries.en: On dingchou day Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zhao Chage was made supreme capital regent; associate regent of Nanjing Prince of Wu Renxian was made Southern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On dingchou day Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zhao Chage was made supreme capital regent; associate regent of Nanjing Prince of Wu Renxian was made Southern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 乙酉，遣使分道平賦稅，繕戎器，勸農桑，禁盜賊。
entries.en: On yiyou day envoys were dispatched on separate routes to equalize taxes and levies, repair weapons, encourage farming and sericulture, and forbid bandits.
entries.literal: On yiyou day envoys were dispatched on separate routes to equalize taxes and levies, repair weapons, encourage farming and sericulture, and forbid bandits.

entries.zh: 八月辛未，如秋山。
entries.en: On xinwei day of the eighth month the court went to autumn mountains.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on xinwei day, went to autumn mountains.

entries.zh: 九月庚子，幸中京，祭聖宗、興宗於會安殿。
entries.en: On gengzi day of the ninth month the court visited the Central Capital and sacrificed to Shengzong and Xingzong at Hui'an Hall.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on gengzi day, visited the Central Capital and sacrificed to Shengzong and Xingzong at Hui'an Hall.

entries.zh: 冬十月丙子，如中會川。
entries.en: On bingzi day of the tenth winter month the court went to Zhonghuichuan.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingzi day, went to Zhonghuichuan.

entries.zh: 十一月戊戌，知左夷離畢事耶律劃裏為夷離畢，北院大王耶律仙童知黃龍府事。
entries.en: On wuxu day of the eleventh month Yelü Huali, who administered Left yilibi affairs, was made yilibi; Northern Court great king Yelü Xiantong was made administrator of Huanglong Prefecture.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on wuxu day, Yelü Huali, who administered Left yilibi affairs, was made yilibi; Northern Court great king Yelü Xiantong was made administrator of Huanglong Prefecture.

entries.zh: 甲辰，文武百僚上尊號曰天佑皇帝，后曰懿德皇后。
entries.en: On jiachen day civil and military officials presented the honorific title Heavenly Blessing Emperor; the Empress, Virtuous and Gracious Empress.
entries.literal: On jiachen day civil and military officials presented the honorific title Heavenly Blessing Emperor; the Empress, Virtuous and Gracious Empress.

entries.zh: 大赦。
entries.en: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

entries.zh: 乙巳，以皇太叔重元為天下兵馬大元帥，徙封趙國王查葛為魏國王、魯國王和魯斡為宋國王、陳國王阿璉為秦國王，吳王涅魯古進封楚國王，百官進遷有差。
entries.en: On yisi day the imperial uncle Chongyuan was made grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven; Prince of Zhao Chage was transferred to Prince of Wei, Prince of Lu Heluwo to Prince of Song, Prince of Chen Alian to Prince of Qin, Prince of Wu Nielugu advanced to Prince of Chu; officials were promoted and transferred by degree.
entries.literal: On yisi day the imperial uncle Chongyuan was made grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven; Prince of Zhao Chage was transferred to Prince of Wei, Prince of Lu Heluwo to Prince of Song, Prince of Chen Alian to Prince of Qin, Prince of Wu Nielugu advanced to Prince of Chu; officials were promoted and transferred by degree.

entries.zh: 十二月戊申朔，以韓王蕭阿剌為北院樞密使，東京留守宿國王陳留北府宰相，宋國王和魯斡上京留守，秦國王阿璉知中丞司事。
entries.en: On the wushen new moon of the twelfth month Prince of Han Xiao Ala was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Suguo Chenliu Northern Court chancellor; Prince of Song Heluwo supreme capital regent; Prince of Qin Alian administrator of Central Secretariat affairs.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on wushen new moon, Prince of Han Xiao Ala was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Suguo Chenliu Northern Court chancellor; Prince of Song Heluwo supreme capital regent; Prince of Qin Alian administrator of Central Secretariat affairs.

entries.zh: 甲寅，上皇太后尊號曰慈懿仁和文惠孝廣敬愛宗天皇太后。
entries.en: On jiayin day the Empress Dowager was given the honorific title Gracious, Benevolent, Harmonious, Cultured, Favorable, Filial, Broadly Reverent, Loving, Honored, Heavenly Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: On jiayin day the Empress Dowager was given the honorific title Gracious, Benevolent, Harmonious, Cultured, Favorable, Filial, Broadly Reverent, Loving, Honored, Heavenly Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 二十四年秋八月己，興宗崩，即皇帝位於柩前，哀慟不聽政。
entries.en: In the twenty-fourth year, in the eighth autumn month on a ji day, Xingzong died; he took the throne before the bier and, in deep grief, would not govern.
entries.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, autumn, eighth month, on a ji day, Xingzong died; he took the throne before the bier and, in deep grief, would not govern.

entries.zh: 辛卯，百僚上表固請，許之。
entries.en: On xinmao day the hundred officials memorialized repeatedly urging him, and he assented.
entries.literal: On xinmao day the hundred officials memorialized repeatedly urging him; he assented.

entries.zh: 詔曰：「朕以菲德，托居士民之上，第恐智識有不及，群下有未信；
entries.en: An edict said: "I, with slight virtue, have been placed above the people, and I only fear my wisdom and knowledge may fall short and that those below may not trust me;
entries.literal: Edict said: "I, with slight virtue, have been placed above the people, and I only fear my wisdom and knowledge may fall short and that those below may not trust me;

entries.zh: 賦斂妄興，賞罰不中；
entries.en: taxes and levies may be rashly raised, rewards and punishments may miss the mark;
entries.literal: taxes and levies may be rashly raised, rewards and punishments may miss the mark;

entries.zh: 上恩不能及下，下情不能達上。
entries.en: the sovereign's grace may not reach those below, and sentiment below may not reach the sovereign.
entries.literal: the sovereign's grace may not reach those below, and sentiment below may not reach the sovereign.

entries.zh: 凡爾士庶，直言無諱。
entries.en: Let all scholars and commoners speak frankly without reserve.
entries.literal: All you scholars and commoners, speak frankly without reserve.

entries.zh: 可則擇用，否則不以為愆。
entries.en: What is fit, select and use; what is not, do not treat it as fault.
entries.literal: What is fit, select and use; what is not, do not treat it as fault.

entries.zh: 卿等其體朕意。」
entries.en: You ministers, embody my intent."
entries.literal: You ministers, embody my intent."

entries.zh: 壬辰，以皇太弟重元為皇太叔，免漢拜，不名。
entries.en: On renchen day the Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan was made imperial uncle, exempted from Han-style obeisance, and addressed without taboo on his name.
entries.literal: On renchen day the Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan was made imperial uncle, exempted from Han-style obeisance, and addressed without taboo on his name.

entries.zh: 癸巳，遣使報哀於宋及夏、高麗。
entries.en: On guisi day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song and to Xia and Goryeo.
entries.literal: On guisi day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song and to Xia and Goryeo.

entries.zh: 甲午，遣重元安撫南京軍民。
entries.en: On jiawu day Chongyuan was dispatched to reassure troops and people at Nanjing.
entries.literal: On jiawu day Chongyuan was dispatched to reassure troops and people at Nanjing.

entries.zh: 戊戌，以遺詔，命西北路招討使西平郡王蕭阿剌為北府宰相，仍權知南院樞密使事，北府宰相蕭虛烈為武定軍節度使。
entries.en: On wuxu day, by the testamentary edict, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Xiping Xiao Ala was made Northern Court chancellor and still acted as Southern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court chancellor Xiao Xulie was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.
entries.literal: On wuxu day, by the testamentary edict, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Xiping Xiao Ala was made Northern Court chancellor and still acted as Southern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court chancellor Xiao Xulie was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.

entries.zh: 辛丑，改元清寧，大赦。
entries.en: On xinchou day the era name was changed to Qingning and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: On xinchou day the era name was changed to Qingning and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

entries.zh: 九月戊午，詔常所幸圍場外毋禁。
entries.en: On wuwu day of the ninth month an edict ordered that outside hunting grounds the Emperor often favored, there was to be no prohibition.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on wuwu day, edict ordered that outside hunting grounds the Emperor often favored, there was to be no prohibition.

entries.zh: 庚申，詔除護衛士，餘不得佩刃入宮；
entries.en: On gengshen day an edict removed guard soldiers; the rest might not wear blades when entering the palace;
entries.literal: On gengshen day, edict removed guard soldiers; the rest might not wear blades when entering the palace;

entries.zh: 非勛戚後及夷離堇、副使、承應諸職事人，不得冠巾。
entries.en: except meritorious kin, descendants, yilijin, deputy commissioners, and attendants of various posts, none might wear the official headcloth.
entries.literal: except meritorious kin, descendants, yilijin, deputy commissioners, and attendants of various posts, none might wear the official headcloth.

entries.zh: 壬戌，詔夷離堇及副使之族並民奴賤，不得服駝尼、水獺裘，刀柄、兔鶻、鞍勒、珮子不許用犀玉、骨突犀；
entries.en: On renxu day an edict ordered that yilijin and deputy commissioners' clans together with commoner slaves and the base might not wear tuoni or otter-fur coats; knife handles, hawk-bells, saddles, straps, and pendants might not use rhinoceros horn, jade, or bone-tipped rhinoceros horn;
entries.literal: On renxu day, edict ordered that yilijin and deputy commissioners' clans together with commoner slaves and the base might not wear tuoni or otter-fur coats; knife handles, hawk-bells, saddles, straps, and pendants might not use rhinoceros horn, jade, or bone-tipped rhinoceros horn;

entries.zh: 惟大將軍不禁。
entries.en: only great generals were not forbidden.
entries.literal: only great generals were not forbidden.

entries.zh: 乙丑，賜內外臣僚爵賞有差。
entries.en: On yichou day rank and rewards were granted to inner and outer officials by degree.
entries.literal: On yichou day rank and rewards were granted to inner and outer officials by degree.

entries.zh: 庚午，尊皇太后為太皇太后。
entries.en: On gengwu day the Empress Dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.
entries.literal: On gengwu day the Empress Dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.

entries.zh: 辛未，遣左夷離畢蕭謨魯、翰林學士韓運以先帝遺物遺宋。
entries.en: On xinwei day Left yilibi Xiao Molu and Hanlin academician Han Yun were dispatched to present the late emperor's bequeathed goods to Song.
entries.literal: On xinwei day Left yilibi Xiao Molu and Hanlin academician Han Yun were dispatched to present the late emperor's bequeathed goods to Song.

entries.zh: 癸酉，遣使以即位報宋。
entries.en: On guiyou day envoys were dispatched to inform Song of the accession.
entries.literal: On guiyou day envoys were dispatched to inform Song of the accession.

entries.zh: 丙子，尊皇后為皇太后，宴菆塗殿。
entries.en: On bingzi day the Empress was honored as Empress Dowager and a banquet was held at Zatu Hall.
entries.literal: On bingzi day the Empress was honored as Empress Dowager and a banquet was held at Zatu Hall.

entries.zh: 以上京留守宿國王陳留為南京留守。
entries.en: Supreme Capital regent Prince of Suguo Chenliu was made regent of Nanjing.
entries.literal: Supreme Capital regent Prince of Suguo Chenliu was made regent of Nanjing.

entries.zh: 壬午，遣使賜高麗、夏國先帝遺物。
entries.en: On renwu day envoys were dispatched to bestow the late emperor's bequeathed goods on Goryeo and Xia State.
entries.literal: On renwu day envoys were dispatched to bestow the late emperor's bequeathed goods on Goryeo and Xia State.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁亥，有司請以帝生日為天安節，從之。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the tenth winter month the relevant offices requested that the Emperor's birthday be made the Heavenly Peace Festival; the request was granted.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dinghai day, the relevant offices requested that the Emperor's birthday be made the Heavenly Peace Festival; assented.

entries.zh: 以吳王仁先同知南京留守事，陳王塗孛特為南府宰相，進封吳王。
entries.en: Prince of Wu Renxian was made associate regent of Nanjing; Prince of Chen Tubote was made Southern Court chancellor and advanced to Prince of Wu.
entries.literal: Prince of Wu Renxian was made associate regent of Nanjing; Prince of Chen Tubote was made Southern Court chancellor and advanced to Prince of Wu.

entries.zh: 壬寅，以順義軍節度使十神奴為南院大王。
entries.en: On renyin day Shunyi Army military commissioner Shishennu was made Southern Court great king.
entries.literal: On renyin day Shunyi Army military commissioner Shishennu was made Southern Court great king.

entries.zh: 十一月甲子，葬興宗皇帝於慶陵。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the eleventh month Emperor Xingzong was buried at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on jiazi day, Emperor Xingzong was buried at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 宋及高麗遣使來會。
entries.en: Song and Goryeo sent envoys to attend.
entries.literal: Song and Goryeo dispatched envoys to attend.

entries.zh: 名其山曰永興。
entries.en: The mountain was named Yongxing.
entries.literal: The mountain was named Yongxing.

entries.zh: 丙寅，以南院大王侯古為中京留守，北府宰相西平郡王蕭阿剌進封韓王。
entries.en: On bingyin day Southern Court great king Hougu was made regent of the Central Capital; Northern Court chancellor Prince of Xiping Xiao Ala was advanced to Prince of Han.
entries.literal: On bingyin day Southern Court great king Hougu was made regent of the Central Capital; Northern Court chancellor Prince of Xiping Xiao Ala was advanced to Prince of Han.

entries.zh: 壬申，次懷州。
entries.en: On renshen day the court halted at Huai Prefecture.
entries.literal: On renshen day halted at Huai Prefecture.

entries.zh: 有事於太宗、穆宗廟。
entries.en: Rites were performed at Taizong's and Muzong's temples.
entries.literal: Rites were performed at Taizong's and Muzong's temples.

entries.zh: 甲戌，謁祖陵。
entries.en: On jiaxu day the court paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

entries.zh: 戊寅，冬至，有事於太祖、景宗、興宗廟，不受群臣賀。
entries.en: On wuyin day, the winter solstice, rites were performed at Taizu's, Jingzong's, and Xingzong's temples; the court did not receive congratulations from the ministers.
entries.literal: On wuyin day, winter solstice, rites were performed at Taizu's, Jingzong's, and Xingzong's temples; the court did not receive congratulations from the ministers.

entries.zh: 十二月丙戌，詔左夷離畢曰：「朕以眇沖，獲嗣大位，夙夜憂懼，恐弗克任。
entries.en: On bingxu day of the twelfth month an edict to the Left yilibi said: "I, young and small, have received the great position; day and night I worry and fear lest I be unequal to it.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on bingxu day, edict to the Left yilibi said: "I, young and small, have received the great position; day and night I worry and fear lest I be unequal to it.

entries.zh: 欲聞直言，以匡其失。
entries.en: I wish to hear frank speech to correct my faults.
entries.literal: I wish to hear frank speech to correct my faults.

entries.zh: 今已數月，未見所以副朕委任股肱耳目之意。
entries.en: Now several months have passed, yet I have not seen what fulfills my intent to entrust you as arms and legs and ears and eyes.
entries.literal: Now several months have passed, yet I have not seen what fulfills my intent to entrust you as arms and legs and ears and eyes.

entries.zh: 其令內外百官，比秩滿，各言一事。
entries.en: Order inner and outer officials of all ranks, when their term is complete, each to speak on one matter.
entries.literal: Order inner and outer officials of all ranks, when their term is complete, each to speak on one matter.

entries.zh: 仍轉諭所部，無貴賤老幼，皆得直言無諱。」
entries.en: Also relay instructions to their jurisdictions: without regard to noble or base, old or young, all may speak frankly without reserve."
entries.literal: Also relay instructions to their jurisdictions: without regard to noble or base, old or young, all may speak frankly without reserve."

entries.zh: 戊子，應聖節，上太皇太后壽，宴群臣、命婦，冊妃蕭氏為皇后。
entries.en: On wuzi day, the Responding Sage Festival, longevity was wished for the Grand Empress Dowager; ministers and titled wives were feasted; consort Xiao was invested Empress.
entries.literal: On wuzi day, the Responding Sage Festival, longevity was wished for the Grand Empress Dowager; ministers and titled wives were feasted; consort Xiao was invested Empress.

entries.zh: 進封皇弟越王和魯斡為魯國王，許王阿璉為陳國王，楚王涅魯古徙封吳王。
entries.en: The Emperor's younger brother Prince of Yue Heluwo was advanced to Prince of Lu; Prince of Xu Alian to Prince of Chen; Prince of Chu Nielugu was transferred to Prince of Wu.
entries.literal: The Emperor's younger brother Prince of Yue Heluwo was advanced to Prince of Lu; Prince of Xu Alian to Prince of Chen; Prince of Chu Nielugu was transferred to Prince of Wu.

entries.zh: 辛卯，詔部署院，事有機密即奏，其投謗訕書，輒受及讀者並棄市。
entries.en: On xinmao day an edict to the Deployment Office ordered that when affairs were confidential they were to be memorialized at once; whoever submitted or received libelous writings was to be executed in the market along with the reader.
entries.literal: On xinmao day edict to the Deployment Office: when affairs were confidential they were to be memorialized at once; whoever submitted or received libelous writings was to be executed in the market along with the reader.

entries.zh: 癸巳，皇族十公悖母，伏誅。
entries.en: On guisi day ten princes of the imperial clan were disrespectful to their mother and were executed.
entries.literal: On guisi day ten princes of the imperial clan were disrespectful to their mother and were executed.

entries.zh: 甲午，以樞密副使姚景行為參知政事，翰林學士吳湛為樞密副使，參知政事、同知樞密院事韓紹文為上京留守。
entries.en: On jiawu day associate privy commissioner Yao Jingxing was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Hanlin academician Wu Zhan associate privy commissioner; Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate privy commissioner Han Shaowen supreme capital regent.
entries.literal: On jiawu day associate privy commissioner Yao Jingxing was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Hanlin academician Wu Zhan associate privy commissioner; Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate privy commissioner Han Shaowen supreme capital regent.

entries.zh: 丙申，宋遣歐陽修等來賀即位。
entries.en: On bingshen day Song sent Ouyang Xiu and others to congratulate the accession.
entries.literal: On bingshen day Song dispatched Ouyang Xiu and others to congratulate the accession.

entries.zh: 戊戌，詔設學養士，頒《五經》傳疏，置博士、助教各一員。
entries.en: On wuxu day an edict ordered schools established to nurture scholars, the commentaries on the 《Five Classics》 promulgated, and one doctor and one assistant instructor appointed each.
entries.literal: On wuxu day edict ordered schools established to nurture scholars, the commentaries on the 《Five Classics》 promulgated, and one doctor and one assistant instructor appointed each.

entries.zh: 癸卯，以知涿州楊績參知政事兼同知樞密院事。
entries.en: On guimao day Zhuo Prefecture administrator Yang Ji was made Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On guimao day Zhuo Prefecture administrator Yang Ji was made Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 庚戌，以聖宗在時生辰，赦上京囚。
entries.en: On gengxu day, because it was Shengzong's birthday while he lived, prisoners at the Supreme Capital were pardoned.
entries.literal: On gengxu day, because it was Shengzong's birthday while he lived, prisoners at the Supreme Capital were pardoned.

entries.zh: 是年，禦清涼殿放進士張孝傑等四十四人。
entries.en: That year, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Zhang Xiaojie and forty-four others were passed.
entries.literal: That year, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Zhang Xiaojie and forty-four others were passed.

entries.zh: 三年春正月庚辰，如鴨子河。
entries.en: In the third year, on gengchen day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.
entries.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on gengchen day, went to the Duck River.

entries.zh: 丙戌，置倒塌嶺節度使。
entries.en: On bingxu day the Daotaoling military commissioner was established.
entries.literal: On bingxu day the Daotaoling military commissioner was established.

entries.zh: 乙未，五國部長來貢方物。
entries.en: On yiwei day chieftains of the Five States presented local products.
entries.literal: On yiwei day chieftains of the Five States presented local products.

entries.zh: 二月己未，如大魚濼。
entries.en: On jiwei day of the second month the court went to Dayu Marsh.
entries.literal: Second month, on jiwei day, went to Dayu Marsh.

entries.zh: 三月辛巳，以楚國王涅魯古為武定軍節度使。
entries.en: On xinsi day of the third month Prince of Chu Nielugu was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.
entries.literal: Third month, on xinsi day, Prince of Chu Nielugu was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.

entries.zh: 夏四月丙辰，清暑永安山。
entries.en: On bingchen day of the fourth summer month the court summered at Yongan Mountain.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingchen day, summered at Yongan Mountain.

entries.zh: 五月己亥，如慶陵，獻酎於金殿、同天殿。
entries.en: On jihai day of the fifth month the court visited Qing Mausoleum and offered libation at the Golden Hall and Tongtian Hall.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on jihai day, visited Qing Mausoleum and offered libation at the Golden Hall and Tongtian Hall.

entries.zh: 六月辛未，以魏國王查葛為惕隱，同知樞密院事蕭唐古南府宰相，魏國王貼不東京留守。
entries.en: On xinwei day of the sixth month Prince of Wei Chage was made tiyin; associate privy commissioner Xiao Tanggu Southern Court chancellor; Prince of Wei Tiebu Eastern Capital regent.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on xinwei day, Prince of Wei Chage was made tiyin; associate privy commissioner Xiao Tanggu Southern Court chancellor; Prince of Wei Tiebu Eastern Capital regent.

entries.zh: 秋七月甲申，南京地震，赦其境內。
entries.en: On jiashen day of the seventh autumn month Nanjing had an earthquake; amnesty was granted within its territory.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiashen day Nanjing had an earthquake; amnesty within its territory.

entries.zh: 乙酉，如秋山。
entries.en: On yiyou day the court went to autumn mountains.
entries.literal: On yiyou day went to autumn mountains.

entries.zh: 八月辛亥，帝以《君臣同志華夷同風詩集》進皇太后。
entries.en: On xinhai day of the eighth month the Emperor presented the Grand Empress Dowager with 《Collected Poems on Ruler and Minister Sharing One Will and Chinese and Barbarian Sharing One Custom》.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on xinhai day, the Emperor presented the Grand Empress Dowager with 《Collected Poems on Ruler and Minister Sharing One Will and Chinese and Barbarian Sharing One Custom》.

entries.zh: 九月庚子，幸中會川。
entries.en: On gengzi day of the ninth month the court visited Zhonghuichuan.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on gengzi day, visited Zhonghuichuan.

entries.zh: 冬十月己酉，謁祖陵。
entries.en: On jiyou day of the tenth winter month the court paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiyou day, paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

entries.zh: 庚申，謁讓國皇帝及世宗廟。
entries.en: On gengshen day the court paid respects at the Abdication Emperor's and Shizong's temples.
entries.literal: On gengshen day paid respects at the Abdication Emperor's and Shizong's temples.

entries.zh: 辛酉，奠酎於玉殿。
entries.en: On xinyou day libation was offered at the Jade Hall.
entries.literal: On xinyou day libation was offered at the Jade Hall.

entries.zh: 十一月丙子，以左夷離畢蕭謨魯為契丹行宮都部署。
entries.en: On bingzi day of the eleventh month Left yilibi Xiao Molu was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on bingzi day, made Left yilibi Xiao Molu Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

entries.zh: 庚子，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On gengzi day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On gengzi day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 十二月庚戌，禁職官於部內假貸貿易。
entries.en: On gengxu day of the twelfth month officials were forbidden to lend or trade within their jurisdictions.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on gengxu day, forbidden officials to lend or trade within their jurisdictions.

entries.zh: 戊辰，太皇太后不豫，曲赦行在五百里內囚。
entries.en: On wuchen day the Grand Empress Dowager fell ill; partial amnesty for prisoners within five hundred li of the imperial halt.
entries.literal: On wuchen day the Grand Empress Dowager fell ill; partial amnesty for prisoners within five hundred li of the imperial halt.

entries.zh: 己巳，太皇太后崩。
entries.en: On jisi day the Grand Empress Dowager died.
entries.literal: On jisi day the Grand Empress Dowager died.

entries.zh: 六年春，如鴛鴦濼。
entries.en: In the sixth year, in spring, the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
entries.literal: In the sixth year, spring, went to Yuanyang Marsh.

entries.zh: 夏五月戊子朔，監修國史耶律白請編次御製詩賦，仍命白為序。
entries.en: On the wuzi new moon of the fifth summer month compiler of the national history Yelü Bai requested compilation of the Emperor's poems and rhapsodies and was ordered to write the preface.
entries.literal: Summer, fifth month, on wuzi new moon, compiler of the national history Yelü Bai requested compilation of the Emperor's poems and rhapsodies and was ordered to write the preface.

entries.zh: 己酉，駐蹕納葛濼。
entries.en: On jiyou day the court halted at Nage Marsh.
entries.literal: On jiyou day halted at Nage Marsh.

entries.zh: 六月戊午朔，以東北路女直詳穩高家奴為惕隱。
entries.en: On the wuwu new moon of the sixth month Northeast Route Jurchen detail-stable Gaojianu was made tiyin.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on wuwu new moon, Northeast Route Jurchen detail-stable Gaojianu was made tiyin.

entries.zh: 壬戌，遣使錄囚。
entries.en: On renxu day envoys were dispatched to review prisoners.
entries.literal: On renxu day dispatched envoys to review prisoners.

entries.zh: 丙寅，中京置國子監，命以時祭先聖先師，癸未，以隋王仁先為北院大王，賜御制誥。
entries.en: On bingyin day the Directorate of Education was established at the Central Capital and seasonal sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Teacher was ordered; on guiwei day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Northern Court great king and granted an imperial drafting edict.
entries.literal: On bingyin day the Directorate of Education was established at the Central Capital; ordered seasonal sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Teacher; on guiwei day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Northern Court great king and granted an imperial drafting edict.

entries.zh: 冬十月甲子，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiazi day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 四年春正月壬申朔，遣使報哀於宋、夏。
entries.en: In the fourth year, on the renshen new moon of the first spring month envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song and Xia.
entries.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on renshen new moon, envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song and Xia.

entries.zh: 如鴨子河釣魚。
entries.en: The court went to the Duck River to fish.
entries.literal: Went to the Duck River to fish.

entries.zh: 癸酉，宋遣使奉宋主繪像來。
entries.en: On guiyou day Song sent envoys presenting a painted likeness of the Song ruler.
entries.literal: On guiyou day Song dispatched envoys presenting a painted likeness of the Song ruler.

entries.zh: 丁亥，知易州事耶律頗得秩滿，部民乞留，許之。
entries.en: On dinghai day Yelü Pode, who administered Yi Prefecture, completed his term; the people of his district begged he remain; permission was granted.
entries.literal: On dinghai day Yelü Pode, who administered Yi Prefecture, completed his term; the people of his district begged he remain; permitted.

entries.zh: 二月丙午，詔夷離畢：諸路鞫死罪，獄雖具，仍令別州縣覆按，無冤，然後決之；
entries.en: On bingwu day of the second month an edict to the yilibi ordered that for capital offenses in all routes, though the case was complete, another prefecture or district was still to review; if there was no injustice, then decide;
entries.literal: Second month, on bingwu day, edict to the yilibi: for capital offenses in all routes, though the case was complete, still order another prefecture or district to review; if there was no injustice, then decide;

entries.zh: 稱冤者，即具奏。
entries.en: whoever claimed injustice was immediately to be memorialized in full.
entries.literal: whoever claimed injustice was immediately to be memorialized in full.

entries.zh: 庚戌，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: On gengxu day the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: On gengxu day went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 三月戊寅，募天德、鎮武、東勝等處勇捷者，籍為軍。
entries.en: On wuyin day of the third month the bold and swift were recruited from Tiande, Zhenwu, Dongsheng, and other places and registered as troops.
entries.literal: Third month, on wuyin day, recruited the bold and swift from Tiande, Zhenwu, Dongsheng, and other places and registered them as troops.

entries.zh: 甲午，肆赦。
entries.en: On jiawu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: On jiawu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

entries.zh: 夏四月甲辰，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On jiachen day of the fourth summer month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiachen day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 丁卯，宋遣使吊祭。
entries.en: On dingmao day Song sent envoys to offer condolences.
entries.literal: On dingmao day Song dispatched envoys to offer condolences.

entries.zh: 五月庚午朔，上大行太皇太后尊謚曰欽哀皇后。
entries.en: On the gengwu new moon of the fifth month the posthumous honorific for the late Grand Empress Dowager was Empress Qin'ai.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on gengwu new moon, posthumous honorific for the late Grand Empress Dowager: Empress Qin'ai.

entries.zh: 癸酉，葬慶陵。
entries.en: On guiyou day burial was at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On guiyou day buried at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 夏國、高麗遣使來會。
entries.en: Xia State and Goryeo sent envoys to attend.
entries.literal: Xia State and Goryeo dispatched envoys to attend.

entries.zh: 乙酉，如永安山清暑。
entries.en: On yiyou day the court went to Yongan Mountain to escape summer heat.
entries.literal: On yiyou day went to Yongan Mountain to escape summer heat.

entries.zh: 六月乙丑，以北院樞密使鄭王蕭革為南院樞密使，徙封楚王，南院樞密使吳王仁先為北院樞密使。
entries.en: On yichou day of the sixth month Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zheng Xiao Ge was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Chu; Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wu Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on chou day, Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zheng Xiao Ge was made Southern Court privy commissioner, transferred to Prince of Chu; Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wu Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 秋七月辛巳，制諸掌內藏庫官盜兩貫以上者，許奴婢告。
entries.en: On xinsi day of the seventh autumn month it was regulated that officials in charge of the inner treasury who stole two strings of cash or more might be reported by slaves and maidservants.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinsi day, regulated that officials in charge of the inner treasury who stole two strings of cash or more might be reported by slaves and maidservants.

entries.zh: 壬午，獵於黑嶺。
entries.en: On renwu day the court hunted at Heiling.
entries.literal: On renwu day hunted at Heiling.

entries.zh: 冬十月戊戌朔，以同知東京留守事侯古為南院大王，保安軍節度使奚底為奚六部大王。
entries.en: On the wuxu new moon of the tenth winter month associate Eastern Capital regent Hougu was made Southern Court great king; Bao'an Army military commissioner Xidi was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuxu new moon, associate Eastern Capital regent Hougu was made Southern Court great king; Bao'an Army military commissioner Xidi was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.

entries.zh: 十一月癸酉，行再生及柴冊禮，宴群臣於八方陂。
entries.en: On guiyou day of the eleventh month the rebirth and firewood-bundle rituals were performed; ministers were feasted at Bafang Marsh.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on guiyou day performed the rebirth and firewood-bundle rituals; ministers were feasted at Bafang Marsh.

entries.zh: 庚辰，禦清風殿受大冊禮。
entries.en: On gengchen day at Clear Wind Hall the great investiture ritual was received.
entries.literal: On gengchen day at Clear Wind Hall received the great investiture ritual.

entries.zh: 大赦。
entries.en: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

entries.zh: 以吳王仁先為南京兵馬副元帥，徙封隋王。
entries.en: Prince of Wu Renxian was made Nanjing deputy grand marshal and transferred to Prince of Sui.
entries.literal: Prince of Wu Renxian was made Nanjing deputy grand marshal; transferred to Prince of Sui.

entries.zh: 壬午，謁太祖及諸帝宮。
entries.en: On renwu day the court paid respects at Taizu's and the various emperors' palaces.
entries.literal: On renwu day paid respects at Taizu's and the various emperors' palaces.

entries.zh: 丙戌，祠木葉山。
entries.en: On bingxu day sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.
entries.literal: On bingxu day sacrificed at Muye Mountain.

entries.zh: 禁造玉器。
entries.en: Manufacture of jade vessels was forbidden.
entries.literal: Forbidden manufacture of jade vessels.

entries.zh: 十二月辛丑，弛駝尼、水獺裘之禁。
entries.en: On xinchou day of the twelfth month the prohibition on tuoni and otter-fur coats was relaxed.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on xinchou day, relaxed the prohibition on tuoni and otter-fur coats.

entries.zh: 乙巳，許士庶畜鷹。
entries.en: On yisi day scholars and commoners were permitted to keep hawks.
entries.literal: On yisi day permitted scholars and commoners to keep hawks.

entries.zh: 辛亥，南院樞密使楚王蕭革復為北院樞密使。
entries.en: On xinhai day Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Chu Xiao Ge again became Northern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On xinhai day Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Chu Xiao Ge again became Northern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 閏月己巳，賜皇太叔重元金券。
entries.en: In the intercalary month, on jisi day, the imperial uncle Chongyuan was granted a gold tally.
entries.literal: Intercalary month, on jisi day, granted the imperial uncle Chongyuan a gold tally.

entries.zh: 是歲，皇子浚生。
entries.en: That year the imperial son Jun was born.
entries.literal: That year the imperial son Jun was born.

entries.zh: 五年春，如春州。
entries.en: In the fifth year, in spring, the court went to Chun Prefecture.
entries.literal: In the fifth year, spring, went to Chun Prefecture.

entries.zh: 夏六月甲子朔，駐蹕納葛濼。
entries.en: On the jiazi new moon of the sixth summer month the court halted at Nage Marsh.
entries.literal: Summer, sixth month, on jiazi new moon, halted at Nage Marsh.

entries.zh: 己丑，以南院樞密使蕭阿速為北府宰相，樞密副使耶律乙辛南院樞密使，惕隱查葛遼興軍節度使，魯王謝家奴武定軍節度使，東京留守吳王貼不西京留守。
entries.en: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.
entries.literal: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.

entries.zh: 秋七月丁酉，以烏古敵烈詳穩蕭謨魯為左夷離畢。
entries.en: On dingyou day of the seventh autumn month Wugu Dilie detail-stable Xiao Molu was made Left yilibi.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dingyou day, Wugu Dilie detail-stable Xiao Molu was made Left yilibi.

entries.zh: 冬十月壬子朔，幸南京，祭興宗於嘉寧殿。
entries.en: On the renzi new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited Nanjing and sacrificed to Xingzong at Jianing Hall.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renzi new moon, visited Nanjing and sacrificed to Xingzong at Jianing Hall.

entries.zh: 十一月，禁獵。
entries.en: In the eleventh month hunting was forbidden.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, hunting was forbidden.

entries.zh: 十二月壬戌，以北院林牙奚馬六為右夷離畢，參知政事吳湛以弟洵冒入仕籍，削爵為民。
entries.en: On renxu day of the twelfth month Northern Court linya Xima Liu was made Right yilibi; Associate Administrator of Affairs Wu Zhan, because his younger brother Xun had fraudulently entered the service register, was stripped of rank and made a commoner.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on renxu day, Northern Court linya Xima Liu was made Right yilibi; Associate Administrator of Affairs Wu Zhan, because his younger brother Xun had fraudulently entered the service register, was stripped of rank and made a commoner.

entries.zh: 是年，上御百福殿，放進士梁援等百一十五人。
entries.en: That year at the Hundred Blessings Hall the jinshi Liang Yuan and one hundred fifteen others were passed.
entries.literal: That year at the Hundred Blessings Hall the jinshi Liang Yuan and one hundred fifteen others were passed.

entries.zh: 七年春三月庚戌，如春州。
entries.en: In the seventh year, on gengxu day of the third spring month the court went to Chun Prefecture.
entries.literal: In the seventh year, spring, third month, on gengxu day, went to Chun Prefecture.

entries.zh: 以耶律乙辛知北院樞密使事。
entries.en: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
entries.literal: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.

entries.zh: 夏四月辛未，禁吏民畜海東青鶻。
entries.en: On xinwei day of the fourth summer month officials and commoners were forbidden to keep eastern-sea green falcons.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinwei day, forbidden officials and commoners to keep eastern-sea green falcons.

entries.zh: 五月丙戌，清暑永安山。
entries.en: On bingxu day of the fifth month the court summered at Yongan Mountain.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day, summered at Yongan Mountain.

entries.zh: 丙午，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On bingwu day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On bingwu day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 辛亥，殺東京留守陳王蕭阿剌。
entries.en: On xinhai day Eastern Capital regent Prince of Chen Xiao Ala was killed.
entries.literal: On xinhai day Eastern Capital regent Prince of Chen Xiao Ala was killed.

entries.zh: 六月壬子朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the renzi new moon of the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on renzi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 甲子，以蕭謨魯為順義軍節度使。
entries.en: On jiazi day Xiao Molu was made military commissioner of Shunyi Army.
entries.literal: On jiazi day Xiao Molu was made military commissioner of Shunyi Army.

entries.zh: 丁卯，幸弘義、永興、崇德三宮致祭。
entries.en: On dingmao day the court visited Hongyi, Yongxing, and Chongde palaces to perform sacrifice.
entries.literal: On dingmao day visited Hongyi, Yongxing, and Chongde palaces to perform sacrifice.

entries.zh: 射柳，賜宴，賞賚有差。
entries.en: Willow-shooting was held; a feast was granted and rewards by degree.
entries.literal: Willow-shooting; a feast was granted; rewards by degree.

entries.zh: 戊辰，行再生禮，復命群臣分朋射柳。
entries.en: On wuchen day the rebirth ritual was performed; ministers were again ordered to shoot willows in separate teams.
entries.literal: On wuchen day performed the rebirth ritual; again ordered ministers to shoot willows in separate teams.

entries.zh: 丁丑，以楚國王涅魯古知南院樞密使事。
entries.en: On dingchou day Prince of Chu Nielugu was made to administer Southern Court privy affairs.
entries.literal: On dingchou day Prince of Chu Nielugu was made to administer Southern Court privy affairs.

entries.zh: 秋九月丁丑，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On dingchou day of the ninth autumn month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Autumn, ninth month, on dingchou day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 冬十二月壬午，以知黃龍府事耶律阿裏只為南院大王。
entries.en: On renwu day of the twelfth winter month Yelü Alizhi, who administered Huanglong Prefecture, was made Southern Court great king.
entries.literal: Winter, twelfth month, on renwu day, Yelü Alizhi, who administered Huanglong Prefecture, was made Southern Court great king.

entries.zh: 道宗二
entries.en: Daozong, Part Two
entries.literal: Daozong, Part Two

entries.zh: 咸雍元年春正月辛酉朔，文武百僚加上尊號曰聖文神武全功大略廣智聰仁睿孝天佑皇帝。
entries.en: In the first year of Xianyong, on the xinyou new moon of the first spring month civil and military officials presented the honorific title Sagely, Cultured, Spiritually Martial, All-Achieving, Great Strategy, Broad Wisdom, Perceptive, Benevolent, Sagely, Filial, Heavenly Blessing Emperor.
entries.literal: In the first year of Xianyong, spring, first month, on xinyou new moon, civil and military officials presented the honorific title Sagely, Cultured, Spiritually Martial, All-Achieving, Great Strategy, Broad Wisdom, Perceptive, Benevolent, Sagely, Filial, Heavenly Blessing Emperor.

entries.zh: 改元，大赦。
entries.en: The era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: The era name was changed and a general amnesty proclaimed.

entries.zh: 冊梁王浚為皇太子，內外官賜級有差。
entries.en: Prince of Liang Jun was invested crown prince; inner and outer officials were granted rank by degree.
entries.literal: Prince of Liang Jun was invested crown prince; inner and outer officials were granted rank by degree.

entries.zh: 甲子，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: On jiazi day the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: On jiazi day went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 庚寅，詔諸遇正旦、重午、冬至，別表賀東宮。
entries.en: On gengyin day an edict ordered that on New Year's Day, Double Fifth, and winter solstice, separate memorials congratulating the Eastern Palace were to be presented.
entries.literal: On gengyin day, edict ordered that on encountering New Year's Day, Double Fifth, and winter solstice, separate memorials congratulating the Eastern Palace were to be presented.

entries.zh: 三月丁亥，以知興中府事楊績知樞密院事。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the third month Yang Ji, who administered Xingzhong Prefecture, was made to administer Privy Council affairs.
entries.literal: Third month, on dinghai day, Yang Ji, who administered Xingzhong Prefecture, was made to administer Privy Council affairs.

entries.zh: 夏四月辛卯，以知樞密院事張嗣復疾，改知興中府事。
entries.en: On xinmao day of the fourth summer month, because Zhang Sifu, who administered Privy Council affairs, was ill, he was changed to administer Xingzhong Prefecture.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinmao day, because Zhang Sifu, who administered Privy Council affairs, was ill, he was changed to administer Xingzhong Prefecture.

entries.zh: 庚子，清暑拖古烈。
entries.en: On gengzi day the court summered at Tuogulie.
entries.literal: On gengzi day summered at Tuogulie.

entries.zh: 五月辛巳，夏國遣使來貢。
entries.en: On xinsi day of the fifth month Xia State sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on xinsi day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 秋七月丙子，以皇太后射獲熊，賞賚百官有差。
entries.en: On bingzi day of the seventh autumn month, because the Empress Dowager shot and captured a bear, officials were rewarded by degree.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingzi day, because the Empress Dowager shot and captured a bear, officials were rewarded by degree.

entries.zh: 八月丙申，客星犯天廟。
entries.en: On bingshen day of the eighth month a guest star violated the Heavenly Temple.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on bingshen day a guest star violated the Heavenly Temple.

entries.zh: 詔諸路備盜賊，嚴火禁。
entries.en: An edict ordered all routes to prepare against bandits and strictly forbid fire.
entries.literal: Edict ordered all routes to prepare against bandits and strictly forbid fire.

entries.zh: 九月乙亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On yihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on yihai day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 丁丑，左夷離畢慥古為孟父敞穩。
entries.en: On dingchou day Left yilibi Zaogu was made Mengfu detail-stable.
entries.literal: On dingchou day Left yilibi Zaogu was made Mengfu detail-stable.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，幸醫巫閭山。
entries.en: On the dinghai new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited Yiwulü Mountain.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dinghai new moon, visited Yiwulü Mountain.

entries.zh: 己亥，皇太后射獲虎，大宴群臣，令各賦詩。
entries.en: On jihai day the Empress Dowager shot and captured a tiger; a great feast was held for ministers and each was ordered to compose a poem.
entries.literal: On jihai day the Empress Dowager shot and captured a tiger; a great feast was held for ministers and each ordered to compose a poem.

entries.zh: 十一月壬戌，有星如鬥，逆行，隱隱有聲。
entries.en: On renxu day of the eleventh month there was a star like a dipper, moving retrograde, with a faint sound.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on renxu day there was a star like a dipper, moving retrograde, with a faint sound.

entries.zh: 十二月甲午，以遼王仁先為南京留守，徙封晉王。
entries.en: On jiawu day of the twelfth month Prince of Liao Renxian was made regent of Nanjing and transferred to Prince of Jin.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on jiawu day Prince of Liao Renxian was made regent of Nanjing and transferred to Prince of Jin.

entries.zh: 辛亥，以南京留守蕭惟信為左夷離畢。
entries.en: On xinhai day Nanjing regent Xiao Weixin was made Left yilibi.
entries.literal: On xinhai day Nanjing regent Xiao Weixin was made Left yilibi.

entries.zh: 壬子，熒惑與月並行，自旦至午。
entries.en: On renzi day Mars traveled with the moon from dawn to noon.
entries.literal: On renzi day Mars traveled with the moon from dawn to noon.

entries.zh: 九年春正月辛亥，幸鴛鴦濼。
entries.en: In the ninth year, on xinhai day of the first spring month the court visited Yuanyang Marsh.
entries.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on xinhai day, visited Yuanyang Marsh.

entries.zh: 辛未，禁民鬻銅。
entries.en: On xinwei day the people were forbidden to sell copper.
entries.literal: On xinwei day forbidden the people to sell copper.

entries.zh: 三月辛未，宋主禎殂，以侄曙為子嗣位。
entries.en: On xinwei day of the third month Song ruler Zhen died; his nephew Shu succeeded as adopted son and took the throne.
entries.literal: Third month, on xinwei day Song ruler Zhen died; his nephew Shu succeeded as adopted son and took the throne.

entries.zh: 夏五月丙午，以隋王仁先為南院樞密使，徙封許王。
entries.en: On bingwu day of the fifth summer month Prince of Sui Renxian was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Xu.
entries.literal: Summer, fifth month, on bingwu day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Xu.

entries.zh: 是月，清暑曷裏狘。
entries.en: That month the court summered at Helibie.
entries.literal: That month, summered at Helibie.

entries.zh: 秋七月丙辰，如太子山。
entries.en: On bingchen day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Crown Prince Mountain.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingchen day, went to Crown Prince Mountain.

entries.zh: 戊午，皇太叔重元與其子楚國王涅魯古及陳國王陳六、同知北院樞密使事蕭胡睹、衛王貼不、林牙涅剌溥古、統軍使蕭叠裏得、駙馬都尉參及弟術者、圖骨、旗鼓拽剌詳穩耶律郭九、文班太保奚叔、內藏提點烏骨、護衛左太保敵不古、按答、副宮使韓家奴、寶神奴等凡四百人，誘脅弩手軍犯行宮。
entries.en: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.
entries.literal: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.

entries.zh: 時南院樞密使許王仁先、知北樞密院事趙王耶律乙辛、南府宰相蕭唐古、北院宣徽使蕭韓家奴、北院樞密副使蕭惟信、敦睦宮使耶律良等率宿衛士卒數千人禦之。
entries.en: At the time Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Xu Renxian, Yelü Yixin who administered Northern Privy Council affairs, Southern Court chancellor Xiao Tanggu, Northern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hanjianu, Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin, Dunmu Palace commissioner Yelü Liang, and others led several thousand night-guard troops to resist.
entries.literal: At the time Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Xu Renxian, Yelü Yixin who administered Northern Privy Council affairs, Southern Court chancellor Xiao Tanggu, Northern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hanjianu, Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin, Dunmu Palace commissioner Yelü Liang, and others led several thousand night-guard troops to resist.

entries.zh: 涅魯古躍馬突出，將戰，為近侍詳穩渤海阿廝、護衛蘇射殺之。
entries.en: Nielugu leaped his horse forward and was about to fight when he was shot and killed by attendant detail-stable Bohai Asi and guard Su.
entries.literal: Nielugu leaped his horse forward and was about to fight when he was shot and killed by attendant detail-stable Bohai Asi and guard Su.

entries.zh: 己未，族逆黨家。
entries.en: On jiwei day the families of the rebel party were exterminated by clan.
entries.literal: On jiwei day the families of the rebel party were exterminated by clan.

entries.zh: 庚申，重元亡入大漠，自殺。
entries.en: On gengshen day Chongyuan fled into the great desert and killed himself.
entries.literal: On gengshen day Chongyuan fled into the great desert and killed himself.

entries.zh: 辛酉，詔諭諸道。
entries.en: On xinyou day an edict instructed all routes.
entries.literal: On xinyou day edict instructed all routes.

entries.zh: 壬戌，以仁先為北院樞密使，進封宋王，加尚父，耶律乙辛南院樞密使，蕭韓家奴殿前都點檢，封荊王。
entries.en: On renxu day Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner, advanced to Prince of Song and honored as imperial father; Yelü Yixin was made Southern Court privy commissioner; Xiao Hanjianu was made Palace Front commander and enfeoffed Prince of Jing.
entries.literal: On renxu day Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner, advanced to Prince of Song and honored as imperial father; Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; Xiao Hanjianu Palace Front commander and enfeoffed Prince of Jing.

entries.zh: 蕭惟信、耶律馮家奴並加太子太傅。
entries.en: Xiao Weixin and Yelü Fengjianu were both promoted Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
entries.literal: Xiao Weixin and Yelü Fengjianu were both promoted Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

entries.zh: 宿衛官蕭乙辛、回鶻海鄰、裏、耶律撻不也、阿廝、宮分人急裏哥、霞抹、乙辛、只魯並加上將軍。
entries.en: Night-guard officials Xiao Yixin, Uighur Hailin, Li, Yelü Tabuye, Asi, palace division men Jilige, Xiamo, Yixin, and Zhilu were all promoted upper generals.
entries.literal: Night-guard officials Xiao Yixin, Uighur Hailin, Li, Yelü Tabuye, Asi, palace division men Jilige, Xiamo, Yixin, Zhilu were all promoted upper generals.

entries.zh: 諸護衛及士卒、庖夫、弩手、傘子等三百餘人，各授官有差。
entries.en: More than three hundred guards, soldiers, cooks, crossbowmen, umbrella-bearers, and the like each received office by degree.
entries.literal: More than three hundred guards, soldiers, cooks, crossbowmen, umbrella-bearers, and the like each received office by degree.

entries.zh: 耶律良密告重元變，命籍橫帳夷離堇房，為漢人行宮都部署。
entries.en: Yelü Liang had secretly reported Chongyuan's plot; the horizontal-account yilijin houses were ordered registered; he was made Han mobile palace deployment director.
entries.literal: Yelü Liang had secretly reported Chongyuan's plot; ordered the horizontal-account yilijin houses registered; made Han mobile palace deployment director.

entries.zh: 癸亥，貼不訴為重元等所脅，詔削爵為民，流鎮州。
entries.en: On guihai day Tiebu pleaded that he had been coerced by Chongyuan and the others; an edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner, exiled to Zhen Prefecture.
entries.literal: On guihai day Tiebu pleaded that he had been coerced by Chongyuan and the others; edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner, exiled to Zhen Prefecture.

entries.zh: 戊辰，以黑白羊祭天。
entries.en: On wuchen day black and white sheep were used to sacrifice to Heaven.
entries.literal: On wuchen day black and white sheep were used to sacrifice to Heaven.

entries.zh: 八月庚午朔，遣使安撫南京吏民。
entries.en: On the gengwu new moon of the eighth month envoys were dispatched to reassure officials and people at Nanjing.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on gengwu new moon, dispatched envoys to reassure officials and people at Nanjing.

entries.zh: 癸酉，以永興宮使耶律塔不也有定亂動，為同知點檢司事。
entries.en: On guiyou day Yongxing Palace commissioner Yelü Tabuye, for merit in quelling disorder, was made associate commander of the Inspection Office.
entries.literal: On guiyou day Yongxing Palace commissioner Yelü Tabuye, for merit in quelling disorder, was made associate commander of the Inspection Office.

entries.zh: 冬十月戊辰朔，幸興王寺。
entries.en: On the wuchen new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited Xingwang Temple.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuchen new moon, visited Xingwang Temple.

entries.zh: 庚午，以六院部太保耶律合術知南院大王事。
entries.en: On gengwu day Six Courts grand guardian Yelü Heshu was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs.
entries.literal: On gengwu day Six Courts grand guardian Yelü Heshu was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs.

entries.zh: 是月，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: That month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: That month halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 十一月辛丑，以南院宣徽使蕭九哥為北府宰相。
entries.en: On xinchou day of the eleventh month Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Jiuge was made Northern Court chancellor.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on xinchou day Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Jiuge was made Northern Court chancellor.

entries.zh: 己未，追封故富春郡王耶律義先為許王。
entries.en: On jiwei day the late Prince of Fuchun Yelü Yixian was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xu.
entries.literal: On jiwei day posthumously enfeoffed the late Prince of Fuchun Yelü Yixian as Prince of Xu.

entries.zh: 是歲，封皇子浚為梁王。
entries.en: That year the imperial son Jun was enfeoffed Prince of Liang.
entries.literal: That year the imperial son Jun was enfeoffed Prince of Liang.

entries.zh: 十年春正月己亥，北幸。
entries.en: In the tenth year, on jihai day of the first spring month the court traveled north.
entries.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on jihai day, traveled north.

entries.zh: 二月，禁南京民決水種粳稻。
entries.en: In the second month Nanjing people were forbidden to breach dikes to plant glutinous rice.
entries.literal: Second month, forbidden Nanjing people to breach dikes to plant glutinous rice.

entries.zh: 秋七月壬申，詔決諸路囚。
entries.en: On renshen day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered prisoners in all routes decided.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renshen day, edict ordered prisoners in all routes decided.

entries.zh: 辛巳，禁僧尼私詣行在，妄述禍福取財物。
entries.en: On xinsi day monks and nuns were forbidden to visit the imperial halt privately or falsely declare fortune and misfortune to take property.
entries.literal: On xinsi day forbidden monks and nuns to visit the imperial halt privately, falsely declaring fortune and misfortune to take property.

entries.zh: 九月壬寅，幸懷州，謁太宗、穆宗廟。
entries.en: On renyin day of the ninth month the court visited Huai Prefecture and paid respects at Taizong's and Muzong's temples.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, visited Huai Prefecture and paid respects at Taizong's and Muzong's temples.

entries.zh: 冬十月壬辰朔，駐蹕中京。
entries.en: On the renchen new moon of the tenth winter month the court halted at the Central Capital.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renchen new moon, halted at the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 戊午，禁民私刊印文字。
entries.en: On wuwu day the people were forbidden to print texts privately.
entries.literal: On wuwu day forbidden the people to print texts privately.

entries.zh: 十一月甲子，定吏民衣服之制。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the eleventh month regulations were fixed for officials' and commoners' clothing.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on jiazi day, fixed regulations for officials' and commoners' clothing.

entries.zh: 辛未，禁六齋日屠殺。
entries.en: On xinwei day slaughter on the six fast days was forbidden.
entries.literal: On xinwei day forbidden slaughter on the six fast days.

entries.zh: 丁丑，詔求乾文閣所闕經籍，命儒臣校讎。
entries.en: On dingchou day an edict sought missing classics from the Qianwen Pavilion and ordered Confucian ministers to collate and emend.
entries.literal: On dingchou day, edict sought missing classics from the Qianwen Pavilion and ordered Confucian ministers to collate and emend.

entries.zh: 庚辰，以彰國軍節度使韓謝十為惕隱。
entries.en: On gengchen day Zhangguo Army military commissioner Han Xieshi was made tiyin.
entries.literal: On gengchen day Zhangguo Army military commissioner Han Xieshi was made tiyin.

entries.zh: 詔南京不得私造御用彩緞，私貨鐵，及非時飲酒。
entries.en: An edict ordered Nanjing not to manufacture imperial-colored silks privately, smuggle iron, or drink wine out of season.
entries.literal: Edict ordered Nanjing not to manufacture imperial-colored silks privately, smuggle iron, or drink wine out of season.

entries.zh: 命南京三司，每歲春秋以官錢饗將士。
entries.en: Nanjing's Three Departments were ordered each spring and autumn to feast soldiers with official funds.
entries.literal: Ordered Nanjing's Three Departments each spring and autumn to feast soldiers with official funds.

entries.zh: 十二月癸巳，以北院大王蕭兀古匿為契丹行宮都部署。
entries.en: On guisi day of the twelfth month Northern Court great king Xiao Wuguini was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on guisi day Northern Court great king Xiao Wuguini was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

entries.zh: 是歲，南京、西京大熟。
entries.en: That year Nanjing and the Western Capital had great harvests.
entries.literal: That year Nanjing and the Western Capital had great harvests.

entries.zh: 四年春正月甲戌朔，日有食之。
entries.en: In the fourth year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on jiaxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 丙子，如鴛鴦濼。
entries.en: On bingzi day the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
entries.literal: On bingzi day went to Yuanyang Marsh.

entries.zh: 辛巳，改易州兵馬使為安撫使。
entries.en: On xinsi day Yi Prefecture military commissioner was changed to pacification commissioner.
entries.literal: On xinsi day changed Yi Prefecture military commissioner to pacification commissioner.

entries.zh: 丁亥，獵炭山。
entries.en: On dinghai day the court hunted at Tanshan.
entries.literal: On dinghai day hunted at Tanshan.

entries.zh: 辛卯，遣使振西京饑民。
entries.en: On xinmao day envoys were dispatched to relieve hungry people in the Western Capital.
entries.literal: On xinmao day dispatched envoys to relieve hungry people in the Western Capital.

entries.zh: 二月甲辰朔，詔元帥府募軍。
entries.en: On the jiachen new moon of the second month an edict ordered the marshal's office to recruit troops.
entries.literal: Second month, on jiachen new moon, edict ordered the marshal's office to recruit troops.

entries.zh: 壬子，夏國王李諒祚子秉常遣使告哀。
entries.en: On renzi day Xia State king Li Liangzuo's son Bingchang sent envoys to announce the mourning.
entries.literal: On renzi day Xia State king Li Liangzuo's son Bingchang dispatched envoys to announce the mourning.

entries.zh: 癸丑，頒行《御製華嚴經贊》。
entries.en: On guichou day the 《Imperially Composed Avatamsaka Sutra Eulogy》 was promulgated.
entries.literal: On guichou day promulgated the 《Imperially Composed Avatamsaka Sutra Eulogy》.

entries.zh: 丁卯，北行。
entries.en: On dingmao day the court traveled north.
entries.literal: On dingmao day traveled north.

entries.zh: 三月丙子，遣使夏國吊祭。
entries.en: On bingzi day of the third month envoys were dispatched to Xia State to offer condolences.
entries.literal: Third month, on bingzi day dispatched envoys to Xia State to offer condolences.

entries.zh: 甲申，振應州饑民。
entries.en: On jiashen day hungry people in Ying Prefecture were relieved.
entries.literal: On jiashen day relieved hungry people in Ying Prefecture.

entries.zh: 乙酉，詔南京除軍行地，餘皆得種稻。
entries.en: On yiyou day an edict ordered Nanjing that except military march lands, the rest might plant rice.
entries.literal: On yiyou day, edict ordered Nanjing that except military march lands, the rest might plant rice.

entries.zh: 庚寅，振朔州饑民。
entries.en: On gengyin day hungry people in Shuo Prefecture were relieved.
entries.literal: On gengyin day relieved hungry people in Shuo Prefecture.

entries.zh: 乙未，夏國李秉常遣使獻其父諒祚遺物。
entries.en: On yiwei day Xia State Li Bingchang sent envoys presenting his father Liangzuo's bequeathed goods.
entries.literal: On yiwei day Xia State Li Bingchang dispatched envoys presenting his father Liangzuo's bequeathed goods.

entries.zh: 夏四月戊午，阿薩蘭回鶻遣使來貢。
entries.en: On wuwu day of the fourth summer month Asalan Uighur sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuwu day Asalan Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 五月丙戌，駐蹕拖古烈。
entries.en: On bingxu day of the fifth month the court halted at Tuogulie.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day, halted at Tuogulie.

entries.zh: 六月壬子，西北路雨谷，方三十里。
entries.en: On renzi day of the sixth month the Northwest Route rained grain over an area thirty li square.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on renzi day the Northwest Route rained grain over an area thirty li square.

entries.zh: 丙寅，以北院林牙耶律趙三為北院大王，右夷離畢蕭素颯中京留守。
entries.en: On bingyin day Northern Court linya Yelü Zhaosan was made Northern Court great king; Right yilibi Xiao Susu Central Capital regent.
entries.literal: On bingyin day Northern Court linya Yelü Zhaosan was made Northern Court great king; Right yilibi Xiao Susu Central Capital regent.

entries.zh: 秋七月壬申，置烏古敵烈部都統軍司。
entries.en: On renshen day of the seventh autumn month the Wugu Dilie inspector-general's office was established.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renshen day established the Wugu Dilie inspector-general's office.

entries.zh: 丙子，獵黑嶺。
entries.en: On bingzi day the court hunted at Heiling.
entries.literal: On bingzi day hunted at Heiling.

entries.zh: 是月，南京霖雨，地震。
entries.en: That month Nanjing had continuous rain and an earthquake.
entries.literal: That month Nanjing had continuous rain and an earthquake.

entries.zh: 九月己亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On jihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on jihai day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 冬十月辛亥，曲赦南京徒罪以下囚。
entries.en: On xinhai day of the tenth winter month a partial amnesty was granted for convict-labor offenses and below at Nanjing.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinhai day, partial amnesty for convict-labor offenses and below at Nanjing.

entries.zh: 永清、武清、安次、固安、新城、歸義、容城諸縣水，復一歲租。
entries.en: Yongqing, Wuqing, Anci, Gu'an, Xincheng, Guiyi, and Rongcheng counties had flood; one year's rent was remitted.
entries.literal: Yongqing, Wuqing, Anci, Gu'an, Xincheng, Guiyi, and Rongcheng counties had flood; one year's rent was remitted.

entries.zh: 戊辰，冊李秉常為夏國王。
entries.en: On wuchen day Li Bingchang was invested king of Xia State.
entries.literal: On wuchen day Li Bingchang was invested king of Xia State.

entries.zh: 十二月辛亥，夏國遣使來貢。
entries.en: On xinhai day of the twelfth month Xia State sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on xinhai day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 三年春正月辛亥，如鴨子河。
entries.en: In the third year, on xinhai day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.
entries.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on xinhai day, went to the Duck River.

entries.zh: 甲子，禦安流殿釣魚。
entries.en: On jiazi day the court fished at Anliu Hall.
entries.literal: On jiazi day fished at Anliu Hall.

entries.zh: 三月癸亥，宋主曙殂，子頊嗣位，遣使告哀；
entries.en: On guihai day of the third month Song ruler Shu died; his son Xiang succeeded; envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning;
entries.literal: Third month, on guihai day Song ruler Shu died; his son Xiang succeeded; envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning;

entries.zh: 即遣右護衛太保蕭撻不也、翰林學士陳覺第吊祭。
entries.en: Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Xiao Tabuye and Hanlin academician Chen Juedi were immediately dispatched to offer condolences.
entries.literal: immediately dispatched Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Xiao Tabuye and Hanlin academician Chen Juedi to offer condolences.

entries.zh: 閏月丁亥，扈駕軍營火，賜錢、粟及馬有差。
entries.en: In the intercalary month, on dinghai day, escort army camps caught fire; money, grain, and horses were bestowed by degree.
entries.literal: Intercalary month, on dinghai day, escort army camps caught fire; money, grain, and horses were bestowed by degree.

entries.zh: 辛卯，駐蹕春州北澱。
entries.en: On xinmao day the court halted at Chun Prefecture North Marsh.
entries.literal: On xinmao day halted at Chun Prefecture North Marsh.

entries.zh: 乙巳，以蕭兀古匿為北府宰相。
entries.en: On yisi day Xiao Wuguini was made Northern Court chancellor.
entries.literal: On yisi day Xiao Wuguini was made Northern Court chancellor.

entries.zh: 夏五月壬辰，駐蹕納葛濼。
entries.en: On renchen day of the fifth summer month the court halted at Nage Marsh.
entries.literal: Summer, fifth month, on renchen day, halted at Nage Marsh.

entries.zh: 壬寅，賜隨駕官諸工人馬。
entries.en: On renyin day horses were bestowed on escort officials and various craftsmen.
entries.literal: On renyin day horses were bestowed on escort officials and various craftsmen.

entries.zh: 六月戊申，有司奏新城縣民楊從謀反，偽署官吏。
entries.en: On wushen day of the sixth month the relevant offices memorialized that Xincheng County commoner Yang Cong plotted rebellion and falsely appointed officials.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on wushen day the relevant offices memorialized that Xincheng County commoner Yang Cong plotted rebellion and falsely appointed officials.

entries.zh: 上曰：「小人無知，此兒戲爾。」
entries.en: The Emperor said: "Petty men are ignorant; this is child's play."
entries.literal: The Emperor said: "Petty men are ignorant; this is child's play."

entries.zh: 獨流其首惡，餘釋之。
entries.en: Only the ringleaders were exiled; the rest were released.
entries.literal: Only the ringleaders were exiled; the rest were released.

entries.zh: 庚戌，宋遣使饋其先帝遺物。
entries.en: On gengxu day Song sent envoys presenting the late emperor's bequeathed goods.
entries.literal: On gengxu day Song dispatched envoys presenting the late emperor's bequeathed goods.

entries.zh: 辛亥，宋以即位，遣陳襄來報，即遣知黃龍府事蕭圖古辭、中書舍人馬鉉往賀。
entries.en: On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; Xiao Tuguci, administrator of Huanglong Prefecture, and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan were immediately dispatched to congratulate.
entries.literal: On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; immediately dispatched Huanglong Prefecture administrator Xiao Tuguci and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan to congratulate.

entries.zh: 壬戌，南府宰相韓王蕭唐古致仕。
entries.en: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Prince of Han Xiao Tanggu retired.
entries.literal: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Prince of Han Xiao Tanggu retired.

entries.zh: 壬申，以廣德軍節度使耶律蕊奴為南府宰相，度支使趙徽參知政事。
entries.en: On renshen day Guangde Army military commissioner Yelü Ruinu was made Southern Court chancellor; Revenue Commissioner Zhao Hui was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
entries.literal: On renshen day Guangde Army military commissioner Yelü Ruinu was made Southern Court chancellor; Revenue Commissioner Zhao Hui Associate Administrator of Affairs.

entries.zh: 秋七月辛丑，熒惑晝見，凡三十五日。
entries.en: On xinchou day of the seventh autumn month Mars was seen in daytime for thirty-five days in all.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinchou day Mars was seen in daytime for thirty-five days in all.

entries.zh: 九月戊戌，詔給諸路囚糧。
entries.en: On wuxu day of the ninth month an edict ordered grain given to prisoners in all routes.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on wuxu day, edict ordered grain given to prisoners in all routes.

entries.zh: 癸卯，幸南京。
entries.en: On guimao day the court visited Nanjing.
entries.literal: On guimao day visited Nanjing.

entries.zh: 冬十一月壬辰，夏國遣使進回鶻僧、金佛、《梵覺經》。
entries.en: On renchen day of the eleventh winter month Xia State sent envoys presenting Uighur monks, a gold Buddha, and the 《Fanjue Sutra》.
entries.literal: Winter, eleventh month, on renchen day Xia State dispatched envoys presenting Uighur monks, a gold Buddha, and the 《Fanjue Sutra》.

entries.zh: 十二月丁未，以參知政事劉詵為樞密副使，東北路詳穩高八南院大王，樞密直學士張孝傑參知政事。
entries.en: On dingwei day of the twelfth month Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner; Northeast Route detail-stable Gao Ba Southern Court great king; Privy Council academician Zhang Xiaojie Associate Administrator of Affairs.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on dingwei day Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner; Northeast Route detail-stable Gao Ba Southern Court great king; Privy Council academician Zhang Xiaojie Associate Administrator of Affairs.

entries.zh: 己酉，以張孝傑同知樞密院事。
entries.en: On jiyou day Zhang Xiaojie was made associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
entries.literal: On jiyou day Zhang Xiaojie was made associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

entries.zh: 丁巳，行再生禮，赦死罪以下。
entries.en: On dingsi day the rebirth ritual was performed; amnesty was granted for offenses from capital crime downward.
entries.literal: On dingsi day performed the rebirth ritual; amnesty for offenses from capital crime downward.

entries.zh: 是月，夏國王李諒祚薨。
entries.en: That month Xia State king Li Liangzuo died.
entries.literal: That month Xia State king Li Liangzuo died.

entries.zh: 是歲，南京旱、蝗。
entries.en: That year Nanjing had drought and locusts.
entries.literal: That year Nanjing had drought and locusts.

entries.zh: 八年春正月癸丑，如鴨子河。
entries.en: In the eighth year, on guichou day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.
entries.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on guichou day, went to the Duck River.

entries.zh: 二月，駐蹕納葛濼。
entries.en: In the second month the court halted at Nage Marsh.
entries.literal: Second month, halted at Nage Marsh.

entries.zh: 三月戊申朔，楚王蕭革致仕，進封鄭國王。
entries.en: On the wushen new moon of the third month Prince of Chu Xiao Ge retired and was advanced to Prince of Zheng.
entries.literal: Third month, on wushen new moon, Prince of Chu Xiao Ge retired and was advanced to Prince of Zheng.

entries.zh: 夏五月，吾獨婉惕隱屯禿葛等乞歲貢馬、駝，許之。
entries.en: In the fifth summer month Wuduwan tiyin Tutugu and others begged yearly tribute of horses and camels; permission was granted.
entries.literal: Summer, fifth month, Wuduwan tiyin Tutugu and others begged yearly tribute of horses and camels; permitted.

entries.zh: 六月丙子朔，駐蹕拖古烈。
entries.en: On the bingzi new moon of the sixth month the court halted at Tuogulie.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on bingzi new moon, halted at Tuogulie.

entries.zh: 辛丑，以右夷離畢奚馬六為奚六部大王。
entries.en: On xinchou day Right yilibi Xima Liu was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.
entries.literal: On xinchou day Right yilibi Xima Liu was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.

entries.zh: 是月，禦清涼殿放進士王鼎等九十三人。
entries.en: That month, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Wang Ding and ninety-three others were passed.
entries.literal: That month, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Wang Ding and ninety-three others were passed.

entries.zh: 秋七月甲子，射熊於外室剌。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the seventh autumn month a bear was shot at Waisila.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiazi day, shot a bear at Waisila.

entries.zh: 冬十月甲戌朔，駐蹕獨盧金。
entries.en: On the jiaxu new moon of the tenth winter month the court halted at Dulujin.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiaxu new moon, halted at Dulujin.

entries.zh: 十二月庚辰，以知北院樞密使事蕭圖古辭為北院樞密使。
entries.en: On gengchen day of the twelfth month Xiao Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on gengchen day, Xiao Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 癸未，幸西京。
entries.en: On guiwei day the court visited the Western Capital.
entries.literal: On guiwei day visited the Western Capital.

entries.zh: 戊子，以皇太后行再生禮，曲赦西京囚。
entries.en: On wuzi day, because the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth ritual, a partial amnesty was granted for prisoners at the Western Capital.
entries.literal: On wuzi day, because the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth ritual, partial amnesty for prisoners at the Western Capital.

entries.zh: 二年春正月丁巳，如鴨子河。
entries.en: In the second year, on dingsi day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.
entries.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on dingsi day, went to the Duck River.

entries.zh: 宋賀正使王嚴卒，以禮送還。
entries.en: Song envoy congratulating the New Year Wang Yan died; he was sent back with full rites.
entries.literal: Song envoy congratulating the New Year Wang Yan died; he was sent back with full rites.

entries.zh: 癸未，幸山榆澱。
entries.en: On guiwei day the court visited Shanyu Marsh.
entries.literal: On guiwei day visited Shanyu Marsh.

entries.zh: 二月甲午，詔武定軍節度使姚景行，問以治道，拜南院樞密使。
entries.en: On jiawu day of the second month Wuding Army military commissioner Yao Jingxing was issued an edict on the way of governance and appointed Southern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: Second month, on jiawu day, edict to Wuding Army military commissioner Yao Jingxing inquiring on the way of governance; he was appointed Southern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 三月辛巳，以東北路詳穩耶律韓福奴為北院大王。
entries.en: On xinsi day of the third month Northeast Route detail-stable Yelü Hanfunu was made Northern Court great king.
entries.literal: Third month, on xinsi day Northeast Route detail-stable Yelü Hanfunu was made Northern Court great king.

entries.zh: 壬午，彗星見於西方。
entries.en: On renwu day a comet appeared in the west.
entries.literal: On renwu day a comet appeared in the west.

entries.zh: 夏四月，霖雨。
entries.en: In the fourth summer month there was continuous rain.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, continuous rain.

entries.zh: 五月乙亥，駐蹕拖古烈。
entries.en: On yihai day of the fifth month the court halted at Tuogulie.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on yihai day, halted at Tuogulie.

entries.zh: 辛巳，以戶部使劉詵為樞密副使。
entries.en: On xinsi day Household Commissioner Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On xinsi day Household Commissioner Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 六月丙戌，回鶻來貢。
entries.en: On bingxu day of the sixth month Uighur came with tribute.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on bingxu day Uighur came with tribute.

entries.zh: 甲辰，阻卜來貢。
entries.en: On jiachen day Zubu came with tribute.
entries.literal: On jiachen day Zubu came with tribute.

entries.zh: 秋七月癸丑朔，以西北路招討使蕭術者為北府宰相，左夷離畢蕭惟信南院樞密使，同知南院樞密使事耶律白惕隱。
entries.en: On the guichou new moon of the seventh autumn month Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Muzhe was made Northern Court chancellor; Left yilibi Xiao Weixin Southern Court privy commissioner; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Bai tiyin.
