entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guichou new moon, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Muzhe was made Northern Court chancellor; Left yilibi Xiao Weixin Southern Court privy commissioner; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Bai tiyin.

entries.zh: 丙辰，南院樞密使姚景行致仕。
entries.en: On bingchen day Southern Court privy commissioner Yao Jingxing retired.
entries.literal: On bingchen day Southern Court privy commissioner Yao Jingxing retired.

entries.zh: 庚申，錄囚。
entries.en: On gengshen day prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: On gengshen day reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 辛酉，景行復前職。
entries.en: On xinyou day Jingxing resumed his former post.
entries.literal: On xinyou day Jingxing resumed his former post.

entries.zh: 丁卯，如藕絲澱。
entries.en: On dingmao day the court went to Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: On dingmao day went to Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 以歲旱，遣使振山後貧民。
entries.en: Because of drought that year, envoys were dispatched to relieve poor people beyond the mountains.
entries.literal: Because of drought that year, envoys were dispatched to relieve poor people beyond the mountains.

entries.zh: 九月壬子朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the renzi new moon of the ninth month there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on renzi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 以參知政事韓孚為樞密副使。
entries.en: Associate Administrator of Affairs Han Fu was made associate privy commissioner.
entries.literal: Associate Administrator of Affairs Han Fu was made associate privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 冬十二月壬午，以知樞密院事楊績為南院樞密使，樞密副使劉詵參知政事。
entries.en: On renwu day of the twelfth winter month Yang Ji, who administered Privy Council affairs, was made Southern Court privy commissioner; associate privy commissioner Liu Shen was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
entries.literal: Winter, twelfth month, on renwu day Yang Ji, who administered Privy Council affairs, was made Southern Court privy commissioner; associate privy commissioner Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.

entries.zh: 戊子，僧守志加守司徒。
entries.en: On wuzi day monk Shouzhi was promoted acting Minister of Works.
entries.literal: On wuzi day monk Shouzhi was promoted acting Minister of Works.

entries.zh: 丁酉，以西京留守合術為南院大王。
entries.en: On dingyou day Western Capital regent Heshu was made Southern Court great king.
entries.literal: On dingyou day Western Capital regent Heshu was made Southern Court great king.

entries.zh: 辛丑，以蕭術者為武定軍節度使。
entries.en: On xinchou day Xiao Muzhe was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.
entries.literal: On xinchou day Xiao Muzhe was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.

entries.zh: 是年，禦永安殿，放進士張臻等百一人。
entries.en: That year, at Yong'an Hall the jinshi Zhang Zhen and one hundred one others were passed.
entries.literal: That year, at Yong'an Hall the jinshi Zhang Zhen and one hundred one others were passed.

entries.zh: 五年春正月，阻卜叛，以晉王仁先為西北路招討使，領禁軍討之。
entries.en: In the fifth year, in the first spring month Zubu rebelled; Prince of Jin Renxian was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner to lead forbidden troops against them.
entries.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, Zubu rebelled; Prince of Jin Renxian was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner to lead forbidden troops against them.

entries.zh: 夏六月己亥，駐蹕拖古烈。
entries.en: On jihai day of the sixth summer month the court halted at Tuogulie.
entries.literal: Summer, sixth month, on jihai day, halted at Tuogulie.

entries.zh: 丙午，吐蕃遣使來貢。
entries.en: On bingwu day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On bingwu day Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 壬戌，以南院樞密使蕭惟信知北院樞密使事。
entries.en: On renxu day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Weixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
entries.literal: On renxu day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Weixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.

entries.zh: 秋七月乙丑朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the yichou new moon of the seventh autumn month there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yichou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 戊辰，夏國遣使來謝封冊。
entries.en: On wuchen day Xia State sent envoys to thank the investiture.
entries.literal: On wuchen day Xia State dispatched envoys to thank the investiture.

entries.zh: 癸未，詔禁皇族恃勢侵漁細民。
entries.en: On guiwei day an edict forbade the imperial clan to rely on power to encroach on common people.
entries.literal: On guiwei day, edict forbidden the imperial clan to rely on power to encroach on common people.

entries.zh: 八月，謁慶陵。
entries.en: In the eighth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: Eighth month, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 九月戊辰，仁先遣人奏阻卜捷。
entries.en: On wuchen day of the ninth month Renxian dispatched men to memorialize victory over Zubu.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on wuchen day Renxian dispatched men to memorialize victory over Zubu.

entries.zh: 冬十月己亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On jihai day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jihai day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 十一月丁卯，詔四方館副使止以契丹人充。
entries.en: On dingmao day of the eleventh month an edict ordered Four Directions Bureau deputy commissioners to be filled only by Khitan.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on dingmao day, edict ordered Four Directions Bureau deputy commissioners to be filled only by Khitan.

entries.zh: 丁丑，五國剖阿裏部叛，命蕭素颯討之。
entries.en: On dingchou day the Five States Poali tribe rebelled; Xiao Susu was ordered to suppress them.
entries.literal: On dingchou day the Five States Poali tribe rebelled; Xiao Susu was ordered to suppress them.

entries.zh: 閏月戊申，夏國王李秉常遣使乞賜印綬。
entries.en: In the intercalary month, on wushen day, Xia State king Li Bingchang sent envoys begging seals and credentials.
entries.literal: Intercalary month, on wushen day Xia State king Li Bingchang dispatched envoys begging seals and credentials.

entries.zh: 己未，僧誌福加守司徒。
entries.en: On jiwei day monk Zhifu was promoted acting Minister of Works.
entries.literal: On jiwei day monk Zhifu was promoted acting Minister of Works.

entries.zh: 十二月甲子，行皇太子再生禮，減諸路徒以下罪一等。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the twelfth month, because the crown prince performed the rebirth ritual, convict-labor offenses in all routes were reduced one degree.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on jiazi day, because the crown prince performed the rebirth ritual, convict-labor offenses in all routes were reduced one degree.

entries.zh: 乙丑，詔百官廷議國政。
entries.en: On yichou day an edict ordered the hundred officials to debate state affairs at court.
entries.literal: On yichou day, edict ordered the hundred officials to debate state affairs at court.

entries.zh: 甲戌，五國來降。
entries.en: On jiaxu day the Five States came to surrender.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day the Five States came to surrender.

entries.zh: 仍獻方物。
entries.en: They also presented local products.
entries.literal: They also presented local products.

entries.zh: 七年春正月戊子，如鴨子河。
entries.en: In the seventh year, on wuzi day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.
entries.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on wuzi day, went to the Duck River.

entries.zh: 二月乙丑，女直進馬。
entries.en: On yichou day of the second month Jurchen presented horses.
entries.literal: Second month, on yichou day Jurchen presented horses.

entries.zh: 丙寅，以南院樞密使姚景行知興中府事。
entries.en: On bingyin day Southern Court privy commissioner Yao Jingxing was made administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
entries.literal: On bingyin day Southern Court privy commissioner Yao Jingxing was made administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.

entries.zh: 三月己酉，以討五國功，加知黃龍府事蒲延、懷化軍節度使高元紀、易州觀察使高正並千牛衛上將軍，五國節度使蕭陶蘇斡、寧江州防禦使大榮並靜江軍節度使。
entries.en: On jiyou day of the third month, for merit against the Five States, Huanglong Prefecture administrator Puyan, Huaihua Army military commissioner Gao Yuanji, and Yi Prefecture observation commissioner Gao Zheng were all promoted Thousand-Ox Guard upper generals; Five States military commissioner Xiao Taosuwan and Ningjiang Prefecture defense commissioner Darong were both made Jingjiang Army military commissioners.
entries.literal: Third month, on jiyou day, for merit against the Five States, Huanglong Prefecture administrator Puyan, Huaihua Army military commissioner Gao Yuanji, and Yi Prefecture observation commissioner Gao Zheng were all promoted Thousand-Ox Guard upper generals; Five States military commissioner Xiao Taosuwan and Ningjiang Prefecture defense commissioner Darong were both made Jingjiang Army military commissioners.

entries.zh: 幸黑水。
entries.en: The court visited Heishui.
entries.literal: Visited Heishui.

entries.zh: 夏四月癸酉，如納葛濼。
entries.en: On guiyou day of the fourth summer month the court went to Nage Marsh.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guiyou day, went to Nage Marsh.

entries.zh: 乙亥，禁布帛短狹不中尺度者。
entries.en: On yihai day cloth and silk that was short and narrow and did not meet standard measure was forbidden.
entries.literal: On yihai day forbidden cloth and silk that was short and narrow and did not meet standard measure.

entries.zh: 六月己卯，吐蕃來貢。
entries.en: On jimao day of the sixth month Tibet came with tribute.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jimao day Tibet came with tribute.

entries.zh: 癸未，南院大王高八致仕。
entries.en: On guiwei day Southern Court great king Gao Ba retired.
entries.literal: On guiwei day Southern Court great king Gao Ba retired.

entries.zh: 秋七月甲申朔，以東北路詳穩合裏只為南院大王，西南面招討使拾得奴為奚六部大王。
entries.en: On the jiashen new moon of the seventh autumn month Northeast Route detail-stable Helizhi was made Southern Court great king; Southwest Route pacification commissioner Shidenunu was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiashen new moon, Northeast Route detail-stable Helizhi was made Southern Court great king; Southwest Route pacification commissioner Shidenunu was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.

entries.zh: 己丑，遣使按問五京囚。
entries.en: On jichou day envoys were dispatched to investigate prisoners in the Five Capitals.
entries.literal: On jichou day dispatched envoys to investigate prisoners in the Five Capitals.

entries.zh: 庚子，如藕絲澱。
entries.en: On gengzi day the court went to Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: On gengzi day went to Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 八月辛巳，置佛骨於招仙浮圖，罷獵，禁屠殺。
entries.en: On xinsi day of the eighth month Buddha relics were placed in the Zhaoxian pagoda; hunting was stopped and slaughter forbidden.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on xinsi day Buddha relics were placed in the Zhaoxian pagoda; hunting was stopped and slaughter forbidden.

entries.zh: 冬十月己卯，如醫巫閭山。
entries.en: On jimao day of the tenth winter month the court went to Yiwulü Mountain.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jimao day, went to Yiwulü Mountain.

entries.zh: 壬戌，以南府宰相耶律蕊奴為南京統軍使。
entries.en: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Ruinu was made Nanjing supreme commander.
entries.literal: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Ruinu was made Nanjing supreme commander.

entries.zh: 戊辰，謁乾陵。
entries.en: On wuchen day the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On wuchen day paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 庚辰，詔百官廷議軍國事。
entries.en: On gengchen day an edict ordered the hundred officials to debate military and state affairs at court.
entries.literal: On gengchen day, edict ordered the hundred officials to debate military and state affairs at court.

entries.zh: 十一月戊子，免南京流民租。
entries.en: On wuzi day of the eleventh month rent for Nanjing refugees was remitted.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on wuzi day remitted rent for Nanjing refugees.

entries.zh: 己丑，振饒州饑民。
entries.en: On jichou day hungry people in Rao Prefecture were relieved.
entries.literal: On jichou day relieved hungry people in Rao Prefecture.

entries.zh: 丙午，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On bingwu day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On bingwu day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 十二月壬子，以契丹行宮都部署耶律胡睹知北院樞密使事，知北院樞密使事蕭惟信為南府宰相，兼契丹行宮都部署。
entries.en: On renzi day of the twelfth month Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Hudu was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Xiao Weixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Southern Court chancellor and also Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on renzi day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Hudu was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Xiao Weixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Southern Court chancellor and also Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

entries.zh: 丁巳，漢人行宮都部署李仲禧、北院宣徽使劉霂、樞密副使王觀、都承旨楊興工各賜國姓。
entries.en: On dingsi day Han mobile palace deployment director Li Zhongxi, Northern Court palace commissioner Liu Mu, associate privy commissioner Wang Guan, and chief usher Yang Xinggong were each granted the imperial clan surname.
entries.literal: On dingsi day Han mobile palace deployment director Li Zhongxi, Northern Court palace commissioner Liu Mu, associate privy commissioner Wang Guan, and chief usher Yang Xinggong were each granted the imperial clan surname.

entries.zh: 戊寅，回鶻來貢。
entries.en: On wuyin day Uighur came with tribute.
entries.literal: On wuyin day Uighur came with tribute.

entries.zh: 是歲，春州鬥粟六錢。
entries.en: That year grain at Chun Prefecture was six cash per dou.
entries.literal: That year, grain at Chun Prefecture was six cash per dou.

entries.zh: 道宗三
entries.en: Daozong, Part Three
entries.literal: Daozong, Part Three

entries.zh: 十年春正月乙卯，如鴛鴦濼。
entries.en: In the tenth year, on yimao day of the first spring month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
entries.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on yimao day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.

entries.zh: 二月癸未，蠲平州復業民租賦。
entries.en: On guiwei day of the second month rent and tax for Ping Prefecture households resuming cultivation were remitted.
entries.literal: Second month, on guiwei day, remitted rent and tax for Ping Prefecture households resuming cultivation.

entries.zh: 戊子，阻卜來貢。
entries.en: On wuzi day Zubu came with tribute.
entries.literal: On wuzi day Zubu came with tribute.

entries.zh: 三月甲子，如拖古烈。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the third month the court went to Tuogulie.
entries.literal: Third month, on jiazi day, went to Tuogulie.

entries.zh: 以耶律巢為北院大王。
entries.en: Yelü Chao was made Northern Court great king.
entries.literal: Yelü Chao was made Northern Court great king.

entries.zh: 夏四月，旱。
entries.en: In the fourth summer month there was drought.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, drought.

entries.zh: 辛未，以奚人達魯三世同居，賜官旌之。
entries.en: On xinwei day, because Xi man Dalu's three generations lived together, office was granted to honor him.
entries.literal: On xinwei day, because Xi man Dalu's three generations lived together, office was granted to honor him.

entries.zh: 五月丙寅，錄囚。
entries.en: On bingyin day of the fifth month prisoners were reviewed.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on bingyin day, reviewed prisoners.

entries.zh: 六月戊辰，親出題試進士。
entries.en: On wuchen day of the sixth month the Emperor personally set topics to test jinshi.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on wuchen day, the Emperor personally set topics to test jinshi.

entries.zh: 壬申，詔臣庶言得失。
entries.en: On renshen day an edict ordered ministers and commoners to speak on gains and losses.
entries.literal: On renshen day, edict ordered ministers and commoners to speak on gains and losses.

entries.zh: 丙子，禦永安殿，策賢良。
entries.en: On bingzi day at Yong'an Hall worthy and good men were tested.
entries.literal: On bingzi day at Yong'an Hall tested worthy and good men.

entries.zh: 秋七月丙辰，如秋山。
entries.en: On bingchen day of the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingchen day, went to autumn mountains.

entries.zh: 癸亥，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On guihai day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On guihai day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 九月庚戌，幸東京，謁二儀、五鸞殿。
entries.en: On gengxu day of the ninth month the court visited the Eastern Capital and paid respects at the Two Principles and Five Phoenix halls.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on gengxu day, visited the Eastern Capital and paid respects at the Two Principles and Five Phoenix halls.

entries.zh: 癸亥，祠木葉山。
entries.en: On guihai day sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.
entries.literal: On guihai day sacrificed at Muye Mountain.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁卯，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On dingmao day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingmao day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 丁丑，詔有司頒行《史記》、《漢書》。
entries.en: On dingchou day an edict ordered the relevant offices to promulgate the 《Records of the Grand Historian》 and 《Book of Han》.
entries.literal: On dingchou day, edict ordered the relevant offices to promulgate the 《Records of the Grand Historian》 and 《Book of Han》.

entries.zh: 十一月戊午，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On wuwu day of the eleventh month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on wuwu day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 十二月辛巳，改明年為大康，大赦。
entries.en: On xinsi day of the twelfth month the coming year was changed to Dikang and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on xinsi day the coming year was changed to Dikang and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

entries.zh: 二年春正月己未，如春水。
entries.en: In the second year, on jiwei day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.
entries.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on jiwei day, went to spring waters.

entries.zh: 庚辰，駐蹕雙濼。
entries.en: On gengchen day the court halted at Shuang Marsh.
entries.literal: On gengchen day halted at Shuang Marsh.

entries.zh: 二月戊子，振黃龍府饑。
entries.en: On wuzi day of the second month famine in Huanglong Prefecture was relieved.
entries.literal: Second month, on wuzi day relieved famine in Huanglong Prefecture.

entries.zh: 癸丑，南京路饑，免租稅一年。
entries.en: On guichou day Nanjing Route had famine; rent and tax were remitted for one year.
entries.literal: On guichou day Nanjing Route had famine; rent and tax were remitted for one year.

entries.zh: 三月辛酉，皇太后崩。
entries.en: On xinyou day of the third month the Empress Dowager died.
entries.literal: Third month, on xinyou day the Empress Dowager died.

entries.zh: 壬戌，遣殿前副點檢耶律轄古報哀於宋。
entries.en: On renxu day Palace Front deputy commander Yelü Xiagu was dispatched to announce the mourning to Song.
entries.literal: On renxu day dispatched Palace Front deputy commander Yelü Xiagu to announce the mourning to Song.

entries.zh: 癸亥，遣使報哀於高麗、夏國。
entries.en: On guihai day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Goryeo and Xia State.
entries.literal: On guihai day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Goryeo and Xia State.

entries.zh: 丁卯，大赦。
entries.en: On dingmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: On dingmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

entries.zh: 戊寅，以皇太后遺物遣使遺宋、夏。
entries.en: On wuyin day envoys were dispatched with the Empress Dowager's bequeathed goods as gifts to Song and Xia.
entries.literal: On wuyin day envoys were dispatched with the Empress Dowager's bequeathed goods as gifts to Song and Xia.

entries.zh: 夏六月乙酉朔，上大行皇太后尊謚曰仁懿皇后。
entries.en: On the yiyou new moon of the sixth summer month the posthumous honorific for the late Empress Dowager was Empress Rende.
entries.literal: Summer, sixth month, on yiyou new moon, posthumous honorific for the late Empress Dowager: Empress Rende.

entries.zh: 戊子，宋及高麗、夏國各遣使吊祭。
entries.en: On wuzi day Song and Goryeo and Xia State each sent envoys to offer condolences.
entries.literal: On wuzi day Song and Goryeo and Xia State each dispatched envoys to offer condolences.

entries.zh: 甲午，葬仁懿皇后於慶陵。
entries.en: On jiawu day Empress Rende was buried at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On jiawu day buried Empress Rende at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 己亥，駐蹕拖古烈。
entries.en: On jihai day the court halted at Tuogulie.
entries.literal: On jihai day halted at Tuogulie.

entries.zh: 壬寅，出北院樞密使魏王耶律乙辛為中京留守。
entries.en: On renyin day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was dismissed as regent of the Central Capital.
entries.literal: On renyin day dismissed Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin as regent of the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 丁未，冊皇后蕭氏，封其父祗候郎君鱉裏剌為趙王，叔西北路招討使餘里也遼西郡王，兄漢人行宮都部署、駙馬都慰霞抹柳城郡王，參知政事楊遵勖知南院樞密使事，北院樞密使副蕭速撒知北院樞密使事，漢人行宮副部署劉詵參知政事。
entries.en: On dingwei day Empress Xiao was invested; her father attendant langjun Bieliuli was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; her uncle Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yuliye Prince of Liaoxi; her elder brother Han mobile palace deployment director and imperial son-in-law Xiamo Prince of Liucheng; Associate Administrator of Affairs Yang Zunxu was made administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Susa administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.
entries.literal: On dingwei day invested Empress Xiao; her father attendant langjun Bieliuli was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; her uncle Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yuliye Prince of Liaoxi; her elder brother Han mobile palace deployment director and imperial son-in-law Xiamo Prince of Liucheng; Associate Administrator of Affairs Yang Zunxu administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Susa administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.

entries.zh: 己酉，南府宰相趙徽致仕。
entries.en: On jiyou day Southern Court chancellor Zhao Hui retired.
entries.literal: On jiyou day Southern Court chancellor Zhao Hui retired.

entries.zh: 秋七月戊辰，如秋山。
entries.en: On wuchen day of the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day went to autumn mountains.

entries.zh: 癸酉，柳城郡王霞抹薨。
entries.en: On guiyou day Prince of Liucheng Xiamo died.
entries.literal: On guiyou day Prince of Liucheng Xiamo died.

entries.zh: 八月庚寅，獵，遇麛失其母，憫之，不射。
entries.en: On gengyin day of the eighth month the court hunted; encountering a fawn that had lost its mother, the Emperor pitied it and did not shoot.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on gengyin day hunted; encountering a fawn that had lost its mother, he pitied it and did not shoot.

entries.zh: 九月戊午，以南京蝗，免明年租稅。
entries.en: On wuwu day of the ninth month, because Nanjing had locusts, next year's rent and tax were remitted.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on wuwu day, because Nanjing had locusts, next year's rent and tax were remitted.

entries.zh: 己卯，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On jimao day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: On jimao day halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 冬十月戊戌，召中京留守魏王耶律乙辛復為北院樞密使。
entries.en: On wuxu day of the tenth winter month Central Capital regent Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was summoned back as Northern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuxu day summoned Central Capital regent Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin back as Northern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 十一月甲戌，上欲觀《起居註》，修註郎不攧及忽突堇等不進，各杖二百，罷之。
entries.en: On jiaxu day of the eleventh month the Emperor wished to view the 《Diary of Actions and Repose》; revising annotator Budian and Hutujin and others did not present it; each was beaten two hundred strokes and dismissed.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu day the Emperor wished to view the 《Diary of Actions and Repose》; revising annotator Budian and Hutujin and others did not present it; each was beaten two hundred strokes and dismissed.

entries.zh: 流林牙蕭巖壽於烏隗部。
entries.en: Linya Xiao Yanshou was exiled to the Wuhui tribe.
entries.literal: Linya Xiao Yanshou was exiled to the Wuhui tribe.

entries.zh: 是月，南京地震，民舍多壞。
entries.en: That month Nanjing had an earthquake; many commoners' houses were destroyed.
entries.literal: That month Nanjing had an earthquake; many commoners' houses were destroyed.

entries.zh: 十二月己丑，以左夷離畢蕭撻不也為南京統軍使。
entries.en: On jichou day of the twelfth month Left yilibi Xiao Tabuye was made Nanjing supreme commander.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on jichou day Left yilibi Xiao Tabuye was made Nanjing supreme commander.

entries.zh: 八年春正月癸未，烏古敵烈部詳穩耶律巢等奏克北邊捷。
entries.en: In the eighth year, on guiwei day of the first spring month Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao and others memorialized victory on the northern border.
entries.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on guiwei day, Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao and others memorialized victory on the northern border.

entries.zh: 以戰多殺人，飯僧南京、中京。
entries.en: Because the fighting had killed many, monks were fed at Nanjing and the Central Capital.
entries.literal: Because the fighting had killed many, monks were fed at Nanjing and the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 甲申，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: On jiashen day the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: On jiashen day went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 壬寅，昏霧連日。
entries.en: On renyin day dull fog lasted many days.
entries.literal: On renyin day dull fog lasted many days.

entries.zh: 二月丙辰，北、南樞密院言無事可陳。
entries.en: On bingchen day of the second month the Northern and Southern Privy Councils said there was nothing to memorialize.
entries.literal: Second month, on bingchen day Northern and Southern Privy Councils said there was nothing to memorialize.

entries.zh: 壬戌，以討北部功，烏古敵烈部詳穩耶律巢知北院大王事，都監蕭阿魯帶烏古敵烈部詳穩，加左監門衛上將軍。
entries.en: On renxu day, for merit in attacking the northern tribes, Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao was made to administer Northern Court great king affairs; inspector-general Xiao Aludai was made Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable and promoted Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.
entries.literal: On renxu day, for merit in attacking the northern tribes, Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao was made to administer Northern Court great king affairs; inspector-general Xiao Aludai Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable, promoted Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.

entries.zh: 戊辰，歲饑，免武安州租稅，振恩、蔚、順、惠等州民。
entries.en: On wuchen day there was famine that year; Wuan Prefecture rent and tax were remitted, and people in En, Yu, Shun, and Hui prefectures were relieved.
entries.literal: On wuchen day there was famine that year; Wuan Prefecture rent and tax were remitted, and people in En, Yu, Shun, and Hui prefectures were relieved.

entries.zh: 三月癸卯，有司奏春、泰、寧江三州三千餘人願為僧尼，受具足戒，許之。
entries.en: On guimao day of the third month the relevant offices memorialized that more than three thousand people in Chun, Tai, and Ningjiang prefectures wished to become monks and nuns and receive full precepts; permission was granted.
entries.literal: Third month, on guimao day the relevant offices memorialized that more than three thousand people in Chun, Tai, and Ningjiang prefectures wished to become monks and nuns and receive full precepts; permitted.

entries.zh: 夏四月壬子，振義、饒二州民。
entries.en: On renzi day of the fourth summer month people in Yi and Rao prefectures were relieved.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renzi day, relieved people in Yi and Rao prefectures.

entries.zh: 丁巳，駐蹕塔裏舍。
entries.en: On dingsi day the court halted at Talishe.
entries.literal: On dingsi day halted at Talishe.

entries.zh: 己卯，清暑拖古烈。
entries.en: On jimao day the court summered at Tuogulie.
entries.literal: On jimao day summered at Tuogulie.

entries.zh: 五月壬午，晉王仁先薨。
entries.en: On renwu day of the fifth month Prince of Jin Renxian died.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on renwu day Prince of Jin Renxian died.

entries.zh: 六月甲寅，振易州貧民。
entries.en: On jiayin day of the sixth month poor people in Yi Prefecture were relieved.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin day, relieved poor people in Yi Prefecture.

entries.zh: 己未，振中京。
entries.en: On jiwei day the Central Capital was relieved.
entries.literal: On jiwei day relieved the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 甲子，振興中府。
entries.en: On jiazi day Xingzhong Prefecture was relieved.
entries.literal: On jiazi day relieved Xingzhong Prefecture.

entries.zh: 甲戌，封北府宰相楊績為趙王，樞密副使耶律觀參知政事兼知南院樞密使事。
entries.en: On jiaxu day Northern Court chancellor Yang Ji was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; associate privy commissioner Yelü Guan was made Associate Administrator of Affairs and administrator of Southern Court privy affairs.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day Northern Court chancellor Yang Ji was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; associate privy commissioner Yelü Guan Associate Administrator of Affairs and administrator of Southern Court privy affairs.

entries.zh: 丁丑，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On dingchou day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On dingchou day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 秋七月己卯，慶州靳文高八世同居，詔賜爵。
entries.en: On jimao day of the seventh autumn month, in Qing Prefecture Jin Wengao's eight generations lived together; an edict granted rank.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jimao day, in Qing Prefecture Jin Wen's eight generations lived together; edict granted rank.

entries.zh: 丙申，振饒州饑民。
entries.en: On bingshen day hungry people in Rao Prefecture were relieved.
entries.literal: On bingshen day relieved hungry people in Rao Prefecture.

entries.zh: 丁酉，幸黑嶺。
entries.en: On dingyou day the court visited Heiling.
entries.literal: On dingyou day visited Heiling.

entries.zh: 丁未，以御書《華嚴經五頌》出示群臣。
entries.en: On dingwei day the imperial composition 《Five Eulogies on the Avatamsaka Sutra》 was shown to the ministers.
entries.literal: On dingwei day the imperial composition 《Five Eulogies on the Avatamsaka Sutra》 was shown to the ministers.

entries.zh: 閏月辛未，射熊於羖羊山。
entries.en: In the intercalary month, on xinwei day, a bear was shot at Guyang Mountain.
entries.literal: Intercalary month, on xinwei day, shot a bear at Guyang Mountain.

entries.zh: 八月庚辰，混同郡王侯古薨，遣使致祭。
entries.en: On gengchen day of the eighth month Prince of Huntong Commandery Hougu died; envoys were dispatched to offer sacrifice.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on gengchen day Prince of Huntong Commandery Hougu died; envoys were dispatched to offer sacrifice.

entries.zh: 九月甲子，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on jiazi day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 冬十月己丑，參知政事耶律觀矯制營私第，降為庶人。
entries.en: On jichou day of the tenth winter month Associate Administrator of Affairs Yelü Guan forged an edict to build a private residence and was demoted to commoner.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jichou day Associate Administrator of Affairs Yelü Guan forged an edict to build a private residence and was demoted to commoner.

entries.zh: 癸巳，回鶻來貢。
entries.en: On guisi day Uighur came with tribute.
entries.literal: On guisi day Uighur came with tribute.

entries.zh: 十一庚戌，免祖州稅。
entries.en: On gengxu day of the eleventh month Zu Prefecture tax was remitted.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on gengxu day, remitted Zu Prefecture tax.

entries.zh: 丙辰，大雪，許民樵采禁地。
entries.en: On bingchen day heavy snow fell; the people were permitted to gather firewood in forbidden grounds.
entries.literal: On bingchen day heavy snow fell; the people were permitted to gather firewood in forbidden grounds.

entries.zh: 丁卯，賜延昌宮貧戶錢。
entries.en: On dingmao day money was bestowed on poor households of Yanchang Palace.
entries.literal: On dingmao day money was bestowed on poor households of Yanchang Palace.

entries.zh: 十二月戊辰，漢人行宮都部署耶律仲禧封韓國公，樞密副使、參知政事趙徽出為武定軍節度使，樞密副使柴德滋參知政事，漢人行宮副部署耶律大悲奴升都部署，同知南院樞密使事蕭韓家奴知左夷離畢事。
entries.en: On wuchen day of the twelfth month Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Zhongxi was enfeoffed Duke of Han; associate privy commissioner and Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Hui was dismissed as military commissioner of Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Chai Dezi was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Yelü Dabeinu was promoted deployment director; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was made administrator of Left yilibi affairs.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on wuchen day Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Zhongxi was enfeoffed Duke of Han; associate privy commissioner and Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Hui was dismissed as military commissioner of Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Chai Dezi Associate Administrator of Affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Yelü Dabeinu was promoted deployment director; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu administrator of Left yilibi affairs.

entries.zh: 丁，以坤寧節，大赦。
entries.en: On a ding day, because of the Kunning Festival, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: On a ding day, because of the Kunning Festival, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

entries.zh: 庚寅，賜高麗佛經一藏。
entries.en: On gengyin day one complete canon of Buddhist scriptures was bestowed on Goryeo.
entries.literal: On gengyin day one complete canon of Buddhist scriptures was bestowed on Goryeo.

entries.zh: 九年春正月丁未，如雙濼。
entries.en: In the ninth year, on dingwei day of the first spring month the court went to Shuang Marsh.
entries.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on dingwei day, went to Shuang Marsh.

entries.zh: 夏四月壬辰，如旺國崖。
entries.en: On renchen day of the fourth summer month the court went to Wangguo Cliff.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renchen day, went to Wangguo Cliff.

entries.zh: 秋七月甲辰，獵大熊山。
entries.en: On jiachen day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Daxiong Mountain.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiachen day, hunted at Daxiong Mountain.

entries.zh: 戊申，烏古敵烈統軍言，八石烈敵烈人殺其節度使以叛。
entries.en: On wushen day Wugu Dilie supreme commander memorialized that Eight Shilie Dilie people had killed their military commissioner and rebelled.
entries.literal: On wushen day Wugu Dilie supreme commander memorialized that Eight Shilie Dilie people had killed their military commissioner and rebelled.

entries.zh: 己酉，詔隗烏古部軍分道擊之。
entries.en: On jiyou day an edict ordered Kui Wugu tribal troops to attack on separate routes.
entries.literal: On jiyou day edict ordered Kui Wugu tribal troops to attack on separate routes.

entries.zh: 丙寅，南京奏歸義。
entries.en: On bingyin day Nanjing memorialized Guiyi.
entries.literal: On bingyin day Nanjing memorialized Guiyi.

entries.zh: 淶水兩縣蝗飛入宋境，餘為蜂所食。
entries.en: In Lishui two counties locusts flew into Song territory; the remainder were eaten by wasps.
entries.literal: In Lishui two counties locusts flew into Song territory; the remainder were eaten by wasps.

entries.zh: 八月丙申，以耶律仲禧為南院樞密使。
entries.en: On bingshen day of the eighth month Yelü Zhongxi was made Southern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on bingshen day Yelü Zhongxi was made Southern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 九月癸卯，駐蹕獨盧金。
entries.en: On guimao day of the ninth month the court halted at Dulujin.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on guimao day, halted at Dulujin.

entries.zh: 冬十月，幸陰山，遂如西京。
entries.en: In the tenth winter month the court visited Yin Mountain, then went to the Western Capital.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, visited Yin Mountain, then went to the Western Capital.

entries.zh: 十一月戊午，詔行幸之地免租一年。
entries.en: On wuwu day of the eleventh month an edict ordered that places the court visited were exempt from rent for one year.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on wuwu day, edict ordered that places the court visited were exempt from rent for one year.

entries.zh: 甲子，南院大王合理只致仕。
entries.en: On jiazi day Southern Court great king Helizhi retired.
entries.literal: On jiazi day Southern Court great king Helizhi retired.

entries.zh: 十二月辛未，以知北院樞密使事耶律宜新為中京留守，南院宣徽使耶律撒剌為南院大王。
entries.en: On xinwei day of the twelfth month Yelü Yixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made regent of the Central Capital; Southern Court palace commissioner Yelü Sala was made Southern Court great king.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on xinwei day Yelü Yixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made regent of the Central Capital; Southern Court palace commissioner Yelü Sala Southern Court great king.

entries.zh: 壬辰，高麗、夏國並遣使來貢。
entries.en: On renchen day Goryeo and Xia State both sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On renchen day Goryeo and Xia State both dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 大康元年春正月乙未，如混同江。
entries.en: In the first year of Dikang, on yiwei day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the first year of Dikang, spring, first month, on yiwei day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 壬寅，振雲州饑。
entries.en: On renyin day famine in Yun Prefecture was relieved.
entries.literal: On renyin day relieved famine in Yun Prefecture.

entries.zh: 二月丁卯，祥州火，遣使恤災。
entries.en: On dingmao day of the second month Xiang Prefecture caught fire; envoys were dispatched to comfort the disaster.
entries.literal: Second month, on dingmao day Xiang Prefecture caught fire; envoys were dispatched to comfort the disaster.

entries.zh: 乙酉，駐蹕大魚濼。
entries.en: On yiyou day the court halted at Dayu Marsh.
entries.literal: On yiyou day halted at Dayu Marsh.

entries.zh: 丁亥，以獲鵝，加鷹坊使耶律楊六為工部尚書。
entries.en: On dinghai day, because geese were obtained, hawk-mews commissioner Yelü Yangliu was promoted Minister of Works.
entries.literal: On dinghai day, because geese were obtained, hawk-mews commissioner Yelü Yangliu was promoted Minister of Works.

entries.zh: 三月乙巳，命皇太子寫佛書。
entries.en: On yisi day of the third month the crown prince was ordered to copy Buddhist books.
entries.literal: Third month, on yisi day, ordered the crown prince to copy Buddhist books.

entries.zh: 夏四月丙子，振平州饑。
entries.en: On bingzi day of the fourth summer month famine in Ping Prefecture was relieved.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingzi day, relieved famine in Ping Prefecture.

entries.zh: 己酉，如犢山閏月丙午，振平、灤二州饑。
entries.en: On jiyou day the court went to Du Mountain; in the intercalary month, on bingwu day, famine in Ping and Luan prefectures was relieved.
entries.literal: On jiyou day went to Du Mountain; intercalary month, on bingwu day, relieved famine in Ping and Luan prefectures.

entries.zh: 庚戌，皇孫延禧生。
entries.en: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.
entries.literal: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.

entries.zh: 五月甲子，賜妃之親及東宮僚屬爵有差。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the fifth month rank was granted by degree to the consort's kin and Eastern Palace staff.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on jiazi day rank was granted by degree to the consort's kin and Eastern Palace staff.

entries.zh: 六月癸巳，以興聖宮使奚謝家奴知奚六部大王事。
entries.en: On guisi day of the sixth month Xing Sheng Palace commissioner Xi Xiejianu was made to administer Xi Six Tribes great king affairs.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on guisi day Xing Sheng Palace commissioner Xi Xiejianu was made to administer Xi Six Tribes great king affairs.

entries.zh: 戊戌，知三司使事韓操以錢谷增羨，授三司使。
entries.en: On wuxu day Han Cao, who administered Three Departments affairs, because money and grain increased was appointed Three Departments commissioner.
entries.literal: On wuxu day Han Cao, who administered Three Departments affairs, because money and grain increased was appointed Three Departments commissioner.

entries.zh: 癸卯，遣使按問諸路囚。
entries.en: On guimao day envoys were dispatched to investigate prisoners in all routes.
entries.literal: On guimao day dispatched envoys to investigate prisoners in all routes.

entries.zh: 以惕隱大悲奴為始平軍節度使，參知政事柴德滋武定軍節度使。
entries.en: Tiyin Dabeinu was made military commissioner of Shiping Army; Associate Administrator of Affairs Chai Dezi military commissioner of Wuding Army.
entries.literal: Tiyin Dabeinu was made military commissioner of Shiping Army; Associate Administrator of Affairs Chai Dezi military commissioner of Wuding Army.

entries.zh: 乙卯，吐蕃來貢。
entries.en: On yimao day Tibet came with tribute.
entries.literal: On yimao day Tibet came with tribute.

entries.zh: 丙辰，詔皇太子總領朝政，仍戒諭之。
entries.en: On bingchen day an edict ordered the crown prince to oversee court government in general, and he was admonished.
entries.literal: On bingchen day, edict ordered the crown prince to oversee court government in general, and he was admonished.

entries.zh: 以武定軍節度使趙徽為南府宰相，樞密副使楊遵勖參知政事。
entries.en: Wuding Army military commissioner Zhao Hui was made Southern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yang Zunxu was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
entries.literal: Wuding Army military commissioner Zhao Hui was made Southern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yang Zunxu Associate Administrator of Affairs.

entries.zh: 秋七月辛酉朔，獵平地松林。
entries.en: On the xinyou new moon of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinyou new moon, hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.

entries.zh: 丙寅，振南京貧民。
entries.en: On bingyin day poor people in Nanjing were relieved.
entries.literal: On bingyin day relieved poor people in Nanjing.

entries.zh: 八月庚寅朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the gengyin new moon of the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on gengyin new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 九月乙亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On yihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on yihai day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 己卯，以南京饑，免租稅一年，仍出錢粟振之。
entries.en: On jimao day, because Nanjing had famine, rent and tax were remitted for one year and money and grain were issued for relief.
entries.literal: On jimao day, because Nanjing had famine, rent and tax were remitted for one year and money and grain were issued for relief.

entries.zh: 冬十月，西北路酋長遐搭、雛搭、雙古等來降。
entries.en: In the tenth winter month Northwest Route chieftains Xiadá, Choudá, Shuanggu, and others came to surrender.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, Northwest Route chieftains Xiadá, Choudá, Shuanggu, and others came to surrender.

entries.zh: 十一月辛酉，皇后被誣，賜死；
entries.en: On xinyou day of the eleventh month the Empress was slandered and ordered to die;
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on xinyou day the Empress was slandered and ordered to die;

entries.zh: 殺伶人趙惟一、高長命，並籍其家屬。
entries.en: The musicians Zhao Weiyi and Gao Changming were killed, and their families were registered and confiscated.
entries.literal: musicians Zhao Weiyi and Gao Changming were killed, and their families were registered and confiscated.

entries.zh: 十二月己丑朔，以南京統軍使耶律魘奴為惕隱，漢人行宮都部署耶律霂樞密副使，同知東京留守事蕭鐸剌夷離畢。
entries.en: On the jichou new moon of the twelfth month Nanjing supreme commander Yelü Yannu was made tiyin; Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Li was made associate privy commissioner; associate Eastern Capital regent Xiao Telaci was made yilibi.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on jichou new moon, Nanjing supreme commander Yelü Yannu was made tiyin; Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Li associate privy commissioner; associate Eastern Capital regent Xiao Telaci yilibi.

entries.zh: 庚寅，賜張孝傑國姓。
entries.en: On gengyin day Zhang Xiaojie was granted the imperial clan surname.
entries.literal: On gengyin day Zhang Xiaojie was granted the imperial clan surname.

entries.zh: 壬辰，以西京留守蕭燕六為左夷離畢。
entries.en: On renchen day Western Capital regent Xiao Yanliu was made Left yilibi.
entries.literal: On renchen day Western Capital regent Xiao Yanliu was made Left yilibi.

entries.zh: 三年春正月癸丑，如混同江。
entries.en: In the third year, on guichou day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on guichou day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 乙卯，省諸道春貢金帛，及停周歲所輸尚方銀。
entries.en: On yimao day spring tribute of gold and silk in all routes was reduced and yearly silver tribute to the imperial workshop was stopped.
entries.literal: On yimao day reduced spring tribute of gold and silk in all routes and stopped yearly silver tribute to the imperial workshop.

entries.zh: 二月壬午朔，東北路統軍使蕭韓家奴加尚父，封吳王。
entries.en: On the renwu new moon of the second month Eastern Route supreme commander Xiao Hanjianu was honored imperial father and enfeoffed Prince of Wu.
entries.literal: Second month, on renwu new moon, Eastern Route supreme commander Xiao Hanjianu was honored imperial father and enfeoffed Prince of Wu.

entries.zh: 甲申，詔北院樞密使魏王耶律乙辛同母兄大奴、同母弟阿思世預北、南院樞密之選，其異母諸弟世預夷離堇之選。
entries.en: On jiashen day an edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.
entries.literal: On jiashen day, edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.

entries.zh: 己丑，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: On jichou day the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: On jichou day went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 辛卯，中京饑，罷巡幸。
entries.en: On xinmao day the Central Capital had famine; the tour was stopped.
entries.literal: On xinmao day the Central Capital had famine; the tour was stopped.

entries.zh: 夏四月乙酉，泛舟黑龍江。
entries.en: On yiyou day of the fourth summer month the court boated on the Black Dragon River.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yiyou day boated on the Black Dragon River.

entries.zh: 五月丙辰，玉田、安次蝝，傷稼。
entries.en: On bingchen day of the fifth month Yutian and Anci had aphids that injured the crops.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on bingchen day Yutian and Anci had aphids that injured the crops.

entries.zh: 癸亥，日中有黑子。
entries.en: On guihai day there was a black spot in the sun.
entries.literal: On guihai day there was a black spot in the sun.

entries.zh: 己巳，駐蹕犢山。
entries.en: On jisi day the court halted at Du Mountain.
entries.literal: On jisi day halted at Du Mountain.

entries.zh: 乙亥，北院樞密使耶律乙辛奏，右護衛太保查剌等告知北院樞密使事蕭速撒等八人謀立皇太子，上以無狀，不治，出速撒等三人補外，護衛撒撥等六人各鞭百餘，徙於邊。
entries.en: On yihai day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin memorialized that Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala and others reported that associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Susa and eight others plotted to install the crown prince; the Emperor said it was groundless and did not punish; three including Susa were sent out to fill external posts; six including guard Sapo were each flogged more than a hundred strokes and exiled to the border.
entries.literal: On yihai day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin memorialized that Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala and others reported that associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Susa and eight others plotted to install the crown prince; the Emperor said it was groundless and did not punish; three including Susa were sent out to fill external posts; six including guard Sapo were each flogged more than a hundred strokes and exiled to the border.

entries.zh: 丙子，以西北路招討使遼西郡王蕭餘里也為北府宰相，兼知契丹行宮都部署事。
entries.en: On bingzi day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northern Court chancellor and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.
entries.literal: On bingzi day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northern Court chancellor and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.

entries.zh: 戊寅，詔告謀逆事者，重加官賞。
entries.en: On wuyin day an edict announced that those who reported plotting rebellion would be heavily rewarded with office.
entries.literal: On wuyin day, edict announced that those who reported plotting rebellion would be heavily rewarded with office.

entries.zh: 六月己卯朔，耶律乙辛令牌印郎君蕭訛都斡誣首嘗預速撒等謀，籍其姓名以告。
entries.en: On the jimao new moon of the sixth month Yelü Yixin ordered seal-and-tally langjun Xiao Eduwo to falsely accuse and say he had once joined Susa and the others in the plot, registering names to report.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jimao new moon, Yelü Yixin ordered seal-and-tally langjun Xiao Eduwo to falsely accuse and say he had once joined Susa and the others in the plot, registering names to report.

entries.zh: 即命乙辛及耶律仲禧、蕭餘里也、耶律孝傑、楊遵勖、燕哥、抄只、蕭十三等鞫治，杖皇太子，囚之宮中。
entries.en: Yixin and Yelü Zhongxi, Xiao Yuliye, Yelü Xiaojie, Yang Zunxu, Yange, Chaozhi, Xiao Shisan, and others were immediately ordered to investigate; the crown prince was beaten and imprisoned in the palace.
entries.literal: Immediately ordered Yixin and Yelü Zhongxi, Xiao Yuliye, Yelü Xiaojie, Yang Zunxu, Yange, Chaozhi, Xiao Shisan, and others to investigate; the crown prince was beaten and imprisoned in the palace.

entries.zh: 辛巳，殺宿直官敵裏剌等三人。
entries.en: On xinsi day three night-duty officials including Dirili were killed.
entries.literal: On xinsi day killed three night-duty officials including Dirili.

entries.zh: 壬午，殺宣徽使撻不也等二人。
entries.en: On renwu day two including palace commissioner Tabuye were killed.
entries.literal: On renwu day killed two including palace commissioner Tabuye.

entries.zh: 癸未，殺始平軍節度使撒剌等十人，又遣使殺上京留守速撒，及已徙護衛撒撥等六人。
entries.en: On guimao day ten including Shiping Army military commissioner Sala were killed; envoys were also dispatched to kill Supreme Capital regent Susa and the six exiled guards including Sapo.
entries.literal: On guimao day killed ten including Shiping Army military commissioner Sala; also dispatched envoys to kill Supreme Capital regent Susa and the six exiled guards including Sapo.

entries.zh: 乙酉，殺耶律撻不也及其弟陳留。
entries.en: On yiyou day Yelü Tabuye and his younger brother Chenliu were killed.
entries.literal: On yiyou day killed Yelü Tabuye and his younger brother Chenliu.

entries.zh: 丙戌，廢皇太子為庶人，囚之上京。
entries.en: On bingxu day the crown prince was deposed as commoner and imprisoned at the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: On bingxu day deposed the crown prince as commoner and imprisoned him at the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 己丑，回鶻來貢。
entries.en: On jichou day Uighur came with tribute.
entries.literal: On jichou day Uighur came with tribute.

entries.zh: 殺東京留守同知耶律回裏不。
entries.en: Eastern Capital regent associate administrator Yelü Huilibu was killed.
entries.literal: Killed Eastern Capital regent associate administrator Yelü Huilibu.

entries.zh: 辛卯，殺速撒等諸子，籍其家。
entries.en: On xinmao day Susa's sons were killed and their households were registered.
entries.literal: On xinmao day killed Susa's sons and registered their households.

entries.zh: 戊申，遣使按五京諸道獄。
entries.en: On wushen day envoys were dispatched to investigate prisons in the Five Capitals and all routes.
entries.literal: On wushen day dispatched envoys to investigate prisons in the Five Capitals and all routes.

entries.zh: 秋七月辛亥，護衛太保查剌加鎮國大將軍，預突呂不部節度使之選，室韋查剌及蕭寶神奴、謀魯古並加左衛大將軍，牌印郎君訛都斡尚皇女趙國公主，授駙馬都尉、始平軍節度使，祗候郎君耶律撻不也及蕭圖古辭並加監門衛上將軍。
entries.en: On xinhai day of the seventh autumn month Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala was promoted Pacifying State grand general and hereditary in selection for Tielübu tribal military commissioner; Shiwei Zhala and Xiao Baoshennu and Molugu were all promoted Left Guard grand generals; seal-and-tally langjun Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao, was appointed imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Shiping Army; attendant langjun Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Tuguci were both promoted Defender of the Gate Commandant upper generals.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala was promoted Pacifying State grand general and hereditary in selection for Tielübu tribal military commissioner; Shiwei Zhala and Xiao Baoshennu and Molugu were all promoted Left Guard grand generals; seal-and-tally langjun Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao, appointed imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Shiping Army; attendant langjun Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Tuguci were both promoted Defender of the Gate Commandant upper generals.

entries.zh: 壬子，知北院樞密副使蕭韓家奴為漢人行宮都部署。
entries.en: On renzi day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.
entries.literal: On renzi day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.

entries.zh: 乙丑，如秋山。
entries.en: On yichou day the court went to autumn mountains.
entries.literal: On yichou day went to autumn mountains.

entries.zh: 丁丑，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On dingchou day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On dingchou day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 八月庚寅，漢人行宮都部署蕭韓家奴薨。
entries.en: On gengyin day of the eighth month Han mobile palace deployment director Xiao Hanjianu died.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on gengyin day Han mobile palace deployment director Xiao Hanjianu died.

entries.zh: 辛丑，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On xinchou day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On xinchou day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 九月癸亥，玉田貢嘉禾。
entries.en: On guihai day of the ninth month Yutian presented auspicious grain.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on guihai day Yutian presented auspicious grain.

entries.zh: 壬申，修乾陵廟。
entries.en: On renshen day Qian Mausoleum temple was repaired.
entries.literal: On renshen day repaired Qian Mausoleum temple.

entries.zh: 冬十月辛丑，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On xinchou day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinchou day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 十一月，北院樞密使耶律乙辛遣其私人盜殺庶人浚於上京。
entries.en: In the eleventh month Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin dispatched his private agents to assassinate the commoner Jun at the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin dispatched his private agents to assassinate the commoner Jun at the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 閏十二月戊午，以北府宰相遼西郡王蕭餘里也知北院樞密使事，左夷離畢耶律燕哥為契丹行宮都部署。
entries.en: In the intercalary twelfth month, on wuwu day Northern Court chancellor Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Yange was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
entries.literal: Intercalary twelfth month, on wuwu day Northern Court chancellor Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Yange Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

entries.zh: 丙寅，預行正旦禮。
entries.en: On bingyin day New Year's rites were performed in advance.
entries.literal: On bingyin day New Year's rites were performed in advance.

entries.zh: 是歲，南京大熟。
entries.en: That year Nanjing had a great harvest.
entries.literal: That year Nanjing had a great harvest.

entries.zh: 四年春正月庚辰，如春水。
entries.en: In the fourth year, on gengchen day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.
entries.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on gengchen day, went to spring waters.

entries.zh: 甲午，振東京饑。
entries.en: On jiawu day famine in the Eastern Capital was relieved.
entries.literal: On jiawu day relieved famine in the Eastern Capital.

entries.zh: 二月乙丑，駐蹕掃獲野。
entries.en: On yichou day of the second month the court halted at Saohuoye.
entries.literal: Second month, on yichou day, halted at Saohuoye.

entries.zh: 戊辰，以東路統軍使耶律王九為惕隱。
entries.en: On wuchen day Eastern Route supreme commander Yelü Wangjiu was made tiyin.
entries.literal: On wuchen day Eastern Route supreme commander Yelü Wangjiu was made tiyin.

entries.zh: 夏四月辛亥，高麗遣使乞賜鴨淥江以東地，不許。
entries.en: On xinhai day of the fourth summer month Goryeo sent envoys begging grant of lands east of the Yalu River; permission was refused.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinhai day Goryeo dispatched envoys begging grant of lands east of the Yalu River; not permitted.

entries.zh: 五月丙戌，駐蹕散水原。
entries.en: On bingxu day of the fifth month the court halted at Sanshui Plain.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day, halted at Sanshui Plain.

entries.zh: 六月甲寅，阻卜諸酋長進良馬。
entries.en: On jiayin day of the sixth month Zubu tribal chiefs presented fine horses.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin day Zubu tribal chiefs presented fine horses.

entries.zh: 秋七月甲戌，諸路奏飯僧尼三十六萬。
entries.en: On jiaxu day of the seventh autumn month all routes memorialized feeding three hundred sixty thousand monks and nuns.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiaxu day all routes memorialized feeding three hundred sixty thousand monks and nuns.

entries.zh: 八月癸卯，詔有司決滯獄。
entries.en: On guimao day of the eighth month an edict ordered the relevant offices to decide delayed cases.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on guimao day, edict ordered the relevant offices to decide delayed cases.

entries.zh: 九月乙未，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On yiwei day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on yiwei day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 庚子，五國部長來貢。
entries.en: On gengzi day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
entries.literal: On gengzi day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

entries.zh: 冬十月癸卯，以參知政事劉伸為保靜軍節度使。
entries.en: On guimao day of the tenth winter month Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made military commissioner of Baojing Army.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on guimao day Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made military commissioner of Baojing Army.

entries.zh: 十一月丁亥，禁士庶服用錦綺、日月、山龍之文。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the eleventh month scholars and commoners were forbidden to wear brocade and silk with sun, moon, mountain, and dragon designs.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on dinghai day forbidden scholars and commoners to wear brocade and silk with sun, moon, mountain, and dragon designs.

entries.zh: 己丑，回鶻遣使來貢。
entries.en: On jichou day Uighur sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On jichou day Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 庚寅，南院樞密使耶律仲禧為廣德軍節度使。
entries.en: On gengyin day Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhongxi was made military commissioner of Guangde Army.
entries.literal: On gengyin day Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhongxi was made military commissioner of Guangde Army.

entries.zh: 辛卯，錦州民張寶四世同居，命諸子三班院祗候。
entries.en: On xinmao day Jin Prefecture commoner Zhang Bao's four generations lived together; his sons were ordered attendants of the Third Class Court.
entries.literal: On xinmao day Jin Prefecture commoner Zhang Bao's four generations lived together; his sons were ordered attendants of the Third Class Court.

entries.zh: 十二月丁卯，以北院樞密副使耶律霂知北院樞密使事。
entries.en: On dingmao day of the twelfth month Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Li was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on dingmao day Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Li was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.

entries.zh: 道宗四
entries.en: Daozong, Part Four
entries.literal: Daozong, Part Four

entries.zh: 七年春正月戊申，五國部長來貢。
entries.en: In the seventh year, on wushen day of the first spring month chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
entries.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on wushen day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

entries.zh: 甲寅，女直貢良馬。
entries.en: On jiayin day Jurchen presented fine horses.
entries.literal: On jiayin day Jurchen presented fine horses.

entries.zh: 二月甲子，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the second month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: Second month, on jiazi day, went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 夏五月壬子，駐蹕嶺西。
entries.en: On renzi day of the fifth summer month the court halted west of the ridge.
entries.literal: Summer, fifth month, on renzi day, halted west of the ridge.

entries.zh: 癸丑，有司奏永清、武清、固安三縣蝗。
entries.en: On guichou day the relevant offices memorialized locusts in Yongqing, Wuqing, and Gu'an counties.
entries.literal: On guichou day the relevant offices memorialized locusts in Yongqing, Wuqing, and Gu'an counties.

entries.zh: 甲寅，以蕭撻不也兼殿前都點檢，蕭酬斡為漢人行宮都部署兼知樞密院事。
entries.en: On jiayin day Xiao Tabuye was also Palace Front commander; Xiao Chouwo was made Han mobile palace deployment director and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
entries.literal: On jiayin day Xiao Tabuye was also Palace Front commander; Xiao Chouwo Han mobile palace deployment director and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

entries.zh: 六月甲子，詔月祭觀德殿，歲寒食，諸帝在時生辰及忌日，詣景宗御容殿致奠。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the sixth month an edict ordered monthly sacrifice at Guande Hall; each year on the Cold Food festival and on the birthdays and death anniversaries of the various emperors, proceed to Jingzong's imperial portrait hall to offer sacrifice.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jiazi day, edict ordered monthly sacrifice at Guande Hall; on Cold Food each year, on birthdays and death days while emperors lived, proceed to Jingzong's imperial portrait hall to offer sacrifice.

entries.zh: 丙寅，阻卜余古赧來貢。
entries.en: On bingyin day Zubu Yugunian came with tribute.
entries.literal: On bingyin day Zubu Yugunian came with tribute.

entries.zh: 丁卯，以翰林學士王言敷參知政事，封北院宣徽使石篤漆水郡王。
entries.en: On dingmao day Hanlin academician Wang Yanfu was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Northern Court palace commissioner Shi Du was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.
entries.literal: On dingmao day Hanlin academician Wang Yanfu Associate Administrator of Affairs; Northern Court palace commissioner Shi Du enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.

entries.zh: 秋七月戊子，如秋山。
entries.en: On wuzi day of the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuzi day, went to autumn mountains.

entries.zh: 丙申，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On bingshen day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On bingshen day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 八月丁卯，射鹿赤山，加圍場使涅葛為靜江軍節度使。
entries.en: On dingmao day of the eighth month deer were shot at Red Mountain; hunting-grounds commissioner Niege was promoted military commissioner of Jingjiang Army.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on dingmao day shot deer at Red Mountain; hunting-grounds commissioner Niege was promoted military commissioner of Jingjiang Army.

entries.zh: 九月戊子，次懷州，命皇謁懷陵。
entries.en: On wuzi day of the ninth month the court halted at Huai Prefecture; the crown prince was ordered to pay respects at Huai Mausoleum.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on wuzi day halted at Huai Prefecture; ordered the crown prince to pay respects at Huai Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 辛卯，次祖州，命皇后謁祖陵。
entries.en: On xinmao day the court halted at Zu Prefecture; the Empress was ordered to pay respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
entries.literal: On xinmao day halted at Zu Prefecture; ordered the Empress to pay respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

entries.zh: 乙巳，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On yisi day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: On yisi day halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 冬十月戊辰，以惕隱王九為南院大王，夷離畢奚抄只為彰國軍節度使。
entries.en: On wuchen day of the tenth winter month tiyin Wangjiu was made Southern Court great king; yilibi Xi Chaozhi military commissioner of Zhangguo Army.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuchen day tiyin Wangjiu was made Southern Court great king; yilibi Xi Chaozhi military commissioner of Zhangguo Army.

entries.zh: 十一月乙酉，詔歲出官錢，振諸宮分及邊戍貧戶。
entries.en: On yiyou day of the eleventh month an edict ordered yearly disbursement of official funds to relieve poor households of various palace divisions and border garrisons.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on yiyou day, edict ordered yearly disbursement of official funds to relieve poor households of various palace divisions and border garrisons.

entries.zh: 丁亥，幸駙馬都尉蕭酬斡第，方飲，宰相梁穎諫曰：「天子不可飲人臣家。」
entries.en: On dinghai day the court visited imperial son-in-law Xiao Chouwo's residence; while drinking, Chancellor Liang Ying admonished: "The Son of Heaven must not drink in a subject's house."
entries.literal: On dinghai day visited imperial son-in-law Xiao Chouwo's residence; while drinking, Chancellor Liang Ying admonished: "The Son of Heaven must not drink in a subject's house."

entries.zh: 上即還宮。
entries.en: The Emperor immediately returned to the palace.
entries.literal: The Emperor immediately returned to the palace.

entries.zh: 己亥，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On jihai day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On jihai day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 辛亥，除絹帛尺度狹短之令。
entries.en: On xinhai day the regulation on narrow silk and cloth measures was abolished.
entries.literal: On xinhai day abolished the regulation on narrow silk and cloth measures.

entries.zh: 十二月丁卯，武定軍節度使耶律仁傑以罪削爵為民。
entries.en: On dingmao day of the twelfth month Wuding Army military commissioner Yelü Renjie, for an offense, was stripped of rank and made a commoner.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on dingmao day Wuding Army military commissioner Yelü Renjie, for an offense, was stripped of rank and made a commoner.

entries.zh: 辛未，知興中府事耶律乙辛以罪囚於來州。
entries.en: On xinwei day Xingzhong Prefecture administrator Yelü Yixin, for an offense, was imprisoned at Laizhou.
entries.literal: On xinwei day Xingzhong Prefecture administrator Yelü Yixin, for an offense, was imprisoned at Laizhou.

entries.zh: 六年春正月癸酉，如鴛鴦濼。
entries.en: In the sixth year, on guiyou day of the first spring month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
entries.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on guiyou day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.

entries.zh: 辛卯，耶律乙辛出知興中府事。
entries.en: On xinmao day Yelü Yixin was sent out as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
entries.literal: On xinmao day Yelü Yixin was sent out as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.

entries.zh: 三月庚寅，封皇孫延禧為梁王，忠順軍節度使耶律頗德南院大王，耶律仲禧南院樞密使，戶部使陳毅參知政事。
entries.en: On gengyin day of the third month imperial grandson Yanxi was enfeoffed Prince of Liang; Zhongshun Army military commissioner Yelü Pode was made Southern Court great king; Yelü Zhongxi Southern Court privy commissioner; Household Commissioner Chen Yi Associate Administrator of Affairs.
entries.literal: Third month, on gengyin day enfeoffed imperial grandson Yanxi Prince of Liang; Zhongshun Army military commissioner Yelü Pode Southern Court great king; Yelü Zhongxi Southern Court privy commissioner; Household Commissioner Chen Yi Associate Administrator of Affairs.

entries.zh: 夏四月乙卯，獵炭山。
entries.en: On yimao day of the fourth summer month the court hunted at Tanshan.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yimao day, hunted at Tanshan.

entries.zh: 五月壬申，免平州復業民租賦一年。
entries.en: On renshen day of the fifth month one year's rent and tax for Ping Prefecture households resuming cultivation was remitted.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on renshen day, remitted one year's rent and tax for Ping Prefecture households resuming cultivation.

entries.zh: 庚寅，以旱，禱雨，命左右以水相沃，俄而雨降。
entries.en: On gengyin day, because of drought, rain was prayed for; attendants were ordered to douse one another with water, and soon rain fell.
entries.literal: On gengyin day, because of drought, prayed for rain; ordered attendants to douse one another with water, and soon rain fell.

entries.zh: 六月戊戌，駐蹕納葛濼。
entries.en: On wuxu day of the sixth month the court halted at Nage Marsh.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on wuxu day, halted at Nage Marsh.

entries.zh: 戊申，以度支使王績參知政事。
entries.en: On wushen day Revenue Commissioner Wang Ji was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
entries.literal: On wushen day Revenue Commissioner Wang Ji Associate Administrator of Affairs.

entries.zh: 庚戌，女直遣使來貢。
entries.en: On gengxu day Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On gengxu day Jurchen dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 秋七月戊辰，觀市。
entries.en: On wuchen day of the seventh autumn month the court viewed the market.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day viewed the market.

entries.zh: 癸未，為皇孫梁王延禧設旗鼓拽剌六人衛護之。
entries.en: On guiwei day six drum-and-banner zhala guards were established to protect imperial grandson Prince of Liang Yanxi.
entries.literal: On guiwei day six drum-and-banner zhala guards were established to protect imperial grandson Prince of Liang Yanxi.

entries.zh: 甲申，獵沙嶺。
entries.en: On jiashen day the court hunted at Shaling.
entries.literal: On jiashen day hunted at Shaling.

entries.zh: 九月壬寅，祠木葉山。
entries.en: On renyin day of the ninth month sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on renyin day sacrificed at Muye Mountain.

entries.zh: 己酉，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On jiyou day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: On jiyou day halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 冬十月己未朔，省同知廣德軍節度使事，命奉先軍節度使兼巡警乾、顯二州。
entries.en: On the jiwei new moon of the tenth winter month the post of associate Guangde Army military commissioner was abolished; Fengxian Army military commissioner was ordered also to patrol Qian and Xian prefectures.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiwei new moon, abolished the post of associate Guangde Army military commissioner; ordered Fengxian Army military commissioner also to patrol Qian and Xian prefectures.

entries.zh: 丁卯，耶律仁傑出為武定軍節度使。
entries.en: On dingmao day Yelü Renjie was sent out as military commissioner of Wuding Army.
entries.literal: On dingmao day Yelü Renjie was sent out as military commissioner of Wuding Army.

entries.zh: 庚午，參知政事劉詵致仕。
entries.en: On gengwu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen retired.
entries.literal: On gengwu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen retired.

entries.zh: 癸酉，以陳毅為漢人行宮都部署，王績同知樞密院事。
entries.en: On guiyou day Chen Yi was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Wang Ji associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
entries.literal: On guiyou day Chen Yi was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Wang Ji associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

entries.zh: 辛巳，回鶻遣使來貢。
entries.en: On xinsi day Uighur sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On xinsi day Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 十一月己丑朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the jichou new moon of the eleventh month there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on jichou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 癸卯，召群臣議政。
entries.en: On guimao day ministers were summoned to discuss government.
entries.literal: On guimao day summoned ministers to discuss government.

entries.zh: 十二月甲子，以耶律特裏底為孟父敞穩。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the twelfth month Yelü Telidi was made Mengfu detail-stable.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on jiazi day Yelü Telidi was made Mengfu detail-stable.

entries.zh: 乙丑，以蕭撻不也為北府宰相，耶律世遷知北院樞密使事，耶律慎思同知北院樞密使事。
entries.en: On yichou day Xiao Tabuye was made Northern Court chancellor; Yelü Shiqian was made administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Yelü Shensi associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On yichou day Xiao Tabuye was made Northern Court chancellor; Yelü Shiqian administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Yelü Shensi associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 庚午，免西京流民租賦一年。
entries.en: On gengwu day Western Capital refugees' rent and tax were remitted for one year.
entries.literal: On gengwu day Western Capital refugees' rent and tax were remitted for one year.

entries.zh: 甲戌，減民賦。
entries.en: On jiaxu day the people's tax levies were reduced.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day the people's tax levies were reduced.

entries.zh: 丁亥，豫行正旦禮。
entries.en: On dinghai day New Year's rites were performed in advance.
entries.literal: On dinghai day New Year's rites were performed in advance.

entries.zh: 戊子，如混同江。
entries.en: On wuzi day the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: On wuzi day went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 五年春正月壬申，如混同江。
entries.en: In the fifth year, on renshen day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on renshen day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 癸酉，賜宰相耶律孝傑名仁傑。
entries.en: On guiyou day chancellor Yelü Xiaojie was granted the name Renjie.
entries.literal: On guiyou day granted chancellor Yelü Xiaojie the name Renjie.

entries.zh: 乙亥，如山榆澱。
entries.en: On yihai day the court went to Shanyu Marsh.
entries.literal: On yihai day went to Shanyu Marsh.

entries.zh: 三月辛未，以宰相仁傑獲頭鵝，加侍中。
entries.en: On xinwei day of the third month, because Chancellor Renjie obtained a swan's head, he was promoted Palace Attendant.
entries.literal: Third month, on xinwei day, because Chancellor Renjie obtained a swan's head, he was promoted Palace Attendant.

entries.zh: 壬辰，以北院樞密使魏王耶律乙辛知南院大王事，加於越，知北院樞密使事耶律霂為北院樞密使，北院樞密副使耶律特裏底知北院樞密使事，左夷離畢耶律世遷同知北院樞密使事。
entries.en: On renchen day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs and promoted yuyue; Yelü Mu, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Telidi was made administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Shiqian was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On renchen day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs and promoted yuyue; Yelü Li, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Telidi administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Shiqian associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 夏四月己未，如納葛濼。
entries.en: On jiwei day of the fourth summer month the court went to Nage Marsh.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiwei day, went to Nage Marsh.

entries.zh: 五月丁亥，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the fifth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on dinghai day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 以契丹行宮都部署耶律燕哥為南府宰相，北面林牙耶律永寧為夷離畢，同知南院樞密使事蕭撻不也及殿前副點檢、駙馬都尉蕭酬斡並封蘭陵郡王。
entries.en: Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yange was made Southern Court chancellor; Northern linya Yelü Yongning was made yilibi; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Tabuye and Palace Front deputy commander and imperial son-in-law Xiao Chouwo were all enfeoffed Prince of Lanling Commandery.
entries.literal: Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yange Southern Court chancellor; Northern linya Yelü Yongning yilibi; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Tabuye and Palace Front deputy commander and imperial son-in-law Xiao Chouwo were all enfeoffed Prince of Lanling Commandery.

entries.zh: 六月辛亥，阻卜來貢。
entries.en: On xinhai day of the sixth month Zubu came with tribute.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on xinhai day, Zubu came with tribute.

entries.zh: 丁巳，以北府宰相、遼西郡王蕭餘里也為西北路招討使。
entries.en: On dingsi day Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.
entries.literal: On dingsi day Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.

entries.zh: 己未，遣使隸囚。
entries.en: On jiwei day envoys were dispatched to review prisoners.
entries.literal: On jiwei day dispatched envoys to review prisoners.

entries.zh: 是月，放進士劉瓘等百一十三人。
entries.en: That month the jinshi Liu Guan and one hundred thirteen others were passed.
entries.literal: That month the jinshi Liu Guan and one hundred thirteen others were passed.

entries.zh: 秋七月己卯，獵夾山。
entries.en: On jimao day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Jia Mountain.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jimao day, hunted at Jia Mountain.

entries.zh: 八月庚申，命有司撰《太宗神功碑》，立於南京。
entries.en: On gengshen day of the eighth month the relevant offices were ordered to compose the 《Stele of Taizong's Divine Merit》 and erect it at Nanjing.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on gengshen day, ordered the relevant offices to compose the 《Stele of Taizong's Divine Merit》 and erect it at Nanjing.

entries.zh: 九月己卯，詔諸路毋禁僧徒開壇。
entries.en: On jimao day of the ninth month an edict ordered all routes not to forbid monks from opening altars.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on jimao day, edict ordered all routes not to forbid monks from opening altars.

entries.zh: 壬午，禁扈從擾民。
entries.en: On renwu day escorts were forbidden to harass the people.
entries.literal: On renwu day forbidden escorts to harass the people.

entries.zh: 冬十月戊戌，夏國遣使來貢。
entries.en: On wuxu day of the tenth winter month Xia State sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuxu day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 己亥，駐蹕獨盧金。
entries.en: On jihai day the court halted at Dulujin.
entries.literal: On jihai day halted at Dulujin.

entries.zh: 壬子，詔惟皇子仍一字王，餘並削降。
entries.en: On renzi day an edict ordered that only imperial sons might remain single-character princes; the rest were all demoted.
entries.literal: On renzi day, edict ordered that only imperial sons might remain single-character princes; the rest were all demoted.

entries.zh: 丁巳，振平州貧民。
entries.en: On dingsi day poor people in Ping Prefecture were relieved.
entries.literal: On dingsi day relieved poor people in Ping Prefecture.

entries.zh: 己未，以趙王楊績為遼西郡王，魏王耶律乙辛降封混同郡王，吳王蕭韓家奴蘭陵郡王，致仕。
entries.en: On jiwei day Prince of Zhao Yang Ji was made Prince of Liaoxi; Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was demoted to Prince of Huntong Commandery; Prince of Wu Xiao Hanjianu Prince of Lanling Commandery, retired.
entries.literal: On jiwei day Prince of Zhao Yang Ji was made Prince of Liaoxi; Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was demoted to Prince of Huntong Commandery; Prince of Wu Xiao Hanjianu Prince of Lanling Commandery, retired.

entries.zh: 十一月丁丑，召沙門守道開壇於內殿。
entries.en: On dingchou day of the eleventh month monk Shoudao was summoned to open an altar in the inner hall.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on dingchou day summoned monk Shoudao to open an altar in the inner hall.

entries.zh: 癸未，復南京流民差役三年，被火之家免租稅一年。
entries.en: On guiwei day Nanjing refugees' corvée was remitted for three years; households that had suffered fire were exempt from rent and tax for one year.
entries.literal: On guiwei day Nanjing refugees' corvée was remitted for three years; households that had suffered fire were exempt from rent and tax for one year.

entries.zh: 十二月丙午，彗星犯尾。
entries.en: On bingwu day of the twelfth month a comet violated the Tail constellation.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on bingwu day a comet violated the Tail constellation.

entries.zh: 乙卯，幸西京。
entries.en: On yimao day the court visited the Western Capital.
entries.literal: On yimao day visited the Western Capital.

entries.zh: 戊午，行再生禮，赦雜犯死罪以下。
entries.en: On wuwu day the rebirth ritual was performed; amnesty was granted for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.
entries.literal: On wuwu day performed the rebirth ritual; amnesty for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.

entries.zh: 九年春正月辛巳，如春水。
entries.en: In the ninth year, on xinsi day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.
entries.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on xinsi day, went to spring waters.

entries.zh: 夏四月丙午朔，大雪，平地丈餘，馬死者十六七。
entries.en: On the bingwu new moon of the fourth summer month heavy snow fell more than a zhang deep on level ground; sixty or seventy percent of horses died.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingwu new moon, heavy snow fell more than a zhang deep on level ground; sixty or seventy percent of horses died.

entries.zh: 五月，如黑嶺。
entries.en: In the fifth month the court went to Heiling.
entries.literal: Fifth month went to Heiling.

entries.zh: 六月己未，駐蹕散水原。
entries.en: On jiwei day of the sixth month the court halted at Sanshui Plain.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jiwei day, halted at Sanshui Plain.
