entries.zh: 甲子，以耶律阿思為契丹行宮都部署，耶律慎思北院樞密副使。
entries.en: On jiazi day Yelü Asi was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; Yelü Shensi Northern Court associate privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On jiazi day Yelü Asi was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; Yelü Shensi Northern Court associate privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 庚午，詔諸路檢括脫戶，罪至死者，原之。
entries.en: On gengwu day an edict ordered all routes to register escaped households; offenses reaching death were pardoned.
entries.literal: On gengwu day, edict ordered all routes to register escaped households; offenses reaching death were pardoned.

entries.zh: 閏月丁丑，以漢人行宮副部署可汗奴為南院大王。
entries.en: In the intercalary month, on dingchou day, Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Kehannu was made Southern Court great king.
entries.literal: Intercalary month, on dingchou day Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Kehannu was made Southern Court great king.

entries.zh: 戊寅，追謚庶人浚為昭懷太子。
entries.en: On wuyin day the commoner Jun was posthumously honored as Crown Prince Zhaohuai.
entries.literal: On wuyin day posthumously honored the commoner Jun as Crown Prince Zhaohuai.

entries.zh: 丁亥，阻卜來貢。
entries.en: On dinghai day Zubu came with tribute.
entries.literal: On dinghai day Zubu came with tribute.

entries.zh: 己丑，以知興中府事邢熙年為漢人行宮都部署，漢人行宮都部署王績為南院樞密副使。
entries.en: On jichou day Xingzhong Prefecture administrator Xing Xinian was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Han mobile palace deployment director Wang Ji Southern Court associate privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On jichou day Xingzhong Prefecture administrator Xing Xinian was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Han mobile palace deployment director Wang Ji Southern Court associate privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 秋七月乙巳，獵馬尾山。
entries.en: On yisi day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Mawei Mountain.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yisi day hunted at Mawei Mountain.

entries.zh: 丁巳，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On dingsi day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On dingsi day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 癸亥，禁外官部內貸錢取息及使者館於民家。
entries.en: On guihai day outer officials were forbidden to lend money at interest within their jurisdictions and envoys were forbidden to lodge in commoners' houses.
entries.literal: On guihai day forbidden outer officials to lend money at interest within their jurisdictions and forbidden envoys to lodge in commoners' houses.

entries.zh: 八月，高麗王徽薨。
entries.en: In the eighth month Goryeo king Hui died.
entries.literal: Eighth month, Goryeo king Hui died.

entries.zh: 九月癸卯朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the guimao new moon of the ninth month there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on guimao new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 己酉，射熊於白石山，加圍場使涅葛左金吾衛大將軍。
entries.en: On jiyou day a bear was shot at Baishi Mountain; hunting-grounds commissioner Niege was promoted Left Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general.
entries.literal: On jiyou day shot a bear at Baishi Mountain; hunting-grounds commissioner Niege promoted Left Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general.

entries.zh: 己巳，以高麗王徽子三韓國公勛權知國事。
entries.en: On jisi day Goryeo king Hui's son Duke of Three Han Xun was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.
entries.literal: On jisi day Goryeo king Hui's son Duke of Three Han Xun was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.

entries.zh: 辛未，五國部長來貢。
entries.en: On xinwei day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
entries.literal: On xinwei day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

entries.zh: 壬申，召北、南樞密院官議政事。
entries.en: On renshen day Northern and Southern Privy Council officials were summoned to discuss government.
entries.literal: On renshen day summoned Northern and Southern Privy Council officials to discuss government.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁丑，謁觀德黔。
entries.en: On dingchou day of the tenth winter month the court paid respects at Guande Hall.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingchou day paid respects at Guande Hall.

entries.zh: 己卯，南院樞密使劉筠薨。
entries.en: On jimao day Southern Court privy commissioner Liu Yun died.
entries.literal: On jimao day Southern Court privy commissioner Liu Yun died.

entries.zh: 壬辰，混同郡王耶律乙辛謀亡入宋，伏誅。
entries.en: On renchen day Prince of Huntong Commandery Yelü Yixin plotted to flee into Song and was executed.
entries.literal: On renchen day Prince of Huntong Commandery Yelü Yixin plotted to flee into Song and was executed.

entries.zh: 十一月丙午，進封梁王延禧為燕國王，大赦。
entries.en: On bingwu day of the eleventh month Prince of Liang Yanxi was advanced to Prince of Yan and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on bingwu day advanced Prince of Liang Yanxi to Prince of Yan and proclaimed a general amnesty.

entries.zh: 以南院宣徽使蕭何葛為南府宰相，三司使王經參知政事兼知樞密事。
entries.en: Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hege was made Southern Court chancellor; Three Departments commissioner Wang Jing Associate Administrator of Affairs and administrator of privy affairs.
entries.literal: Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hege was made Southern Court chancellor; Three Departments commissioner Wang Jing Associate Administrator of Affairs and administrator of privy affairs.

entries.zh: 甲寅，詔僧善知讎校高麗所進佛經，頒行之。
entries.en: On jiayin day an edict ordered monk Shanzhi to collate Buddhist scriptures presented by Goryeo and promulgate them.
entries.literal: On jiayin day, edict ordered monk Shanzhi to collate Buddhist scriptures presented by Goryeo and promulgate them.

entries.zh: 己未，定諸令史、譯史遷敘等級。
entries.en: On jiwei day promotion grades were fixed for various clerks and translators.
entries.literal: On jiwei day fixed promotion grades for various clerks and translators.

entries.zh: 十二月丁亥，以邢熙年知南院樞密使事。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the twelfth month Xing Xinian was made to administer Southern Court privy affairs.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on dinghai day Xing Xinian was made to administer Southern Court privy affairs.

entries.zh: 辛卯，以王言敷為漢人行宮都部署。
entries.en: On xinmao day Wang Yanfu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.
entries.literal: On xinmao day Wang Yanfu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.

entries.zh: 高麗三韓國公王勛薨。
entries.en: Goryeo Duke of Three Han Wang Xun died.
entries.literal: Goryeo Duke of Three Han Wang Xun died.

entries.zh: 是年，御前放進士李君裕等五十一人。
entries.en: That year before the throne the jinshi Li Junyu and fifty-one others were passed.
entries.literal: That year before the throne the jinshi Li Junyu and fifty-one others were passed.

entries.zh: 八年春正月甲申，如混同江。
entries.en: In the eighth year, on jiashen day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on jiashen day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 丁酉，鐵驪、五國諸長各貢方物。
entries.en: On dingyou day chiefs of Tieli and the Five States each presented local products.
entries.literal: On dingyou day chiefs of Tieli and the Five States each presented local products.

entries.zh: 二月戊午，如山榆澱。
entries.en: On wuwu day of the second month the court went to Shanyu Marsh.
entries.literal: Second month, on wuwu day, went to Shanyu Marsh.

entries.zh: 辛酉，詔北、南院官，凡給驛者，必先奏聞。
entries.en: On xinyou day an edict ordered Northern and Southern Court officials: whoever used post stations must first memorialize.
entries.literal: On xinyou day, edict ordered Northern and Southern Court officials: whoever used post stations must first memorialize.

entries.zh: 貢新及奏獄訟，方許馳驛，餘並禁之。
entries.en: Only when presenting tribute of new products or memorializing criminal cases might they ride post relays; the rest were all forbidden.
entries.literal: Only when presenting tribute of new products or memorializing criminal cases might they ride post relays; the rest were all forbidden.

entries.zh: 己巳，夏國獲宋將張天一，遣使來獻。
entries.en: On jisi day Xia State captured Song general Zhang Tianyi and sent envoys to present him.
entries.literal: On jisi day Xia State captured Song general Zhang Tianyi and dispatched envoys to present him.

entries.zh: 壬申，以耶律頗德為南府宰相兼知北院樞密使，燕哥為惕隱，蕭撻不也兼知契丹行宮都部署事。
entries.en: On renshen day Yelü Pode was made Southern Court chancellor and also administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Yange tiyin; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.
entries.literal: On renshen day Yelü Pode was made Southern Court chancellor and also administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Yange tiyin; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.

entries.zh: 三月庚戌，黃龍府女直部長術乃率部民內附，予官，賜印綬。
entries.en: On gengxu day of the third month Huanglong Prefecture Jurchen tribal chief Sunai led his tribesmen to submit; office was granted and seals were bestowed.
entries.literal: Third month, on gengxu day Huanglong Prefecture Jurchen tribal chief Sunai led his tribesmen to submit; office was granted and seals bestowed.

entries.zh: 是月，詔行黍所定升斗。
entries.en: That month an edict ordered use of the sheng and dou measures fixed by the millet standard.
entries.literal: That month, edict ordered use of the sheng and dou measures fixed by the millet standard.

entries.zh: 夏四月壬戌，以耶律世遷為上京留守。
entries.en: On renxu day of the fourth summer month Yelü Shiqian was made supreme capital regent.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renxu day Yelü Shiqian was made supreme capital regent.

entries.zh: 六月辛亥朔，駐蹕納葛濼。
entries.en: On the xinhai new moon of the sixth month the court halted at Nage Marsh.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on xinhai new moon, halted at Nage Marsh.

entries.zh: 丙辰，夏國遣使來貢。
entries.en: On bingchen day Xia State sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On bingchen day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 丁巳，以耶律頗德為北院樞密使，耶律巢哥南府宰相，劉筠南院樞密使，蕭撻不也兼知北院樞密使事，王績漢人行宮都部署，蕭酬斡國舅詳穩。
entries.en: On dingsi day Yelü Pode was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Yelü Chaoge Southern Court chancellor; Liu Yun Southern Court privy commissioner; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Wang Ji Han mobile palace deployment director; Xiao Chouwo imperial maternal uncle detail-stable.
entries.literal: On dingsi day Yelü Pode was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Yelü Chaoge Southern Court chancellor; Liu Yun Southern Court privy commissioner; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Wang Ji Han mobile palace deployment director; Xiao Chouwo imperial maternal uncle detail-stable.

entries.zh: 乙丑，阻卜長來貢。
entries.en: On yichou day Zubu chiefs came with tribute.
entries.literal: On yichou day Zubu chiefs came with tribute.

entries.zh: 丙子，以耶律慎思知右夷離畢事。
entries.en: On bingzi day Yelü Shensi was made administrator of Right yilibi affairs.
entries.literal: On bingzi day Yelü Shensi was made administrator of Right yilibi affairs.

entries.zh: 秋七月甲午，如秋山。
entries.en: On jiawu day of the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiawu day, went to autumn mountains.

entries.zh: 南京霖雨，沙河溢永清、歸義、新城、安次、武清、香河六縣，傷稼。
entries.en: Nanjing had continuous rain; the Sha River overflowed Yongqing, Guiyi, Xincheng, Anci, Wuqing, and Xianghe six counties and injured the crops.
entries.literal: Nanjing had continuous rain; the Sha River overflowed Yongqing, Guiyi, Xincheng, Anci, Wuqing, and Xianghe six counties and injured the crops.

entries.zh: 九月庚寅，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On gengyin day of the ninth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on gengyin day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 丁未，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On dingwei day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: On dingwei day halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 大風雪，牛馬多死，賜扈從官以下衣馬有差。
entries.en: Great wind and snow fell; many cattle and horses died; clothing and horses were bestowed on escort officials and below by degree.
entries.literal: Great wind and snow; many cattle and horses died; clothing and horses were bestowed on escort officials and below by degree.

entries.zh: 冬十月乙卯，詔化哥傅導梁王延禧，加金吾衛大將軍。
entries.en: On yimao day of the tenth winter month an edict ordered Huage to tutor Prince of Liang Yanxi and promoted him Grand General of the Jinwu Guard.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yimao day, edict ordered Huage to tutor Prince of Liang Yanxi; promoted Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general.

entries.zh: 丙子，謁乾陵。
entries.en: On bingzi day the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On bingzi day paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 十一月壬午，以乙室大王蕭何葛為南院宣徽使。
entries.en: On renwu day of the eleventh month Yishi great king Xiao Hege was made Southern Court palace commissioner.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on renwu day Yishi great king Xiao Hege was made Southern Court palace commissioner.

entries.zh: 權知奚六部大王事圖趕為本部大王。
entries.en: Acting administrator of Xi Six Tribes great king affairs Tugan was made great king of that tribe.
entries.literal: Acting administrator of Xi Six Tribes great king affairs Tugan was made great king of that tribe.

entries.zh: 十二月癸丑，烏古敵烈統軍使耶律馬五為北院大王。
entries.en: On guichou day of the twelfth month Wugu Dilie supreme commander Yelü Mawu was made Northern Court great king.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on guichou day Wugu Dilie supreme commander Yelü Mawu was made Northern Court great king.

entries.zh: 庚申，降皇后為惠妃，出居乾陵。
entries.en: On gengshen day the Empress was demoted to Consort Hui and sent to dwell at Qian Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On gengshen day the Empress was demoted to Consort Hui and sent to dwell at Qian Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 十年春正月辛丑朔，如春水。
entries.en: In the tenth year, on the xinchou new moon of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.
entries.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on xinchou new moon, went to spring waters.

entries.zh: 丙午，復建南京奉福寺浮圖。
entries.en: On bingwu day the pagoda of Nanjing's Fengfu Temple was rebuilt.
entries.literal: On bingwu day rebuilt the pagoda of Nanjing's Fengfu Temple.

entries.zh: 戊辰，如山榆澱。
entries.en: On wuchen day the court went to Shanyu Marsh.
entries.literal: On wuchen day went to Shanyu Marsh.

entries.zh: 二月庚午朔，萌古國遣使來聘。
entries.en: On the gengwu new moon of the second month Menggu State sent envoys with a friendly mission.
entries.literal: Second month, on gengwu new moon, Menggu State dispatched envoys with a friendly mission.

entries.zh: 三月戊申，遠萌古國遣使來聘。
entries.en: On wushen day of the third month distant Menggu State sent envoys with a friendly mission.
entries.literal: Third month, on wushen day distant Menggu State dispatched envoys with a friendly mission.

entries.zh: 丁巳，命知制誥王師儒、牌印郎君耶律固傅導燕國王延禧。
entries.en: On dingsi day drafting edict commissioner Wang Shiru and seal-and-tally langjun Yelü Gu were ordered to tutor Prince of Yan Yanxi.
entries.literal: On dingsi day ordered drafting edict commissioner Wang Shiru and seal-and-tally langjun Yelü Gu to tutor Prince of Yan Yanxi.

entries.zh: 夏四月丁丑，女直貢良馬。
entries.en: On dingchou day of the fourth summer month Jurchen presented fine horses.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingchou day Jurchen presented fine horses.

entries.zh: 五月壬戌，駐蹕散水原。
entries.en: On renxu day of the fifth month the court halted at Sanshui Plain.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on renxu day, halted at Sanshui Plain.

entries.zh: 乙丑，阻卜來貢。
entries.en: On yichou day Zubu came with tribute.
entries.literal: On yichou day Zubu came with tribute.

entries.zh: 丙寅，降國舅詳穩班位在敞穩之下。
entries.en: On bingyin day imperial maternal uncle detail-stable rank was demoted to below detail-stable.
entries.literal: On bingyin day demoted imperial maternal uncle detail-stable rank to below detail-stable.

entries.zh: 六月壬辰，禁毀銅錢為器。
entries.en: On renchen day of the sixth month destroying copper cash to make vessels was forbidden.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on renchen day forbidden destroying copper cash to make vessels.

entries.zh: 秋七月甲辰，如黑嶺。
entries.en: On jiachen day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Heiling.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiachen day, went to Heiling.

entries.zh: 九月癸亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On guihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on guihai day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 冬十二月乙未，改慶州大安軍曰興平。
entries.en: On yiwei day of the twelfth winter month Qing Prefecture's Da'an Army was changed to Xingping.
entries.literal: Winter, twelfth month, on yiwei day changed Qing Prefecture's Da'an Army to Xingping.

entries.zh: 是月，改明年為大安，赦雜犯死罪以下。
entries.en: That month the coming year was changed to Da'an and amnesty was granted for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.
entries.literal: That month the coming year was changed to Da'an and amnesty for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.

entries.zh: 大安元年春正月丁酉，如混同江。
entries.en: In the first year of Da'an, on dingyou day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the first year of Da'an, spring, first month, on dingyou day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 癸卯，王績知南院樞密使事，邢熙年為中京留守。
entries.en: On guimao day Wang Ji was made administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Xing Xinian regent of the Central Capital.
entries.literal: On guimao day Wang Ji administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Xing Xinian regent of the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 戊申，以樞密直學士杜公謂參知政事。
entries.en: On wushen day Privy Council academician Du Gongwei was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
entries.literal: On wushen day Privy Council academician Du Gongwei Associate Administrator of Affairs.

entries.zh: 庚戌，五國酋長來貢良馬。
entries.en: On gengxu day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute of fine horses.
entries.literal: On gengxu day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute of fine horses.

entries.zh: 二月辛未，如山榆澱。
entries.en: On xinwei day of the second month the court went to Shanyu Marsh.
entries.literal: Second month, on xinwei day went to Shanyu Marsh.

entries.zh: 夏四月乙酉，宋主頊殂，子煦嗣位，使來告哀。
entries.en: On yiyou day of the fourth summer month Song ruler Xiang died; his son Xu succeeded; envoys came to announce the mourning.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yiyou day Song ruler Xiang died; his son Xu succeeded; envoys came to announce the mourning.

entries.zh: 辛卯，西幸。
entries.en: On xinmao day the court traveled west.
entries.literal: On xinmao day traveled west.

entries.zh: 六月戊辰，駐蹕拖古烈。
entries.en: On wuchen day of the sixth month the court halted at Tuogulie.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on wuchen day, halted at Tuogulie.

entries.zh: 壬申，以王績為南府宰相，蕭撻不也兼知南院樞密使事。
entries.en: On renshen day Wang Ji was made Southern Court chancellor; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Southern Court privy affairs.
entries.literal: On renshen day Wang Ji was made Southern Court chancellor; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Southern Court privy affairs.

entries.zh: 丁丑，遣使吊祭於宋。
entries.en: On dingchou day envoys were dispatched to offer condolences in Song.
entries.literal: On dingchou day dispatched envoys to offer condolences in Song.

entries.zh: 戊寅，宋遣王真、甄佑等饋其先帝遺物。
entries.en: On wuyin day Song sent Wang Zhen, Zhen You, and others presenting the late emperor's bequeathed goods.
entries.literal: On wuyin day Song sent Wang Zhen, Zhen You, and others presenting the late emperor's bequeathed goods.

entries.zh: 秋七月乙巳，遣使賀宋主即位。
entries.en: On yisi day of the seventh autumn month envoys were dispatched to congratulate the Song ruler on his accession.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yisi day dispatched envoys to congratulate the Song ruler on his accession.

entries.zh: 戊午，獵於赤山。
entries.en: On wuwu day the court hunted at Red Mountain.
entries.literal: On wuwu day hunted at Red Mountain.

entries.zh: 八月丁卯，幸慶州。
entries.en: On dingmao day of the eighth month the court visited Qing Prefecture.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on dingmao day visited Qing Prefecture.

entries.zh: 戊辰，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On wuchen day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On wuchen day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 冬十月癸亥，駐蹕好草澱。
entries.en: On guihai day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Haocao Marsh.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on guihai day, halted at Haocao Marsh.

entries.zh: 戊辰，夏國王李秉常遣使報其母梁氏哀。
entries.en: On wuchen day Xia State king Li Bingchang sent envoys to announce his mother Lady Liang's mourning.
entries.literal: On wuchen day Xia State king Li Bingchang dispatched envoys to announce his mother Lady Liang's mourning.

entries.zh: 甲申，以蕭撻不也為南院樞密使。
entries.en: On jiashen day Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On jiashen day Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 十一月乙未，詔「比者外官因譽進秩，久而不調，民被其害。
entries.en: On yiwei day of the eleventh month an edict said: "Lately outer officials have advanced in rank through praise and long go without transfer, harming the people.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei day, edict said: "Lately outer officials have advanced in rank through praise and long go without transfer, harming the people.

entries.zh: 今後皆以資給遷轉。」
entries.en: Henceforth all are to be transferred according to seniority of service."
entries.literal: Henceforth all are to be transferred according to seniority of service."

entries.zh: 丁酉，以南女直詳穩蕭袍裏為北府宰相。
entries.en: On dingyou day Southern Jurchen detail-stable Xiao Paoli was made Northern Court chancellor.
entries.literal: On dingyou day Southern Jurchen detail-stable Xiao Paoli was made Northern Court chancellor.

entries.zh: 辛亥，史臣進太祖以下七帝《實錄》。
entries.en: On xinhai day historians presented the 《Veritable Records》 of the seven emperors from Taizu downward.
entries.literal: On xinhai day historians presented the 《Veritable Records》 of the seven emperors from Taizu downward.

entries.zh: 丙辰，遣使冊三韓國公王勛弟運為高麗國王。
entries.en: On bingchen day envoys were dispatched to invest Duke of Three Han Wang Xun's younger brother Yun as king of Goryeo.
entries.literal: On bingchen day dispatched envoys to invest Duke of Three Han Wang Xun's younger brother Yun as king of Goryeo.

entries.zh: 己未，詔僧尼無故不得赴闕。
entries.en: On jiwei day an edict ordered monks and nuns not to come to court without cause.
entries.literal: On jiwei day, edict ordered monks and nuns not to come to court without cause.

entries.zh: 十二月甲戌，宋遣蔡卞來謝吊祭。
entries.en: On jiaxu day of the twelfth month Song sent Cai Bian to thank for the condolence mission.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on jiaxu day Song dispatched Cai Bian to thank for the condolence mission.

entries.zh: 二年春正月辛卯，如混同江。
entries.en: In the second year, on xinmao day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on xinmao day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 己酉，五國諸部長來貢。
entries.en: On jiyou day chieftains of various Five States tribes came with tribute.
entries.literal: On jiyou day chieftains of various Five States tribes came with tribute.

entries.zh: 癸丑，召權翰林學士趙孝嚴、知制誥王師儒等講《五經》大義。
entries.en: On guichou day acting Hanlin academician Zhao Xiaoyan, drafting edict commissioner Wang Shiru, and others were summoned to lecture on the great meaning of the 《Five Classics》.
entries.literal: On guichou day summoned acting Hanlin academician Zhao Xiaoyan, drafting edict commissioner Wang Shiru, and others to lecture on the great meaning of the 《Five Classics》.

entries.zh: 二月癸酉，駐蹕山榆澱。
entries.en: On guiyou day of the second month the court halted at Shanyu Marsh.
entries.literal: Second month, on guiyou day, halted at Shanyu Marsh.

entries.zh: 是月，太白犯歲星。
entries.en: That month Venus violated Jupiter.
entries.literal: That month Venus violated Jupiter.

entries.zh: 三月乙酉，女直貢良馬。
entries.en: On yiyou day of the third month Jurchen presented fine horses.
entries.literal: Third month, on yiyou day Jurchen presented fine horses.

entries.zh: 夏四月戊戌，北幸。
entries.en: On wuxu day of the fourth summer month the court traveled north.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuxu day, traveled north.

entries.zh: 癸丑，遣使加統軍使蕭訛都斡太子太保，裨將老古金吾衛大將軍，蕭雅哥靜江軍節度使，耶律燕奴右監門衛大將軍，仍賜賚諸軍士。
entries.en: On guichou day envoys were dispatched to promote supreme commander Xiao Eduwo to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, deputy general Laogu to Grand General of the Jinwu Guard, Xiao Yage to military commissioner of Jingjiang Army, and Yelü Yannu to Grand General of the Right Gate Guard, and also to bestow rewards on the troops.
entries.literal: On guichou day dispatched envoys to promote supreme commander Xiao Eduwo to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, deputy general Laogu to Grand General of the Jinwu Guard, Xiao Yage to military commissioner of Jingjiang Army, and Yelü Yannu to Grand General of the Right Gate Guard, and also to bestow rewards on the troops.

entries.zh: 五月丁巳朔，以牧馬蕃息多至百萬，賞群牧官，以次進階。
entries.en: On the dingsi new moon of the fifth month, because herds had multiplied to as many as a million, herd officials were rewarded and advanced in rank by degree.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on dingsi new moon, because herds had multiplied to as many as a million, herd officials were rewarded and advanced in rank by degree.

entries.zh: 乙亥，駐蹕納葛濼。
entries.en: On yihai day the court halted at Nage Marsh.
entries.literal: On yihai day halted at Nage Marsh.

entries.zh: 戊寅，宰相梁穎出知興中府事。
entries.en: On wuyin day Chancellor Liang Ying was sent out as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
entries.literal: On wuyin day Chancellor Liang Ying was sent out as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.

entries.zh: 是月，放進士張轂等二十六人。
entries.en: That month the jinshi Zhang Gu and twenty-six others were passed.
entries.literal: That month the jinshi Zhang Gu and twenty-six others were passed.

entries.zh: 六月丁亥朔，以左夷離畢耶律坦為惕隱，知樞密院事耶律斡特剌兼知左夷離畢事。
entries.en: On the dinghai new moon of the sixth month Left yilibi Yelü Tan was made tiyin; Yelü Wotela, who administered Privy Council affairs, also administrator of Left yilibi affairs.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on dinghai new moon, Left yilibi Yelü Tan tiyin; Yelü Wotela, who administered Privy Council affairs, also administrator of Left yilibi affairs.

entries.zh: 丙申，阻卜來朝。
entries.en: On bingshen day Zubu came to court.
entries.literal: On bingshen day Zubu came to court.

entries.zh: 癸卯，遣使按諸路獄。
entries.en: On guimao day envoys were dispatched to investigate prisons in all routes.
entries.literal: On guimao day dispatched envoys to investigate prisons in all routes.

entries.zh: 甲辰，以同知南京留守事耶律那也知右夷離畢事。
entries.en: On jiachen day associate regent of Nanjing Yelü Naye was made administrator of Right yilibi affairs.
entries.literal: On jiachen day associate regent of Nanjing Yelü Naye administrator of Right yilibi affairs.

entries.zh: 乙巳，阻卜酋長余古赧及愛的來朝，詔燕國王延禧相結為友。
entries.en: On yisi day Zubu chiefs Yugunian and Aide came to court; an edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to bond with them as friends.
entries.literal: On yisi day Zubu chiefs Yugunian and Aide came to court; edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to bond with them as friends.

entries.zh: 戊申，以契丹行宮都部署耶律阿思兼知北院大王事。
entries.en: On wushen day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Asi was also made administrator of Northern Court great king affairs.
entries.literal: On wushen day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Asi also administrator of Northern Court great king affairs.

entries.zh: 壬子，高墩以下、縣令、錄事兄弟及子，悉許敘用。
entries.en: On renzi day Gaodun and below, county magistrates, and record clerks' brothers and sons were all permitted to enter service by seniority.
entries.literal: On renzi day Gaodun and below, county magistrates, and record clerks' brothers and sons were all permitted to enter service by seniority.

entries.zh: 秋七月丁巳，惠妃母燕國夫人削古以厭魅梁王事覺，伏誅，子蘭陵郡王蕭酬斡除名，置邊郡，仍隸興聖宮。
entries.en: On dingsi day of the seventh autumn month Consort Hui's mother Xiaogu, Lady of Yan State, because sorcery against Prince of Liang was exposed, was executed; her son Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Chouwo was struck from the register and placed in a border commandery, still attached to Xing Sheng Palace.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dingsi day Consort Hui's mother Xiaogu, Lady of Yan State, because sorcery against Prince of Liang was exposed, was executed; her son Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Chouwo was struck from the register and placed in a border commandery, still attached to Xing Sheng Palace.

entries.zh: 戊午，獵沙嶺。
entries.en: On wuwu day the court hunted at Shaling.
entries.literal: On wuwu day hunted at Shaling.

entries.zh: 甲子，賜興聖、積慶二宮貧民錢。
entries.en: On jiazi day money was bestowed on poor people of Xing Sheng and Jiqing palaces.
entries.literal: On jiazi day money was bestowed on poor people of Xing Sheng and Jiqing palaces.

entries.zh: 乙酉，出粟振遼州貧民。
entries.en: On yiyou day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Liao Prefecture.
entries.literal: On yiyou day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Liao Prefecture.

entries.zh: 八月戊子，以雪罷獵。
entries.en: On wuzi day of the eighth month hunting was stopped because of snow.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on wuzi day hunting was stopped because of snow.

entries.zh: 九月庚午，還上京。
entries.en: On gengwu day of the ninth month the court returned to the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on gengwu day returned to the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 壬申，發粟振上京、中京貧民。
entries.en: On renshen day grain was issued to relieve poor people at the Supreme and Central capitals.
entries.literal: On renshen day grain was issued to relieve poor people at the Supreme and Central capitals.

entries.zh: 丙子，謁二儀、五鸞二殿。
entries.en: On bingzi day the court paid respects at the Two Principles and Five Phoenix halls.
entries.literal: On bingzi day paid respects at the Two Principles and Five Phoenix halls.

entries.zh: 己卯，出太祖、太宗所禦鎧仗示燕國王延禧，諭以創業征伐之難。
entries.en: On jimao day armor and weapons used by Taizu and Taizong were displayed to Prince of Yan Yanxi, instructing him on the hardship of founding and campaigning.
entries.literal: On jimao day displayed armor and weapons used by Taizu and Taizong to Prince of Yan Yanxi, instructing him on the hardship of founding and campaigning.

entries.zh: 辛巳，召南府宰相議國政。
entries.en: On xinsi day the Southern Court chancellor was summoned to discuss state affairs.
entries.literal: On xinsi day summoned the Southern Court chancellor to discuss state affairs.

entries.zh: 冬十月乙酉朔，以樞密副使竇景庸知樞密院事。
entries.en: On the yiyou new moon of the tenth winter month associate privy commissioner Dou Jingyong was made administrator of Privy Council affairs.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yiyou new moon, associate privy commissioner Dou Jingyong administrator of Privy Council affairs.

entries.zh: 丙戌，五國部長來貢。
entries.en: On bingxu day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
entries.literal: On bingxu day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

entries.zh: 丁亥，以夏國王李秉常薨，遣使詔其子乾順知國事。
entries.en: On dinghai day, because Xia State king Li Bingchang died, envoys were dispatched to inform his son Qianshun to administer state affairs.
entries.literal: On dinghai day, because Xia State king Li Bingchang died, dispatched envoys to inform his son Qianshun to administer state affairs.

entries.zh: 十一月甲戌，為燕國王延禧行再生禮，曲赦上京囚。
entries.en: On jiaxu day of the eleventh month the rebirth ritual was performed for Prince of Yan Yanxi; partial amnesty for prisoners at the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu day performed the rebirth ritual for Prince of Yan Yanxi; partial amnesty for prisoners at the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 戊寅，高麗遣使謝封冊。
entries.en: On wuyin day Goryeo sent envoys to thank for the investiture.
entries.literal: On wuyin day Goryeo dispatched envoys to thank for the investiture.

entries.zh: 癸未，出粟振乾、顯、成、懿四州貧民。
entries.en: On guiwei day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Qian, Xian, Cheng, and Yi prefectures.
entries.literal: On guiwei day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Qian, Xian, Cheng, and Yi prefectures.

entries.zh: 十二月辛卯，以蘭陵郡王蕭撻不也為南院樞密使。
entries.en: On xinmao day of the twelfth month Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on xinmao day Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 己亥，夏國王李乾順遣使上其父遺物。
entries.en: On jihai day Xia State king Li Qianshun sent envoys presenting his father's bequeathed goods.
entries.literal: On jihai day Xia State king Li Qianshun dispatched envoys presenting his father's bequeathed goods.

entries.zh: 道宗五
entries.en: Daozong, Part Five
entries.literal: Daozong, Part Five

entries.zh: 三年春正月乙卯，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: In the third year, on yimao day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on yimao day, went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 甲戌，出錢粟振南京貧民，仍復其租賦。
entries.en: On jiaxu day money and grain were issued to relieve poor people in Nanjing, and their rent and tax were also remitted.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day money and grain were issued to relieve poor people in Nanjing, and their rent and tax were also remitted.

entries.zh: 己卯，大雪。
entries.en: On jimao day heavy snow fell.
entries.literal: On jimao day heavy snow fell.

entries.zh: 二月丙戌，發粟振中京饑。
entries.en: On bingxu day of the second month grain was issued to relieve famine in the Central Capital.
entries.literal: Second month, on bingxu day, grain was issued to relieve famine in the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 甲辰，以民多流散，除安泊逃戶征償法。
entries.en: On jiachen day, because many people had drifted away, the law on collecting compensation from escaped households at Anbo was abolished.
entries.literal: On jiachen day, because many people had drifted away, the law on collecting compensation from escaped households at Anbo was abolished.

entries.zh: 三月乙卯，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On yimao day of the third month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Third month, on yimao day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 己未，免錦州貧民租一年。
entries.en: On jiwei day rent for poor people in Jin Prefecture was remitted for one year.
entries.literal: On jiwei day rent for poor people in Jin Prefecture was remitted for one year.

entries.zh: 甲戌，免上京貧民租如錦州。
entries.en: On jiaxu day rent for poor people at the Supreme Capital was remitted as at Jin Prefecture.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day rent for poor people at the Supreme Capital was remitted as at Jin Prefecture.

entries.zh: 庚辰，女直貢良馬。
entries.en: On gengchen day Jurchen presented fine horses.
entries.literal: On gengchen day Jurchen presented fine horses.

entries.zh: 夏四月戊子，賜中京貧民帛，及免諸路貢輸之半。
entries.en: On wuzi day of the fourth summer month silk was bestowed on poor people in the Central Capital, and half of tribute deliveries in all routes were remitted.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuzi day, silk was bestowed on poor people in the Central Capital, and half of tribute deliveries in all routes were remitted.

entries.zh: 丙申，賜隈烏古部貧民帛。
entries.en: On bingshen day silk was bestowed on poor people of the Kui Wugu tribe.
entries.literal: On bingshen day silk was bestowed on poor people of the Kui Wugu tribe.

entries.zh: 庚子，如涼陘。
entries.en: On gengzi day the court went to Liang Pass.
entries.literal: On gengzi day went to Liang Pass.

entries.zh: 甲辰，南府宰相王績薨。
entries.en: On jiachen day Southern Court chancellor Wang Ji died.
entries.literal: On jiachen day Southern Court chancellor Wang Ji died.

entries.zh: 乙巳，詔出戶部司粟，振諸路流民及義州之饑。
entries.en: On yisi day an edict ordered Household Department grain issued to relieve refugees in all routes and famine in Yi Prefecture.
entries.literal: On yisi day, edict ordered Household Department grain issued to relieve refugees in all routes and famine in Yi Prefecture.

entries.zh: 五月庚申，海雲寺進濟民錢千萬。
entries.en: On gengshen day of the fifth month Haiyun Temple presented ten million cash to aid the people.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on gengshen day Haiyun Temple presented ten million cash to aid the people.

entries.zh: 秋七月丙辰，獵黑嶺。
entries.en: On bingchen day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Heiling.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingchen day, hunted at Heiling.

entries.zh: 丁巳，出雜帛賜興聖宮貧民。
entries.en: On dingsi day miscellaneous silks were issued to relieve poor people of Xing Sheng Palace.
entries.literal: On dingsi day miscellaneous silks were issued to relieve poor people of Xing Sheng Palace.

entries.zh: 庚午，大雨，罷獵。
entries.en: On gengwu day heavy rain fell and hunting was stopped.
entries.literal: On gengwu day heavy rain fell and hunting was stopped.

entries.zh: 丁，秦越國王阿璉薨。
entries.en: On a ding day Prince of Qin and Yue Alian died.
entries.literal: On a ding day Prince of Qin and Yue Alian died.

entries.zh: 九月乙亥，駐蹕匣魯金。
entries.en: On yihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Xialujin.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on yihai day, halted at Xialujin.

entries.zh: 冬十月庚辰，以參知政事王經為三司使。
entries.en: On gengchen day of the tenth winter month Associate Administrator of Affairs Wang Jing was made Three Departments commissioner.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengchen day Associate Administrator of Affairs Wang Jing was made Three Departments commissioner.

entries.zh: 壬辰，罷節度使已下官進珍玩。
entries.en: On renchen day military commissioners and officials below were forbidden from presenting curios.
entries.literal: On renchen day forbidden military commissioners and officials below from presenting curios.

entries.zh: 癸卯，追封秦越國王阿璉為秦魏國王。
entries.en: On guimao day Prince of Qin and Yue Alian was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Qin and Wei.
entries.literal: On guimao day posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Qin and Yue Alian as Prince of Qin and Wei.

entries.zh: 十一月甲寅，以惕隱耶律坦同知南京留守事，遼興軍節度使耶律王九為南府宰相。
entries.en: On jiayin day of the eleventh month tiyin Yelü Tan was made associate regent of Nanjing; Liaoxing Army military commissioner Yelü Wangjiu was made Southern Court chancellor.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on jiayin day tiyin Yelü Tan associate regent of Nanjing; Liaoxing Army military commissioner Yelü Wangjiu Southern Court chancellor.

entries.zh: 十二月己卯朔，以樞密直學士呂嗣立參知政事。
entries.en: On the jimao new moon of the twelfth month Privy Council academician Lü Sili was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on jimao new moon, Privy Council academician Lü Sili Associate Administrator of Affairs.

entries.zh: 四年春正月庚戌，如混同江。
entries.en: In the fourth year, on gengxu day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on gengxu day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 甲寅，太白晝見。
entries.en: On jiayin day Venus was seen in daytime.
entries.literal: On jiayin day Venus was seen in daytime.

entries.zh: 甲子，五國部長來貢。
entries.en: On jiazi day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
entries.literal: On jiazi day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

entries.zh: 庚午，免上京逋逃及貧戶稅賦。
entries.en: On gengwu day rent and tax for fugitives and poor households at the Supreme Capital were remitted.
entries.literal: On gengwu day rent and tax for fugitives and poor households at the Supreme Capital were remitted.

entries.zh: 甲戌，以上京、南京饑，許良人自鬻。
entries.en: On jiaxu day, because the Supreme and Nanjing capitals had famine, commoners were permitted to sell themselves.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day, because the Supreme and Nanjing capitals had famine, commoners were permitted to sell themselves.

entries.zh: 丁丑，曲赦西京役徒。
entries.en: On dingchou day a partial amnesty was granted for convict laborers at the Western Capital.
entries.literal: On dingchou day partial amnesty for convict laborers at the Western Capital.

entries.zh: 二月己丑，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: On jichou day of the second month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: Second month, on jichou day, went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 甲午，曲赦春州役徒，終身者皆五歲免。
entries.en: On jiawu day a partial amnesty was granted for convict laborers at Chun Prefecture; those sentenced for life were all remitted after five years.
entries.literal: On jiawu day partial amnesty for convict laborers at Chun Prefecture; those sentenced for life all remitted after five years.

entries.zh: 己亥，如春州。
entries.en: On jihai day the court went to Chun Prefecture.
entries.literal: On jihai day went to Chun Prefecture.

entries.zh: 赦泰州役徒。
entries.en: Amnesty was granted for convict laborers at Tai Prefecture.
entries.literal: Amnesty for convict laborers at Tai Prefecture.

entries.zh: 三月己丑，免高麗歲貢。
entries.en: On jichou day of the third month Goryeo's yearly tribute was remitted.
entries.literal: Third month, on jichou day Goryeo's yearly tribute was remitted.

entries.zh: 己巳，振上京及平、錦、來三州饑。
entries.en: On jisi day famine at the Supreme Capital and Ping, Jin, and Lai prefectures was relieved.
entries.literal: On jisi day relieved famine at the Supreme Capital and Ping, Jin, and Lai prefectures.

entries.zh: 夏四月己卯，振蘇、吉、復、淥、鐵五州貧民，並免其租稅。
entries.en: On jimao day of the fourth summer month poor people in Su, Ji, Fu, Lu, and Tie prefectures were relieved and their rent and tax was remitted.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jimao day, relieved poor people in Su, Ji, Fu, Lu, and Tie prefectures and remitted their rent and tax.

entries.zh: 甲申，振慶州貧民。
entries.en: On jiashen day poor people in Qing Prefecture were relieved.
entries.literal: On jiashen day relieved poor people in Qing Prefecture.

entries.zh: 乙酉，減諸路常貢服御物。
entries.en: On yiyou day regular tribute of imperial goods in all routes was reduced.
entries.literal: On yiyou day regular tribute of imperial goods in all routes was reduced.

entries.zh: 丁酉，立入粟補官法。
entries.en: On dingyou day the law on entering grain to obtain office was established.
entries.literal: On dingyou day established the law on entering grain to obtain office.

entries.zh: 癸卯，西幸。
entries.en: On guimao day the court traveled west.
entries.literal: On guimao day traveled west.

entries.zh: 召樞密直學士耶律儼講《尚書·洪範》。
entries.en: Privy Council academician Yelü Yan was summoned to lecture on the 《Hongfan》 chapter of the 《Book of Documents》.
entries.literal: Summoned Privy Council academician Yelü Yan to lecture on the 《Hongfan》 chapter of the 《Book of Documents》.

entries.zh: 五月辛亥，命燕國王延禧寫《尚書·五子之歌》。
entries.en: On xinhai day of the fifth month Prince of Yan Yanxi was ordered to copy the 《Five Sons' Songs》 from the 《Book of Documents》.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on xinhai day, ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to copy the 《Five Sons' Songs》 from the 《Book of Documents》.

entries.zh: 乙卯，振祖州貧民。
entries.en: On yimao day poor people in Zu Prefecture were relieved.
entries.literal: On yimao day relieved poor people in Zu Prefecture.

entries.zh: 丁巳，詔免役徒，終身者五歲免之。
entries.en: On dingsi day an edict remitted convict labor; those sentenced for life were remitted after five years.
entries.literal: On dingsi day, edict remitted convict labor; those sentenced for life were remitted after five years.

entries.zh: 己未，振春州貧民。
entries.en: On jiwei day poor people in Chun Prefecture were relieved.
entries.literal: On jiwei day relieved poor people in Chun Prefecture.

entries.zh: 丙寅，禁挾私引水犯田。
entries.en: On bingyin day diverting water privately to encroach on fields was forbidden.
entries.literal: On bingyin day forbidden diverting water privately to encroach on fields.

entries.zh: 六月庚辰，駐蹕散水原。
entries.en: On gengchen day of the sixth month the court halted at Sanshui Plain.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on gengchen day, halted at Sanshui Plain.

entries.zh: 丁亥，命燕國王延禧知中丞司事，以同知南院樞密使事耶律聶裏知右夷離畢，知右夷離畢事耶律那也同知南院樞密使事。
entries.en: On dinghai day Prince of Yan Yanxi was ordered to administer Central Secretariat affairs; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Nieli was made administrator of Right yilibi affairs; Yelü Naye, who administered Right yilibi affairs, was made associate Southern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On dinghai day ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to administer Central Secretariat affairs; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Nieli administrator of Right yilibi affairs; Yelü Naye, who administered Right yilibi affairs, associate Southern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 庚寅，北院樞密使耶律頗德致仕。
entries.en: On gengyin day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Pode retired.
entries.literal: On gengyin day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Pode retired.

entries.zh: 秋七月戊申，曲赦奉聖州役徒。
entries.en: On wushen day of the seventh month a partial amnesty was granted for convict laborers at Fengsheng Prefecture.
entries.literal: Seventh month, on wushen day partial amnesty for convict laborers at Fengsheng Prefecture.

entries.zh: 丙辰，遣使冊李乾順為夏國王。
entries.en: On bingchen day envoys were dispatched to invest Li Qianshun as king of Xia State.
entries.literal: On bingchen day dispatched envoys to invest Li Qianshun as king of Xia State.

entries.zh: 庚申，如秋山。
entries.en: On gengshen day the court went to autumn mountains.
entries.literal: On gengshen day went to autumn mountains.

entries.zh: 己巳，禁錢出境。
entries.en: On jisi day cash was forbidden to leave the border.
entries.literal: On jisi day forbidden cash to leave the border.

entries.zh: 八月庚辰，有司奏宛平、永清蝗為飛鳥所食。
entries.en: On gengchen day of the eighth month the relevant offices memorialized that locusts in Wanping and Yongqing were eaten by birds.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on gengchen day the relevant offices memorialized that locusts in Wanping and Yongqing were eaten by birds.

entries.zh: 庚寅，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On gengyin day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On gengyin day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁丑，獵遼水之濱。
entries.en: On dingchou day of the tenth winter month the court hunted on the banks of the Liao River.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingchou day, hunted on the banks of the Liao River.

entries.zh: 己卯，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On jimao day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: On jimao day halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 癸未，免百姓所貸官粟。
entries.en: On guiwei day government grain lent to commoners was remitted.
entries.literal: On guiwei day government grain lent to commoners was remitted.

entries.zh: 己丑，知北院樞密使事耶律阿思封漆水郡王。
entries.en: On jichou day Yelü Asi, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.
entries.literal: On jichou day Yelü Asi, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.

entries.zh: 癸巳，以乙室大王耶律敵烈知西北路招討使事，權知西北路招討使事蕭朽哥知乙室大王事。
entries.en: On guisi day Yishi great king Yelü Dilie was made to administer Northwest Route pacification affairs; acting Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Xiuge was made administrator of Yishi great king affairs.
entries.literal: On guisi day Yishi great king Yelü Dilie was made to administer Northwest Route pacification affairs; acting Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Xiuge administrator of Yishi great king affairs.

entries.zh: 壬寅，詔諸部長官親鞫獄訟。
entries.en: On renyin day an edict ordered tribal chiefs in all tribes to judge lawsuits in person.
entries.literal: On renyin day, edict ordered tribal chiefs in all tribes to judge lawsuits in person.

entries.zh: 十一月庚申，興中府民張化法以父兄犯盜當之，請代，皆免。
entries.en: On gengshen day of the eleventh month Xingzhong Prefecture commoner Zhang Huafa, because his father and elder brother had committed robbery for which he should stand punishment, begged to substitute; all were pardoned.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on gengshen day Xingzhong Prefecture commoner Zhang Huafa, because his father and elder brother had committed robbery for which he should stand punishment, begged to substitute; all were pardoned.

entries.zh: 十二月戊寅，南府宰相耶律王九致仕。
entries.en: On wuyin day of the twelfth month Southern Court chancellor Yelü Wangjiu retired.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on wuyin day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Wangjiu retired.

entries.zh: 癸未，以孟父敞穩耶律慎思為中京留守。
entries.en: On guiwei day Mengfu detail-stable Yelü Shensi was made regent of the Central Capital.
entries.literal: On guiwei day Mengfu detail-stable Yelü Shensi was made regent of the Central Capital.

entries.zh: 閏十二月癸卯朔，預行正旦禮。
entries.en: On the guimao new moon of the intercalary twelfth month New Year's rites were performed in advance.
entries.literal: Intercalary twelfth month, on guimao new moon, New Year's rites were performed in advance.

entries.zh: 丙午，如混同江。
entries.en: On bingwu day the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: On bingwu day went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 五年春正月癸未，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: In the fifth year, on guiwei day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on guiwei day, went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 甲午，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On jiawu day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On jiawu day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 三月癸酉，詔析津、大定二府精選舉人以聞，仍詔諭學者，當窮經明道。
entries.en: On guiyou day of the third month an edict ordered Xijin and Dading prefectures to select examination candidates carefully and report them; scholars were also instructed to exhaust the classics and clarify the Way.
entries.literal: Third month, on guiyou day, edict ordered Jizhou and Dading prefectures to select examination candidates carefully and report them; also edict instructed scholars to exhaust the classics and clarify the Way.

entries.zh: 夏四月甲辰，以知奚六部大王事涅葛為本部大王。
entries.en: On jiachen day of the fourth summer month Niege, who administered Xi Six Tribes great king affairs, was made great king of that tribe.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiachen day Niege, who administered Xi Six Tribes great king affairs, was made great king of that tribe.

entries.zh: 壬子，獵北山。
entries.en: On renzi day the court hunted at North Mountain.
entries.literal: On renzi day hunted at North Mountain.

entries.zh: 甲子，霖雨，罷獵。
entries.en: On jiazi day continuous rain fell and hunting was stopped.
entries.literal: On jiazi day continuous rain fell and hunting was stopped.

entries.zh: 五月丁亥，駐蹕赤勒嶺。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the fifth month the court halted at Chile Ridge.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on dinghai day, halted at Chile Ridge.

entries.zh: 己丑，以阻卜磨古斯為諸部長。
entries.en: On jichou day Zubu Mogusi was made chief of all tribes.
entries.literal: On jichou day Zubu Mogusi was made chief of all tribes.

entries.zh: 癸巳，回鶻遣使貢良馬。
entries.en: On guisi day Uighur sent envoys presenting fine horses.
entries.literal: On guisi day Uighur dispatched envoys presenting fine horses.

entries.zh: 己亥，以同知南府樞密使事耶律那也知右夷離畢事，左祗候郎君班詳穩耶律涅裏知北院大王事。
entries.en: On jihai day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Naye was made administrator of Right yilibi affairs; Left attendant langjun class detail-stable Yelü Nieli was made administrator of Northern Court great king affairs.
entries.literal: On jihai day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Naye administrator of Right yilibi affairs; Left attendant langjun class detail-stable Yelü Nieli administrator of Northern Court great king affairs.

entries.zh: 六月甲寅，夏國遣使來謝封冊。
entries.en: On jiayin day of the sixth month Xia State sent envoys to thank for the investiture.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin day Xia State dispatched envoys to thank for the investiture.

entries.zh: 壬戌，以參知政事王言敷為樞密副使，前樞密副使賈士勛參知政事，兼同知樞密院事。
entries.en: On renxu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Wang Yanfu was made associate privy commissioner; former associate privy commissioner Jia Shixun was made Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
entries.literal: On renxu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Wang Yanfu associate privy commissioner; former associate privy commissioner Jia Shixun Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

entries.zh: 秋七月庚午，獵沙嶺。
entries.en: On gengwu day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Shaling.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengwu day, hunted at Shaling.

entries.zh: 九月辛卯，遣使遺宋鹿脯。
entries.en: On xinmao day of the ninth month envoys were dispatched to present dried venison to Song.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on xinmao day dispatched envoys to present dried venison to Song.

entries.zh: 壬辰，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On renchen day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: On renchen day halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 冬十月乙巳，以新定法令太煩，復行舊法。
entries.en: On yisi day of the tenth winter month, because the newly fixed laws were too numerous, the old laws were restored.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yisi day, because the newly fixed laws were too numerous, the old laws were restored.

entries.zh: 庚申，以遼興軍節度使何葛為乙室大王。
entries.en: On gengshen day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Hege was made Yishi great king.
entries.literal: On gengshen day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Hege was made Yishi great king.

entries.zh: 十一月丁卯朔，燕國王延禧生子，大赦，妃之族屬進爵有差。
entries.en: On the dingmao new moon of the eleventh month Prince of Yan Yanxi had a son; a general amnesty was proclaimed; the consort's kin advanced in rank by degree.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on dingmao new moon, Prince of Yan Yanxi had a son; general amnesty; the consort's kin advanced in rank by degree.

entries.zh: 六年春正月，如混同江。
entries.en: In the sixth year, in the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 二月辛丑，駐蹕雙山。
entries.en: On xinchou day of the second month the court halted at Shuang Mountain.
entries.literal: Second month, on xinchou day, halted at Shuang Mountain.

entries.zh: 三月辛未，女直遣使來貢。
entries.en: On xinwei day of the third month Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Third month, on xinwei day Jurchen dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 夏四月丁酉，東北路統軍司設掌法官。
entries.en: On dingyou day of the fourth summer month Northeast Route supreme commander's office established judicial officials.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingyou day Northeast Route supreme commander's office established judicial officials.

entries.zh: 庚子，以同知南院樞密使事耶律吐朵知左夷離畢事。
entries.en: On gengzi day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Tuduo was made administrator of Left yilibi affairs.
entries.literal: On gengzi day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Tuduo administrator of Left yilibi affairs.

entries.zh: 五月壬辰，駐蹕散水原。
entries.en: On renchen day of the fifth month the court halted at Sanshui Plain.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on renchen day, halted at Sanshui Plain.

entries.zh: 六月甲辰，遣使決五京囚。
entries.en: On jiachen day of the sixth month envoys were dispatched to decide prisoners in the Five Capitals.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jiachen day dispatched envoys to decide prisoners in the Five Capitals.

entries.zh: 秋七月丙子，如黑嶺。
entries.en: On bingzi day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Heiling.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingzi day, went to Heiling.

entries.zh: 冬十月丁酉，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On dingyou day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingyou day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 十一月壬戌，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On renxu day of the eleventh month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on renxu day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 己巳，以南府宰相竇景庸為武定軍節度使。
entries.en: On jisi day Southern Court chancellor Dou Jingyong was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.
entries.literal: On jisi day Southern Court chancellor Dou Jingyong was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.

entries.zh: 是年，放進士文充等七十二人。
entries.en: That year the jinshi Wen Chong and seventy-two others were passed.
entries.literal: That year the jinshi Wen Chong and seventy-two others were passed.

entries.zh: 七年春正月壬戌，如混同江。
entries.en: In the seventh year, on renxu day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on renxu day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 二月己亥，駐蹕魚兒濼。
entries.en: On jihai day of the second month the court halted at Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: Second month, on jihai day, halted at Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 壬寅，詔給渭州貧民耕牛、布絹。
entries.en: On renyin day an edict ordered plow oxen, cloth, and silk given to poor people in Wei Prefecture.
entries.literal: On renyin day, edict ordered plow oxen, cloth, and silk given to poor people in Wei Prefecture.

entries.zh: 三月丙戌，駐蹕黑龍江。
entries.en: On bingxu day of the third month the court halted at the Black Dragon River.
entries.literal: Third month, on bingxu day, halted at the Black Dragon River.

entries.zh: 夏四月丙戌，以漢人行宮副部署耶律谷欲知乙室大王事。
entries.en: On bingxu day of the fourth summer month Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Yelü Guyu was made administrator of Yishi great king affairs.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingxu day Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Yelü Guyu administrator of Yishi great king affairs.

entries.zh: 五月己未朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the jiwei new moon of the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on jiwei new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 六月甲午，駐蹕赤勒嶺。
entries.en: On jiawu day of the sixth month the court halted at Chile Ridge.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jiawu day, halted at Chile Ridge.

entries.zh: 己亥，倒塌嶺人進古鼎，有文曰：「萬歲永為寶用。」
entries.en: On jihai day people of Daotaoling presented an ancient tripod with an inscription reading: "Ten thousand years—forever a treasure in use."
entries.literal: On jihai day people of Daotaoling presented an ancient tripod with an inscription reading: "Ten thousand years—forever a treasure in use."

entries.zh: 辛丑，回鶻遣使貢方物。
entries.en: On xinchou day Uighur sent envoys with tribute goods.
entries.literal: On xinchou day Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute goods.

entries.zh: 癸卯，以權知東京留守蕭陶隗為契丹行宮都部署。
entries.en: On guimao day acting Eastern Capital regent Xiao Taowei was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
entries.literal: On guimao day acting Eastern Capital regent Xiao Taowei was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

entries.zh: 丁未，端拱殿門災。
entries.en: On dingwei day Duan Gong Hall gate caught fire.
entries.literal: On dingwei day Duan Gong Hall gate caught fire.

entries.zh: 秋七月戊午朔，回鶻遣使來貢異物，不納，厚賜遣之。
entries.en: On the wuwu new moon of the seventh month Uighur sent envoys with exotic goods; they were not accepted; generous gifts were bestowed and they were sent away.
entries.literal: Seventh month, on wuwu new moon, Uighur dispatched envoys with exotic goods; not accepted; generous gifts were bestowed and they were sent away.

entries.zh: 八月庚寅，以霖雨，罷獵。
entries.en: On gengyin day of the eighth month, because of continuous rain, hunting was stopped.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on gengyin day, because of continuous rain, hunting was stopped.

entries.zh: 壬寅，幸慶州，謁慶陵。
entries.en: On renyin day the court visited Qing Prefecture and paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On renyin day visited Qing Prefecture and paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 九月丙申，還上京。
entries.en: On bingshen day of the ninth month the court returned to the Supreme Capital.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on bingshen day returned to the Supreme Capital.

entries.zh: 己亥，日本國遣鄭元、鄭心及僧應範等二十八人來貢。
entries.en: On jihai day Japan sent Zheng Yuan, Zheng Xin, monk Yingfan, and twenty-eight others with tribute.
entries.literal: On jihai day Japan dispatched Zheng Yuan, Zheng Xin, monk Yingfan, and twenty-eight others with tribute.

entries.zh: 冬十月辛巳，命燕國王延禧為天下兵馬大元帥，總北南院樞密使事。
entries.en: On xinsi day of the tenth winter month Prince of Yan Yanxi was ordered grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven and head of Northern and Southern Privy Council affairs.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinsi day ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi grand marshal of all armies and horses under Heaven and head of Northern and Southern Privy Council affairs.

entries.zh: 十一月庚子，如藕絲澱。
entries.en: On gengzi day of the eleventh month the court went to Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on gengzi day went to Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 甲子，望祀木葉山。
entries.en: On jiazi day distant sacrifice was performed at Muye Mountain.
entries.literal: On jiazi day performed distant sacrifice at Muye Mountain.

entries.zh: 八年春正月乙酉，如山榆澱。
entries.en: In the eighth year, on yiyou day of the first spring month the court went to Shanyu Marsh.
entries.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on yiyou day, went to Shanyu Marsh.

entries.zh: 乙未，阻卜諸長來降。
entries.en: On yiwei day Zubu tribal chiefs came to surrender.
entries.literal: On yiwei day Zubu tribal chiefs came to surrender.

entries.zh: 三月己亥，駐蹕撻裏舍澱。
entries.en: On jihai day of the third month the court halted at Talishe Marsh.
entries.literal: Third month, on jihai day, halted at Talishe Marsh.

entries.zh: 丁未，曲赦中京、蔚州役徒。
entries.en: On dingwei day a partial amnesty was granted for convict laborers at the Central Capital and Yu Prefecture.
entries.literal: On dingwei day partial amnesty for convict laborers at the Central Capital and Yu Prefecture.

entries.zh: 夏四月乙卯，阻卜長來貢。
entries.en: On yimao day of the fourth summer month Zubu chiefs came with tribute.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yimao day Zubu chiefs came with tribute.

entries.zh: 丁丑，獵西山。
entries.en: On dingchou day the court hunted at Western Mountain.
entries.literal: On dingchou day hunted at Western Mountain.

entries.zh: 惕德酋長胡裏只來附。
entries.en: Tide chief Hulizhi came to submit.
entries.literal: Tide chief Hulizhi came to submit.

entries.zh: 五月甲辰，駐蹕赤勒嶺。
entries.en: On jiachen day of the fifth month the court halted at Chile Ridge.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on jiachen day, halted at Chile Ridge.

entries.zh: 六月乙丑，夏國為宋侵，遣使乞援。
entries.en: On yichou day of the sixth month Xia State was invaded by Song and sent envoys begging aid.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on yichou day Xia State was invaded by Song and dispatched envoys begging aid.

entries.zh: 秋七月丁亥，獵沙嶺。
entries.en: On dinghai day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Shaling.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dinghai day, hunted at Shaling.

entries.zh: 九月乙巳，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On yisi day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on yisi day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 丁未，日本國遣使來貢。
entries.en: On dingwei day Japan sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On dingwei day Japan dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 冬十月庚戌朔，遣使遺宋鹿脯。
entries.en: On the gengxu new moon of the tenth winter month envoys were dispatched to present dried venison to Song.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengxu new moon, dispatched envoys to present dried venison to Song.

entries.zh: 丙辰，振西北路饑。
entries.en: On bingchen day famine in the Northwest Route was relieved.
entries.literal: On bingchen day relieved famine in the Northwest Route.

entries.zh: 辛酉，阻卜磨古斯殺金吾吐古斯以叛，遣奚六部禿裏耶律郭三發諸蕃部兵討之。
entries.en: On xinyou day Zubu Mogusi killed Defender of the Golden Crow Tugusi and rebelled; Xi Six Tribes Tulie Yelü Guosan was dispatched to lead various tribal troops against him.
entries.literal: On xinyou day Zubu Mogusi killed Defender of the Golden Crow Tugusi and rebelled; dispatched Xi Six Tribes Tulie Yelü Guosan to lead various tribal troops against him.

entries.zh: 壬申，南府宰相王經薨。
entries.en: On renshen day Southern Court chancellor Wang Jing died.
entries.literal: On renshen day Southern Court chancellor Wang Jing died.

entries.zh: 戊寅，以左夷離畢耶律涅裏為彰聖軍節度使。
entries.en: On wuyin day Left yilibi Yelü Nieli was made military commissioner of Zhangsheng Army.
entries.literal: On wuyin day Left yilibi Yelü Nieli was made military commissioner of Zhangsheng Army.

entries.zh: 十一月戊子，以樞密副使王是敦兼知樞密院事，權參知政事韓資讓參知政事，漢人行宮都部署奚回離保知奚六部大王事。
entries.en: On wuzi day of the eleventh month associate privy commissioner Wang Shidun was also made administrator of Privy Council affairs; acting Associate Administrator of Affairs Han Zirang was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Han mobile palace deployment director Xi Huilibao was made administrator of Xi Six Tribes great king affairs.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on wuzi day associate privy commissioner Wang Shidun also administrator of Privy Council affairs; acting Associate Administrator of Affairs Han Zirang Associate Administrator of Affairs; Han mobile palace deployment director Xi Huilibao administrator of Xi Six Tribes great king affairs.

entries.zh: 丁酉，以通州潦水害稼，遣使振之。
entries.en: On dingyou day Tong Prefecture flooding harmed the crops; envoys were dispatched to relieve.
entries.literal: On dingyou day Tong Prefecture flooding harmed the crops; envoys were dispatched to relieve.

entries.zh: 戊申，北院大王合魯薨。
entries.en: On wushen day Northern Court great king Helu died.
entries.literal: On wushen day Northern Court great king Helu died.

entries.zh: 是年，放進士冠尊文等五十三人。
entries.en: That year the jinshi Guan Zunwen and fifty-three others were passed.
entries.literal: That year the jinshi Guan Zunwen and fifty-three others were passed.

entries.zh: 九年春正月庚辰，如混同江。
entries.en: In the ninth year, on gengchen day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on gengchen day, went to the Huntong River.

entries.zh: 二月，磨古斯來侵。
entries.en: In the second month Mogusi came to invade.
entries.literal: Second month, Mogusi came to invade.

entries.zh: 三月，西北路招討使耶律阿魯掃古追磨古斯還，都監蕭張九遇賊，與戰不利。
entries.en: In the third month Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Arusaguo pursued Mogusi back; inspector-general Xiao Zhangjiu encountered the bandits and fighting was unfavorable.
entries.literal: Third month, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Arusaguo pursued Mogusi back; inspector-general Xiao Zhangjiu encountered the bandits and fighting was unfavorable.

entries.zh: 二室韋、拽剌、北王府、特滿群牧、宮分等軍多陷沒。
entries.en: Armies of Two Shiwei, Zhaila, Northern Princes' Palace, Teman herd guards, palace divisions, and others were largely lost.
entries.literal: Armies of Two Shiwei, Zhaila, Northern Princes' Palace, Teman herd guards, palace divisions, and others were largely lost.

entries.zh: 夏四月乙卯，興中府甘露降，遣使祠佛飯僧。
entries.en: On yimao day of the fourth summer month sweet dew fell at Xingzhong Prefecture; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to Buddha and feed monks.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yimao day sweet dew fell at Xingzhong Prefecture; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to Buddha and feed monks.

entries.zh: 癸酉，獵西山。
entries.en: On guiyou day the court hunted at Western Mountain.
entries.literal: On guiyou day hunted at Western Mountain.

entries.zh: 六月丁未朔，駐蹕散水原。
entries.en: On the dingwei new moon of the sixth month the court halted at Sanshui Plain.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on dingwei new moon, halted at Sanshui Plain.

entries.zh: 庚申，以遼興軍節度使榮哥為南院大王，知左夷離畢事耶律吐朵為左夷離畢。
entries.en: On gengshen day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Rongge was made Southern Court great king; Yelü Tuduo, who administered Left yilibi affairs, was made Left yilibi.
entries.literal: On gengshen day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Rongge was made Southern Court great king; Yelü Tuduo, who administered Left yilibi affairs, was made Left yilibi.

entries.zh: 秋七月辛卯，如黑嶺。
entries.en: On xinmao day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Heiling.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinmao day, went to Heiling.

entries.zh: 壬寅，遣使賜高麗羊。
entries.en: On renyin day envoys were dispatched to bestow sheep on Goryeo.
entries.literal: On renyin day dispatched envoys to bestow sheep on Goryeo.

entries.zh: 九月癸卯，振西北路貧民。
entries.en: On guimao day of the ninth month poor people in the Northwest Route were relieved.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on guimao day relieved poor people in the Northwest Route.

entries.zh: 冬十月庚戌，有司奏磨古斯詣西北路招討使耶律撻不也偽降，既而乘虛來襲，撻不也死之。
entries.en: On gengxu day of the tenth winter month the relevant offices memorialized that Mogusi feigned surrender to Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Tabuye, then seized an opening to attack; Tabuye died in the fight.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengxu day the relevant offices memorialized that Mogusi feigned surrender to Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Tabuye, then seized an opening to attack; Tabuye died in the fight.

entries.zh: 阻卜烏古劄叛，達裏底、拔思母並寇倒塌嶺。
entries.en: Zubu Wugu Zha rebelled; Daridi and Basimu also raided Daotaoling.
entries.literal: Zubu Wugu Zha rebelled; Daridi and Basimu also raided Daotaoling.

entries.zh: 壬子，遣使籍諸路兵。
entries.en: On renzi day envoys were dispatched to register troops in all routes.
entries.literal: On renzi day dispatched envoys to register troops in all routes.

entries.zh: 癸丑，以南院大王特末同知南京留守事，命鄭家奴率兵往援倒塌嶺。
entries.en: On guichou day Southern Court great king Temo was made associate regent of Nanjing; Zhengjianu was ordered to lead troops to aid Daotaoling.
entries.literal: On guichou day Southern Court great king Temo associate regent of Nanjing; ordered Zhengjianu to lead troops to aid Daotaoling.

entries.zh: 甲寅，駐蹕藕絲澱，以左夷離畢耶律禿朵、圍場都管撒八並為西北路行軍都監。
entries.en: On jiayin day the court halted at Ousi Marsh; Left yilibi Yelü Tuduo and hunting-grounds director Saba were both made Northwest Route campaign inspector-generals.
entries.literal: On jiayin day halted at Ousi Marsh; Left yilibi Yelü Tuduo and hunting-grounds director Saba were both made Northwest Route campaign inspector-generals.

entries.zh: 乙卯，詔以馬三千給烏古部。
entries.en: On yimao day an edict ordered three thousand horses given to the Wugu tribe.
entries.literal: On yimao day, edict ordered three thousand horses given to the Wugu tribe.

entries.zh: 丙辰，有司奏阻卜長轄底掠西路群牧。
entries.en: On bingchen day the relevant offices memorialized that Zubu chief Zhuadi plundered Western Route herd guards.
entries.literal: On bingchen day the relevant offices memorialized that Zubu chief Zhuadi plundered Western Route herd guards.

entries.zh: 丁巳，振西北路貧民。
entries.en: On dingsi day poor people in the Northwest Route were relieved.
entries.literal: On dingsi day relieved poor people in the Northwest Route.

entries.zh: 己未，燕國王延禧生子，肆赦，妃之族屬並進級。
entries.en: On jiwei day Prince of Yan Yanxi had a son; a general amnesty was proclaimed; the consort's kin were all advanced in rank.
entries.literal: On jiwei day Prince of Yan Yanxi had a son; general amnesty; the consort's kin were all advanced in rank.

entries.zh: 壬戌，以樞密直學士趙廷睦參知政事兼同知南院樞密使事。
entries.en: On renxu day Privy Council academician Zhao Tingmu was made Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate Southern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On renxu day Privy Council academician Zhao Tingmu Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate Southern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 癸亥，烏古敵烈統軍使蕭朽哥奏討阻卜等部捷。
entries.en: On guihai day Wugu Dilie supreme commander Xiao Xiuge memorialized victory over Zubu and other tribes.
entries.literal: On guihai day Wugu Dilie supreme commander Xiao Xiuge memorialized victory over Zubu and other tribes.

entries.zh: 甲子，宋遣使告其母后曹氏哀，即遣使吊祭。
entries.en: On jiazi day Song sent envoys to announce mourning for Empress Dowager Cao; envoys were immediately dispatched to offer condolences.
entries.literal: On jiazi day Song dispatched envoys to announce mourning for Empress Dowager Cao; envoys were immediately dispatched to offer condolences.

entries.zh: 己巳，詔廣積貯，以備水旱。
entries.en: On jisi day an edict ordered great stores accumulated to prepare for flood and drought.
entries.literal: On jisi day, edict ordered great stores accumulated to prepare for flood and drought.

entries.zh: 十一月辛巳，特抹等奏討阻卜捷。
entries.en: On xinsi day of the eleventh month Temo and others memorialized victory over Zubu.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on xinsi day Temo and others memorialized victory over Zubu.

entries.zh: 十二月丙辰，宋遣使以母后遺留物來饋。
entries.en: On bingchen day of the twelfth month Song sent envoys presenting the late empress dowager's bequeathed goods.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on bingchen day Song dispatched envoys presenting the late empress dowager's bequeathed goods.

entries.zh: 十年春正月，如春水。
entries.en: In the tenth year, in the first spring month the court went to spring waters.
entries.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, went to spring waters.

entries.zh: 癸未，惕德來貢。
entries.en: On guiwei day Tide came with tribute.
entries.literal: On guiwei day Tide came with tribute.

entries.zh: 戊子，烏古紥等來降，達裏底、拔思母二部來侵，四捷軍都監特抹死之。
entries.en: On wuzi day Wugu Zha and others came to surrender; Daridi and Basimu two tribes came to invade and Four Victories Army inspector-general Temo died in battle.
entries.literal: On wuzi day Wugu Zha and others came to surrender; Daridi and Basimu two tribes came to invade and Four Victories Army inspector-general Temo died in battle.

entries.zh: 二月甲辰，以破阻卜，賞有功者。
entries.en: On jiachen day of the second month, because Zubu was broken, those with merit were rewarded.
entries.literal: Second month, on jiachen day, because Zubu was broken, those with merit were rewarded.

entries.zh: 丙午，西南面招討司奏討拔思母捷。
entries.en: On bingwu day Southwest Route pacification office memorialized victory over Basimu.
entries.literal: On bingwu day Southwest Route pacification office memorialized victory over Basimu.

entries.zh: 癸丑，排雅、仆裏、同葛、虎骨、仆果等來降。
entries.en: On guichou day Paiya, Pulie, Tongge, Hugu, Puguo, and others came to surrender.
entries.literal: On guichou day Paiya, Pulie, Tongge, Hugu, Puguo, and others came to surrender.

entries.zh: 達裏底來侵。
entries.en: Daridi came to invade.
entries.literal: Daridi came to invade.

entries.zh: 三月壬申朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the renshen new moon of the third month there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: Third month, on renshen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 山北路副部署蕭阿魯帶奏討達裏底捷。
entries.en: Northern Mountain Route deputy deployment Xiao Arudai memorialized victory over Daridi.
entries.literal: Northern Mountain Route deputy deployment Xiao Arudai memorialized victory over Daridi.

entries.zh: 夏四月壬寅朔，惕德萌得斯、老古得等各率所部來附，詔復舊地。
entries.en: On the renyin new moon of the fourth summer month Tide Mengdesi, Laogude, and others each led their tribes to submit; an edict restored their former lands.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renyin new moon, Tide Mengdesi, Laogude, and others each led their tribes to submit; edict restored their former lands.

entries.zh: 甲辰，駐蹕春州北平澱。
entries.en: On jiachen day the court halted at Chun Prefecture North Ping Marsh.
entries.literal: On jiachen day halted at Chun Prefecture North Ping Marsh.

entries.zh: 丙午，烏古部節度使耶律陳家奴奏討茶紥剌捷。
entries.en: On bingwu day Wugu tribal military commissioner Yelü Chenjianu memorialized victory over Chazhala.
entries.literal: On bingwu day Wugu tribal military commissioner Yelü Chenjianu memorialized victory over Chazhala.

entries.zh: 庚戌，以知北院樞密使事耶律斡特剌為都統，夷離畢耶律禿朵為副統，龍虎衛上將軍耶律胡呂都監，討磨古斯，遣積慶宮使蕭虬裏監戰。
entries.en: On gengxu day Yelü Wotela, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made supreme commander; yilibi Yelü Tuduo deputy commander; Dragon-Tiger Guard upper general Yelü Hulu army supervisor to attack Mogusi; Jiqing Palace commissioner Xiao Qiuli supervised the campaign.
entries.literal: On gengxu day Yelü Wotela, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made supreme commander; yilibi Yelü Tuduo deputy commander; Dragon-Tiger Guard upper general Yelü Hulu army supervisor to attack Mogusi; Jiqing Palace commissioner Xiao Qiuli supervised the campaign.

entries.zh: 辛亥，朽哥奏頗裏八部來侵。
entries.en: On xinhai day Xiuge memorialized that the Poli Eight Tribes came to invade.
entries.literal: On xinhai day Xiuge memorialized that the Poli Eight Tribes came to invade.

entries.zh: 擊破之。
entries.en: They were defeated and broken.
entries.literal: They were defeated and broken.

entries.zh: 己巳，除玉田、密雲流民租賦一年。
entries.en: On jisi day rent and tax for refugees in Yutian and Miyun were remitted for one year.
entries.literal: On jisi day rent and tax for refugees in Yutian and Miyun were remitted for one year.

entries.zh: 閏月庚子，賜西北路貧民錢。
entries.en: In the intercalary month, on gengzi day, money was bestowed on poor people in the Northwest Route.
entries.literal: Intercalary month, on gengzi day money was bestowed on poor people in the Northwest Route.

entries.zh: 達裏底、拔思母二部來降。
entries.en: Daridi and Basimu two tribes came to surrender.
entries.literal: Daridi and Basimu two tribes came to surrender.

entries.zh: 五月甲辰，駐蹕赤勒嶺。
entries.en: On jiachen day of the fifth month the court halted at Chile Ridge.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on jiachen day, halted at Chile Ridge.

entries.zh: 甲寅，括馬。
entries.en: On jiayin day horses were registered.
entries.literal: On jiayin day horses were registered.

entries.zh: 戊午，西北路招討司奏敵烈等部來侵，統軍司出兵與戰，不利，招討司以兵擊破之，敦睦宮太師耶律愛奴及其子死之。
entries.en: On wuwu day Northwest Route pacification office memorialized that Dilie and other tribes came to invade; the supreme commander's office sent troops to fight with unfavorable result; the pacification office broke them with troops; Dunmu Palace grand preceptor Yelü Ainu and his son died.
entries.literal: On wuwu day Northwest Route pacification office memorialized that Dilie and other tribes came to invade; the supreme commander's office sent troops to fight with unfavorable result; the pacification office broke them with troops; Dunmu Palace grand preceptor Yelü Ainu and his son died.

entries.zh: 辛酉，以知國舅詳穩事蕭阿烈同領西北路行軍事。
entries.en: On xinyou day imperial maternal uncle detail-stable administrator Xiao Alie jointly led Northwest Route campaign affairs.
entries.literal: On xinyou day imperial maternal uncle detail-stable administrator Xiao Alie jointly led Northwest Route campaign affairs.

entries.zh: 六月辛未，宋遣使來謝吊祭。
entries.en: On xinwei day of the sixth month Song sent envoys to thank for the condolence mission.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on xinwei day Song dispatched envoys to thank for the condolence mission.

entries.zh: 乙酉，烏古敵烈統軍使朽哥有罪，除名。
entries.en: On yiyou day Wugu Dilie supreme commander Xiuge, for an offense, was struck from the register.
entries.literal: On yiyou day Wugu Dilie supreme commander Xiuge, for an offense, was struck from the register.

entries.zh: 丙戌，和烈葛等部來聘。
entries.en: On bingxu day Heliege and other tribes came with a friendly mission.
entries.literal: On bingxu day Heliege and other tribes came with a friendly mission.

entries.zh: 癸巳，惕德來貢。
entries.en: On guisi day Tide came with tribute.
entries.literal: On guisi day Tide came with tribute.

entries.zh: 己亥，禁邊民與蕃部為婚。
entries.en: On jihai day border people were forbidden to marry tribal peoples.
entries.literal: On jihai day forbidden border people to marry tribal peoples.

entries.zh: 是夏，高麗國王運薨，子昱遣使來告，即遣使賻贈。
entries.en: That summer Goryeo king Yun died; his son Yu sent envoys to announce it; envoys were immediately dispatched with funeral gifts.
entries.literal: That summer Goryeo king Yun died; his son Yu dispatched envoys to announce it; envoys were immediately dispatched with funeral gifts.

entries.zh: 秋七月庚子朔，獵赤山。
entries.en: On the gengzi new moon of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Red Mountain.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengzi new moon, hunted at Red Mountain.

entries.zh: 是月，阻卜等寇倒塌嶺，盡掠西路群牧馬去，東北路統軍使耶律石柳以兵追及，盡獲所掠而還。
entries.en: That month Zubu and others raided Daotaoling, carrying off all Western Route herd horses; Northeast Route supreme commander Yelü Shiliu pursued with troops, recovered all that was plundered, and returned.
entries.literal: That month Zubu and others raided Daotaoling, carrying off all Western Route herd horses; Northeast Route supreme commander Yelü Shiliu pursued with troops, recovered all that was plundered, and returned.

entries.zh: 九月己未，以南院大王特末為南院樞密使。
entries.en: On jiwei day of the ninth month Southern Court great king Temo was made Southern Court privy commissioner.
