entries.literal: Ninth month, on jiwei day Southern Court great king Temo was made Southern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 甲子，敵烈諸酋來降，釋其罪。
entries.en: On jiazi day Dilie tribal chiefs came to surrender; their crimes were pardoned.
entries.literal: On jiazi day Dilie tribal chiefs came to surrender; their crimes were pardoned.

entries.zh: 是月，斡特剌破磨古斯。
entries.en: That month Wotela defeated Mogusi.
entries.literal: That month Wotela defeated Mogusi.

entries.zh: 冬十月丙子，駐蹕藕絲澱。
entries.en: On bingzi day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingzi day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 壬午，山北路副部署蕭阿魯帶以討達裏底功，加左金吾衛上將軍。
entries.en: On renwu day Northern Mountain Route deputy deployment Xiao Arudai, for merit against Daridi, was promoted Left Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general.
entries.literal: On renwu day Northern Mountain Route deputy deployment Xiao Arudai, for merit against Daridi, was promoted Left Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general.

entries.zh: 癸巳，西北路統軍司獲阻卜長拍撒葛、蒲魯等來獻。
entries.en: On guisi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office captured Zubu chiefs Paisage, Pulu, and others who came to present captives.
entries.literal: On guisi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office captured Zubu chiefs Paisage, Pulu, and others who came to present captives.

entries.zh: 十一月乙巳，惕德銅刮、阻卜的烈等來降。
entries.en: On yisi day of the eleventh month Tide Tonggua, Zubu Dilie, and others came to surrender.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on yisi day Tide Tonggua, Zubu Dilie, and others came to surrender.

entries.zh: 達裏底及拔思母等復來侵，山北副部署阿魯帶擊敗之。
entries.en: Daridi and Basimu again came to invade; Northern Mountain deputy deployment Arudai defeated them.
entries.literal: Daridi and Basimu again came to invade; Northern Mountain deputy deployment Arudai defeated them.

entries.zh: 十二月癸酉，三河縣民孫賓及其妻皆百歲，復其家。
entries.en: On guiyou day of the twelfth month Sanhe County commoner Sun Bin and his wife were both one hundred years old; their household was remitted.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on guiyou day Sanhe County commoner Sun Bin and his wife were both one hundred years old; their household was remitted.

entries.zh: 甲戌，以參知政事趙廷睦兼同知樞密院事，樞密副使王師儒參知政事兼同知樞密院事。
entries.en: On jiaxu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Tingmu was also made associate administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate privy commissioner Wang Shiru Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Tingmu also associate administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate privy commissioner Wang Shiru Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

entries.zh: 己卯，詔錄西北路有功將士及戰歿者，贈官。
entries.en: On jimao day an edict ordered recording meritorious officers and those killed in battle in the Northwest Route and posthumously granting office.
entries.literal: On jimao day, edict ordered recording meritorious officers and those killed in battle in the Northwest Route and posthumously granting office.

entries.zh: 乙酉，詔改明年元，減雜犯死罪以下，仍除貧民租賦。
entries.en: On yiyou day an edict changed the coming year's era name, reduced mixed offenses from capital crime downward, and still remitted rent and tax for poor people.
entries.literal: On yiyou day, edict changed the coming year's era name, reduced mixed offenses from capital crime downward, and still remitted rent and tax for poor people.

entries.zh: 戊子，西北路統軍司奏討磨古斯捷。
entries.en: On wuzi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Mogusi.
entries.literal: On wuzi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Mogusi.

entries.zh: 道宗六
entries.en: Daozong, Part Six
entries.literal: Daozong, Part Six

entries.zh: 七年春正月壬戌朔，力疾禦清風殿受百官及諸國使賀。
entries.en: In the seventh year, on the renxu new moon of the first spring month, though gravely ill the emperor received congratulations from officials and envoys of all states at Qingfeng Hall.
entries.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on renxu new moon, though gravely ill received congratulations from officials and envoys of all states at Qingfeng Hall.

entries.zh: 是夜，白氣如練，自天而降。
entries.en: That night white vapor like silk descended from heaven.
entries.literal: That night white vapor like silk descended from heaven.

entries.zh: 黑雲起於西北，疾飛有聲。
entries.en: Black clouds rose in the northwest and flew swiftly with sound.
entries.literal: Black clouds rose in the northwest and flew swiftly with sound.

entries.zh: 北有青赤黑白氣，相雜而落。
entries.en: To the north green, red, black, and white vapors mixed and fell.
entries.literal: To the north green, red, black, and white vapors mixed and fell.

entries.zh: 癸亥，如混同江。
entries.en: On guihai day the court went to Huntong River.
entries.literal: On guihai day went to Huntong River.

entries.zh: 甲戌，上崩於行宮，年七十。
entries.en: On jiaxu day the emperor died at the mobile palace, age seventy.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day the emperor died at the mobile palace, age seventy.

entries.zh: 遺詔燕國王延禧嗣位。
entries.en: His testamentary edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to succeed.
entries.literal: His testamentary edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to succeed.

entries.zh: 六月庚子，上尊謚仁聖大孝文皇帝，廟號道宗。
entries.en: On gengzi day of the sixth month posthumous title Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor; temple name Daozong.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on gengzi day posthumous title Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor; temple name Daozong.

entries.zh: 贊曰：道宗初即位，求直言，訪治道，勸農興學，救災恤患，粲然可觀。
entries.en: Appraisal: When Daozong first took the throne he sought frank speech, inquired about governance, encouraged agriculture and learning, relieved disasters and cared for the afflicted — splendid to behold.
entries.literal: Appraisal: When Daozong first took the throne he sought frank speech, inquired about governance, encouraged agriculture and learning, relieved disasters and cared for the afflicted — splendid to behold.

entries.zh: 及夫謗訕之令既行，告訐之賞日重。
entries.en: But when the law on slander was enforced, rewards for informing increased daily.
entries.literal: But when the law on slander was enforced, rewards for informing increased daily.

entries.zh: 群邪並興，讒巧競進。
entries.en: Wicked men arose together; slander and flattery vied to advance.
entries.literal: Wicked men arose together; slander and flattery vied to advance.

entries.zh: 賊及骨肉，皇基浸危。
entries.en: Harm reached even his kin; the imperial foundation gradually grew perilous.
entries.literal: Harm reached even his kin; the imperial foundation gradually grew perilous.

entries.zh: 眾正淪胥，諸部反側，甲兵之用，無寧歲矣。
entries.en: Worthies were ruined; all tribes grew restive; use of arms knew no year of peace.
entries.literal: Worthies were ruined; all tribes grew restive; use of arms knew no year of peace.

entries.zh: 一歲而飯僧三十六萬，一日而祝髮三千。
entries.en: In one year he fed thirty-six thousand monks; in one day three thousand took tonsure.
entries.literal: In one year he fed thirty-six thousand monks; in one day three thousand took tonsure.

entries.zh: 徒勤小惠，蔑計大本，尚足與論治哉？
entries.en: He toiled at petty kindness yet scorned the great foundation — hardly fit to discuss good governance?
entries.literal: He toiled at petty kindness yet scorned the great foundation — hardly fit to discuss good governance?

entries.zh: 六年春正月癸酉，南院大王耶律吾也薨。
entries.en: In the sixth year, on guiyou day of the first spring month Southern Court great king Yelü Wuye died.
entries.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on guiyou day Southern Court great king Yelü Wuye died.

entries.zh: 壬午，以太師致仕禿開起為奚六部大王。
entries.en: On renwu day retired grand preceptor Tukai was raised to Xi Six Divisions great king.
entries.literal: On renwu day retired grand preceptor Tukai was raised to Xi Six Divisions great king.

entries.zh: 丁亥，如春水。
entries.en: On dinghai day the court went to spring waters.
entries.literal: On dinghai day, went to spring waters.

entries.zh: 辛卯，斡特剌執磨古斯來獻。
entries.en: On xinmao day Wotela brought Mogusi in captivity to present.
entries.literal: On xinmao day Wotela brought Mogusi in captivity to present.

entries.zh: 丙申，詔問民疾苦。
entries.en: On bingshen day an edict inquired into the people's hardships.
entries.literal: On bingshen day, edict inquired into the people's hardships.

entries.zh: 二月丁未，以烏古部節度使陳家奴為南院大王。
entries.en: On dingwei day of the second month Wugu tribal military commissioner Chenjianu was made Southern Court great king.
entries.literal: Second month, on dingwei day Wugu tribal military commissioner Chenjianu was made Southern Court great king.

entries.zh: 己酉，磔磨古斯於市。
entries.en: On jiyou day Mogusi was dismembered at the market.
entries.literal: On jiyou day Mogusi was dismembered at the market.

entries.zh: 癸丑，出絹賜五院貧民。
entries.en: On guichou day silk was issued to bestow on poor people of the Five Divisions.
entries.literal: On guichou day silk was issued to bestow on poor people of the Five Divisions.

entries.zh: 辛酉，宋遣使告宋主煦殂，弟佶嗣位，即日遣使吊祭。
entries.en: On xinyou day Song sent envoys announcing the late emperor Xu had died and his younger brother Ji had succeeded; envoys were immediately sent to offer condolences.
entries.literal: On xinyou day Song dispatched envoys announcing the late emperor Xu had died and his younger brother Ji had succeeded; envoys were immediately sent to offer condolences.

entries.zh: 三月甲申，馳朔州山林之禁。
entries.en: On jiashen day of the third month the ban on hunting in Shuozhou forests was lifted.
entries.literal: Third month, on jiashen day the ban on hunting in Shuozhou forests was lifted.

entries.zh: 夏四月丁酉朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the dingyou new moon of the fourth summer month there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingyou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 癸卯，如炭山。
entries.en: On guimao day the court went to Coal Mountain.
entries.literal: On guimao day went to Coal Mountain.

entries.zh: 五月壬午，烏古部討茶紥剌，破之。
entries.en: On renwu day of the fifth month Wugu tribe attacked Chazhala and defeated them.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on renwu day Wugu tribe attacked Chazhala and defeated them.

entries.zh: 乙酉，漢人行宮都部署趙孝嚴薨。
entries.en: On yiyou day Han mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan died.
entries.literal: On yiyou day Han mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan died.

entries.zh: 丙戌，駐蹕納葛濼。
entries.en: On bingxu day the court halted at Nage Marsh.
entries.literal: On bingxu day halted at Nage Marsh.

entries.zh: 辛卯，宋遣使饋先帝遺物。
entries.en: On xinmao day Song sent envoys presenting the late emperor's belongings.
entries.literal: On xinmao day Song dispatched envoys presenting the late emperor's belongings.

entries.zh: 乙未，以東京留守何魯掃古為惕隱，南院宣徽使蕭常哥為漢人行宮都部署。
entries.en: On yiwei day Eastern Capital regent Helu Saogu was made tiyin; Southern Court commissioner of the palace Xiao Changge Han mobile palace deployment director.
entries.literal: On yiwei day Eastern Capital regent Helu Saogu was made tiyin; Southern Court commissioner of the palace Xiao Changge Han mobile palace deployment director.

entries.zh: 六月庚子，遣使賀宋主。
entries.en: On gengzi day of the sixth month envoys were dispatched to congratulate the Song emperor.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on gengzi day envoys were dispatched to congratulate the Song emperor.

entries.zh: 辛丑，以有司案牘書宋帝「嗣位」為「登寶位」，詔奪宰相鄭顓以下官，出顓知興中府事，韓資讓為崇義軍節度使，御史中丞韓君義為廣順軍節度使。
entries.en: On xinchou day, because relevant offices had written in documents that the Song emperor had "succeeded to the throne" rather than "ascended the precious throne," an edict stripped office from chancellor Zheng Zhuan and those below; Zhuan was sent out to administer Xingzhong Prefecture, Han Zirang made Chongyi Army military commissioner, censor-in-chief Han Junyi Guangshun Army military commissioner.
entries.literal: On xinchou day, because relevant offices had written in documents that the Song emperor had "succeeded to the throne" rather than "ascended the precious throne," edict stripped office from chancellor Zheng Zhuan and those below; Zhuan was sent out to administer Xingzhong Prefecture, Han Zirang made Chongyi Army military commissioner, censor-in-chief Han Junyi Guangshun Army military commissioner.

entries.zh: 癸丑，阻卜長來貢。
entries.en: On guichou day Zubu chiefs came with tribute.
entries.literal: On guichou day Zubu chiefs came with tribute.

entries.zh: 戊午，遣使決五京滯獄。
entries.en: On wuwu day envoys were dispatched to decide stalled cases in the Five Capitals.
entries.literal: On wuwu day envoys were dispatched to decide stalled cases in the Five Capitals.

entries.zh: 己未，以遼興軍節度使梁援為樞密副使。
entries.en: On jiwei day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made associate privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On jiwei day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made associate privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 秋七月庚午，如沙嶺。
entries.en: On gengwu day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Sha Ridge.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengwu day, went to Sha Ridge.

entries.zh: 壬申，耶睹刮諸部寇西北路。
entries.en: On renshen day Yedigua and other tribes raided the Northwest Route.
entries.literal: On renshen day Yedigua and other tribes raided the Northwest Route.

entries.zh: 八月，斡特剌以兵擊敗之，使來獻捷。
entries.en: In the eighth month Wotela with troops defeated them and sent envoys presenting victory.
entries.literal: Eighth month, Wotela with troops defeated them and sent envoys presenting victory.

entries.zh: 九月癸未，望祠木葉山。
entries.en: On guiwei day of the ninth month gazed-sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on guiwei day gazed-sacrificed at Muye Mountain.

entries.zh: 戊子，駐蹕藕絲淀。
entries.en: On wuzi day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: On wuzi day halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 冬十月壬寅，以樞密副使王師儒監修國史。
entries.en: On renyin day of the tenth winter month associate privy commissioner Wang Shiru supervised compilation of the national history.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renyin day associate privy commissioner Wang Shiru supervised compilation of the national history.

entries.zh: 癸卯，五國諸部長來貢。
entries.en: On guimao day chieftains of the Five States and various tribes came with tribute.
entries.literal: On guimao day chieftains of the Five States and various tribes came with tribute.

entries.zh: 甲寅，以平州饑，復其租賦一年。
entries.en: On jiayin day, because Ping Prefecture had famine, its rent and tax were remitted for one year.
entries.literal: On jiayin day, because Ping Prefecture had famine, its rent and tax were remitted for one year.

entries.zh: 十一月壬申，以天德軍民田世榮三世同居，詔官之，令一子三班院祗候。
entries.en: On renshen day of the eleventh month, because Tiande Army commoner Tian Shirong's family had lived together three generations, an edict granted him office and ordered one son attendant in the Third-Rank Court.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on renshen day, because Tiande Army commoner Tian Shirong's family had lived together three generations, edict granted him office and ordered one son attendant in the Third-Rank Court.

entries.zh: 丙子，詔醫巫閭山僧誌達設壇於內殿。
entries.en: On bingzi day an edict ordered Yiwulü Mountain monk Zhida to set up an altar in the inner hall.
entries.literal: On bingzi day, edict ordered Yiwulü Mountain monk Zhida to set up an altar in the inner hall.

entries.zh: 戊子，夏國王李乾順遣使請尚公主。
entries.en: On wuzi day Xia State king Li Qianshun sent envoys requesting marriage to an imperial princess.
entries.literal: On wuzi day Xia State king Li Qianshun dispatched envoys requesting marriage to an imperial princess.

entries.zh: 十二月乙未，女直遣使來貢。
entries.en: On yiwei day of the twelfth month Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on yiwei day Jurchen dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 己亥，以知右夷離畢事郝家奴為北面林牙。
entries.en: On jihai day administrator of Right yilibi affairs Haojianu was made Northern Court palace academician.
entries.literal: On jihai day administrator of Right yilibi affairs Haojianu was made Northern Court palace academician.

entries.zh: 辛亥，詔燕國王延禧擬註大將軍以下官。
entries.en: On xinhai day an edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to nominate officers from grand general downward.
entries.literal: On xinhai day, edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to nominate officers from grand general downward.

entries.zh: 庚申，鐵驪來貢。
entries.en: On gengshen day Tieli came with tribute.
entries.literal: On gengshen day Tieli came with tribute.

entries.zh: 宋遣使來謝。
entries.en: Song sent envoys to give thanks.
entries.literal: Song dispatched envoys to give thanks.

entries.zh: 帝不豫。
entries.en: The emperor fell ill.
entries.literal: The emperor fell ill.

entries.zh: 是歲，封高麗王颙長子俁為三韓國公。
entries.en: That year Goryeo king Yong's eldest son Yu was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.
entries.literal: That year Goryeo king Yong's eldest son Yu was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.

entries.zh: 放進士康秉儉等八十七人。
entries.en: Advanced scholars Kang Bingjian and eighty-seven others were released.
entries.literal: Advanced scholars Kang Bingjian and eighty-seven others were released.

entries.zh: 壽隆元年春正月己亥，如混同江。
entries.en: In the first year of Shoulong, on jihai day of the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.
entries.literal: In the first year of Shoulong, spring, first month, on jihai day, went to Huntong River.

entries.zh: 庚戌，西南面招討司奏拔思母來侵，蕭阿魯帶等擊破之。
entries.en: On gengxu day Southwest Route pacification office memorialized that Basimu had come to invade; Xiao Arudai and others defeated them.
entries.literal: On gengxu day Southwest Route pacification office memorialized that Basimu had come to invade; Xiao Arudai and others defeated them.

entries.zh: 乙卯，振奉聖州貧民。
entries.en: On yimao day poor people in Fengsheng Prefecture were relieved.
entries.literal: On yimao day relieved poor people in Fengsheng Prefecture.

entries.zh: 二月戊辰，賜左、右二皮室貧民錢。
entries.en: On wuchen day of the second month money was bestowed on poor people of the Left and Right Two Pishi.
entries.literal: Second month, on wuchen day, money was bestowed on poor people of the Left and Right Two Pishi.

entries.zh: 癸酉，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On guiyou day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On guiyou day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 乙亥，駐蹕魚兒濼。
entries.en: On yihai day the court halted at Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: On yihai day halted at Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 三月丙午，賜東北路貧民絹。
entries.en: On bingwu day of the third month silk was bestowed on poor people of the Northeast Route.
entries.literal: Third month, on bingwu day, silk was bestowed on poor people of the Northeast Route.

entries.zh: 夏四月丁卯，斡特剌奏討耶睹刮捷。
entries.en: On dingmao day of the fourth summer month Wotela memorialized victory over Yedigua.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingmao day Wotela memorialized victory over Yedigua.

entries.zh: 乙亥，女直遣使來貢。
entries.en: On yihai day Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On yihai day Jurchen dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 庚寅，錄西北路有功將士。
entries.en: On gengyin day meritorious officers of the Northwest Route were recorded.
entries.literal: On gengyin day meritorious officers of the Northwest Route were recorded.

entries.zh: 五月乙未朔，左夷離畢耶律吐朵為惕隱，南京宣徽使耶律特末為北院大王。
entries.en: On the yiwei new moon of the fifth month Left yilibi Yelü Tuduo was made tiyin; Nanjing commissioner of the palace Yelü Temuo was made Northern Court great king.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on yiwei new moon, Left yilibi Yelü Tuduo was made tiyin; Nanjing commissioner of the palace Yelü Temuo was made Northern Court great king.

entries.zh: 癸卯，贈陣亡者官。
entries.en: On guimao day office was posthumously granted to those killed in battle.
entries.literal: On guimao day office was posthumously granted to those killed in battle.

entries.zh: 丁巳，駐蹕特禮嶺。
entries.en: On dingsi day the court halted at Teli Ridge.
entries.literal: On dingsi day halted at Teli Ridge.

entries.zh: 六月己巳，以知奚六部大王事回裏不為本部大王，權參知政事趙孝嚴為漢人行宮都部署，圍場都管撒八以討阻卜功，加鎮國大將軍。
entries.en: On jisi day of the sixth month, because he administered Xi Six Divisions great king affairs Huilibu was made great king of that division; acting associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Han mobile palace deployment director; hunting-grounds director Saba, for merit against Zubu, was promoted Defender of the State grand general.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jisi day, because he administered Xi Six Divisions great king affairs Huilibu was made great king of that division; acting associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Han mobile palace deployment director; hunting-grounds director Saba, for merit against Zubu, was promoted Defender of the State grand general.

entries.zh: 癸巳，阻卜長禿裏底及圖木葛來貢。
entries.en: On guisi day Zubu chief Tuliudi and Tumuge came with tribute.
entries.literal: On guisi day Zubu chief Tuliudi and Tumuge came with tribute.

entries.zh: 秋七月庚子，阻卜長猛達斯等來貢。
entries.en: On gengzi day of the seventh autumn month Zubu chief Mengdasi and others came with tribute.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengzi day Zubu chief Mengdasi and others came with tribute.

entries.zh: 癸卯，獵沙嶺。
entries.en: On guimao day the court hunted at Sha Ridge.
entries.literal: On guimao day hunted at Sha Ridge.

entries.zh: 癸丑，頗里八部來附，進方物。
entries.en: On guichou day the eight divisions of Poli came to submit and presented local goods.
entries.literal: On guichou day the eight divisions of Poli came to submit and presented local goods.

entries.zh: 甲寅，斡特剌奏磨古斯捷。
entries.en: On jiayin day Wotela memorialized victory over Mogusi.
entries.literal: On jiayin day Wotela memorialized victory over Mogusi.

entries.zh: 九月甲寅，祠木葉山。
entries.en: On jiayin day of the ninth month sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on jiayin day sacrificed at Muye Mountain.

entries.zh: 丙辰，詔西京炮人、弩人教西北路漢軍。
entries.en: On bingchen day an edict ordered Western Capital artillerymen and crossbowmen to train Northwest Route Han troops.
entries.literal: On bingchen day, edict ordered Western Capital artillerymen and crossbowmen to train Northwest Route Han troops.

entries.zh: 冬十月甲子，駐蹕藕絲淀。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiazi day halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 甲戌，以北面林牙耶律大悲奴為右夷離畢。
entries.en: On jiaxu day Northern Court palace academician Yelü Dabeinu was made Right yilibi.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day Northern Court palace academician Yelü Dabeinu was made Right yilibi.

entries.zh: 癸未，以參知政事王師儒為樞密副使，漢人行宮都部署趙孝嚴參知政事。
entries.en: On guiwei day associate administrator of affairs Wang Shiru was made associate privy commissioner; Han mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan associate administrator of affairs.
entries.literal: On guiwei day associate administrator of affairs Wang Shiru was made associate privy commissioner; Han mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan associate administrator of affairs.

entries.zh: 壬辰，錄討阻卜有功將士。
entries.en: On renchen day meritorious officers against Zubu were recorded.
entries.literal: On renchen day meritorious officers against Zubu were recorded.

entries.zh: 十一月丙申，女直遣使進馬。
entries.en: On bingshen day of the eleventh month Jurchen sent envoys presenting horses.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen day Jurchen dispatched envoys presenting horses.

entries.zh: 己亥，以都統斡特剌為西北路招討使，封漆水郡王。
entries.en: On jihai day supreme commander Wotela was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.
entries.literal: On jihai day supreme commander Wotela was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.

entries.zh: 甲辰，夏國進貝多葉佛經。
entries.en: On jiachen day Xia State presented palm-leaf Buddhist scriptures.
entries.literal: On jiachen day Xia State presented palm-leaf Buddhist scriptures.

entries.zh: 庚申，高麗王昱疾，命其叔颙權知國事。
entries.en: On gengshen day Goryeo king Yun fell ill; his uncle Yong was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.
entries.literal: On gengshen day Goryeo king Yun fell ill; his uncle Yong was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.

entries.zh: 十二月癸亥朔，以知北院樞密使事耶律阿思為北院樞密使。
entries.en: On the guihai new moon of the twelfth month, because he administered Northern Court privy affairs Yelü Asi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on guihai new moon, because he administered Northern Court privy affairs Yelü Asi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 是年，放進士陳衡甫等百三十人。
entries.en: That year advanced scholars Chen Hengfu and one hundred thirty others were released.
entries.literal: That year advanced scholars Chen Hengfu and one hundred thirty others were released.

entries.zh: 二年[1]春正月甲午，如春水。
entries.en: In the second year, on jiawu day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.
entries.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on jiawu day, went to spring waters.

entries.zh: 癸卯，西南面招討司討拔思母，破之。
entries.en: On guimao day Southwest Route pacification office attacked Basimu and defeated them.
entries.literal: On guimao day Southwest Route pacification office attacked Basimu and defeated them.

entries.zh: 乙卯，駐蹕瑟尼思。
entries.en: On yimao day the court halted at Senisi.
entries.literal: On yimao day halted at Senisi.

entries.zh: 辛酉，市牛給烏古、敵烈、隈烏古部貧民。
entries.en: On xinyou day cattle were purchased and given to poor people of Wugu, Dilie, and Weiwugu tribes.
entries.literal: On xinyou day cattle were purchased and given to poor people of Wugu, Dilie, and Weiwugu tribes.

entries.zh: 二月癸亥，振達麻裏別古部。
entries.en: On guihai day of the second month Damaolibiegu tribe was relieved.
entries.literal: Second month, on guihai day Damaolibiegu tribe was relieved.

entries.zh: 夏四月己卯，振西北邊軍。
entries.en: On jimao day of the fourth summer month northwest border armies were relieved.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jimao day northwest border armies were relieved.

entries.zh: 六月辛酉，駐蹕撒裏乃。
entries.en: On xinyou day of the sixth month the court halted at Salinai.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on xinyou day halted at Salinai.

entries.zh: 秋七月甲午，阻卜來貢。
entries.en: On jiawu day of the seventh autumn month Zubu came with tribute.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiawu day Zubu came with tribute.

entries.zh: 丙午，獵赤山。
entries.en: On bingwu day the court hunted at Red Mountain.
entries.literal: On bingwu day hunted at Red Mountain.

entries.zh: 八月乙丑，頗裏八部進馬。
entries.en: On yichou day of the eighth month eight divisions of Poli presented horses.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on yichou day eight divisions of Poli presented horses.

entries.zh: 九月丙午，徙烏古敵烈部於烏納水，以扼北邊之沖。
entries.en: On bingwu day of the ninth month Wugu and Dilie tribes were moved to Wuna River to block the northern frontier pass.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on bingwu day Wugu and Dilie tribes were moved to Wuna River to block the northern frontier pass.

entries.zh: 冬十月戊辰，駐蹕藕絲淀。
entries.en: On wuchen day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuchen day halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 庚辰，高麗遣使來貢。
entries.en: On gengchen day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
entries.literal: On gengchen day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

entries.zh: 十二月己未，斡特剌討梅裏急，破之。
entries.en: On jiwei day of the twelfth month Wotela attacked Meiliji and defeated them.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on jiwei day Wotela attacked Meiliji and defeated them.

entries.zh: 壬戌，南府宰相耶律鐸魯斡致仕。
entries.en: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Teluwo retired.
entries.literal: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Teluwo retired.

entries.zh: 癸亥，蕭撻不也為北府宰相，耶律大悲奴殿前都點檢。
entries.en: On guihai day Xiao Tabuye was made Northern Court chancellor; Yelü Dabeinu hall front inspector-general.
entries.literal: On guihai day Xiao Tabuye was made Northern Court chancellor; Yelü Dabeinu hall front inspector-general.

entries.zh: 乙亥，夏國獻宋俘。
entries.en: On yihai day Xia State presented Song captives.
entries.literal: On yihai day Xia State presented Song captives.

entries.zh: 三年春正月丁亥，如春水。
entries.en: In the third year, on dinghai day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.
entries.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on dinghai day, went to spring waters.

entries.zh: 壬寅，烏古部節度使耶律陳家奴以功加尚書右僕射。
entries.en: On renyin day Wugu tribal military commissioner Yelü Chenjianu, for merit, was promoted Minister of the Right.
entries.literal: On renyin day Wugu tribal military commissioner Yelü Chenjianu, for merit, was promoted Minister of the Right.

entries.zh: 癸卯，駐蹕雙山。
entries.en: On guimao day the court halted at Twin Mountains.
entries.literal: On guimao day halted at Twin Mountains.

entries.zh: 二月丙辰朔，南京水，遣使振之。
entries.en: On the bingchen new moon of the second month Nanjing had flood; envoys were dispatched to relieve it.
entries.literal: Second month, on bingchen new moon, Nanjing had flood; envoys were dispatched to relieve it.

entries.zh: 閏月丙午，阻卜長猛撒葛、粘八葛長禿骨撒、梅裏急長忽魯八等請復舊地，貢方物，從之。
entries.en: On bingwu day of the intercalary third month Zubu chief Mengsage, Nianbage chief Tugusa, Meiliji chief Huluba, and others requested restoration of former lands, presented local goods, and it was granted.
entries.literal: Intercalary third month, on bingwu day Zubu chief Mengsage, Nianbage chief Tugusa, Meiliji chief Huluba, and others requested restoration of former lands, presented local goods, and it was granted.

entries.zh: 三月辛酉，燕國王延禧生子。
entries.en: On xinyou day of the third month Prince of Yan Yanxi had a son.
entries.literal: Third month, on xinyou day Prince of Yan Yanxi had a son.

entries.zh: 癸亥，賜名撻魯。
entries.en: On guihai day the name Talu was bestowed.
entries.literal: On guihai day the name Talu was bestowed.

entries.zh: 妃之父長哥遷左監門衛上將軍，仍賜官屬錢。
entries.en: The consort's father Changge was transferred Left Defender of the Gate grand general and still bestowed money for his staff.
entries.literal: The consort's father Changge was transferred Left Defender of the Gate grand general and still bestowed money for his staff.

entries.zh: 是春，高麗王昱薨。
entries.en: That spring Goryeo king Yun died.
entries.literal: That spring Goryeo king Yun died.

entries.zh: 夏四月，南府宰相趙廷睦出知興中府事，參知政事牛溫舒兼同知樞密院事。
entries.en: In the fourth summer month Southern Court chancellor Zhao Tingmu went out to administer Xingzhong Prefecture; associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu also associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, Southern Court chancellor Zhao Tingmu went out to administer Xingzhong Prefecture; associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu also associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

entries.zh: 五月癸亥，斡特剌討阻卜，破之。
entries.en: On guihai day of the fifth month Wotela attacked Zubu and defeated them.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on guihai day Wotela attacked Zubu and defeated them.

entries.zh: 己巳，駐蹕撒裏乃。
entries.en: On jisi day the court halted at Salinai.
entries.literal: On jisi day halted at Salinai.

entries.zh: 六月甲申，詔罷諸路馳驲貢新。
entries.en: On jiashen day of the sixth month an edict abolished presenting fresh goods by relay post in all routes.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jiashen day, edict abolished presenting fresh goods by relay post in all routes.

entries.zh: 丙戌，詔每冬駐蹕之所，宰相以下構宅，毋役其民。
entries.en: On bingxu day an edict ordered that wherever the court halted each winter, chancellors and below should build residences without levying corvée on the people.
entries.literal: On bingxu day, edict ordered that wherever the court halted each winter, chancellors and below should build residences without levying corvée on the people.

entries.zh: 辛丑丑，夏人來告宋城要地，遣使之宋，諭與夏和。
entries.en: On xinchou day Xia people came to report that Song had seized strategic places; envoys were sent to Song to advise harmony with Xia.
entries.literal: On xinchou day Xia people came to report that Song had seized strategic places; envoys were sent to Song to advise harmony with Xia.

entries.zh: 庚戌，以契丹行宮都部署耶律吾也為南院大王。
entries.en: On gengxu day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Wuye was made Southern Court great king.
entries.literal: On gengxu day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Wuye was made Southern Court great king.

entries.zh: 秋七月壬子朔，獵黑嶺。
entries.en: On the renzi new moon of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Black Ridge.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renzi new moon, hunted at Black Ridge.

entries.zh: 八月己亥，蒲盧毛朵部長率其民來歸。
entries.en: On jihai day of the eighth month Puloumaoduo tribal chief led his people to submit.
entries.literal: Eighth month, on jihai day Puloumaoduo tribal chief led his people to submit.

entries.zh: 乙巳，彗星見西方。
entries.en: On yisi day a comet appeared in the west.
entries.literal: On yisi day a comet appeared in the west.

entries.zh: 九月壬申，駐蹕藕絲淀。
entries.en: On renshen day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Ninth month, on renshen day halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 丁丑，以武定軍節度使梁援為漢人行宮都部署。
entries.en: On dingchou day Wuding Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made Han mobile palace deployment director.
entries.literal: On dingchou day Wuding Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made Han mobile palace deployment director.

entries.zh: 戊寅，斡特剌奏討梅裏急捷。
entries.en: On wuyin day Wotela memorialized victory over Meiliji.
entries.literal: On wuyin day Wotela memorialized victory over Meiliji.

entries.zh: 己卯，五國部長來貢。
entries.en: On jimao day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
entries.literal: On jimao day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

entries.zh: 冬十月庚戌，以西北路招討使斡特剌為南府宰相。
entries.en: On gengxu day of the tenth winter month Northwest Route pacification commissioner Wotela was made Southern Court chancellor.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengxu day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Wotela was made Southern Court chancellor.

entries.zh: 十一月乙卯，蒲盧毛朵部來貢。
entries.en: On yimao day of the eleventh month Puloumaoduo tribe came with tribute.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on yimao day Puloumaoduo tribe came with tribute.

entries.zh: 戊午，以安車召醫巫閭山僧誌達。
entries.en: On wuwu day a carriage was sent to summon Yiwulü Mountain monk Zhida.
entries.literal: On wuwu day a carriage was sent to summon Yiwulü Mountain monk Zhida.

entries.zh: 己未，以中京留守韓資讓知樞密院事，同知南院樞密使事蕭藥師奴知右夷離畢。
entries.en: On jiwei day Central Capital regent Han Zirang was made administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Yaoshinu administrator of Right yilibi affairs.
entries.literal: On jiwei day Central Capital regent Han Zirang was made administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Yaoshinu administrator of Right yilibi affairs.

entries.zh: 丁丑，西北路統軍司奏討梅裏急捷。
entries.en: On dingchou day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Meiliji.
entries.literal: On dingchou day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Meiliji.

entries.zh: 四年春正月壬子，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: In the fourth year, on renzi day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on renzi day, went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 己巳，徙阻卜等貧民於山前。
entries.en: On jisi day poor people among Zubu and others were moved south of the mountains.
entries.literal: On jisi day poor people among Zubu and others were moved south of the mountains.

entries.zh: 辛未，宋遣使來饋錦綺。
entries.en: On xinwei day Song sent envoys presenting brocade and silk.
entries.literal: On xinwei day Song dispatched envoys presenting brocade and silk.

entries.zh: 三月庚午，幸春州。
entries.en: On gengwu day of the third month the court visited Chun Prefecture.
entries.literal: Third month, on gengwu day visited Chun Prefecture.

entries.zh: 丙子，有司奏黃河清。
entries.en: On bingzi day relevant offices memorialized that the Yellow River had cleared.
entries.literal: On bingzi day relevant offices memorialized that the Yellow River had cleared.

entries.zh: 夏四月辛丑，以雨，罷獵。
entries.en: On xinchou day of the fourth summer month, because of rain, hunting was stopped.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinchou day, because of rain, hunting was stopped.

entries.zh: 五月癸酉，那也奏北邊捷。
entries.en: On guiyou day of the fifth month Na Ye memorialized victory on the northern border.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on guiyou day Na Ye memorialized victory on the northern border.

entries.zh: 甲戌，駐蹕撒裏乃。
entries.en: On jiaxu day the court halted at Salinai.
entries.literal: On jiaxu day halted at Salinai.

entries.zh: 六月戊寅朔，夏國為宋所攻，遣使求援。
entries.en: On the wuyin new moon of the sixth month Xia State was attacked by Song and sent envoys seeking aid.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on wuyin new moon, Xia State was attacked by Song and dispatched envoys seeking aid.

entries.zh: 丁亥，以遼興軍節度使涅裏為惕隱，前知惕隱事耶律郭三為南京統軍使。
entries.en: On dinghai day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Nieli was made tiyin; former acting tiyin Yelü Guosan Nanjing supreme commander.
entries.literal: On dinghai day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Nieli was made tiyin; former acting tiyin Yelü Guosan Nanjing supreme commander.

entries.zh: 甲午，以參知政事牛溫舒兼知中京留守事。
entries.en: On jiawu day associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu also administered Central Capital regency.
entries.literal: On jiawu day associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu also administered Central Capital regency.

entries.zh: 秋七月戊午，如黑嶺。
entries.en: On wuwu day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Black Ridge.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuwu day, went to Black Ridge.

entries.zh: 冬十月乙亥朔，駐蹕藕絲淀。
entries.en: On the yihai new moon of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yihai new moon, halted at Ousi Marsh.

entries.zh: 己卯，以南府宰相斡特剌兼契丹行宮都部署，以傅導燕國王延禧。
entries.en: On jimao day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Khitan mobile palace deployment director, to tutor Prince of Yan Yanxi.
entries.literal: On jimao day Southern Court chancellor Wotela also Khitan mobile palace deployment director, to tutor Prince of Yan Yanxi.

entries.zh: 十一月乙巳朔，知右夷離畢事蕭藥師奴、樞密直學士耶律儼使宋，諷與夏和。
entries.en: On the yisi new moon of the eleventh month administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu and privy council academician Yelü Yan were sent to Song to advise harmony with Xia.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on yisi new moon, administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu and privy council academician Yelü Yan were sent to Song to advise harmony with Xia.

entries.zh: 辛酉，夏復遣使求援。
entries.en: On xinyou day Xia again sent envoys seeking aid.
entries.literal: On xinyou day Xia again dispatched envoys seeking aid.

entries.zh: 十二月壬辰，為燕國王延禧行再生禮，曲赦三百里內囚。
entries.en: On renchen day of the twelfth month the rebirth ritual was performed for Prince of Yan Yanxi; partial amnesty for prisoners within three hundred li.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on renchen day performed the rebirth ritual for Prince of Yan Yanxi; partial amnesty for prisoners within three hundred li.

entries.zh: 五年春正月乙巳，如魚兒濼。
entries.en: In the fifth year, on yisi day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
entries.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on yisi day, went to Yuer Marsh.

entries.zh: 己酉，詔夏國王李乾順伐拔思母等部。
entries.en: On jiyou day an edict ordered Xia State king Li Qianshun to attack Basimu and other tribes.
entries.literal: On jiyou day, edict ordered Xia State king Li Qianshun to attack Basimu and other tribes.

entries.zh: 夏五月壬戌，藥師奴等使宋回，奏宋罷兵。
entries.en: On renxu day of the fifth summer month Yaoshinu and others returned from Song and memorialized that Song had ceased hostilities.
entries.literal: Summer, fifth month, on renxu day Yaoshinu and others returned from Song and memorialized that Song had ceased hostilities.

entries.zh: 癸亥，謁乾陵。
entries.en: On guihai day the court visited Qian Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On guihai day visited Qian Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 戊辰，以南府宰相斡特剌兼西北路招討使，禁軍都統。
entries.en: On wuchen day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and forbidden-army supreme commander.
entries.literal: On wuchen day Southern Court chancellor Wotela also Northwest Route pacification commissioner and forbidden-army supreme commander.

entries.zh: 己巳，駐蹕沿柳湖。
entries.en: On jisi day the court halted at Yanliu Lake.
entries.literal: On jisi day halted at Yanliu Lake.

entries.zh: 六月甲申，以奚六部大王回離保為契丹行宮都部署，知右夷離畢事蕭藥師奴南面林牙，兼知契丹行宮都部署事。
entries.en: On jiashen day of the sixth month Xi Six Divisions great king Huilibao was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu Southern Court palace academician and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace affairs.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on jiashen day Xi Six Divisions great king Huilibao was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu Southern Court palace academician and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace affairs.

entries.zh: 乙未，五國部長來朝。
entries.en: On yiwei day chieftains of the Five States came to court.
entries.literal: On yiwei day chieftains of the Five States came to court.

entries.zh: 戊戌，阻卜來貢。
entries.en: On wuxu day Zubu came with tribute.
entries.literal: On wuxu day Zubu came with tribute.

entries.zh: 己亥，以興聖宮使耶律郝家奴為右夷離畢。
entries.en: On jihai day commissioner of Xing Sheng Palace Yelü Haojianu was made Right yilibi.
entries.literal: On jihai day commissioner of Xing Sheng Palace Yelü Haojianu was made Right yilibi.

entries.zh: 秋七月壬寅朔，惕德長禿的等來貢。
entries.en: On the renyin new moon of the seventh autumn month Tiede chief Tude and others came with tribute.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renyin new moon, Tiede chief Tude and others came with tribute.

entries.zh: 辛亥，如大牢古山。
entries.en: On xinhai day the court went to Dalaogu Mountain.
entries.literal: On xinhai day went to Dalaogu Mountain.

entries.zh: 閏九月丙子，駐蹕獨盧金。
entries.en: On bingzi day of the intercalary ninth month the court halted at Dulu Marsh.
entries.literal: Intercalary ninth month, on bingzi day halted at Dulu Marsh.

entries.zh: 冬十月己亥朔，高麗王颙遣使乞封冊。
entries.en: On the jihai new moon of the tenth winter month Goryeo king Yong sent envoys requesting investiture.
entries.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jihai new moon, Goryeo king Yong dispatched envoys requesting investiture.

entries.zh: 丁巳，斡特剌奏討耶睹刮捷。
entries.en: On dingsi day Wotela memorialized victory over Yedigua.
entries.literal: On dingsi day Wotela memorialized victory over Yedigua.

entries.zh: 丙寅，以同知南京留守事蕭得裏底知北院樞密使事。
entries.en: On bingyin day associate regent of Nanjing Xiao Delidi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On bingyin day associate regent of Nanjing Xiao Delidi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 丁卯，宋遣郭知章、曹平來聘。
entries.en: On dingmao day Song sent Guo Zhizhang and Cao Ping on a friendly visit.
entries.literal: On dingmao day Song dispatched Guo Zhizhang and Cao Ping on a friendly visit.

entries.zh: 戌辰，振遼州饑，仍免租賦一年。
entries.en: On wuchen day Liaozhou famine was relieved; rent and tax were also remitted for one year.
entries.literal: On wuchen day Liaozhou famine was relieved; rent and tax were also remitted for one year.

entries.zh: 十一月甲戌，振南、北二糺。
entries.en: On jiaxu day of the eleventh month Southern and Northern Two Jiu were relieved.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu day Southern and Northern Two Jiu were relieved.

entries.zh: 乙酉，夏國以宋罷兵，遣使來謝。
entries.en: On yiyou day, because Song had ceased hostilities, Xia State sent envoys to give thanks.
entries.literal: On yiyou day, because Song had ceased hostilities, Xia State dispatched envoys to give thanks.

entries.zh: 十二月甲子，以參知政事趙孝嚴為漢人行宮都部署，漢人行宮都部署梁援為遼興軍節度使。
entries.en: On jiazi day of the twelfth month associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Han mobile palace deployment director Liang Yuan was made Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, on jiazi day associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Han mobile palace deployment director Liang Yuan was made Liaoxing Army military commissioner.

entries.zh: 天祚皇帝，諱延禧，字延甯，小字阿果。
entries.en: Emperor Tianzuo, taboo name Yanxi, courtesy name Yanning, childhood name Aguo.
entries.literal: Emperor Tianzuo, taboo name Yanxi, courtesy name Yanning, childhood name Aguo.

entries.zh: 道宗之孫，父順宗大孝順聖皇帝，母貞順皇后蕭氏。
entries.en: He was Daozong's grandson; his father was Emperor Shunzong, the Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor; his mother was Empress Zhenshun of the Xiao clan.
entries.literal: He was Daozong's grandson; his father was Emperor Shunzong, the Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor; his mother was Empress Zhenshun of the Xiao clan.

entries.zh: 大康元年生。
entries.en: He was born in the first year of Dakang.
entries.literal: He was born in the first year of Dakang.

entries.zh: 六歲封梁王，加守太尉，兼中書令。
entries.en: At age six he was enfeoffed Prince of Liang, promoted Defender of the State grand mentor, and made concurrently Director of the Secretariat.
entries.literal: At age six he was enfeoffed Prince of Liang, promoted Defender of the State grand mentor, and made concurrently Director of the Secretariat.

entries.zh: 後三年，進封燕國王。
entries.en: Three years later he was advanced to Prince of Yan.
entries.literal: Three years later he was advanced to Prince of Yan.

entries.zh: 大安七年，總北南院樞密使事，加尚書令，為天下兵馬大元帥。
entries.en: In the seventh year of Da'an he oversaw Northern and Southern Privy Council affairs, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and became supreme commander of all armies and horses under Heaven.
entries.literal: In the seventh year of Da'an he oversaw Northern and Southern Privy Council affairs, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and became supreme commander of all armies and horses under Heaven.

entries.zh: 壽隆七年[1]正月甲戌，道宗崩，奉遺詔即皇帝位於柩前。
entries.en: In the seventh year of Shoulong [1], on jiaxu day of the first month Daozong died; by testamentary edict Tianzuo assumed the throne before the coffin.
entries.literal: In the seventh year of Shoulong [1], first month, on jiaxu day, Daozong died; by testamentary edict he assumed the imperial dignity before the coffin.

entries.zh: 群臣上尊號曰天祚皇帝。
entries.en: The hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Tianzuo.
entries.literal: The hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Tianzuo.

entries.zh: 六月庚寅朔，如慶州。
entries.en: On the gengyin new moon of the sixth month the court went to Qing Prefecture.
entries.literal: Sixth month, on gengyin new moon, went to Qing Prefecture.

entries.zh: 甲午，宋遣王潛等來弔祭。
entries.en: On jiawu day Song sent Wang Qian and others to offer mourning sacrifices.
entries.literal: On jiawu day Song dispatched Wang Qian and others to offer mourning sacrifices.

entries.zh: 丙申，高麗、夏國各遣使慰奠。
entries.en: On bingshen day Goryeo and Xia State each sent envoys to offer condolences.
entries.literal: On bingshen day Goryeo and Xia State each dispatched envoys to offer condolences.

entries.zh: 戊戌，以南府宰相斡特剌兼南院樞密使。
entries.en: On wuxu day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Southern Court privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On wuxu day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Southern Court privy commissioner.

entries.zh: 庚子，追懿德皇后為宣懿皇后。
entries.en: On gengzi day Empress Yide was posthumously titled Empress Xuanyi.
entries.literal: On gengzi day Virtuous Consort was posthumously titled Empress Xuanyi.

entries.zh: 壬寅，以宋魏國王和魯斡為天下兵馬大元帥。
entries.en: On renyin day the Prince of Song and Wei, Heluwo, was made supreme commander of all armies and horses under heaven.
entries.literal: On renyin day Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made supreme commander of all armies and horses under heaven.

entries.zh: 乙巳，以北平郡王淳進封鄭王。
entries.en: On yisi day Prince of Beiping Commandery Chun was advanced to Prince of Zheng.
entries.literal: On yisi day Prince of Beiping Commandery Chun was advanced to Prince of Zheng.

entries.zh: 丁未，北院樞密使耶律阿思加於越。
entries.en: On dingwei day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Asi was promoted yuyue.
entries.literal: On dingwei day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Asi was promoted yuyue.

entries.zh: 辛亥，葬仁聖大孝文皇帝、宣懿皇后于慶陵。
entries.en: On xinhai day the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi were buried at Qing Mausoleum.
entries.literal: On xinhai day the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi were buried at Qing Mausoleum.

entries.zh: 十一月丙申，文武百官加上尊號曰惠文智武聖孝天祚皇帝，大赦，以宋魏國王和魯斡為皇太叔，梁王撻魯進封燕國王，鄭王淳為東京留守，進封越國王，百官各進一階。
entries.en: On bingshen day of the eleventh month civil and military officials added the honorific title Benevolent, Cultured, Wise, Martial, Sagely, Filial Emperor Tianzuo; a general amnesty was proclaimed; Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made Imperial Grand Uncle; Prince of Liang Taluo was advanced to Prince of Yan; Prince of Zheng Chun was made Eastern Capital intendant and advanced to Prince of Yue; all officials were promoted one grade.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen day civil and military officials added the honorific title Benevolent, Cultured, Wise, Martial, Sagely, Filial Emperor Tianzuo; general amnesty; Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made Imperial Grand Uncle; Prince of Liang Taluo was advanced to Prince of Yan; Prince of Zheng Chun was made Eastern Capital intendant and advanced to Prince of Yue; all officials were promoted one grade.

entries.zh: 丁酉，以惕隱耶律何魯掃古為南院大王。
entries.en: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Heluosaogu was made Southern Court great king.
entries.literal: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Heluosaogu was made Southern Court great king.

entries.zh: 戊戌，以受尊號，告廟。
entries.en: On wuxu day, because of receiving the honorific title, announcement was made at the ancestral temple.
entries.literal: On wuxu day, because of receiving the honorific title, announcement was made at the ancestral temple.

entries.zh: 乙巳，謁太祖廟，追尊太祖之高祖曰昭烈皇帝，廟號肅祖，妣曰昭烈皇后；
entries.en: On yisi day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.
entries.literal: On yisi day paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.

entries.zh: 曾祖曰莊敬皇帝，廟號懿祖，妣曰莊敬皇后。
entries.en: The great-grandfather was titled Emperor Zhuangjing with temple name Yizu; his consort was titled Empress Zhuangjing.
entries.literal: Great-grandfather was titled Emperor Zhuangjing with temple name Yizu; his consort was titled Empress Zhuangjing.

entries.zh: 召監修國史耶律儼纂太祖諸帝實錄。
entries.en: Supervisor of compilation of the national history Yelü Yan was summoned to compile Veritable Records of the various emperors from Taizu onward.
entries.literal: Supervisor of compilation of the national history Yelü Yan was summoned to compile Veritable Records of the various emperors from Taizu onward.

entries.zh: 十一月乙未，以謝家奴為南院大王，馬奴為奚六部大王。
entries.en: On yiwei day of the eleventh month Xiejianu was made Southern Court great king; Manu was made great king of Xi Six Divisions.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei day Xiejianu was made Southern Court great king; Manu was made great king of Xi Six Divisions.

entries.zh: 丙申，行柴冊禮。
entries.en: On bingshen day the firewood-bundle rite was performed.
entries.literal: On bingshen day the firewood-bundle rite was performed.

entries.zh: 戊戌，大赦。
entries.en: On wuxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
entries.literal: On wuxu day general amnesty.

entries.zh: 以和魯斡為義和仁聖皇太叔，<六>越國王淳進封魏國王，封皇子敖盧斡為晉王，習泥烈為饒樂郡王。
entries.en: Heluwo was titled Imperial Grand Uncle of Yihe, Benevolent and Sagely; [6] Prince of Yue Chun was advanced to Prince of Wei; imperial son Aoluwo was enfeoffed Prince of Jin; Xini Lie was enfeoffed Prince of Raole Commandery.
entries.literal: Heluwo was titled Imperial Grand Uncle of Yihe, Benevolent and Sagely; [6] Prince of Yue Chun was advanced to Prince of Wei; imperial son Aoluwo was enfeoffed Prince of Jin; Xini Lie was enfeoffed Prince of Raole Commandery.

entries.zh: 己亥，謁太祖廟。
entries.en: On jihai day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple.
entries.literal: On jihai day paid respects at Taizu's temple.

entries.zh: 甲辰，祠木葉山。
entries.en: On jiachen day sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.
entries.literal: On jiachen day sacrificed at Muye Mountain.

entries.zh: 十一月乙卯，幸南京。
entries.en: On yimao day of the eleventh month the court went to Nanjing.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, on yimao day went to Nanjing.

entries.zh: 丁卯，謁太祖廟。
entries.en: On dingmao day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple.
entries.literal: On dingmao day paid respects at Taizu's temple.

entries.zh: 五月癸卯，清暑南崖。
entries.en: On guimao day of the fifth month the court took summer ease at Southern Cliff.
entries.literal: Fifth month, on guimao day took summer ease at Southern Cliff.

entries.zh: 壬子，宋遣曾孝廣、王戩報聘。
entries.en: On renzi day Song sent Zeng Xiaoguang and Wang Jian on a return mission.
entries.literal: On renzi day Song dispatched Zeng Xiaoguang and Wang Jian on a return mission.

entries.zh: 是年，放進士劉楨等九十人。
entries.en: That year advanced scholars Liu Zhen and ninety others were released.
entries.literal: That year advanced scholars Liu Zhen and ninety others were released.

entries.zh: 六年春正月丙寅朔，東京夜有惡少年十餘人，乘酒執刃，垣入留守府，問留守蕭保先所在：「今軍變，請為備。」
entries.en: In the sixth year, on the bingyin new moon of the first spring month, at the Eastern Capital more than ten evil youths at night, drunk, took blades, scaled the wall into the regent's residence, and asked where regent Xiao Baoxian was: "There is a military mutiny; please prepare."
entries.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, on bingyin new moon, at the Eastern Capital evil youths of more than ten at night, drunk, took blades, scaled the wall into the regent's residence, and asked where regent Xiao Baoxian was: "There is a military mutiny; please prepare."

entries.zh: 蕭保先出，刺殺之。
entries.en: Xiao Baoxian came out; they stabbed and killed him.
entries.literal: Xiao Baoxian came out; they stabbed and killed him.

entries.zh: 戶部使大公鼎聞亂，即攝留守事，與副留守高清明集奚、漢兵千人，<五>盡捕其眾，斬之，撫定其民。
entries.en: Household Ministry commissioner Da Gongding heard of the disorder, immediately assumed regent affairs, and with associate regent Gao Qingming gathered a thousand Xi and Han troops; [5] they captured the whole band, beheaded them, and pacified the people.
entries.literal: Household Ministry commissioner Da Gongding heard of the disorder, immediately assumed regent affairs, and with associate regent Gao Qingming gathered a thousand Xi and Han troops; [5] they captured the whole band, beheaded them, and pacified the people.

entries.zh: 東京故渤海地，太祖力戰二十餘年乃得之。
entries.en: The Eastern Capital was formerly Bohai territory; the Founder fought more than twenty years before obtaining it.
entries.literal: The Eastern Capital was formerly Bohai territory; the Founder fought more than twenty years before obtaining it.

entries.zh: 而蕭保先嚴酷，渤海苦之，故有是變。
entries.en: Xiao Baoxian was harsh; the Bohai suffered under him, hence this mutiny.
entries.literal: Xiao Baoxian was harsh; the Bohai suffered under him, hence this mutiny.

entries.zh: 其裨將渤海高永昌僭號，稱隆基元年。
entries.en: His lieutenant Bohai Gao Yongchang usurped title and styled the era Longji first year.
entries.literal: His lieutenant Bohai Gao Yongchang usurped title and styled the era Longji first year.

entries.zh: <六>遣蕭乙薛、高興順招之，不從。
entries.en: [6] Xiao Yixue and Gao Xingshun were sent to induce submission; they did not obey.
entries.literal: [6] Xiao Yixue and Gao Xingshun were sent to induce submission; they did not obey.

entries.zh: 五年春正月，下詔親征，遣僧家奴持書約和，斥阿骨打名。
entries.en: In the fifth year, spring, first month, the court issued an edict ordering a personal campaign and sent the monk Jianianu with a letter to sue for peace, naming Aguda by name in reproach.
entries.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, an edict ordered a personal campaign; the monk Jianianu was sent bearing a letter to sue for peace, naming Aguda by name in reproach.

entries.zh: 阿骨打遣賽剌復書，<一>若歸叛人阿疏，遷黃龍府於別地，然後議之。
entries.en: Aguda sent Saisi with a reply: [1] if the rebel Ashu is returned and Huanglong Prefecture is moved to another site, then matters may be discussed.
entries.literal: Aguda sent Saisi with a reply; [1] if the rebel Ashu is returned and Huanglong Prefecture is moved elsewhere, then matters may be discussed.

entries.zh: 都統耶律斡里朵等與女直兵戰于達魯古城，敗績。
entries.en: Commander-in-chief Yelü Woliduo and others fought Jurchen troops at Daru Ancient City and were defeated.
entries.literal: Commander-in-chief Yelü Woliduo and others fought Jurchen troops at Daru Ancient City and were defeated.

entries.zh: 耶律大石者，世號為西遼。
entries.en: Yelü Dashi — his regime is known as Western Liao (Qara-Khitai).
entries.literal: Yelü Dashi — his age is known as Western Liao.

entries.zh: 大石字重德，太祖八代孫也。
entries.en: Dashi's style was Chongde; he was the eighth-generation grandson of Taizu.
entries.literal: Dashi's style was Chongde; he was the eighth-generation grandson of Taizu.

entries.zh: 通遼、漢字，善騎射，登天慶五年進士第，擢翰林應奉，尋升承旨。
entries.en: He mastered Khitan and Han script, was skilled at riding and archery, in Tianqing year 5 passed the jinshi examination, was selected Hanlin attendant-in-waiting, and soon was promoted Hanlin academician-director.
entries.literal: He mastered Khitan and Han script, was skilled at riding and archery, in Tianqing year 5 passed the jinshi examination, was selected Hanlin attendant-in-waiting, and soon was promoted Hanlin academician-director.

entries.zh: 遼以翰林為林牙，故稱大石林牙。
entries.en: Liao took Hanlin as linya, so he was called Great Stone Linya.
entries.literal: Liao took Hanlin as linya, so he was called Great Stone Linya.

entries.zh: 歷泰、祥二州刺史，遼興軍節度使。
entries.en: He served successively as Tai and Xiang two prefectures' prefect, and Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
entries.literal: He served successively as Tai and Xiang two prefectures' prefect, and Liaoxing Army military commissioner.

entries.zh: 保大二年，金兵日逼，天祚播越，與諸大臣立秦晉王淳為帝。
entries.en: In Baoda year 2, as Jin troops daily pressed, Tianzuo was driven from his capital; with the great ministers he set up King of Qin-Jin Chun as emperor.
entries.literal: Baoda year 2, as Jin troops daily pressed, Tianzuo was driven from his capital; with the great ministers he set up King of Qin-Jin Chun as emperor.

entries.zh: 淳死，立其妻蕭德妃為太后，以守燕。
entries.en: When Chun died he set up his wife Virtuous Consort Xiao as Empress Dowager to guard Yan.
entries.literal: When Chun died he set up his wife Virtuous Consort Xiao as Empress Dowager to guard Yan.

entries.zh: 及金兵至，蕭德妃歸天祚。
entries.en: When Jin troops arrived Virtuous Consort Xiao returned to Tianzuo.
entries.literal: When Jin troops arrived Virtuous Consort Xiao returned to Tianzuo.

entries.zh: 天祚怒誅德妃而責大石曰：「我在，汝何敢立淳？」
entries.en: Tianzuo angrily executed Virtuous Consort Xiao and blamed Dashi, saying, "While I live, how dare you set up Chun?"
entries.literal: Tianzuo angrily executed Virtuous Consort Xiao and blamed Dashi, saying, "While I live, how dare you set up Chun?"

entries.zh: 對曰：「陛下以全國之勢，不能一拒敵，棄國遠遁，使黎民塗炭。
entries.en: He replied, "Your Majesty with the power of the whole state could not repulse the enemy once, abandoned the state and fled far away, making the black-haired people suffer torment.
entries.literal: He replied, "Your Majesty with the power of the whole state could not repulse the enemy once, abandoned the state and fled far away, making the black-haired people suffer torment.

entries.zh: 即立十淳，皆太祖子孫，豈不勝乞命於他人耶？」
entries.en: To set up the ten Chuns — all are Taizu's descendants — is surely better than begging life from others, is it not?"
entries.literal: To set up the ten Chuns — all are Taizu's descendants — is surely better than begging life from others, is it not?"

entries.zh: 上無以答，賜酒食，赦其罪。
entries.en: The emperor had no reply; he granted wine and food and pardoned his crime.
entries.literal: The emperor had no reply; he granted wine and food and pardoned his crime.

entries.zh: 延慶三年，班師東歸，馬行二十日，得善地，遂建都城，號虎思斡耳朶，改延慶為康國元年。
entries.en: In Yanqing year 3, the army returned east; after twenty days' march by horse they found good land, built a capital city styled Husi Ordu, and changed Yanqing to Kangguo year 1.
entries.literal: In the third year of Yanqing, the army returned east; after twenty days' march by horse they found good land, thereupon built a capital city styled Husi Ordu, and changed Yanqing to Kangguo year 1.

entries.zh: 三月，以六院司大王蕭斡里剌為兵馬都元帥，敵剌部前同知樞密院事蕭查剌阿不副之，茶赤剌部禿魯耶律燕山為都部署，護衞耶律鐵哥為都監，率七萬騎東征。
entries.en: In the third month, Six Courts Office great king Xiao Wolila was made commander-in-chief of horse and foot; Dila Tribe former associate privy commissioner Xiao Chala Abu was his deputy; Chachila Tribe Tulul Yelü Yanshan was made chief deployment officer; guard Yelü Tiege was made superintendent; and they led seventy thousand cavalry on an eastern campaign.
entries.literal: Third month, Six Courts Office great king Xiao Wolila was made commander-in-chief of horse and foot; Dila Tribe former associate privy commissioner Xiao Chala Abu was his deputy; Chachila Tribe Tulul Yelü Yanshan was made chief deployment officer; guard Yelü Tiege was made superintendent; they led seventy thousand cavalry on an eastern campaign.

entries.zh: 以青牛白馬祭天，樹旗以誓于眾曰：「我大遼自太祖、太宗艱難而成帝業，其後嗣君耽樂無厭，不恤國政，盜賊蠭起，天下土崩。
entries.en: With green ox and white horse he sacrificed to Heaven, raised a banner, and swore to the masses, saying, "Our Great Liao from Taizu and Taizong with hardship achieved the imperial enterprise; afterward the succeeding lords indulged without satiety, did not care for state affairs, bandits swarmed like bees, and the realm collapsed.
entries.literal: With green ox and white horse he sacrificed to Heaven, raised a banner, and swore to the masses, saying, "Our Great Liao from Taizu and Taizong with hardship achieved the imperial enterprise; afterward the succeeding lords indulged without satiety, did not care for state affairs, bandits swarmed like bees, and the realm collapsed.

entries.zh: 朕率爾眾，遠至朔漠，期復大業，以光中興。
entries.en: I lead you masses, going far to the northern desert, hoping to restore the great enterprise and glorify renewal.
entries.literal: I lead you masses, going far to the northern desert, hoping to restore the great enterprise and glorify renewal.

entries.zh: 此非朕與爾世居之地。」
entries.en: This is not the land where you and I have dwelt for generations."
entries.literal: This is not the land where you and I have dwelt for generations."

entries.zh: 申命元帥斡里剌曰：「今汝其往，信賞必罰，與士卒同甘苦，擇善水草以立營，量敵而進，毋自取禍敗也。」
entries.en: He then ordered Marshal Wolila, saying, "Now you shall go; rewards and punishments must be sure; share sweetness and bitterness with officers and soldiers; choose good grass and water to set camp; measure the enemy and advance — do not bring disaster and defeat upon yourselves."
entries.literal: He then ordered Marshal Wolila, saying, "Now you shall go; rewards and punishments must be sure; share sweetness and bitterness with officers and soldiers; choose good grass and water to set camp; measure the enemy and advance — do not bring disaster and defeat upon yourselves."

entries.zh: 行萬餘里無所得，牛馬多死，勒兵而還。
entries.en: They marched more than ten thousand li without gain; cattle and horses mostly died; he restrained the army and returned.
entries.literal: They marched more than ten thousand li without gain; cattle and horses mostly died; he restrained the army and returned.

entries.zh: 大石曰：「皇天弗順，數也！」
entries.en: Dashi said, "Heaven is not favorable — it is fate!"
entries.literal: Dashi said, "Heaven is not favorable — it is fate!"

entries.zh: 康國十年歿，在位二十年，廟號德宗。
entries.en: In Kangguo year 10 he died, having reigned twenty years; temple name Dezong.
entries.literal: In Kangguo year 10 he died, on the throne twenty years; temple name Dezong.

entries.zh: 贊曰：遼起朔野，兵甲之盛，鼓行扙外，席捲河朔，樹晉植漢，何其壯歟？
entries.en: Appraisal: Liao rose from the northern wilds; arms and armor flourished—drums marched beyond the frontier, swept Hebei, planted Jin and raised Han—how magnificent!
entries.literal: Appraisal: Liao rose from the northern wilds; the flourishing of arms and armor — drums marched beyond the frontier, swept Hebei, planted Jin and set up Han — how magnificent!

entries.zh: 太祖、太宗乘百戰之勢，輯新造之邦，英謀略，可謂遠矣。
entries.en: Taizu and Taizong rode the momentum of a hundred battles and gathered a newly forged state; their heroic stratagem and design may be called far-sighted indeed.
entries.literal: Taizu and Taizong rode the momentum of a hundred battles, gathered a newly made state — heroic stratagem and design may be called far-reaching.

entries.zh: 雖以世宗中才，穆宗殘暴，連遘弑逆，而神器不搖。
entries.en: Though Shizong was middling in talent and Muzong cruel and violent, regicide and treason followed in succession—yet the sacred vessel did not tremble.
entries.literal: Though Shizong was middling talent and Muzong cruel and violent, successive misfortunes of regicide and treason came — yet the sacred vessel did not shake.

entries.zh: 蓋由祖宗威令猶足以震疊其國人也。
entries.en: Surely because the ancestors' awesomeness and commands still sufficed to overawe their own people.
entries.literal: Surely because the ancestors' awesomeness and orders still sufficed to shake and fold their own people.

entries.zh: 明年二月甲午，以青牛白馬祭天地、祖宗，整旅而西。
entries.en: Next year second month, on jiawu day, with green ox and white horse he sacrificed to Heaven, Earth, and ancestors, and arrayed the host westward.
entries.literal: Next year second month, on jiawu day, with green ox and white horse he sacrificed to Heaven, Earth, and ancestors, and arrayed the host westward.

entries.zh: 先遺書回鶻王畢勒哥曰：「昔我太祖皇帝北征，過卜古罕城，[7]即遣使至甘州，詔爾祖烏母主曰：『汝思故國耶，朕即為汝復之；
entries.en: First he sent a letter to Uighur king Bilgege, saying, "Formerly our Taizu Emperor on the northern campaign passed Buguhan city, [7] and at once sent envoys to Ganzhou, proclaiming to your ancestor Wumu, saying, 'If you think of the old state, I shall restore it for you;
entries.literal: First he sent a letter to Uighur king Bilgege, saying, "Formerly our Taizu Emperor on the northern campaign passed Buguhan city, [7] and at once sent envoys to Ganzhou, proclaiming to your ancestor Wumu, saying, 'If you think of the old state, I shall restore it for you;

entries.zh: 汝不能返耶，朕則有之。
entries.en: if you cannot return, then I shall possess it.
entries.literal: if you cannot return, then I shall possess it.

entries.zh: 在朕，猶在爾也。』
entries.en: With me, it is as with you.'
entries.literal: With me, it is as with you.'

entries.zh: 爾祖即表謝，以為遷國於此，十有餘世，軍民皆安土重遷，不能復返矣。
entries.en: Your ancestor thereupon memorialized thanks, thinking to move the state here; for more than ten generations army and people have all been attached to the soil and heavy to move, and could not return.
entries.literal: Your ancestor thereupon memorialized thanks, thinking to move the state here; for more than ten generations army and people have all been attached to the soil and heavy to move, and could not return.

entries.zh: 是與爾國非一日之好也。
entries.en: Thus with your state it is not a single day's goodwill.
entries.literal: Thus with your state it is not a single day's goodwill.

entries.zh: 今我將西至大食，假道爾國，其勿致疑。」
entries.en: Now I shall go west to the Great Food; I borrow passage through your state — do not give rise to suspicion."
entries.literal: Now I shall go west to the Great Food; I borrow passage through your state — do not give rise to suspicion."

entries.zh: 畢勒哥得書，即迎至邸，大宴三日。
entries.en: Bilgege received the letter and at once welcomed him to the lodge and feasted him three days.
entries.literal: Bilgege received the letter and at once welcomed him to the lodge and feasted him three days.

entries.zh: 臨行，獻馬六百，駝百，羊三千，願質子孫為附庸，送至境外。
entries.en: On departure he presented six hundred horses, one hundred camels, and three thousand sheep, wished to pledge sons and grandsons as vassals, and escorted him to the border.
entries.literal: On departure he presented six hundred horses, one hundred camels, and three thousand sheep, wished to pledge sons and grandsons as vassals, and escorted him to the border.

entries.zh: 所過，敵者勝之，降者安之。
entries.en: Where he passed, those who opposed he overcame; those who submitted he pacified.
entries.literal: Where he passed, those who opposed he overcame; those who submitted he pacified.

entries.zh: 兵行萬里，歸者數國，獲駝、馬、牛、羊、財物，不可勝計。
entries.en: The army marched ten thousand li; states that returned numbered several; camels, horses, cattle, sheep, and goods obtained were beyond counting.
entries.literal: The army marched ten thousand li; states that returned numbered several; camels, horses, cattle, sheep, and goods obtained were beyond counting.

entries.zh: 軍勢日盛，銳氣日倍。
entries.en: Army power daily grew; keen spirit daily doubled.
entries.literal: Army power daily grew; keen spirit daily doubled.

entries.zh: 聖宗以來，內修政治，外拓疆宇。
entries.en: From Shengzong onward they cultivated government within and extended territory without.
entries.literal: From Shengzong onward they cultivated government within and extended territory without.

entries.zh: 既而申固鄰好，四境安。
entries.en: Thereafter they renewed firm neighborly goodwill, and the four borders were secure.
entries.literal: Thereafter they renewed solid neighborly goodwill; the four borders were secure.

entries.zh: 維持二百餘年之基，有自來矣。
entries.en: That a foundation of more than two hundred years was maintained had its reasons.
entries.literal: Maintaining a foundation of more than two hundred years had its reasons.

entries.zh: 天祚皇帝四 耶律淳 耶律雅里 耶律大石子:夷列 夷列妹:普速完 夷列次子:直魯古
entries.en: Emperor Tianzuo IV; Yelü Chun; Yelü Yali; Yelü Dashi — Yilie; Yilie's sister Pusuwan; Yilie's second son Zhilugu
entries.literal: Emperor Tianzuo IV; Yelü Chun; Yelü Yali; Yelü Dashi: Yilie; Yilie's sister Pusuwan; Yilie's second son Zhilugu

entries.zh: 遼國之法：天子踐位，置宮衛，分州縣，析部族，設官府，籍戶口，備兵馬。
entries.en: Liao law: when the Son of Heaven assumed the throne, palace guards were established, prefectures and counties divided, tribal divisions analyzed, government offices set up, household registers made, and troops and horses prepared.
entries.literal: Liao state's law: when the Son of Heaven took the throne, palace guards were set up, prefectures and counties divided, tribal divisions analyzed, government offices established, household registers recorded, troops and horses prepared.

entries.zh: 崩則扈從后妃宮帳，以奉陵寢。
entries.en: On death the entourage followed the empress and consorts' palace tents to attend the imperial tomb.
entries.literal: On demise the entourage followed the empress and consorts' palace tents to serve the imperial tomb.

entries.zh: 有調發，則丁壯從戎事，老弱居守。
entries.en: When levies were issued, able-bodied men followed military affairs while the old and weak remained on guard.
entries.literal: When there were levies, able-bodied men followed military affairs and old and weak remained on guard.

entries.zh: 太祖曰弘義宮，應天皇后曰長寧宮，太宗曰永興宮，世宗曰積慶宮。
entries.en: Taizu: Hongyi Palace; Empress Yingtian: Changning Palace; Taizong: Yongxing Palace; Shizong: Jiqing Palace.
entries.literal: Taizu: Hongyi Palace; Empress Yingtian: Changning Palace; Taizong: Yongxing Palace; Shizong: Jiqing Palace.

entries.zh: 穆宗曰延昌宮，景宗曰彰湣宮，承天太后曰崇德宮，聖宗曰興聖宮，興宗曰延慶宮，道宗曰太和宮，天祚曰永昌宮。
entries.en: Muzong: Yanchang Palace; Jingzong: Zhangmin Palace; Empress Chengtian: Chongde Palace; Shengzong: Xingsheng Palace; Xingzong: Yanqing Palace; Daozong: Taihe Palace; Tianzuo: Yongchang Palace.
entries.literal: Muzong: Yanchang Palace; Jingzong: Zhangmin Palace; Empress Chengtian: Chongde Palace; Shengzong: Xingsheng Palace; Xingzong: Yanqing Palace; Daozong: Taihe Palace; Tianzuo: Yongchang Palace.

entries.zh: 又孝文皇太弟有敦睦宮，丞相耶律隆運有文忠王府。
entries.en: Also the Literary Emperor's younger brother had Dunmu Palace, and Chancellor Yelü Longyun had the Wenzhong Princely Residence.
entries.literal: Also the Literary Emperor's imperial younger brother had Dunmu Palace; Chancellor Yelü Longyun had the Wenzhong Princely Residence.

entries.zh: 凡州三十八，縣十，提轄司四十一，石烈二十三，瓦裏七十四，抹裏九十八，得裏二，閘撒十九。
entries.en: In all there were 38 prefectures, 10 counties, 41 supervisory offices, 23 shile, 74 wali, 98 moli, 2 deli, and 19 zhazha.
entries.literal: Totaling 38 prefectures, 10 counties, 41 supervisory offices, 23 shile, 74 wali, 98 moli, 2 deli, and 19 zhazha.

entries.zh: 為正戶八萬，蕃漢轉戶十二萬三千，共二十萬三千戶。
entries.en: There were 80,000 regular households, 123,000 tribal and Han rotational households, 203,000 households in total.
entries.literal: As regular households eighty thousand, tribal and Han rotational households one hundred twenty-three thousand, together two hundred three thousand households.

entries.zh: 算斡魯朵，太祖置。
entries.en: The Suan orudo, established by Taizu.
entries.literal: Suan orudo, Taizu established.

entries.zh: 國語心腹曰『算』，宮曰『斡魯朵』。
entries.en: In the national language "heart and core" is suan; "palace" is orudo.
entries.literal: National language: heart-and-core is called "suan"; palace is called "orudo."

entries.zh: 是為弘義宮。
entries.en: This is the Hongyi Palace.
entries.literal: This was the Hongyi Palace.

entries.zh: 以心腹之衛置，益以渤海俘，錦州戶。
entries.en: It was established from the core bodyguard, augmented by Bohai captives and households of Jin prefecture.
entries.literal: Set up using the core bodyguard, augmented by Bohai captives and households of Jin prefecture.

entries.zh: 其斡魯朵在臨潢府，陵寢在祖州東南二十里。
entries.en: Its orudo was at Linhuang prefecture; the tomb was twenty li southeast of Zu prefecture.
entries.literal: Its orudo was at Linhuang prefecture; the tomb was twenty li southeast of Zu prefecture.

entries.zh: 正戶八千，蕃漢轉戶七千，出騎軍六千。
entries.en: Regular households 8,000; tribal and Han rotational households 7,000; fielding 6,000 cavalry.
entries.literal: Regular households 8,000; tribal and Han rotational households 7,000; producing 6,000 cavalry.

entries.zh: 國阿輦斡魯朵，太宗置。
entries.en: The Guoalian orudo, established by Taizong.
entries.literal: Guoalian orudo, Taizong established.

entries.zh: 收國曰「國阿輦」。
entries.en: In the national language it is called "Guoalian."
entries.literal: National language it is called "Guoalian."

entries.zh: 是為永興宮，初名孤穩斡魯朵。
entries.en: This is the Yongxing Palace, originally named the Guwen orudo.
entries.literal: This was the Yongxing Palace, originally named the Guwen orudo.

entries.zh: 以太祖平渤海俘戶，東京、懷州提轄司及雲州懷仁縣、澤州灤河縣等戶置。
entries.en: It was established from Taizu's Bohai captives, the Tokyo and Huaizhou supervisory offices, and households of Huairen county in Yun prefecture, Luanhe county in Ze prefecture, and the like.
entries.literal: Set up using Taizu's Bohai captives, the Tokyo and Huaizhou supervisory offices, and households of Huairen county in Yun prefecture, Luanhe county in Ze prefecture, and the like.

entries.zh: 其斡魯朵在遊古河側。
entries.en: Its orudo was on the bank of the Yougu River.
entries.literal: Its orudo was on the bank of the Yougu River.

entries.zh: 陵寢在懷州南三十里。
entries.en: The tomb was thirty li south of Huaizhou.
entries.literal: The tomb was thirty li south of Huaizhou.

entries.zh: 正戶三千，番漢轉戶七千，出騎軍五千。
entries.en: Regular households 3,000; tribal and Han rotational households 7,000; fielding 5,000 cavalry.
entries.literal: Regular households 3,000; tribal and Han rotational households 7,000; producing 5,000 cavalry.

entries.zh: 耶魯碗斡魯朵，世宗置。
entries.en: The Yeluwan orudo, established by Shizong.
entries.literal: Yeluwan orudo, Shizong established.

entries.zh: 興盛曰「耶魯碗」。
entries.en: In the national language "flourishing" is "Yeluwan."
entries.literal: National language "flourishing" is "Yeluwan."

entries.zh: 是為積慶宮。
entries.en: This is the Jiqing Palace.
entries.literal: This was the Jiqing Palace.

entries.zh: 以文獻皇帝衛從及太祖俘戶，及雲州提轄司，並高、宜等州戶置。
entries.en: It was established from the Literary Emperor's guard retinue and Taizu's captives, the Yun prefecture supervisory office, and households of Gao, Yi, and other prefectures.
entries.literal: Set up using the Literary Emperor's guard retinue and Taizu's captives, the Yun prefecture supervisory office, and households of Gao, Yi, and other prefectures.

entries.zh: 其斡魯朵在土河東，陵寢在長寧宮北。
entries.en: Its orudo was east of the Tu River; the tomb was north of Changning Palace.
entries.literal: Its orudo was east of the Tu River; the tomb was north of Changning Palace.

entries.zh: 正戶五千，蕃漢轉戶八千，出騎軍八千。
entries.en: Regular households 5,000; tribal and Han rotational households 8,000; fielding 8,000 cavalry.
entries.literal: Regular households 5,000; tribal and Han rotational households 8,000; producing 8,000 cavalry.

entries.zh: 蒲速碗斡魯朵，應天皇太后置。
entries.en: The Pusuwan orudo, established by Empress Yingtian.
entries.literal: Pusuwan orudo, Empress Yingtian established.

entries.zh: 興隆曰「蒲速碗」。
entries.en: In the national language "prosperity" is "Pusuwan."
entries.literal: National language "prosperity" is "Pusuwan."

entries.zh: 是為長寧宮。
entries.en: This is the Changning Palace.
entries.literal: This was the Changning Palace.

entries.zh: 以遼州及海濱縣等戶置。
entries.en: It was established from households of Liaozhou and Haibin county and the like.
entries.literal: Set up using households of Liaozhou and Haibin county and the like.

entries.zh: 其斡魯朵在高州，陵寢在龍化州東一百里。
entries.en: Its orudo was at Gaozhou; the tomb was a hundred li east of Longhua prefecture.
entries.literal: Its orudo was at Gaozhou; the tomb was a hundred li east of Longhua prefecture.

entries.zh: 世宗分屬讓國皇帝宮院。
entries.en: Shizong apportioned part of it to the palace establishment of the Emperor Who Yielded the State.
entries.literal: Shizong apportioned part of it to the palace establishment of the Emperor Who Yielded the State.

entries.zh: 正戶七千，蕃漢轉戶六千，出騎軍五千。
entries.en: Regular households 7,000; tribal and Han rotational households 6,000; fielding 5,000 cavalry.
entries.literal: Regular households 7,000; tribal and Han rotational households 6,000; producing 5,000 cavalry.

entries.zh: 著帳郎君：初，遙輦痕德堇可汗以蒲古只等三族害於越釋魯，籍沒家屬入瓦裏。
entries.en: Registered-household gentlemen: At first, when the three clans of Puguzhi and others killed Yuyue Shilu under Yaolian Hendejin Khan, their families were confiscated and entered the wali.
entries.literal: Registered-household gentlemen: at first, when Yaolian Hendejin Khan had the three clans of Puguzhi and others kill Yuyue Shilu, their families were confiscated and entered the wali.

entries.zh: 淳欽皇后有之，以為著帳郎君。
entries.en: Empress Chunqin took charge of them and made them registered-household gentlemen.
entries.literal: Empress Chunqin took charge of them and made them registered-household gentlemen.

entries.zh: 世宗悉免。
entries.en: Shizong pardoned them all.
entries.literal: Shizong pardoned them all.

entries.zh: 從族、戚、世官犯罪者沒入。
entries.en: Those of collateral clans, affinal kin, and hereditary offices who committed crimes were confiscated and entered.
entries.literal: Those of collateral clans, affinal kin, and hereditary offices who committed crimes were confiscated and entered.

entries.zh: 監母斡魯朵，景宗置。
entries.en: The Jianmu orudo, established by Jingzong.
entries.literal: Jianmu orudo, Jingzong established.

entries.zh: 是為彰憨宮。
entries.en: This is the Zhangmin Palace.
entries.literal: This was the Zhangmin Palace.

entries.zh: 遺留曰「監母。」
entries.en: In the national language "legacy" is "Jianmu."
entries.literal: Legacy is called "Jianmu."

entries.zh: 以章肅皇帝侍衛及武安州戶置。
entries.en: It was established from the Zhangsu Emperor's bodyguard and households of Wu'an prefecture.
entries.literal: Set up using the Zhangsu Emperor's bodyguard and Wu'an prefecture households.

entries.zh: 其斡魯朵在合魯河，陵寢在祖州南。
entries.en: Its orudo was on the Helu River; the tomb was south of Zu prefecture.
